jobs.excerpt: Short-Form Video Editor – Reels & Premium Brand Content | Remote Position Type: Fractional, Remote Function: Creative / Video Production About the Role At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Short-Form Video / Reels Editor to transform raw footage and existing brand assets into polished, premium short-form video content.
jobs.description:
Short-Form Video Editor – Reels & Premium Brand Content | Remote

Position Type: Fractional, Remote
Function: Creative / Video Production

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Short-Form Video / Reels Editor to transform raw footage and existing brand assets into polished, premium short-form video content.

This is an execution-focused creative role, not a social media strategy or management position. You’ll receive footage, assets, and creative direction and be responsible for turning them into refined, brand-aligned Reels and short-form videos.

We’re specifically looking for someone whose work feels premium, intentional, and professionally produced—not the typical influencer or template-driven CapCut aesthetic.

What You’ll Own

Short-Form Video Editing

  • Edit raw footage into polished Reels and short-form videos
  • Create strong pacing and natural visual flow
  • Select the strongest footage and structure edits effectively
  • Trim and sequence clips with attention to rhythm and storytelling
  • Incorporate existing brand assets into finished videos
  • Prepare final videos for social platforms and short-form placements

Premium Visual Execution

  • Maintain a sophisticated, premium visual aesthetic
  • Apply professional color correction and color grading
  • Ensure transitions and effects complement rather than overpower the content
  • Maintain consistency with existing brand direction
  • Produce clean, intentional edits rather than heavily templated social content

Sound & Music

  • Select music that complements the brand and creative direction
  • Edit audio for clean, professional output
  • Balance dialogue, music, and other audio elements appropriately
  • Use sound intentionally to improve pacing and overall production quality

Creative Production

  • Work from provided footage, assets, and creative direction
  • Turn existing materials into finished, publication-ready content
  • Incorporate feedback efficiently
  • Manage multiple edits and revisions as needed
  • Maintain organized project files and final exports
  • Help maintain a backlog of completed short-form creative

Requirements

  • Professional experience editing short-form video, Reels, branded content, or commercial social content
  • Strong portfolio or reel demonstrating high-quality video editing
  • Excellent sense of pacing, rhythm, composition, and storytelling
  • Strong color correction and color-grading skills
  • Strong judgment around music and sound selection
  • Ability to create premium brand content without relying heavily on templates or trendy effects
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Ability to work independently from provided creative direction
  • Comfortable working in a fractional, remote capacity
  • Ability to consistently deliver polished creative on deadline

Preferred Skills

  • Experience producing content for premium, luxury, lifestyle, or design-conscious brands
  • Strong experience with professional video-editing software
  • Experience editing Instagram Reels and other vertical short-form formats
  • Understanding of typography and motion graphics for video
  • Experience working with existing brand systems and creative direction
  • Strong color-grading capabilities
  • Experience selecting and integrating music and sound into branded content

Tools & Technology

Adobe Premiere Pro | DaVinci Resolve | Final Cut Pro | After Effects | Professional Color-Grading Tools | Audio Editing Tools

Equivalent professional editing tools are also welcome.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Have a strong visual eye and can immediately recognize when an edit feels polished
  • Understand the difference between premium branded content and typical influencer-style editing
  • Know when to keep an edit clean rather than adding unnecessary effects
  • Have excellent instincts for pacing, music, and sound
  • Can elevate raw footage through editing and color
  • Work well from an established creative direction
  • Are highly execution-oriented and don’t need to own social strategy
  • Can consistently deliver refined, brand-ready work
  • Take feedback well and turn revisions around efficiently

What a Typical Project Looks Like

You’ll receive raw footage, existing creative assets, and direction for a piece of short-form content.

From there, you’ll select the strongest footage, build the edit, establish pacing, refine the color, select appropriate music and sound, incorporate brand elements, and deliver a polished final video ready to publish.

In short: we provide the footage, assets, and direction; you turn them into premium short-form content.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Quality and polish of finished videos
  • Consistency with the established brand aesthetic
  • Strength of editing and pacing
  • Quality of color grading
  • Effectiveness of music and sound selection
  • Turnaround time
  • Accuracy to creative direction
  • Efficiency incorporating revisions

  • Partner with Automation to auto-remediate the highest-volume alert types.
  • Review every missed or late alert that caused client impact, and close the gap.
  • Ensure CJIS client alerts are handled only by CJIS-cleared, US-based staff.

What you will be doing:

  • Lead, hire, coach, and review NOC staff; manage schedules, utilization, and on-call for 24/7 coverage.
    Lead a multi-shift team, including an overnight manager, and plan 24/7 coverage within CJIS requirements.
  • Track and report SLA performance; keep the backlog current, prioritized, and time-entered in real time.
  • Act as escalation point for client incidents, major infrastructure issues, and escalations from Service Delivery. communicate clearly with clients and internal teams.
  • Take ownership of major incidents, ensuring coordination of resolving parties, effective communication to stakeholders, and post-incident reviews.
  • Proactively manage capacity and ensure the staff requisition process is followed in a timely manner.
  • Present operational performance, trends, and improvement plans to senior management in a clear and concise way.
  • Work autonomously, making independent decisions, prioritizing work, and allocating resources to meet objectives without extensive oversight.
  • Own OS and application patching for servers and workstations, plus network device updates: schedules, maintenance windows, approvals, and exceptions.
  • Run and maintain vulnerability scanning tools so scans cover every managed asset on schedule.
  • Report patch compliance by client, OS, and severity.
  • Run recurring hygiene and lifecycle work: firmware, end-of-life OS and hardware, certificate and warranty expirations.
  • Manage capacity and thresholds so problems are caught before they cause outages.
  • Lead root cause analysis (RCA) on recurring incidents and turn findings into preventive tasks or automation.
  • Ensure monitoring tools and other standard tools are deployed and functioning on every managed endpoint.
  • Track uptime and performance of client network infrastructure.
  • Tune monitoring and alerts so they are accurate and actionable.
  • Coordinate with vendors and carriers to resolve network issues.
  • Write and maintain NOC standards, runbooks, and documentation, aligned with VC3 toolset governance.
  • Keep asset and configuration records accurate in ConnectWise and IT Glue.
  • Partner with the Automation and Toolset teams to automate remediation and remove manual, repetitive work.
Shift Coordination:
  • Coordinate with Service Delivery on overnight resource coverage, scheduling, and staffing to support 24/7 operations.
  • Define and maintain the handoff process between shifts, covering open work, in-progress maintenance, and active escalations.
  • Review overnight activity with Service Delivery and close gaps in coverage or handoff.
Additional Responsibilities:
  • Collaborate across all VC3 departments to maximize overall customer satisfaction.
  • Maintain accurate and up to date documentation through the change management processes.
  • Ensure quality administrative results from your team. For example, real-time time entry, timely submission of timesheets and expenses, frequent and business appropriate customer communications, and overall presentability.
  • Be a leader within the company, attending staff events, participating in meetings, encouraging a positive morale and holding all employees accountable. Set the example to follow for customer service.
  • Attend training & team meetings as required.
  • Additional duties as required
Performance Deliverables:
Each employee’s performance is tracked through both leading and lagging key performance metrics. The Enterprise Service Manager is evaluated on both team and corporate goals. These deliverables are expected to have improvement plan in first 60 days.
  • SLA Performance – SLAs met and reported monthly.
  • Patching – Managed workstations, servers, and network devices maintained in an N-1 state (no more than one release behind current), reportable and trackable.
  • NOC-Generated Ticket Volume – Clear downward trend in duplicate and unactionable tickets.
  • Repeat Incidents – Recurring issues on the same assets on a clear downward trajectory.
  • Tool and Record Coverage – Monitoring tools and other standard tools healthy everywhere; asset records accurate.
  • Utilization: This is a measure of the time spent working on utilized work types, (Billable time on SRs) versus non-utilized work types, (Sick time, Admin time). Vacation, Break, meeting and training time are excluded from this calculation.

The tools you bring:

  • 8+ years relevant technical experience supporting server, network, and endpoint environments, ideally at an MSP.
  • 8+ years relevant management or leadership experience, including hiring, coaching, and performance management, OR completion of VC3 leadership academy and 5+ years of leadership experience at VC3.
  • Proven ownership of a patching program with measurable compliance results.
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring tools (Kaseya, NinjaOne, ConnectWise, N-able or similar), including building policies or automation in them.
  • Experience with budgeting, headcount planning, and vendor cost analysis.
  • Experience in managing and working with the following technologies:
    • Windows Server
    • Cloud environments including Microsoft 365
    • Virtualization (Hyper-V, VMware)
    • Routing and Switching
    • Firewalls
    • Network device firmware
  • Experience running RCA, SLA reporting, and capacity or threshold management.
  • Demonstrable experience in incident, problem, and change management.
  • Comfort working from data: building reports, setting targets, and explaining trends to leadership.
  • Clear written and verbal communication with clients, vendors, carriers, and internal teams.
  • Preferred: ITIL foundation or similar process background.
  • Preferred: Scripting or automation (PowerShell or similar).
  • Preferred: Experience running vulnerability scanning tools.
  • Preferred: Experience with ConnectWise PSA and IT Glue.
  • Preferred: Microsoft, Cisco, or similar industry certifications.

What's in it for you:

  • Flexibility– We’re remote-first, but not remote-only. Some roles include an onsite component, depending on team needs. We aim to give you the flexibility to do your best work, plus company-paid time off to help you thrive in work and in life.
  • Well-being & Support - Caring for our team goes beyond the workday. We offer a range of benefits to support your overall well-being, from mental health and leave support through our Employee and Family Assistance Program, to financial wellness through company-matched 401(k)/RRSP plans. Whether it’s today’s needs or tomorrow’s goals, we’ve got you covered.
  • Grow with Us – Whether you’re just getting started or ready to take the next step, we are committed to investing in your growth. We offer structured development through our Leadership Academy, monthly learning sessions, mentorship programs, learning reimbursements, internal career fairs, job shadowing, and personalized career-pathing to support internal mobility.
  • People-First Culture – We live our values, support each other, and create a space where everyone belongs. We have a common goal of doing work that matters, with autonomy, recognition, and a mission to serve those who serve.
  • Transparent Leadership – From open communication to clear company goals, our leaders are involved, and our managers are here to support your growth every step of the way.
Applicant selected will be subject to a criminal and department of motor vehicles background checks and must meet Criminal Justice Information Systems (CJIS) requirements post-employment
Thank you for your interest in VC3. We appreciate all applications; however, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

jobs.title: Director, Digital Health & Customer Platforms - Remote
jobs.excerpt: At Solventum, we improve lives by helping healthcare professionals do their best work.
jobs.description:
At Solventum, we improve lives by helping healthcare professionals do their best work. Join a team using innovation and insight to make a real impact on the future of healthcare. All roles listed are with Solventum, and we’re committed to protecting your personal information—learn more in our Privacy Policy

Job Description:

Director, Digital Health & Customer Platforms - Remote

3M Health Care is now Solventum

At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.

We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.

The Impact You’ll Make

We are seeking a Director, Digital Health & Customer Platforms to lead the strategy, modernization, development, and evolution of Solventum’s digital ordering, customer, patient, and connected-care capabilities.

This leader will own the Express platform and shape the future of how customers order Solventum solutions, how Solventum connects with healthcare systems and technology partners, and how patients and providers engage with digital capabilities throughout the therapy journey. The role encompasses digital ordering, customer platforms, healthcare interoperability, patient engagement, remote patient monitoring, data-enabled experiences, partner integrations, workflow automation, and emerging digital technologies.

The opportunity extends beyond improving today’s platforms. You will help create simpler, faster, more automated and connected experiences that increasingly integrate with the systems and workflows customers, providers, and patients already use. You will lead the development organization responsible for delivering these capabilities and translate business needs into technology roadmaps, development priorities, budgets, and investment decisions.

Our vision is to meet customers, providers, and patients where they are, whether through Express, integrated hospital workflows, EHR/EMR ecosystems, partner technologies, patient-facing applications, remote patient monitoring, or future connected digital experiences.


How you will make an impact

  • Set the digital platform strategy: Own the multiyear vision, roadmap, and investment priorities for Express and the broader portfolio of digital ordering, customer platform, patient engagement, remote patient monitoring, interoperability, and connected-care capabilities.
  • Transform the customer experience: Simplify complex ordering and service processes, reduce duplicate entry and administrative burden, and create intuitive digital experiences for customers across acute, post-acute, and home-care settings. Identify opportunities to automate workflows, eliminate repetitive work, and improve the overall experience of doing business with Solventum.
  • Advance patient engagement and remote patient monitoring: Lead digital capabilities that support patients throughout the therapy journey, including patient-facing applications, remote patient monitoring, patient communication and engagement, therapy support, and digitally enabled interactions between patients and care teams.
  • Connect with clinical workflows: Advance integration with hospital systems, EHR/EMR platforms, interoperability networks, and healthcare technology ecosystems, enabling ordering, documentation, therapy management, and other interactions to increasingly occur within customers’ existing clinical and administrative workflows.
  • Lead healthcare interoperability and partner integrations: Establish the strategy for APIs, integrations, healthcare data exchange, and technology partnerships that connect Solventum solutions with health systems, external platforms, and the broader healthcare ecosystem.
  • Develop data-enabled capabilities: Establish how customer, ordering, patient, therapy, device, and partner data can be used responsibly to improve workflows, experiences, operational performance, decision-making, and future digital solutions.
  • Navigate the reimbursement landscape: Maintain a strong understanding of healthcare reimbursement, payer requirements, DME workflows, documentation requirements, revenue-cycle dependencies, and evolving reimbursement models. Ensure digital solutions support clinical and customer workflows while enabling the documentation and operational requirements necessary for reimbursement.
  • Shape the technology strategy: Maintain a forward-looking understanding of the healthcare technology landscape, including digital health, EHR/EMR platforms, interoperability, remote monitoring, patient engagement, AI, automation, data platforms, and emerging technologies. Evaluate build, buy, and partner opportunities and translate changes in the technology landscape into actionable business strategies.
  • Lead product and software development: Lead and develop the teams responsible for delivering customer and patient digital capabilities. Translate business strategy and customer needs into clear product requirements, development priorities, and technology roadmaps while balancing speed, quality, regulatory requirements, cybersecurity, technical sustainability, and business value.
  • Prioritize business needs and manage investment: Establish portfolio priorities across business units and stakeholders and translate those needs into development roadmaps, budgets, resource allocation, and investment decisions. Make trade-offs based on customer and patient impact, strategic value, business benefit, development capacity, technical complexity, regulatory requirements, and available funding.
  • Accelerate automation: Apply workflow automation, intelligent decisioning, APIs, data, and AI to reduce manual processing, improve speed and accuracy, eliminate repetitive work, and enable greater straight-through processing.
  • Create connected experiences across the continuum of care: Connect digital ordering, patient engagement, remote monitoring, interoperability, data, and other digital services to support the patient and customer journey from hospital initiation and ordering through discharge, home therapy, monitoring, service, documentation, and ongoing therapy management.
  • Drive measurable outcomes: Establish and manage KPIs spanning order cycle time, customer effort, patient engagement, digital adoption, automation, interoperability, platform reliability, operational efficiency, development performance, and overall business impact.
  • Lead across the enterprise: Partner across technology, R&D, operations, commercial, marketing, clinical, customer service, regulatory, privacy, cybersecurity, reimbursement, finance, and external technology partners to translate business priorities into an integrated digital roadmap.
  • Build a high-performing team: Lead and develop digital product, platform, integration, and software development talent while creating clear accountability for customer, patient, technology, and business outcomes. Establish an operating model that connects strategy, product ownership, development, implementation, lifecycle management, and continuous improvement.

Your Skills and Expertise

To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:


  • Bachelor’s degree AND 7+ years of experience in digital product management, healthcare technology, digital health, digital commerce/ordering, customer platforms, connected care, interoperability, or enterprise digital transformation.

AND


In addition to the above requirements, the following are also required:

  • Experience leading a significant digital product, platform, development organization, or technology portfolio.
  • Modernizes business-critical healthcare workflows and develops or manages patient-facing digital solutions, including patient engagement, remote patient monitoring, connected devices, and digitally enabled therapy management, while meeting operational and regulatory requirements.
  • Applies knowledge of digital product management, platform strategy, software development, APIs and integrations, interoperability, automation, data, AI, healthcare reimbursement, payer requirements, DME fulfillment, and revenue-cycle processes.
  • Develops and manages multiyear technology and product roadmaps, budgets, investment priorities, development capacity, and portfolio trade-offs, and evaluates technologies, vendors, partnerships, and build-versus-buy options.
  • Leads multidisciplinary and cross-functional teams to translate customer, patient, clinical, commercial, and operational requirements into technology priorities, development plans, investment decisions, and measurable outcomes.

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

  • Masters degree from an accredited institution
  • Experience in MedTech, healthcare technology, digital health, healthcare services, DME, or another regulated industry.
  • Experience with hospital clinical and administrative workflows and EHR/EMR ecosystems.
  • Experience with healthcare interoperability, healthcare data exchange, APIs, digital ordering, partner integrations, and connected-care workflows.
  • Experience with remote patient monitoring, connected therapy, patient engagement platforms, patient-facing applications, or digitally enabled therapy management.
  • Experience with reimbursement, payer, DME, documentation, and revenue-cycle workflows.
  • Experience leading or partnering directly with software development and technical teams, including prioritizing development capacity against business requirements and available funding.
  • Experience applying automation, intelligent decisioning, data, or AI to complex operational and healthcare processes.
  • Experience evaluating and establishing strategic technology partnerships to extend internal capabilities and accelerate business strategy.

What Success Looks Like

Success is bigger than adding features to a platform. It is creating a connected digital ecosystem that makes it easier for customers to do business with Solventum, integrates Solventum into the healthcare workflows where care is delivered, supports patients throughout their therapy journey, and connects ordering, interoperability, data, patient engagement, remote patient monitoring, and digital services into a cohesive experience.

Success also means ensuring that business priorities drive technology investments, that development resources and budgets are focused on the highest-value opportunities, and that Solventum continues to evolve as healthcare technology, reimbursement models, interoperability, customer expectations, and patient needs change.

Ultimately, it is creating the simplest, fastest, and most connected experience for customers, providers, partners, and patients, whether that experience happens in Express, within a hospital or EHR workflow, through an integrated technology partner, through a patient-facing application or remote monitoring experience, or through the next generation of connected digital capabilities.


Work location: Remote - USA

Travel: May include up to 10% domestic/international

Relocation Assistance: May be authorized

Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).

Supporting Your Well-being 

Solventum offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, Solventum regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope. 

Responsibilities of this position include that corporate policies, procedures and security standards are complied with while performing assigned duties.

Solventum is committed to maintaining the highest standards of integrity and professionalism in our recruitment process. Applicants must remain alert to fraudulent job postings and recruitment schemes that falsely claim to represent Solventum and seek to exploit job seekers.

Please note that all email communications from Solventum regarding job opportunities with the company will be from an email with a domain of @solventum.com. Be wary of unsolicited emails or messages regarding Solventum job opportunities from emails with other email domains.

Please note, Solventum does not expect candidates in this position to perform work in the unincorporated areas of Los Angeles County.Solventum is an equal opportunity employer. Solventum will not discriminate against any applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

jobs.excerpt: Join a team that shares your calling At MultiCare, you’re more than just a job title — you’re part of a team built on trust that cares for each other, our patients and our communities.
jobs.description:
Join a team that shares your calling

At MultiCare, you’re more than just a job title — you’re part of a team built on trust that cares for each other, our patients and our communities. Belonging here means living our mission and values every day. If your purpose and passions align with ours, you’ll find a place to grow, do meaningful work and build a career you love in a community that feels like home.

FTE: 1.0, Shift: Day, Schedule: Day

Position Summary

The Enterprise Pricing Architect leads the development, maintenance, and optimization of enterprise pricing strategies for $20B+ of hospital and professional services gross revenue. This role analyzes charge structures, reimbursement methodologies, and market competitiveness to advance organizational financial objectives. By collaborating closely with senior Revenue Integrity, Payer Contracting, Finance, and Operational leadership, the Architect ensures pricing decisions optimize reimbursement and support strategic objectives. The Architect also ensures that system algorithms and fee schedules are accurately configured, and regulatory compliance is maintained. The ideal candidate combines advanced analytical skills with strong business acumen and the ability to translate complex financial data into actionable recommendations for executive audiences.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop, maintain, and implement a comprehensive pricing strategy for hospital and professional services that aligns with organizational goals, industry benchmarks, and payer reimbursement methodologies. Lead annual pricing reviews, recurring rate updates, and charge structure evaluations, ensuring pricing decisions support financial sustainability, competitive market positioning, and margin integrity.
  • Utilizing SQL, Epic Clarity, and advanced Excel techniques, build complex analytical models to extract, analyze, and interpret gross and net revenue impacts on pricing, factoring in specific payer reimbursement rates, pricing elasticity, competitor pricing, and cost, as necessary.
  • Conduct benchmarking using state databases, commercial pricing tools, and peer comparisons to evaluate market competitiveness; identify pricing outliers, inconsistencies, or opportunities for strategic adjustment; and recommend pricing refinements that balance competitiveness, reimbursement, and patient affordability.
  • Develop executive-level reports for each business unit to guide strategic decision-making and partner with Finance teams to incorporate future price changes into the budgeting process.
  • Support compliance with CMS and state-level price transparency requirements by provisioning data and overseeing pricing data accuracy for public-facing tools; collaborate with internal and external audit teams; and monitor regulatory changes impacting pricing, reimbursement, and charge strategy.
  • Collaborate with clinical and operational stakeholders on new service evaluations, program expansions, and budget variance assessments.
  • Partner with Revenue Integrity to ensure Epic fee schedules and algorithms result in expected pricing, auditing performance and facilitating changes as needed.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare or Business Administration required, with a concentration in accounting, finance or other related field highly preferred.
  • Minimum five (5) years of experience in healthcare financial analysis, revenue integrity, pricing, reimbursement, or related analytical roles in a healthcare setting required.
  • Hands-on experience with hospital/physician pricing, CDM management, or reimbursement modeling strongly preferred.
  • Systems experience and proficiency with Epic, SQL, Microsoft Outlook, PowerPoint, Word, and advanced Excel techniques.

Why MultiCare?

Rooted in the local community

Partnering with patients, families and neighbors across the Pacific Northwest for more than 140 years.

Growth and education

Competitive tuition assistance, award-winning residencies, fellowships and career development to invest in you.

Well-being and support

Generous PTO, Code Lavender and Employee Assistance Programs to help you maintain balance and feel cared in your work and life.

Living our values

Respect, integrity, kindness and collaboration guide how we care for patients, communities and each other.

Belonging for all

Resource Groups and outreach programs help ensure every team member feels safe, seen, heard and valued.

Pacific Northwest lifestyle

Work and live where natural beauty, adventure and strong community connections are part of everyday life.

Pay and Benefit Expectations

We provide a comprehensive benefits package, including competitive salary, medical, dental and retirement benefits and paid time off. As required by various pay transparency laws, we share a competitive range of compensation for candidates hired into each position. The pay scale is $101,545.60 - $146,140.80 USD. However, pay is influenced by factors specific to applicants, including but not limited to: skill set, level of experience, and certification(s) and/or education. If this position is associated with a union contract, pay will be reflective of the appropriate step on the pay scale to which the applicant’s years of experience align.

jobs.description:
Company Overview

Docusign brings agreements to life. More than 1.8 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using the Docusign AI-native IAM platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

What you'll do

The Core+ Support Expert - eSign is the internal voice for our customer base, with accountability and responsibility to deliver on our customers’ needs. This role is the liaison between customers and all functional areas within Docusign to resolve technical support inquiries. Working with resources across Docusign, the Core+ Support Expert expedites the resolution of complex technical issues to empower customers to achieve the highest value and adoption of our software.

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Technical Support Manager.

Responsibility

  • Support for Docusign Intelligent Agreement Management (IAM) and associated services
  • Resolution of escalated cases from support channels involving customer-reported issues
  • Ownership of customer issues requiring engineering engagement to address technical bugs and influence the development roadmap
  • Application of technical product expertise within IAM areas to support customer adoption
  • Achievement of Docusign Customer Support service level goals in IAM areas
  • Utilization of support tools and resources, including telephone, Salesforce, Jira, Docusign logging systems, SharePoint, browser developer tools, internal admin console, SQL, and text analysis tools
  • Query languages to gather and track affected documents to further understand customer impact, a.k.a. Documents
  • Identification of product improvements, bugs, and opportunities to enhance customer experience
  • Promotion of Docusign products and services through consultative discussions
  • Handle escalated cases from internal channels to troubleshoot issues customers face when using Docusign products
  • Partnership with non-delivery teams to identify training needs and develop content
  • Collaboration with cross-functional teams such as Product, Engineering, and Account Management to ensure alignment

Job Designation

Remote: Employee is not required to be in or near an office frequently and works from a designated remote work location for the majority of the time.

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.

What you bring

Basic

  • Bachelor of Science degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical discipline
  • 2+ years of SaaS troubleshooting experience in a Technical Support capacity
  • An understanding of modern markup and programming languages such as XML, C#, Python, PHP, JavaScript/jQuery, or similar tools
  • An experience with troubleshooting in a web-based environment, including HTTP, JSON, IIS, HTML, and CSS
  • A proficiency with log analysis using network tools such as Wireshark, Fiddler, Charles Proxy, or other browser/developer tools, or something similar
  • Proven ability to document steps taken to troubleshoot problems through resolution for explanation with any audience, as well as provide updates when a case/ticket has been reviewed, reassigned, and/or escalated
  • Familiarity with at least one (1) vertical or subject matter associated with Docusign, signing or agreement products, or similar technology supported or used previously
  • Fluent in Japanese

Preferred

  • Ability to troubleshoot regular expressions and other complex data validation rules
  • Expertise with web-based applications, web service APIs, monitoring tools (e.g., Dynatrace), and authentication technologies such as SAML and OAuth
  • Familiarity with structured query languages such as SQL and SOQL
  • Ability to maintain composure in critical situations and communicate clearly with both internal and external customers
  • Ability to collaborate with co-workers within the organization and beyond to resolve any situation for our customers, provide help as readily as possible, and obtain assistance as needed
  • Familiarity with basic Docusign Contract Lifecycle and Agreement Management workflows and methodology
  • Speak another language fluently as per the advertised opportunity, Docusign, a.k.a. supported languages
  • Professional experience within relevant industries for which Docusign provides solutions
  • Can work well within a team environment as well as independently
  • Docusign organization administration work experience, or similar knowledge
  • Familiarity with JIRA and Salesforce
  • Self-motivated, goal-oriented, with exceptional organizational, writing, and time management skills
  • Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills, real-time troubleshooting
  • Effective communication skills are a key component of this role, with audiences that include customers, peers, and occasional executive presence

Overview of Position


The Director, SEC Reporting leads the Company’s SEC reporting processes, including quarterly Forms 10-Q, annual Form 10-K, and Benefit Plan financial statements. The role is responsible for the execution and oversight of external financial reporting, ensuring compliance with SEC and U.S. GAAP requirements and maintaining strong disclosure controls and reporting processes. The Director partners across Accounting, FP&A, Legal, Investor Relations, Compensation & Benefits, Tax, Financial Controls, and external audit, while leading and developing the SEC Reporting team.


What will my duties and responsibilities be in this job?


SEC Reporting & Financial Close | 50%

  • Lead SEC reporting activities associated with the quarterly and annual consolidated U.S. GAAP reporting close, including Forms 10-Q, 10-K, and Benefit Plan financial statements.
  • Oversee the preparation, review, and filing of SEC reports and related disclosures for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with SEC and U.S. GAAP requirements.
  • Coordinate reporting activities across business segments and corporate functions; establish deliverables, deadlines, and reporting requirements.
  • Review disclosure support, resolve reporting issues with stakeholders and external auditors, and oversee quarterly XBRL tagging, review, and filing.
  • Review earnings materials, including the financial supplement and earnings release, for consistency, accuracy, and appropriate support.

Technical Accounting, Controls & Governance | 15%

  • Partner with Accounting Policy and other technical accounting stakeholders to assess disclosure impacts of new standards and significant or unusual transactions.
  • Partner with the Financial Controls team to maintain effective SOX and disclosure controls and support remediation where needed.
  • Synthesize complex reporting matters and communicate implications and recommendations to senior Finance leadership and key stakeholders.

Stock-Based Compensation Accounting | 15%

  • Oversee accounting, forecasting, reporting, and disclosures for the Company’s stock-based compensation plans.
  • Partner with Compensation & Benefits, FP&A, Tax, and third-party administrators to ensure accurate expense, EPS calculations, and disclosures.
  • Assess and communicate the accounting and reporting implications of plan changes and new compensation initiatives.

People Leadership & Talent Development | 10%

  • Lead, develop, and coach the SEC Reporting team; establish clear accountabilities, prioritize work, and strengthen technical capability across reporting cycles.
  • Provide timely performance feedback, support development and succession planning, and foster a collaborative, high-accountability team culture.
  • Allocate resources and maintain continuity during high-volume quarterly and annual reporting cycles.

Process Improvement & Strategic Initiatives | 10%

  • Drive improvements in reporting quality, efficiency, automation, documentation, and control sustainability.
  • Partner with the AVP, SEC Reporting & Investment Accounting, on strategic initiatives, complex reporting matters, executive requests, and other external reporting priorities.

What are the requirements needed for this position?

This role will oversee corporate income and indirect tax deliverables, coordinate with external advisers and tax authorities, support year-end tax provisions and audits, and provide accurate reporting to Group Tax.

The position will also support regional treasury activities, including cash forecasting, banking administration, access controls, and wire-approval processes. Approximately 85% of the role is focused on tax and 15% on treasury, making this an excellent opportunity for an experienced corporate tax professional interested in expanding their treasury exposure.

This position will be based remotely within the United States and will require approximately 10% domestic and international travel. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship.

The salary range for this position is $134,965 - $165,073 USD annually. The salary provided is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels.   • Own the North America year-end tax provision process, including current and deferred tax calculations, state and provincial provisions, tax packs, return-to-provision analysis and audit support.
  • Coordinate US and Canadian corporate income tax compliance with external advisers, including preparation of PBC information, review of federal, state and provincial returns, extensions, elections, filings, payments and refunds.

  • Monitor changes in US and Canadian tax law; assess business impact, communicate relevant developments and maintain appropriate tax controls and documentation.
  • Manage tax authority correspondence, inquiries and audits, prepare or coordinate responses and engage external advisers on where necessary on complex matters.
  • Partner with Group Tax and North American Finance on tax strategy, transfer pricing information requests, business initiatives, forecasts and the timely provision of information required for Group reporting.
  • Prepare regular short- and medium-term treasury cash forecasts for North America, explain material variances and provide visibility of expected tax, operational and financing cash flows to the Group Treasury team.
  • Administer North American banking access and controls, including user security, access reviews, token management, authorized signatory records, wire approval workflows and coordination with banks and internal stakeholders.

Genus is an agricultural biotechnology pioneer. We are a global FTSE 250 company, headquartered in the UK, and listed on the London Stock Exchange. Why Syneos Health

Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

Job Description

Biostatistician – Real-World Evidence (RWA)

Role Overview

We are seeking a biostatistician with strong experience in real-world data (RWD) with observational study design and safety study experience in addition to RWA CMH experience. This role will support evidence generation across multiple therapeutic areas. This role will focus on the design, analysis, and interpretation of observational studies using EMR and claims data to inform: clinical development, HEOR, regulatory strategy, and market access.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and execute real-world evidence (RWA) studies using EMR and claims data; Conducting data specs, SAP and protocol with key research objectives

  • Develop and apply robust statistical methodologies, including:

  • Causal inference methods (e.g., propensity score methods, weighting, matching; GLM or GLMM, MMRM; survival analysis; random forest)

  • Trial emulation frameworks

  • External control arm development and borrowing strategies

  • Perform data analysis using healthcare coding systems (e.g., ICD, NDC)

  • Conduct sample size estimation and power calculations for observational and hybrid study designs

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with stakeholders across:

  • HEOR

  • Market Access

  • Regulatory

  • Clinical Development

  • Translate complex analytical results into clear, actionable insights, e.g. powerpoint or study report for decision-making

  • Support methodological innovation in RWE, including integration of machine learning approaches where appropriate

Required Qualifications

  • M.S. or Ph.D. in Biostatistics, Statistics, Epidemiology, or related field

  • ≥5 years of experience in RWA/RWD analytics (industry or equivalent)

  • Strong experience with EMR and/or claims data

  • Proficiency in healthcare coding systems (e.g., ICD, NDC)

  • Programming expertise in at least one of: SAS, R, or Python

  • Working knowledge with SQL logic and OMOP data structures

  • Solid understanding of:

  • Causal inference methods

  • Observational study design

  • Sample size and power considerations

  • Some examples: Independently write cohort definitions in SQL logic; Debug data issues e.g., time zero alignment, exposure gaps; Understand concept mapping (ICD ↔ SNOMED ↔ RxNorm); Translate statistical estimand → censoring rule and data extraction logic

  • RWE CMH Experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Ph.D. strongly preferred

  • Experience in one or more therapeutic areas:

  • Diabetes

  • Cardiovascular disease

  • Metabolic disorders

  • Familiarity with:

  • Trial emulation methodologies

  • External control borrowing / hybrid designs

  • Basic machine learning methods applied to RWD

  • Demonstrated ability to work across multiple therapeutic areas (TAs) in a fast-paced environment

  • Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills

  • Advanced (nice-to-have, not always required)

  • Build reusable cohort pipelines

  • Optimize queries for large-scale databases

  • Work across multiple CDMs (OMOP, Sentinel, PCORnet)

Core Competencies

  • Analytical rigor and methodological depth

  • Cross-functional collaboration

  • Ability to operate with agility across diverse projects and therapeutic areas

  • Clear and effective scientific communication

 


At  Syneos Health, we believe in providing an environment and culture in which Our People can thrive, develop and advance. We reward and recognize our people by providing valuable benefits and a quality-of-life balance. The benefits for this position may include a company car or car allowance, Health benefits to include Medical, Dental and Vision, Company match 401k, Eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and individual performance, and flexible paid time off (PTO) and sick time. Because certain states and municipalities have regulated paid sick time requirements, eligibility for paid sick time may vary depending on where you work. Syneos complies with all applicable federal, state, and municipal paid sick time requirements.

$80,600.00 - $145,000.00

The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high of the Syneos Health range for this position. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role.

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

jobs.description:
Job Description

A bit about this role:

The Program Manager for UM Operations is a high-impact, hands-on leader responsible for driving consistency, workforce readiness, regulatory compliance, and operational efficiency across the Utilization Management (UM) department.

This role combines advanced UM expertise, program management, and data-driven decision-making to build and lead programs that help UM teams perform at their best. The Program Manager will lead a team, partner closely with UM leadership and the UM OPS Quality Team, and ensure UM programs meet Regulatory Guidelines and CMS Regulations.

This is a fast-paced, high-change environment requiring someone who thrives on operational challenges, can manage multiple priorities simultaneously, and is comfortable building and scaling programs during rapid growth.


Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:

Program Leadership & Team Management:

  • Lead section, priorities, and standards that support consistent, compliant operations across UM.
  • Serve as the single point of accountability for program outcomes and report results to UM leadership.

Training Program Development:

  • Build, implement, and manage the UM training program, establishing consistent curriculum and standards across all UM teams.
  • Design and develop role-based training content for clinical and non-clinical UM staff and Medical Directors, using adult learning principles.
  • Create and maintain training materials, job aids, e-learning, and a central training library that reflects current policies, criteria, and regulatory requirements.
  • Translate SOPs, medical policies, regulatory requirements, and system changes into clear, practical training.

Onboarding & Ongoing Education:

  • Oversee onboarding for all new UM hires, including orientation, classroom training, supervised nesting, and readiness sign-off before independent work.
  • Establish role-based competency and readiness standards and partner with operational leaders on new-hire progress.
  • Manage recurring monthly education and ad hoc education for new policies, regulatory changes, system releases, and criteria updates.
  • Partner with the UM OPS Quality Team to deliver re-education for staff with poor quality performance and confirm improvement.
  • Track attendance, completion, and attestation to support audit and accreditation readiness.

Inter-Rater Reliability (IRR) Program:

  • Build and manage the UM IRR program for clinical reviewers and Medical Directors, including methodology, case development, scoring, and passing standards.
  • Administer IRR assessments on schedule, oversee remediation and retesting, and use results to guide education priorities.
  • Ensure IRR processes and documentation meet accreditation, state, and CMS requirements, and present results to UM leadership and committees.

Reporting, Analytics & Continuous Improvement:

  • Build dashboards and reports that measure program effectiveness, including time to productivity, IRR results, education completion, and impact on quality and turnaround times.
  • Analyze program, IRR, and quality data to identify gaps and opportunities for improvement across UM.
  • Lead initiatives to streamline UM workflows, quality decision making, reduce administrative burden, and improve consistency.

Technology & AI Enablement:

  • Partner with Quality, Data Science, and Engineering to support adoption of AI/LLM-assisted workflows, including human-in-the-loop review and responsible use.
  • Use AI and learning technology to scale program delivery and improve efficiency.
  • Manage the tools and systems used to schedule, track, and report program activity.

Cross-Functional Partnership:

  • Partner with UM leaders to identify needs and reduce the time leaders spend building and delivering training.
  • Work closely with the UM OPS Quality Team to turn audit findings into action while keeping training and auditing independent.
  • Collaborate with Compliance, Medical Directors, Pharmacy, Clinical Policy, and HR/Talent on regulatory updates, policy changes, and hiring plans.

Required skills and experience:

  • Active, unrestricted RN or LVNlicense with 5+ years of UM experience (inpatient, outpatient, post-acute, or appeals).
  • 2+ years of experience in clinical education, or UM training.
  • People leadership experience.
  • In-depth knowledge of UM processes, medical necessity criteria, accreditation standards, Regulatory Guidelines, and CMS Regulations.
  • Strong communication, facilitation, analytical, and project management skills.

Desired skills and experience:

  • Experience building or managing a training program, including onboarding and IRR or competency assessments.
  • Knowledge of Medicare Advantage and Medicaid managed care UM requirements.
  • Experience with LMS platforms and AI/LLM-enabled workflows in a healthcare environment.


Salary Range: $73,000-$115,000

jobs.excerpt: Description We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Analyst to support a large-scale data migration initiative involving the transition from ADP to Workday HCM and Workday Payroll.
jobs.description:
Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Analyst to support a large-scale data migration initiative involving the transition from ADP to Workday HCM and Workday Payroll. This individual will own data analysis, profiling, cleansing, mapping, validation, and reconciliation activities throughout the migration lifecycle.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with HRIS and payroll data conversions, strong knowledge of ADP and Workday data structures, and advanced analytical skills using SQL, Excel, and preferably Python.

This role will work closely with HR, Payroll, the Workday implementation partner, and Data Engineering teams to ensure data accuracy, integrity, and completeness across mock conversions, payroll parallel testing, cutover, and post-implementation hypercare.

Key Responsibilities

1. Data Profiling, Cleansing & Mapping

  • Profile and analyze source data from ADP to identify data quality issues, inconsistencies, missing values, and duplicates.
  • Perform data cleansing, standardization, and transformation activities to prepare source data for Workday migration.
  • Develop and maintain detailed source-to-target mapping documents between ADP and Workday HCM and Payroll.
  • Create and manage code crosswalks for organizational structures, employee attributes, payroll codes, earnings, deductions, taxes, and other payroll-related elements.
  • Partner with HR, Payroll, and Data Engineering teams to resolve data gaps and define transformation rules.

2. Data Migration & Reconciliation

  • Own data validation and reconciliation activities across multiple mock conversion cycles.
  • Reconcile converted data using control totals, record counts, field-level validations, and business rule checks.
  • Validate migrated data directly within Workday using Workday Report Writer and standard reporting capabilities.
  • Identify, investigate, and resolve discrepancies between ADP source data and Workday converted data.
  • Maintain detailed reconciliation reports, document exceptions, and track issues through resolution.

3. Payroll Parallel Testing & Validation

  • Support and analyze 2–3 payroll parallel cycles to validate payroll conversion accuracy.
  • Perform employee-level and pay-component-level comparisons between ADP and Workday payroll results.
  • Analyze payroll variances and partner with Payroll SMEs to identify root causes and recommend corrective actions.
  • Validate converted payroll balances, gross and net pay, earnings, deductions, taxes, garnishments, and leave balances.
  • Track payroll discrepancies, document findings, and coordinate resolution with Payroll, Workday implementation, and engineering teams.
  • Prepare payroll reconciliation and parallel testing sign-off packages.

4. Reporting, Documentation & Stakeholder Management

  • Develop and maintain data profiling reports, source-to-target mapping workbooks, reconciliation reports, and data quality dashboards.
  • Build and maintain Power BI dashboards to track migration progress, data quality metrics, reconciliation status, outstanding issues, and readiness for cutover.
  • Work closely with HR, Payroll, Workday implementation partners, and Data Engineering teams to coordinate migration activities.
  • Provide regular status updates on data quality, conversion progress, risks, and outstanding dependencies.
  • Support final data validation, production cutover, and post-go-live hypercare activities.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation and audit trails for migration decisions, data issues, and sign-offs.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, Senior Data Analyst, or Data Migration Analyst.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting HRIS, HCM, or Payroll data migration and conversion projects.
  • Hands-on experience working with ADP and Workday HCM and/or Workday Payroll data.
  • Strong understanding of HR and payroll data structures, including employee records, compensation, earnings, deductions, taxes, garnishments, and leave balances.
  • Advanced SQL skills for data extraction, profiling, validation, reconciliation, and analysis.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including complex formulas, pivot tables, lookups, and data comparison techniques.
  • Experience developing source-to-target mapping documents, code crosswalks, and data transformation rules.
  • Experience validating mock conversions, payroll parallel results, and migration outputs.
  • Familiarity with Workday Report Writer and Workday reporting capabilities.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to perform root-cause analysis.
  • Experience handling confidential employee, payroll, and other sensitive HR data with appropriate security and data privacy practices.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Python for data profiling, cleansing, automation, and reconciliation.
  • Experience with Power BI dashboard development and data visualization.
  • Direct experience with Workday HCM and Workday Payroll implementations.
  • Experience supporting multiple mock conversion cycles and 2–3 payroll parallel runs.
  • Familiarity with Workday EIBs, integrations, and data loading processes.
  • Experience working with Workday implementation partners and cross-functional Data Engineering teams.
  • Knowledge of payroll controls, financial reconciliation, and audit requirements.
  • Experience supporting enterprise-wide HR and payroll transformation initiatives.

WHY JOIN US

Matrix is a global, dynamic, and fast‑growing technology services and consulting company with over 17,000 employees worldwide. Founded in 2001, Matrix has grown through significant organic expansion and strategic acquisitions, executing some of the largest and most impactful technology projects in the market.

We specialize in the design, development, and implementation of advanced technologies, software solutions, and digital products. Our services include infrastructure and consulting, IT outsourcing and offshore delivery, training and assimilation programs, and acting as a trusted implementation and delivery partner for the world’s leading software vendors.

With deep expertise across both the private and public sectors—spanning Finance, Telecom, Healthcare, Hi‑Tech, Education, Defense, and Security—Matrix serves a strong customer base in Israel alongside a continuously expanding global client portfolio.

At Matrix, our people are at the heart of our success. We are a community of talented, creative, and dedicated professionals who are passionate about innovation and excellence. We actively attract, develop, and retain top talent, recognizing that every employee’s contribution is critical to our continued growth and future success.

Matrix’s success is built on a challenging and engaging work environment, competitive compensation and benefits, and meaningful career development opportunities. We foster a diverse, inclusive culture that encourages collaboration, continuous learning, and growth—together.

About the Job:

Starforge Systems is looking for a Technical Customer Support Representative to remotely troubleshoot Windows-based gaming PCs and help customers resolve hardware, software, and performance issues.

You will regularly investigate problems involving system instability, blue screens, driver conflicts, failed components, performance issues, Windows errors, and PCs that do not boot or display properly. Most customer communication is handled through email. Because you will not have the computer in front of you, you must be able to gather useful information, interpret diagnostic results, and guide customers of varying technical skill levels through troubleshooting safely and clearly.

Driver installation and clean removal, Disk Management, Windows installation, and reset procedures

1 Dash is seeking an experienced QuickBooks and accounting professional to help us test, evaluate, and improve an accounting-focused software platform currently under development.

This is not a traditional bookkeeping position.

We are looking for someone who understands how businesses actually use QuickBooks and accounting software and can apply that experience from a product and workflow perspective.

You will spend approximately four hours per day actively working inside our software, creating realistic accounting scenarios, testing workflows, identifying problems or inefficiencies, and recommending improvements to our development team.

Your accounting expertise will directly influence how the product is designed and how its accounting functionality works.

## What You'll Do

Your primary responsibility will be to act as an accounting and QuickBooks subject-matter expert for our software development team.

You will:

- Spend approximately 4 hours per day actively testing the software
- Create realistic businesses, transactions, accounts, customers, vendors, invoices, payments, expenses, and other accounting scenarios
- Evaluate how the software handles common accounting workflows
- Compare workflows and functionality with QuickBooks and accounting best practices
- Review the current accounting structure and recommend better ways to organize or configure the system
- Identify missing accounting features or functionality
- Identify workflows that are unnecessarily complicated or confusing
- Look for accounting situations that could create inaccurate financial reporting
- Test new features and updates released by the development team
- Document bugs, accounting issues, and unexpected behavior
- Recommend functional and workflow improvements
- Explain accounting requirements to developers who may not have an accounting background
- Work directly with our development and leadership teams to prioritize improvements
- Help determine how accounting information should be presented to business owners who may not be accounting experts

## Examples of What You May Review

You may be asked to test and provide recommendations regarding:

- Chart of Accounts structure
- Bank and credit card transactions
- Transaction categorization
- Bank reconciliation
- Accounts receivable
- Accounts payable
- Invoicing and payments
- Customer credits and refunds
- Vendor bills and expenses
- Deposits
- Transfers
- Journal entries
- Recurring transactions
- Financial reporting
- Profit & Loss statements
- Balance Sheets
- Cash-flow reporting
- General Ledger activity
- Sales tax workflows
- Month-end accounting procedures
- Accounting controls and audit trails
- User permissions and accounting controls
- QuickBooks import/export or integration workflows
- Overall ease of use for small-business owners

## What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate has strong hands-on QuickBooks experience combined with a solid understanding of accounting principles.

You should be comfortable looking at a software workflow and saying:

*"This technically works, but this isn't how an accountant or business owner would expect it to work. Here's how we should change it."*

### Preferred Qualifications

- 5+ years of hands-on accounting or bookkeeping experience
- Advanced QuickBooks Online experience
- Strong understanding of GAAP and general accounting principles
- Experience managing books for multiple businesses or clients
- Experience with month-end close and financial statement preparation
- Strong understanding of real-world small-business accounting workflows
- Ability to identify accounting errors and unusual financial results
- Comfortable learning and testing new software
- Able to clearly document problems and recommended solutions
- Comfortable communicating directly with software developers

**QuickBooks ProAdvisor certification is strongly preferred.**

CPA certification is welcome but not required. Practical QuickBooks and accounting experience is more important for this position.

## What Makes This Role Different

This position sits between accounting and software product development.

You will not simply be entering transactions or reconciling accounts. You will be helping determine how accounting software should work.

We want someone who enjoys asking questions such as:

- Is there a better way to handle this transaction?
- Would this workflow make sense to an accountant?
- Would a small-business owner understand this?
- What happens if the user makes a mistake?
- Does this transaction flow correctly through the financial statements?
- What accounting functionality are we missing?
- How does QuickBooks handle this, and could we make the experience better?

Your recommendations will be reviewed directly by our development team and may become part of the product.

## Schedule

This is a part-time position requiring approximately 4 hours per day.

We are looking for someone who can consistently dedicate focused time to testing the platform rather than occasionally reviewing features.

## Ideal Candidate

This role would be especially well suited for an experienced QuickBooks ProAdvisor, accountant, senior bookkeeper, fractional controller, or accounting consultant who enjoys technology and would like to help shape the development of a new software platform.

If you have ever used accounting software and thought, "There has to be a better way to do this," this may be an excellent fit.

Ejecutar y dar seguimiento a las actividades de planificación y abastecimiento de RFRSH bajo un modelo sin producción propia, gestionando el ciclo completo de abastecimiento —elaboración del forecast (FCST), la emisión y seguimiento de órdenes de compra (OC) a ILG, la revisión del avance de la producción y abastecimiento de materiales, así como la entrega del producto terminado a CBC en los 3 países atendidos. Asimismo, consolidar y analizar la información de demanda, producción, abastecimiento e inventarios para seguimiento al proceso S&OP, así como verificar y controlar el cumplimiento de los parámetros de PFN e IBR en las operaciones y con los proveedores, de acuerdo con las políticas y lineamientos definidos por la Dirección, con el fin de garantizar la disponibilidad de producto, el nivel de servicio, la eficiencia en costos y un modelo operativo escalable a nuevos mercados, en cumplimiento de los planes tácticos y estratégicos de la compañía.

Responsabilidades

  1. Dar seguimiento a las actividades del ciclo mensual de S&OP, consolidando la información de los planes de Comercial, Marketing y Finanzas con la capacidad de ILG y los requerimientos de CBC en cada país. Registrar acuerdos, comunicar pendientes y revisar el avance de las acciones definidas para mantener actualizada la información de demanda, el abastecimiento y los objetivos del negocio.
  2. Elaborar y actualizar el forecast (FCST) de demanda por país y SKU en conjunto con Comercial y CBC, calcular las necesidades de abastecimiento y emitir oportunamente las órdenes de compra (OC) a ILG, conforme al plan aprobado, verificando cantidades, fechas y condiciones.
  3. Revisar diaria y semanalmente el estatus de las OC, la programación de producción en ILG, el abastecimiento de materiales y las entregas a CBC, analizar las desviaciones identificadas y comunicar oportunamente los riesgos que afecten el costo, la disponibilidad de producto o el nivel de servicio a las áreas involucradas y a la dirección.
  4. Programar y dar seguimiento a los movimientos de concentrados, materias primas, materiales de empaque y producto terminado entre proveedores, ILG y CBC en cada país, verificando cantidades, fechas, documentación comercial y logística, y cumplimiento del plan aprobado. Registrar y actualizar la información correspondiente en los sistemas, tableros y reportes del área.
  5. Revisarlos niveles de inventario y cobertura en ILG, proveedores y CBC conforme a las políticas establecidas, actualizar las alertas de excesos, faltantes, obsolescencia y materiales o productos en riesgo, controlar los niveles de PFN e IBR tanto en las operaciones como en los proveedores, y dar seguimiento a los planes de acción definidos para su reducción.
  6. Analizar las desviaciones de demanda, capacidad, suministro o servicio, documentar sus causas y preparar alternativas operativas de corto plazo para presentarlas a la Dirección y facilitar su revisión y aprobación.
  7. Liderar la ejecución operativa de lanzamientos e innovaciones con ILG y CBC, verificando la disponibilidad de materiales, la programación de pruebas industriales, los planes de producción y abastecimiento, y el cumplimiento de las fechas comprometidas por país.
  8. Estandarizar, documentar y automatizar los procesos operativos (FCST, OC, seguimiento y entregas), seguimiento y entregas; identificar oportunidades de mejora y automatización y preparar los requerimientos operativos para su revisión por Dirección. Asimismo, recopilar la información logística y de abastecimiento necesaria para apoyar la incorporación de nuevos países, conforme a los lineamientos aprobados.
  9. Recabar y registrara oportunamente la información operativa necesaria de ILG, proveedores y CBC, incluyendo la planificación de mantenimientos, restricciones de capacidad, entrega de insumos y otros eventos que incidan en la operación, verificar su integridad y comunicar desviaciones o información pendiente para facilitar la planificación y reducir imprevistos.
  10. Consolidar y actualizar la información para el Forecast Trimestral y de la Planificación Operativa Anual (AOP) de abastecimiento, recopilano datos de capacidad de ILG, materiales, inventarios y costos. Preparar análisis y reportes operativos que sirvan de insumos operativos para apoyar, bajo las prioridades estratégicas definidas por Dirección, la construcción y actualización del master plan de cinco años, incluyendo los requerimientos operativos para nuevos países, conforme a las prioridades definidas por la Dirección.
  • Licenciatura o Ingeniería Ingeniería Industrial, Administración de Empresas, Logística, Cadena de Abastecimiento o carrera afín.

  • Minimo 2 años de experiencia como Analista Senior o Coordinador de Planificación, Operaciones, Logística o Cadena de Abastecimiento 2 a 5 años

La misión de Grupo Mariposa es fomentar el crecimiento y la sostenibilidad dentro de la industria global de alimentos y bebidas. Estamos comprometidos con la excelencia a través de una gestión disciplinada, prácticas innovadoras y una cultura dinámica que acepta el cambio.

jobs.title: Solution Architect, Agentic Security
jobs.excerpt: Description Who We Are Come join the company at the center of how the world adopts AI securely.
jobs.description:
Description

Who We Are

Come join the company at the center of how the world adopts AI securely. Cyera’s mission is to give enterprises the confidence to embrace AI safely — deciding exactly what it can see and do as it reaches deeper into the business. We started by solving the hardest problem in data security: finding and securing data faster and more precisely than anyone thought possible. That foundation is now the essential AI trust infrastructure for the Fortune 1000. We’re hiring mission-driven talent to put those leaders at the center of our story.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We’re looking for a Solution Architect, Agentic Security to be the technical and strategic bridge between Cyera and the enterprises deploying AI agents in production. You’ll help security, IAM, and AI platform teams answer three questions: which agents exist, what they are allowed to access, and how to govern and stop them when something goes wrong.

This is a field role across pre-sales and post-sales: shape the deal architecture, prove it in a POC against real agent workloads, then own deployment and rollout with live customers. You’ll work closely with Sales, Product, Research, executive leadership, and founders. Because this category is being defined right now, you’ll also turn what you learn in the field into the patterns, reference architectures, and point of view the rest of the market follows.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Agentic discovery and threat modeling: Lead technical discovery across agent frameworks, AI platforms, MCP servers, and the identities and data they touch. Map how agents authenticate, what tools and data they reach, where delegation chains run, and where prompt injection or over-permissioned access creates real exposure.
  • Solution architecture: Design end-to-end architectures that align Cyera capabilities to the customer’s AI adoption program: agent inventory and ownership, least-privilege access for agents and their tools, runtime policy and guardrails, auditability, and kill-switch and revocation paths.
  • Demos and deep dives: Deliver technically rigorous demos and workshops that make agentic risk concrete for AI platform engineers, IAM and security architects, and CISOs alike. Show the attack path, then show the control.
  • Technical strategy for strategic deals: Partner with Sales leadership on high-impact pursuits. Build bespoke prototypes and POCs against live agent workloads, define evaluation criteria, and run evaluations to a clear decision.
  • Deployment and adoption: Own technical rollout with new customers, from first integrations to production policy, and close the loop on capabilities in use.
  • Field-to-product feedback loop: Translate what agents are actually doing in customer environments into problem statements Product and Research can act on. Track protocol and framework changes (MCP, A2A, agent SDKs) and their security implications for the roadmap.
  • Partner enablement: Equip AI platform, cloud, and services partners with patterns and enablement materials to accelerate joint wins.
  • Artifacts and thought leadership: Produce reference architectures, threat models, playbooks, and reusable assets for GTM and CS. Represent Cyera externally through talks, workshops, and written POV on agentic security.

Requirements

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 6+ years of technical depth from customer-facing, engineering, or product roles in security, identity, or cloud infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience building with or securing LLM applications or AI agents: you have wired an agent to tools, read the traces, and know where it breaks.
  • Working knowledge of how agents authenticate and are authorized: OAuth 2.x and token delegation, API keys and secrets, service accounts, and workload identity.
  • Ability to explain AI-specific threats (prompt injection, tool poisoning, excessive agency, data exfiltration through agents) and the controls that address them, to both engineers and executives.
  • Proven experience designing architectures, building POCs, and producing crisp technical collateral such as reference designs, threat models, and playbooks.
  • Comfort partnering cross-functionally with Sales, Product, and R field-oriented, with strong customer empathy and a bias for action.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and presentation skills; confident leading strategic conversations and aligning diverse stakeholders.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with agent frameworks and platforms such as LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Amazon Bedrock Agents, or Google Vertex AI Agent Builder.
  • Depth in agent protocols: MCP (servers, transports, authorization) and A2A, including how identity and trust propagate across agent-to-agent and agent-to-tool calls.
  • Background in IAM/PAM, non-human identity governance, or secrets management; familiarity with SPIFFE/SPIRE or cloud-native workload identity.
  • Data security experience: classification, DLP, or data access governance, and how it applies to RAG pipelines and agent data access.
  • Cloud and platform fluency across AWS, Azure, or GCP, plus Kubernetes and infrastructure-as-code.
  • A public track record: conference talks, published research, open-source contributions, or vulnerability disclosures in AI or identity security.

What success looks like

  • First 90 days: You run the agentic security demo and discovery motion independently, own technical execution on at least two active POCs, and ship your first reusable asset (a reference architecture or threat model for a common agent deployment pattern).
  • First year: You are the technical lead on our largest agentic security deals, have converted POCs into production deployments, have brought recurring field problems to Product as roadmap-ready problem statements, and are a recognized external voice on securing AI agents.

COMPENSATION INFORMATION:

Compensation Range: $200,000-$250,000.

The range represents total compensation, and may include incentive for sales roles, equity or benefits, as applicable.

This compensation range represents Cyera’s good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of posting, and Cyera may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. The final salary for this position will be determined in Cyera’s sole discretion, consistent with applicable law, and based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to the employee’s work experience, skills, and qualifications for the role, as well as the needs of Cyera’s business and other operational considerations.

Final compensation will vary based on seniority and relevance of experience, location, and position requirements.

This role may be eligible for potential merit increases based on factors such as individual or company performance, time in role, and other discretionary factors.

BENEFITS - Why Cyera?

  • Ability to work remotely, with office setup reimbursement
  • Competitive salary
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Paid holidays and sick time
  • Health, vision, and dental insurance
  • Life, short and long-term disability insurance
