jobs.description:
Job Summary

Aptive Resources is seeking a Senior Program Analyst to support research program operations for the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Office of Research and Development (ORD) Health Systems Research (HSR) team, in support of the Field Enterprise Research Support Services (FERSS) contract. The role supports ORD's implementation science and health systems research activities by providing program-level coordination, operational analysis, and administrative support across budget-related workflows, project processing, and program operations.

This position serves as a central coordination point for HSR's budget-related requests and day-to-day administrative operations. The successful candidate will review and track budget and project requests, maintain accurate program tracking tools, prepare summaries and analyses for HSR leadership, and identify opportunities to improve program effectiveness. The role requires a candidate who takes ownership of assigned workstreams, works proactively and autonomously with minimal direction, applies established procedures and templates consistently, and incorporates leadership feedback quickly. This position requires strong client interaction skills, a high level of attention to detail, and the ability to support multiple program priorities and stakeholders at once.

This is a full-time (40 hours/week), 100% remote position.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Prescreen, review, and facilitate processing of budget requests, project modification requests, and project initiation materials related to implementation science and health systems research, ensuring submissions are complete and aligned with established guidelines before they advance to HSR leadership for decision.
  • Maintain budget-related tracking for the HSR project portfolio, including monitoring submissions, updates, request status, and spending projections, and reconciling multi-year project budgets by fiscal year.
  • Prepare budget-related summaries, reconciliations, and analyses to inform HSR leadership's planning and resource decisions.
  • Coordinate and execute program workflows related to budget, project, and peer review processes, ensuring alignment with established guidelines and timelines.
  • Provide administrative and coordination support to the HSR Director/Deputy Director and the HSR project portfolio, including tracking action items, deadlines, and correspondence across the office.
  • Provide guidance to investigators and project teams on submission requirements for budget and project requests, and follow up on missing or incomplete materials.
  • Collect, validate, analyze, and synthesize data from field activities to support reporting, performance tracking, and dissemination to stakeholders.
  • Maintain and update personnel and project tracking spreadsheets to support application and peer review processes.
  • Coordinate and support application and peer review processes, including tracking submissions, ensuring completeness, and facilitating communication across stakeholders.
  • Prepare program-level reports, summaries, and analyses related to project activities, budget-related workflows, and program operations.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and lead or support the development and implementation of standard operating procedures (SOPs), job aids, and training materials.
  • Support automation and streamlining of workflows using tools such as Excel, SharePoint, or other systems to improve efficiency and consistency of program operations.
  • Coordinate with program leadership and stakeholders to ensure timely and accurate processing of requests and deliverables.
  • Communicate clearly and professionally with internal and external stakeholders to resolve issues, ensure data accuracy, and support program objectives.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in business administration, public administration, health administration, public health, research, finance, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of experience supporting program management, program operations, or program analysis in a complex organization.
  • Experience supporting budget, grants, or research administration workflows in a program or research environment, such as budget request review, tracking, projections, or reconciliation.
  • Demonstrated ability to take ownership of assigned workstreams, prioritize independently, and contribute to program-level operations with minimal oversight.
  • Demonstrated experience with data validation, analysis, and maintaining structured tracking tools (e.g., Excel, SharePoint).
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools, including Microsoft Excel (e.g., data management, formulas), Microsoft Teams, and SharePoint.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while managing assigned tasks and deadlines.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a public trust clearance.
  • Legal authorization to work in the U.S.

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience supporting research program operations, including implementation science or health systems research.
  • Experience in an administrative officer, business operations, or program operations role supporting the leadership of a research office or program.
  • 2+ years of experience in budget, grants, or research administration.
  • Familiarity with federal budget justification formats and VA research funding mechanisms.
  • Experience reconciling multi-year budgets by fiscal year.
  • Working knowledge of General Schedule (GS) pay tables and locality adjustments, as applied to personnel costs in research budgets.
  • Experience with grants management or research funding processes (e.g., NIH, VA, or another federal research funding organization).
  • Experience working in a federal or VA research environment.
  • Experience processing high volumes of requests across many investigators or project teams while maintaining accuracy and turnaround times.
  • Demonstrated project management experience, managing timelines, deliverables, and cross-functional workstreams. Formal PM certification (e.g., PMP) is a plus but not required.
  • Experience supporting program performance tracking, reporting, or evaluation activities.
  • Experience developing SOPs, job aids, or training for staff and investigators.
  • High level of experience and comfort working independently with senior leadership, faculty, staff, medical professionals, and external agencies in complex organizations.
  • Demonstrated ability to synthesize data and stakeholder input to inform program improvements or operational decisions.
  • Experience working with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.
  • Must possess discretion and mature judgment, as confidential information is routinely encountered.

Physical Requirements

Physical Requirements: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit for extended periods, use a computer keyboard and mouse, and communicate verbally and in writing. The employee may occasionally need to stand, walk, bend, or lift up to 15 pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this role.

About Aptive

About Aptive. Aptive partners with federal agencies to achieve their missions through improved performance, streamlined operations and enhanced service delivery. Based in Alexandria, Virginia, we support more than a dozen agencies including Veterans Affairs, Transportation, Defense, Homeland Security and the National Science Foundation. We specialize in applying technology, creativity and human-centered services to optimize mission delivery and improve experiences for millions of people who count on government services every day. Location: Onsite, Hybrid, or Remote

About MIRA Safety

MIRA Safety helps people prepare for emergencies with high-quality protective equipment and preparedness education. We’re a small, close-knit team in the Austin area. We also partner with Austin Pets Alive! to foster kittens in our office Cat Lounge.

About the Program

This is a hands-on training program for students and recent graduates who want practical skills in generative AI, video, and digital storytelling. You don’t need to be an AI expert. We’re looking for creative, curious people who like to experiment.

Over 16 weeks, you’ll learn professional AI tools through structured training, guided practice, and feedback from our creative team. Assignments are shaped around your learning goals.

What You’ll Learn

  • Generating AI images and short-form video (text-to-image, image-to-video, text-to-video)
  • Writing effective prompts and improving results through iteration
  • Combining AI assets with traditional editing techniques
  • AI voiceovers, digital avatars, animation, and cinematic storytelling
  • How businesses use generative AI for ad concepts and product visuals, through sample assignments
  • Short-form formats for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts
  • Responsible AI use, including copyright, privacy, and brand standards

Learning projects may include AI video demos, sample ad concepts, visual storytelling experiments, preparedness education concepts, and research presentations on emerging AI tools.

Who Should Apply

  • College students or recent graduates in digital media, marketing, design, film, communications, computer science, or related fields
  • Aspiring content creators interested in AI video and imagery
  • Self-motivated learners who enjoy experimenting with new technology

Creativity and curiosity matter more than experience. It’s a plus if you’ve used generative AI tools, Canva, CapCut, or Adobe Creative Cloud, or if you follow social media trends.

What You’ll Gain

  • Hands-on AI training with guided instruction and feedback
  • Company-provided access to professional AI platforms
  • Mentorship from experienced creative and marketing professionals
  • Portfolio pieces you can share, with MIRA’s approval
  • A recommendation letter when you complete the program

Program Terms

  • Unpaid and educational: Interns do not receive wages or benefits and should have no expectation of compensation. The program provides training similar to an educational setting.
  • Academic alignment: You may pursue academic credit through your school, and your schedule will work around your academic commitments.
  • Limited duration: The internship lasts 16 weeks.
  • No guarantee of employment: Completing the internship doesn’t create an entitlement to a paid internship, freelance work, or a job. High-performing interns may be considered for future opportunities based on business needs.
  • Internship Agreement: Selected interns sign an Internship Agreement confirming the unpaid educational status, along with MIRA’s confidentiality and intellectual property agreement.
  • Ownership of work: Work created during the internship belongs to MIRA Safety. Interns may include approved work in their portfolios with MIRA’s written approval.
  • Responsible AI use: Interns follow MIRA’s AI and confidentiality guidelines and each platform’s terms of use. No confidential or personal information may be entered into AI tools.

How to Apply

  1. Submit your resume. A portfolio or work samples are optional but welcome.
  2. Interview with our HR team.
  3. Selected candidates complete the Culture Index Survey.

MIRA Safety is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As an Intermediate Security Engineer on GitLab's Security Incident Response Team (SIRT), you will be on the frontline of protecting both GitLab.com and GitLab the company from security threats. This role operates on a compressed 4-day work schedule, with a full-time week's hours condensed into four longer working days. Shifts run either Sunday through Wednesday or Wednesday through Saturday to provide 24/7/365 security coverage. This role also supports our FedRAMP environment and requires U.S. citizenship and residency within the United States.

Your primary focus will be detecting and responding to security incidents during your scheduled shifts. You'll work extensively with our incident response automation tools to investigate, analyze, and resolve security events. You'll also use AI to build security tooling and automation, helping to improve our detection and response capabilities.

In this role, you'll develop expertise using our security infrastructure to monitor for threats, analyze potential incidents, and coordinate response efforts across teams. This position is ideal for someone who wants to grow their incident response skills while working within GitLab's established security framework. You'll learn to think both tactically and strategically about security, while getting hands-on experience handling real-world incidents.

Successful Security Engineers thrive in high-pressure environments, remaining calm while following prepared runbooks and thinking critically about security challenges. In this role, you will learn to think like both an attacker and defender, developing proactive and preventative security measures to keep GitLab and its users' data safe in our ever-changing threat landscape. Through hands-on experience and mentorship, you'll develop the skills needed to anticipate security risks, respond effectively to incidents, and contribute to GitLab's robust security posture.

Find out more about the Security Operations team and responsibilities here:

  • Incident Response
  • Trust and Safety
  • Red Team
  • Threat-Intelligence
  • Detection Engineering

What you’ll do

  • Respond to and own security incidents in our 24/7 global rotation, managing them from detection through containment and recovery
  • Create and maintain incident response documentation, including runbooks and standard procedures
  • Contribute to post-incident analysis through RCA and lessons-learned reviews to strengthen our incident response program
  • Build AI-assisted automation and tooling to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual work
  • Drive continuous improvement by identifying security gaps and contributing to advanced detection and response capabilities
  • Collaborate across GitLab teams to develop new security capabilities and deliver technical projects that enhance our infrastructure

What you’ll bring

  • Demonstrated ability to learn and lead incident response processes independently
  • Experience with SIEM/security logging tools
  • Experience with cloud platforms (GCP and/or AWS)
  • Experience building tools or automation with AI, and the judgment to test and verify what it produces (Python, SOAR, or other scripting is a plus)
  • A passion for technical documentation
  • Proactive approach to identifying and investigating security threats
  • Interest in conducting forensic analysis of infected hosts
  • Experience or strong desire to learn cloud-based security investigations

Due to government requirements, you must be a United States Citizen (defined as any individual who is a citizen of the United States by law, birth, or naturalization) to fill this position.

About the team

Security Operations is a globally distributed team of engineers split across 3 core regions; AMER, APAC and EMEA, and is at the forefront of security events that impact both GitLab.com and GitLab. jobs.excerpt: Practice/Department: Application Modernization / Observability and Intelligent Operations(OIO) Position Title: Director, Service Delivery Job Summary: The Director of Service Delivery leads the Services organization’s overall performance, growth, profitability, and operational effectiveness.
jobs.description:
Practice/Department: Application Modernization / Observability and Intelligent Operations(OIO) Position Title: Director, Service Delivery

Job Summary:

The Director of Service Delivery leads the Services organization’s overall performance, growth, profitability, and operational effectiveness. This senior leader owns customer engagement and delivery outcomes across a portfolio of professional services engagements, overseeing Services P&L, business operations, project execution, resource management, team development, customer satisfaction, and services revenue growth. The Director will serve as a senior customer-facing leader, building trusted relationships with customer executives and key stakeholders while ensuring engagements deliver measurable business value. The role will work closely with Sales, Solution/Enterprise Architects, Practice Leaders, Project Managers, Finance, Operations, and delivery teams to successfully transition opportunities from sales through implementation and continued customer expansion. This leader is expected to combine the discipline of a delivery executive, the commercial mindset of a business leader, and the relationship skills of a trusted customer advisor.

Essential Functions:

Perform the following essential functions across four areas of responsibility: Financial Management

Drive services revenue growth. Manage gross margin and project profitability. Optimize billable utilization. Manage services backlog and bookings performance. Maintain accurate services forecasts.

Customer Engagement Management

Monitor and improve customer satisfaction (CSAT). Monitor and improve Net Promoter Score (NPS), where applicable. Drive customer retention. Manage Customer escalations and oversee project delivery and issues. Build and maintain strong customer executive relationships. Grow expansion revenue from existing customers.

Delivery Management

Oversee project delivery to meet timelines and budgets. Monitor and manage portfolio and project health. Manage project scope and change control effectively. Resolve delivery issues to reduce escalations and troubled projects. Maintain effective project governance.

People & Operations Support

Optimize resource utilization and productivity. Support employee retention. Develop team skills and support professional certifications. Align hiring and delivery capacity with business needs. Develop leadership succession plans and strengthen the talent pipeline.

Required Skills/Abilities/Competencies

  • Customer Engagement & Executive Relationships

Serve as a senior executive point of contact for strategic customers and critical services engagements. Establish and maintain trusted relationships with customer executives, business leaders, and technology stakeholders. Understand customer business objectives and ensure services engagements remain aligned with expected business and technology outcomes. Conduct executive business reviews, delivery reviews, and customer health discussions. Monitor customer satisfaction and proactively address delivery concerns before they become significant escalations. Act as the executive escalation point for critical customer, project, commercial, and delivery issues. Partner with customers to identify follow-on initiatives and opportunities where additional services can create value. Build customer advocacy through successful delivery, references, case studies, and long-term relationships.

  • Services P&L & Financial Management

Own and manage the financial performance of the Services organization or assigned portfolio. Develop and manage services revenue, gross margin, cost, utilization, backlog, bookings, and profitability targets. Develop annual operating plans, budgets, forecasts, and capacity plans. Monitor actual financial performance against plan and implement corrective actions where necessary. Manage project economics, including labor cost, subcontractor cost, project margin, billing, and revenue performance. Review project financial health and identify potential margin erosion early. Partner with Finance to maintain accurate forecasting, billing, revenue recognition, and financial reporting. Balance delivery capacity, utilization, and hiring to support profitable growth.

  • Services Revenue Growth

Develop and execute strategies for growing professional services revenue within existing and new customer accounts. Partner with Sales and Practice Leaders to identify consulting, implementation, optimization, transformation, and expansion opportunities. Participate in strategic pursuits, proposals, SOW development, estimation, and commercial discussions. Identify new opportunities arising from current engagements and convert successful delivery into additional services. Develop repeatable service offerings, implementation models, and delivery approaches that improve scalability and profitability. Maintain visibility into pipeline, bookings, backlog, and future resource demand. Build strong alignment between services capacity and the sales pipeline. Support account planning and expansion strategies for strategic customers.

  • Service Delivery Management

Provide executive oversight across the portfolio of customer projects and programs. Ensure engagements are delivered successfully against agreed scope, schedule, budget, quality, and customer expectations. Establish standardized delivery governance, methodologies, controls, and operating rhythms. Conduct regular portfolio and project health reviews. Monitor delivery KPIs and identify projects requiring leadership intervention. Ensure effective management of project scope, dependencies, risks, issues, and change requests. Maintain accountability for commitments defined in Statements of Work and contractual agreements. Drive corrective actions for projects that are financially, operationally, or technically at risk. Establish effective escalation and recovery processes for critical engagements. On-time/on-budget delivery, RAID management, change control, SOW alignment, executive reporting, and escalation management.

  • Business & Delivery Operations

Build and manage the operating model required to scale the Services organization. Establish KPIs, dashboards, and management processes covering:

Services revenue Gross margin Billable utilization Project profitability Backlog Resource capacity and demand Customer satisfaction Project health Pipeline-to-capacity alignment

Establish weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews. Improve forecasting accuracy across revenue, resource demand, project completion, and hiring. Identify operational inefficiencies and implement process improvements and automation. Establish consistent delivery standards across practices, technologies, and geographies.

  • Team Building & Leadership

Build, lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing Services organization. Develop organization structures and hiring plans aligned with services growth. Recruit and retain project managers, consultants, architects, engineers, and other delivery professionals. Build leadership depth by developing delivery managers and future practice leaders. Establish skills matrices, competency models, career paths, and development plans. Create a culture of accountability, customer focus, collaboration, high-quality delivery, and continuous improvement. Manage distributed, offshore, nearshore, partner, and subcontractor delivery resources where applicable. Establish succession plans for key leadership and delivery roles.

  • Resource & Capacity Management

Own capacity planning and resource allocation across the services portfolio. Balance customer demand, utilization, skills availability, pipeline, and hiring requirements. Monitor billable utilization and bench levels and take actions to optimize workforce productivity. Ensure projects are staffed with appropriately skilled resources. Anticipate future skills demand based on sales pipeline and technology trends. Develop strategies for balancing employees, offshore resources, partners, and subcontractors. Partner with delivery and practice leadership to identify and close critical skill gaps.

  • Project & Portfolio Governance

Establish governance standards across the project portfolio. Review project status, financial performance, customer health, risks, and resource constraints. Ensure Project Managers maintain appropriate project plans, financial forecasts, RAID logs, status reports, and change controls. Facilitate executive governance for large or strategically important programs. Ensure significant risks and issues have clear ownership and resolution plans. Provide leadership intervention and recovery plans for challenged engagements.

Education and Experience:

Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline; Master's degree preferred. 12+ years of progressive experience across professional services, consulting, technology delivery, or service delivery leadership. Significant experience leading customer-facing professional services or consulting organizations. Demonstrated experience managing Services P&L, budgets, revenue, margin, forecasting, and operational performance. Strong experience overseeing complex enterprise technology projects and programs. Proven ability to build, scale, mentor, and lead high-performing delivery organizations. Demonstrated ability to manage executive customer relationships and complex escalations. Experience partnering with Sales to grow services revenue through new and existing customer accounts. Strong understanding of project and portfolio management disciplines. Experience managing geographically distributed, offshore, nearshore, partner, or subcontracted delivery organizations. Strong commercial understanding of Statements of Work, change requests, resource models, project economics, and contract commitments. Excellent executive communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-management skills.

Your previous internal requirements called for 10+ years of progressive IT service-management experience, large-scale delivery experience, financial/budget skills, vendor management, distributed-team leadership, risk/compliance knowledge, and familiarity with cloud delivery and digital transformation. For this broader Director role, I recommend raising the experience bar to 12+ years because of the added P&L and growth accountability. Experience leading a technology consulting or professional services business.

Experience within enterprise platforms and services such as ServiceNow, Observability/AIOps, Cloud, Infrastructure, Automation, IT Operations, or Digital Transformation. Experience with delivery and project management platforms such as ServiceNow and Jira. Knowledge of cloud platforms including AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud. ITIL certification preferred. PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent program/project-management credentials preferred. Experience building global or blended onshore/offshore delivery models.

Physical Requirements:

Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer. Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times.

About the role

As a Senior Mainframe Application Support Engineer – Deposits, you will provide advanced production support for banking deposit applications in an IBM mainframe environment. You will troubleshoot complex production incidents, support batch and online processing, investigate application and file-processing issues, and drive problems through resolution. You will partner with development, operations, project and business teams while serving as a subject matter expert for assigned applications.


Your key responsibilities

  • Provide advanced production support for banking deposit applications, including batch processing, online systems, file transmissions and application recovery.
  • Lead troubleshooting of complex production incidents, perform root cause analysis and drive corrective actions for recurring issues.
  • Analyze job streams, dependencies, scheduling, abnormal job terminations and batch failures, and resolve complex file-processing issues.
  • Partner with development, operations, project and business teams on implementations, enhancements and issue resolution.
  • Maintain support, recovery and operational documentation, participate in on-call and major incident response activities, and mentor team members.

What you bring

Required qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience supporting banking or financial applications in an IBM mainframe environment, with experience in deposit or transaction processing.
  • Strong COBOL programming skills, including coding, application maintenance and debugging.
  • Strong knowledge of z/OS, Job Control Language (JCL), Customer Information Control System (CICS), Time Sharing Option/Interactive System Productivity Facility (TSO/ISPF), batch processing and job scheduling.
  • Experience with Virtual Storage Access Method (VSAM), sequential files, balancing and validation, and large-volume transaction processing.
  • Strong production support and troubleshooting experience, including incident management, application recovery, root cause analysis and resolution of complex production issues.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with DB2 and Structured Query Language (SQL) for querying and validating transaction data.
  • Experience with mainframe change-management, promotion and release processes.
  • Client-facing support experience, including working with operations teams and external clients.

The impact you’ll make

As a Senior Mainframe Application Support Engineer – Deposits, you will help maintain the stability and reliability of business-critical banking applications. You will apply deep mainframe and production-support expertise to complex incidents, recurring processing issues and application recovery. Through troubleshooting, documentation, knowledge sharing and mentoring, you will help strengthen operational reliability and support effective issue resolution.

jobs.excerpt: No other company in our industry is supercharging the way they work and serve their clients like OneDigital.
jobs.description:
No other company in our industry is supercharging the way they work and serve their clients like OneDigital. Fresh thinking has always been the core of OneDigital’s vision and growth strategy. It’s how we stand out in our industry, it’s how we stay competitive and resilient in a changing world. Most importantly, our innovative approach is helping more people do their best work and live their best lives. Innovation fuels our employee experience by making it easier to do your best work anytime, anywhere and from any device. And our tech-based products for clients are a game changer in our industry. If you thrive on change and innovation, OneDigital is the career choice for you.

Our Newest Opportunity:

Summary
The Product Adoption & Enablement Manager drives the adoption of every product OneDigital builds and launches.This role is the dedicated adoption and enablement partner to our Product Managers, owning the rollout planning, communication, coordination, and champion-network mechanics that turn a release into real usage, so Product Managers can stay focused on product strategy and delivery.


The role works across the full suite of applications supported and launched by the Product team, including applications added to the portfolio over time. It is embedded in how the Product team operates, plugged into roadmaps and the operating rhythm closely enough to know what is coming, where each initiative sits in the rollout lifecycle, who is impacted, and what the communication, training, and enablement motion needs to look like. It is involved early enough to own adoption and enablement strategy across the portfolio proactively, rather than receiving a finished release and reacting to it.


While accountable for building and executing structured rollout and adoption plans and for surfacing actionable insights, this role partners with Product Managers and business leaders, who retain accountability for KPIs and business results. The role exists to support the Product Management team, not to substitute for it. Product Managers remain accountable for ensuring their applications have the functionality and usability users need. This role is accountable for ensuring users know how to use each application, understand what it can and cannot do today, are getting the most out of what exists right now, and are encouraged toward adoption overall.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Portfolio Visibility & Adoption Strategy

  • Participate in the Product team's operating rhythm, including roadmap reviews, planning and prioritization discussions, and release readiness checkpoints, as a standing member of the team rather than an occasional invitee.
  • Maintain a forward view of the portfolio: what is coming, on what timeline, where each initiative sits in the rollout lifecycle, and which audiences are affected.
  • Own the adoption and enablement strategy across the portfolio, determining the communication, training, and enablement motion each initiative warrants, and sequencing that work across applications.
  • Engage upstream, while releases are still being shaped, so adoption and enablement needs inform rollout timing, sequencing, and readiness rather than being addressed after the fact.
  • Assess change impact early: who is affected, how significant the change is for them, and what level of support it warrants.
  • Coordinate with L&D to ensure users know how to use each application and understand its current capabilities and limitations. Where adoption is constrained by missing functionality or usability problems, surface it clearly to the responsible Product Manager, who owns remediation.
  • Remove adoption and enablement planning from each Product Manager's individual workload, replacing it with one consistent approach applied across the portfolio.

User Release Communication

  • Own the drafting, publishing, and sending of release notes and platform updates to the user base across all Product-supported applications.
  • Translate technical and product inputs from Product Managers into clear, user-facing language that explains what changed, why it matters, and what the user needs to do.
  • Own messaging consistency for release notes and platform updates; define and maintain the templates, cadence, tone, and quality standards so communication is consistent across applications.
  • Manage the release communication calendar, sequencing updates across applications to avoid overloading shared audiences.
  • Partner with Marketing and Communications, where required, on enterprise-wide message consistency across every channel, including larger company-wide communication initiatives where a release requires broader reach than the standard user channels.

Rollout Planning & Coordination

  • Develop tailored rollout plans for each initiative, flexing the approach to the size, audience, and complexity of the product or feature, based on an underlying repeatable framework those plans draw from.
  • Align rollout plans with business objectives through close engagement with business stakeholders, so each rollout is tied to what the business is trying to achieve.
  • Orchestrate delivery across contributing teams to support application and functionality rollouts.
  • Coordinate with the L&D team to schedule and stand up training support tied to releases, including where a rollout plan calls for tailored or audience-specific training.
  • Coordinate with Marketing to promote enablement content such as success stories and customer proof points.
  • Guide and partner with L&D and Marketing, where required, on their workstreams, including training, enablement, and messaging, to align with the strategic adoption plan.
  • Track rollout dependencies, timelines, and handoffs, and keep Product Managers and contributing teams aligned on who owns what and by when.
  • Flag coordination risks and blockers early so Product Managers can adjust rollout timing or sequencing.

Champion Network Governance Support

  • Support the governance of the champion network across the product portfolio.
  • Help Product Managers formalize how champions are recruited, trained, and activated.
  • Maintain the operating mechanics of the network, including rosters, onboarding, communication rhythms, and activation playbooks, so Product Managers are not rebuilding the process for each launch.
  • Serve as a consistent point of contact for champions and route their questions and feedback to the right Product Manager or team.

Adoption Support

  • Monitor and interpret utilization metrics and adoption statistics across supported applications using existing reporting and dashboards.
  • Surface insights and patterns, including where adoption is lagging, which segments are stalling, and what is working, rather than reporting raw numbers.
  • Partner with Product Managers to develop and refine strategies to increase adoption based on what the data shows.
  • Recommend additional metrics worth tracking where current reporting does not answer the adoption questions Product Managers need answered.
  • Close the loop after launches by capturing what drove adoption and feeding those learnings into the next rollout plan.

Qualifications, Skills and Requirements

  • Product communications capability is a priority: demonstrated ability to take a release or a new capability and turn it into clear, engaging communication for the end user, not simply announcing that something launched, but creating genuine interest in it and articulating plainly why it matters to the person using it.
  • Strong writer, able to take technical product input and produce clear, concise, user-facing communication with minimal editing. Writes with energy as well as accuracy, so communication leaves users wanting to try what shipped rather than merely informed that it exists.
  • Understands how Product teams operate, including roadmaps, release cycles, and prioritization trade-offs, and is comfortable being embedded in that rhythm rather than briefed from outside it.
  • Strategic thinker with the ability to flex rollout plans and approaches based on product size, audience, and complexity.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate cross-functional delivery across teams they do not manage.
  • Comfortable working with usage and adoption data; able to read dashboards, spot trends, and translate them into recommendations.
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills across business stakeholders, regional leaders, and frontline users.
  • Highly organized; able to run multiple concurrent rollouts across multiple applications without dropping details.
  • Nimble and adaptive; thrives in fast-paced, evolving environments.
  • Human-centered mindset: keeps employees and clients at the heart of adoption planning.

Education, Training and Experience

  • 4-8 years in product marketing, product operations, adoption/enablement, technical communication, or a comparable role supporting product teams.
  • Demonstrated product communications experience, including translating releases and new capabilities into user-facing communication.
  • Experience working closely with Product teams and being embedded in their roadmap, release, and prioritization rhythm.
  • Previous experience working in or alongside Product teams to coordinate multi-channel rollouts.
  • Experience building or running a champion, super-user, or ambassador network is a strong plus.
  • Strong preference for experience in insurance, benefits, or financial services; exposure to SaaS and digital transformation environments is an advantage.

jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

We're looking for a technically strong, forward-thinking specialist to help shape the next generation of Campaign Operations. This role focuses on innovation, AI-driven capabilities, and technical solutions that make our campaign operating model more intelligent, scalable, and efficient.

You'll spend most of your time designing and building: prototyping AI agents, automations, and integrations, then turning the ones that work into reusable capabilities the whole team can adopt. You'll also bring enough Campaign Operations expertise to support campaign execution when needed.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You're energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

  • Drive innovation: Explore emerging technologies, identify opportunities, and build next-generation Campaign Operations capabilities that go beyond traditional automation.
  • Build AI and technical solutions: Design, prototype, and implement solutions using AI agents, automation, APIs, and scripting, taking scoped projects from concept through implementation.
  • Own internal tools and agents: Maintain and improve the team's intake agent and other internal tools, including issue triage, stakeholder feedback, and a roadmap for what comes next.
  • Optimize operations: Find opportunities to improve scalability, efficiency, quality, and reliability across campaign workflows and systems, and measure the impact.
  • Lead cross-functional technical initiatives: Serve as the Campaign Operations point person for platform and workflow projects, such as marketing automation platform migrations, owning project plans, timelines, and stakeholder alignment while partnering with MarTech, MDA, Web Dev, Engineering, and vendor teams.
  • Own shared processes: Document, standardize, and automate capabilities such as list uploads and landing-page creation, building repeatable processes and clarifying dependencies with partner teams.
  • Shape the technical roadmap: Help shape and own the technical and AI roadmap for Campaign Operations: decide which capabilities to bring in-house, integrate, rebuild, or automate, and serve as the Campaign Ops subject matter expert and owner for the semantic layer and standardized skills that power our agentic workflows.
  • Provide lead flow backup coverage: Act as a backup point of contact for critical lead flow outages and technical troubleshooting (e.g., audit logs, vendor support), in partnership with the lead flow owners.
  • Enable the team: Share knowledge, drive adoption of new capabilities, and provide hands-on campaign execution support when needed.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 7+ years of hands-on campaign operations experience at a fast-paced B2B technology company, including hands-on execution of multi-channel campaigns (email, landing pages, webinars) in a marketing automation platform such as Marketo, Iterable, and/or HubSpot.
  • Proficiency building AI agents and automated workflows with tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Gumloop, n8n, or similar.
  • Proficiency in Python or JavaScript, plus working experience with APIs, integrations, and data manipulation.
  • Experience experimenting with emerging technologies and turning concepts into functional, maintainable solutions.
  • Strong project management and process orientation: able to scope, plan, and drive cross-functional initiatives from intake to delivery, and to document and standardize repeatable processes.
  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, curiosity, and a builder mindset.
  • Ability to work independently, collaborate cross-functionally, and adapt quickly in a fast-paced environment.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate operational needs into practical technical solutions.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience with Marketo and/or Iterable.
  • Familiarity with AI-native or AI-forward marketing automation platforms, and experience evaluating or migrating between MAPs.
  • Experience with SQL, Salesforce, Hightouch, Databricks, Airtable, Zapier, Workato, or Splash.
  • General marketing operations exposure to lead flow concepts such as routing, scoring, and lifecycle stages.
  • Familiarity with MCP, agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain), and semantic-layer concepts for agentic workflows.
  • Familiarity with email compliance regulations (e.g., GDPR, CAN-SPAM, CASL) and data privacy best practices.
  • Basic familiarity with HTML and CSS.

Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

$105,315—$159,300 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Our Commitment to Authenticity

You will play a key role in planning, coordinating, facilitating, and monitoring capacity-building initiatives across states, strengthening the Master Trainer and Cascade Trainer ecosystem, and enabling State Learning Experience (LE) SPOCs to take ownership of implementation.

The role requires experience in designing training content and learning experiences for educators, Master Trainers, and internal teams (prior experience in EdTech programs is an advantage). Primary focus areas include Computational Thinking, the Ideathon-Hackathon process, and Future Skills, with a growing emphasis on Artificial Intelligence and Career Readiness.

1. Training Design, Facilitation & Capacity Building

  • Design engaging trainings for internal teams, educators, and Master Trainers using a blended learning approach.

  • Facilitate and co-facilitate Training of Trainers (ToTs), webinars, review meetings, and other capacity-building spaces to deliver high-quality cascade trainings.

  • Work with State LE SPOCs to translate central capacity-building plans into state-level implementation.

  • Develop training content, resources, and facilitation plans aligned with program objectives.

  • Mentor and coach Master Trainers and state teams through timely feedback and implementation support.

  • Coordinate communities of practice, virtual learning spaces, and webinars.

  • Promote consistent use of training resources, facilitation practices, and learning processes across states.

2. Training Planning, Coordination & Review

  • Manage annual and quarterly training calendars in collaboration with state teams.

  • Coordinate training schedules, logistics, facilitators, participant communication, and overall training readiness.

  • Identify implementation challenges and coordinate timely support and resolution.

  • Collaborate with EdTech and cross-functional teams to ensure smooth rollout of digital learning initiatives and courses.

  • Lead training review meetings, analyze implementation and monitoring data, and provide actionable feedback to strengthen delivery.

  • Establish regular support touchpoints with State LE SPOCs and facilitate cross-state learning.

3. Implementation Quality, Monitoring & Continuous Improvement

  • Ensure quality implementation of the program and educator recognition strategy across states.

  • Conduct regular field visits to monitor implementation, gather feedback from educators and state teams, and identify support needs.

  • Track training participation and implementation progress using dashboards and monitoring data to share actionable insights.

  • Build the capacity of State LE SPOCs to independently plan, coordinate, monitor, and improve initiatives.

  • Support annual and quarterly review and planning processes with state teams and Master Trainers.

  • Bring field and implementation insights into central LE discussions to improve capacity-building strategy.

4. Stakeholder Coordination

  • Coordinate regularly with state teams and collaborate with Product, Monitoring, and Evaluation teams to support effective program implementation.

  • Surface field challenges and support timely issue resolution.

  • Build strong relationships with relevant stakeholders to strengthen ownership of capacity-building efforts.

5. Documentation & Knowledge Sharing

  • Document implementation experiences, challenges, adaptations, and emerging practices across states.

  • Capture and share success stories from field visits, review meetings, and educator interactions.

  • Prepare synthesis reports on implementation trends, support needs, and recommendations.

  • Maintain updated training resources and repositories.

Required Experience & Skills:

  • Experience: 4–5 years in designing and facilitating trainings, preferably within government school systems.

  • Models: Experience working with Master Trainer, Training of Trainers (ToT), or cascade-based capacity-building models.

  • Domain Knowledge: Experience in Computational Thinking, Coding/STEM, and Life & Career Skills.

  • Core Skills: Strong planning, coordination, stakeholder management, coaching, communication, and documentation skills.

  • Data-Driven: Ability to use data for planning, monitoring, and decision-making.

  • Mindset: Demonstrated ownership, accountability, adaptability, and willingness to travel for trainings and field visits.

Cyber Security Engineer, Software Solutions


About the role

Are you the kind of security engineer who wants to be in the code, not on the sidelines?


Our software teams move quickly to deliver solutions for commercial clients, and security needs to move just as fast. In this role, you’ll work directly alongside engineering teams, reviewing designs before they’re built, uncovering real vulnerabilities in real code, and helping make the secure path the easy path for developers.


This is a hands-on role. Expect to spend most of your week in code, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud configurations, not buried in policy documents.


What you will do

  • Perform threat modeling and security design review on new features and services, early enough to change the outcome.
  • Review application code for security defects, focused on authentication, authorization, injection, secrets handling, and dependency risk.
  • Own and tune the application security tooling in CI/CD: SAST, DAST, SCA, and secrets scanning. Reduce false positives so developers trust the results.
  • Triage findings from scans, bug bounty submissions, and client security reviews. Assign real severity, write reproducible tickets, and drive them to closure.
  • Review cloud infrastructure-as-code for misconfiguration, with a focus on identity, network boundaries, and data exposure.
  • Build secure defaults: reusable libraries, hardened baseline configurations, and paved-road patterns that remove entire vulnerability classes.
  • Support client-facing security questionnaires, penetration test remediation, and control evidence for SOC 2 or ISO 27001 audits.
  • Coach developers through pairing, review comments, and short internal training. Security literacy across the team is part of the deliverable.

Required qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional experience in application security, product security, or software engineering with security responsibilities.
  • Experience using at least one modern programming language in a production environment, such as Python, Java, C#, Go, TypeScript, or a similar language.
  • Experience working with OWASP Top 10 application security risks and vulnerabilities.
  • Experience working hands-on with at least one major cloud platform, such as Azure, AWS, or GCP, including identity and access management.
  • Experience integrating security tools into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience working hands-on with containers, including troubleshooting common container issues.

Preferred qualifications

  • Clear written communication. Vulnerability writeups that developers can act on without a follow-up meeting.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Bicep, or CloudFormation) and policy-as-code.
  • Exposure to SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, or HIPAA in a commercial delivery context.
  • Offensive security experience: CTFs, bug bounty participation, or professional penetration testing.
  • Certifications such as OSCP, GWAPT, GCSA, CCSP, or a cloud security specialty credential.
  • Experience in a consulting or multi-client delivery environment, where security standards have to travel across different client stacks.

jobs.description:
Title: Senior Data Engineer
Location: Remote
Clearance: Active DoD Top Secret
Employment Type: Full-time, W-2
Salary: $130,000 to $140,000


About the Role

VivSoft is seeking a Senior Data Engineer to support the Defense Counterintelligence and Security Agency's (DCSA) personnel vetting modernization under Trusted Workforce 2.0. You will own the data engineering behind the migration from the legacy Defense Information System for Security (DISS) to the modernized Personnel Vetting Adjudication and Access Management System (PVAAMS), running in AWS GovCloud at IL5.

This is the data role on the program's critical path: the migration has to be complete, reconciled, and provable, while the production systems on either side keep running. Every record is someone's clearance, so correctness is the mission, not just a metric. You will act as the de facto data lead for the DISS-to-PVAAMS migration and work alongside architects, security engineers, and other NBIS contractors on shared infrastructure.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Plan and lead large-scale data migration from DISS to PVAAMS, including schema mapping, transformation, reconciliation, cutover sequencing, and rollback planning.
  • Administer production databases through the release cycle: schema changes and conversions during application upgrades, production change support, replication and backup-site synchronization, and test environment refreshes.
  • Design, build, and maintain REST API and file-based data interfaces with upstream and downstream NBIS systems.
  • Run the data quality program: detect errors, coordinate with external data providers, and prove remediation through system queries within a 10-business-day resolution window.
  • Deliver governed ad hoc data services against 5- and 10-business-day SLAs.
  • Integrate continuous vetting data sources and support rules-based alert generation (FIS, EFI, Adjudicative Guidelines, SEAD).
  • Own backup, recovery, disaster recovery, and COOP procedures for all data stores, including documented and tested restoration.
  • Support RMF ATO evidence production, STIG hardening of database platforms, and IAVA remediation.
  • Participate in a 24x7 on-call rotation for data-affecting incidents and perform root-cause analysis.


Required Qualifications:

  • 6–9 years of professional data engineering experience.
  • Demonstrated experience leading large-scale data migration between a legacy production system and its modernized replacement.
  • Production database administration depth: schema evolution, release-driven conversions, replication, and refresh automation.
  • Experience building data interfaces using both APIs and file-based exchange.
  • AWS data services experience at scale in AWS GovCloud or an equivalent FedRAMP High / IL4+ environment.
  • Strong SQL, including writing reconciliation and remediation queries that prove a data issue is closed.
  • Backup, recovery, DR, and COOP design and execution for enterprise data stores.
  • Bachelor's degree in a related technical field, or equivalent experience year-for-year.
  • Active DoD Top Secret clearance (T5/T5R); must be enrolled in Continuous Evaluation / Continuous Vetting (CE/CV) prior to start.
  • U.S. person.
  • Willingness to participate in a 24x7 on-call rotation.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior DCSA, NBIS, DISS, DoD CAF/AVS, or personnel-security data experience; knowledge of the DISS data model is strongly preferred.
  • Continuous vetting data-source integration and rules-driven alert generation (FIS, EFI, AG, SEAD).
  • Experience with synthetic test-data tooling such as the DISS/PVAAMS DevSecOps Data Generator.
  • Analytics and risk-based assessment work supporting Trusted Workforce 2.0.
  • RMF ATO, STIG hardening, and IAVA remediation experience.
  • DoD 8140.01 / 8570.01-M baseline certification.
  • TS/SCI eligibility; current DCSA badge or active CAC.


About VivSoft

VivSoft solves complex federal problems with emerging and open technologies. We build secure software factories based on DoD reference designs and NIST frameworks, delivering AI/ML, data science, and microservices for DoD, healthcare, and civilian agencies.

VivSoft is an EO employer,  Veterans/Disabled and other protected categories.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

We are looking for a Senior DevOps / Infrastructure Engineer with strong hands-on experience in Google Cloud, Terraform and Kubernetes. If you enjoy the challenge of working with globally distributed clusters in an environment where security and scalability are taken seriously, this role is for you.

Our team has invested in a stable, observable platform. The next step is to scale that foundation. That means moving more workloads onto IaC, hardening our security posture, and preparing our services for rapid user growth. This is a hands-on role in a small, senior, fully remote team. You will own services end to end, make pragmatic technical decisions, and help other teams become self-sufficient. If you like keeping things simple, standard, well automated and monitored, come talk to us.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build and maintain our Google Cloud infrastructure using Terraform, with the goal of having all production infrastructure defined as code and reviewed through pull requests.

  • Run and evolve our Kubernetes (GKE) clusters, including cluster upgrades, capacity planning, autoscaling, networking and workload isolation.

  • Migrate remaining manually deployed services onto Kubernetes, with documented and repeatable deployment flows.

  • Consolidate configuration, access and user management across Google Cloud projects into a single source of truth.

  • Keep separate, clearly bounded environments for internal services, partner workloads and future community facing services.

  • Partner with the other internal teams to move their infrastructure onto infrastructure as code and Kubernetes.

  • Keep GitHub Actions secure and efficient: pinned dependencies, least privilege tokens, sensible runner usage and controlled costs.

  • Maintain and extend our metrics, logging and alerting stack so that every service has metrics, logs and actionable alerts.

  • Apply least privilege access across Google Cloud, Kubernetes and GitHub, and review temporary admin rights regularly.

  • Contribute to the team's quarterly and yearly roadmap and give realistic estimates, including proposing discovery periods for complex projects.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, platform or infrastructure engineering roles, including at least 2 years running production workloads at a senior level.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes in production, including deployments, networking, upgrades, autoscaling and troubleshooting.

  • Strong experience with Terraform, including module design, state management and managing multiple environments.

  • Solid experience with Google Cloud Platform (GKE, IAM, networking, Pub/Sub or similar managed services).

  • Experience setting up and operating observability tooling for metrics, logs and alerting in Grafana (or similar) stack.

  • Experience building CI/CD pipelines, ideally with GitHub Actions, and building and running containerised services with Docker.

  • Good understanding of security best practices, including secrets management, IAM and least privilege access.

  • Strong Linux and networking fundamentals comfortable scripting Bash.

  • Experience migrating manually managed services onto infrastructure as code.

  • Able to work independently in a fully remote, async team, prioritise your own work and communicate clearly with stakeholders.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

Preferred

  • Google Cloud certification (for example Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer or Professional Cloud Architect) or a Kubernetes certification (CKA or CKS).

  • Experience running infrastructure for environments with strict security requirements.

  • Experience with push notification infrastructure (Firebase Cloud Messaging, APNs) at scale.

  • Familiarity with peer-to-peer or distributed systems.

  • Familiarity with services and how to run them in production.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Every therapist on the remote caseload starts with six in-person brace fittings on patients from your own current caseload, so you know the devices you will be coaching patients on. This is not a sales role. We do not ask you to refer; you treat patients you already see.

After six fittings

• Free specialized training and certification in orthopedic bracing.

• Keep your current job. This is additional, independent-contractor work alongside it.

    • Active physical therapist or physical therapist assistant license in the state where you practice.

jobs.excerpt: Job Description Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?
jobs.description:
Job Description

Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Uniquely Yours.

You work with the information security team as a competent and experienced information security and compliance specialist.

How you will contribute

You will assess information security risks in line with internal policy and external best practices, and support security of information and IT assets by testing security systems and applying security standards, policies, and procedures. Under the guidance of global information security lead, you will implement cyber security technology and provide day-to-day business support. If relevant to your role, you will manage third-party providers to ensure that any internal or third-party adhere to standards. You will also provide information security training to appropriate teams.

What you will bring

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career. You will bring experience and knowledge in:

  • Information security, compliance and risk management
  • Security solutions and their applicability to Mondelēz International
  • Security strategies, awareness campaigns, policies/standards and governance
  • Communicating effectively with technical specialists, leaders and peers
  • Analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Being a team player by supporting and leading to achieve common goals

Reporting to the Global IT Compliance Lead, as an IT Compliance Manager, the successful candidate will be proficient at managing risk-based IT compliance initiatives across Mondelez. The role is key in the successful delivery of the annual Sarbanes-Oxley information technology compliance program and the operationalization of EU NIS2 Directive requirements for all in-scope applications and supported technologies. In addition, the candidate will be performing compliance activities related to technology assurance areas around access management, vulnerability management, and configuration management, among others. Candidate will also demonstrate ability and experience in governance related activities including administrative management of risk and control registers as well as policies and standards.


How You Will Contribute

Assurance Program Responsibilities

  • Conduct assurance activities related to the annual SOX Compliance audit with a specific focus of IT General Controls and Vendor SOX Compliance.
  • Review and assess SOC1 Type 2 reports from third-party service providers to evaluate the design and operating effectiveness of controls relevant to the organization.
  • Perform quarterly compliance assurance testing and document testing evidence and results in alignment with defined evidence quality standards to maintain audit-ready assurances.
  • Maintain the Management Action Plan (MAP) catalog with due dates. Manage monthly MAP status reporting, including timely communication of open MAPs to stakeholders and escalation of risks to completing MAPs by their agreed delivery dates.
  • Perform administrative activities in the GRC solution for compliance-related activities, including maintaining risk and control documentation.
  • Manage ad-hoc external IT audits.
  • Support GRC Lead for CTO/CISO focused internal audits.
  • Support compliance program reporting activities.

Requirements

  • 7 years in one or more of the following fields: Information Security, SOX Compliance, Internal Controls, Internal Audit or GRC
  • 3+ years leading or supporting Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) IT compliance program for or on behalf of a US-listed company.
  • Demonstrated experience reviewing and assessing SOC1 Type 2 reports, including evaluating complementary user entity controls (CUECs) and identifying control gaps in third-party service providers.
  • Direct experience with EU cybersecurity regulations, NIS2 Directive, GDPR, CCPA, EU AI Act
  • Experience with GRC tools (e.g., Archer).
  • ISACA CISA, CISM and/or CRISC Certifications (significant plus)
  • Knowledge of security concepts and methodologies such as risk assessments, risk & controls, policies & standards, enterprise security strategies, network, and cloud security.
  • Working knowledge of security and compliance frameworks such as CIS, NIST and ISO
  • Excellent written and verbal communications skills, including presentational skills and able to clearly communicate issues to management and other key stakeholders.

Requires 25% of travel

The responsibilities of this position are performed within the framework of a regional business model that is defined and managed by Mondelēz Europe GmbH, Switzerland.

No Relocation support available

Business Unit Summary

Mondelēz International, Inc. empowers people to snack right in over 150 countries around the world. We are leading the future of snacking with mouth-watering iconic brands such as Oreo, belVita, LU and Ritz biscuits; Cadbury Dairy Milk, Green & Blacks, Milka and Toblerone chocolate; Philadelphia and Dairylea cheese; and Maynards Bassetts, Trebor and Trident gums. Our more than 80,000 colleagues around the world are key to the success of our business. Great people and great brands. That’s who we are. Join us on our journey to continue leading the future of snacking around the world by offering the right snack, for the right moment, made the right way.

Mondelēz International is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.description:
Description

Tufin helps enterprises govern and secure connectivity across complex multi-vendor networks. The network is entering the agentic era, and Tufin is the first and only solution built for protecting it – we're growing fast, and this is a chance to help build a brand-new category from the ground up.

We are hiring a Channel Marketing Director to lead and scale our partner marketing motion across our Value-Added Reseller (VAR) and distributor ecosystem in North America and EMEA. This is a rare chance to build the channel marketing function from the ground up inside a company defining a brand-new security category – your work will directly shape how Tufin wins in the agentic era.

Your goal: increase Tufin’s awareness and mindshare with key partners across North America and EMEA, turn that mindshare into measurable partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, and work with our Global Channel Account Managers (CAMs) to navigate accounts and build momentum in partner-led deals in both regions. Alongside that, you’ll set the strategy, budget, and operating model for channel marketing, spanning partner enablement, communications, the MDF program, co-marketing campaigns, and channel reporting. The role reports to the VP, Channels and works closely with Global CAMs, Sales Leadership, Product Marketing, and Field Marketing.

Responsibilities

  • Define and own the channel marketing strategy, roadmap, and budget for North America and EMEA
  • Build executive relationships at strategic partners and work with Global CAMs to accelerate partner-led deals
  • Lead partner campaigns and co-marketing programs with Field Marketing, localized by region
  • Direct partner enablement materials in partnership with Product Marketing
  • Own the MDF program and budget, including allocation, ROI tracking, and compliance
  • Own partner communications, including the monthly newsletter and program updates
  • Own the partner portal, training, and certification programs
  • Set KPIs and pipeline targets, and report results to leadership

Requirements

  • 8+ years in channel or partner marketing, including 3+ years leading a program, budget, and team – ideally in cybersecurity or enterprise infrastructure software
  • Experience building programs with VARs and distributors across North America and EMEA; existing relationships with partners like CDW, Computacenter, GuidePoint, NTT, Optiv, Trace3, or WWT are ideal
  • Track record running and localizing channel programs across North America and EMEA
  • AI-first mentality for scaling operations, content, and data
  • Analytical, able to turn partner funnel data into improvement plans
  • Hands-on MDF program experience, including regional compliance (e.g., GDPR, FCPA, UK Bribery Act)
  • Strong program leadership across multiple partners and workstreams
  • Excellent communicator, credible with partner sellers, architects, and executives
  • Builder mindset: comfortable with ambiguity in an early-stage program
