Job Title: TAX MANAGER
Reports to: Sr. Tax Manager
Department: Partner Success
Duration: Full-time (flexibility to work occasional nights and weekends, particularly during tax season)
Salary:$105,000 to $125,000 base annual salary, plus a 5% to 10% SLA and performance based bonus (total target compensation of $110,250 to $137,500)
Location: Remote (Headquarter Office in Coconut Grove, FL)

About Taxfyle

Taxfyle is a technology-enabled tax preparation platform that connects individuals and businesses with qualified tax professionals to deliver a seamless, efficient, and accurate filing experience. Our platform brings together tax expertise, technology, and automation to modernize the way professional tax services are delivered. Headquartered in Coconut Grove, Florida, Taxfyle is a fast-moving technology company focused on making professional services more accessible through technology and innovation.

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced Tax Manager to prepare, review, and sign off on individual and business tax returns as a member of Taxfyle’s internal tax team. Reporting to the Senior Tax Manager, this role carries final review and signing authority on the returns in its portfolio and is expected to work independently, making sound technical judgment calls without requiring a second level of review. This is not a junior role. Candidates must already hold an active CPA license or Enrolled Agent credential and have experience serving as the final reviewer or signing preparer of record on individual and business returns. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports; the Tax Manager will collaborate closely with teammates and partner with other departments across the company.

Taxfyle is a technology startup, and we are looking for a tax professional who is as comfortable with technology as they are with the tax. The Tax Manager will actively use AI and automation to create efficiencies in their own workflow, help Taxfyle scale capacity during tax season without sacrificing quality, and partner with Product and Engineering to shape how AI is used to modernize tax preparation and review.

Key Responsibilities

Tax Review & Sign Off

  • Independently review and sign off on federal and state individual and business tax returns, including Forms 1040, 1065, 1120, and 1120S, as the signing preparer of record.
  • Prepare complex returns from start to finish when needed, including multistate filings.
  • Review returns prepared by Taxfyle tax professionals for accuracy, completeness, and compliance, and resolve review notes directly.
  • Research complex tax issues independently, document conclusions, and apply sound professional judgment.
  • Apply Taxfyle review standards, checklists, and quality controls consistently on every return.
  • Escalate only unusual, high risk, or precedent setting matters to the Senior Tax Manager.
  • Maintain organized, audit ready workpapers and documentation that support every signed return.

AI, Technology & Workflow Efficiency

  • Use AI tools, tax software, and workflow platforms every day to prepare and review returns faster and more accurately.
  • Proactively find ways to use AI to remove manual steps from your own workflow, such as document review, data extraction, research, workpaper preparation, and client communication drafts.
  • Validate AI generated outputs carefully and confirm accuracy before any return is signed.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for Product and Engineering, testing new AI and automation features and giving practical feedback to improve them.
  • Share AI workflows, prompts, and best practices with the tax team so efficiencies scale across the team.
  • Stay current on emerging tax technology and AI tools, and recommend new tools where they can save time or improve quality.

Client Service & SLAs

  • Complete assigned reviews and returns within established turnaround times and service level agreements (SLAs).
  • Communicate with clients through the Taxfyle platform to clarify information, explain results in plain language, and set clear expectations on timelines and next steps.
  • Respond to and help resolve IRS and state notices related to returns you signed.
  • Partner with Partner Success to resolve client escalations quickly and professionally.

Workflow & Team Collaboration

  • Manage an assigned review and preparation workload, and keep job status current in Taxfyle systems so leadership has accurate visibility into capacity and backlog.
  • Meet the productivity, quality, and SLA goals set by the Senior Tax Manager, which determine eligibility for the SLA and performance based bonus.
  • Collaborate with teammates by sharing technical knowledge and review insights to raise overall quality.
  • Help identify recurring errors and contribute to review checklists, training materials, and process improvements.
  • Work closely with the Senior Tax Manager, Partner Success, Operations, Product, and Engineering.
  • Support peak season demands, including extended hours leading up to filing deadlines.

Requirements

  • Active CPA license (any US state) or Enrolled Agent (EA) credential, in good standing.
  • Active IRS Preparer Tax Identification Number (PTIN).
  • 5+ years of progressive tax preparation and review experience in public accounting or a professional tax practice, including 2+ years as final reviewer or signing preparer of record on Forms 1040, 1065, 1120, and/or 1120S.
  • Strong technical knowledge of individual and business tax returns, including Forms 1040, 1065, 1120, and 1120S, and multistate filings.
  • Proven ability to work independently and make sound technical judgment calls without a second level of review.
  • Strong comfort with technology and demonstrated use of AI tools (such as generative AI assistants or AI features within tax and document software) to create efficiencies in your daily work is strongly preferred.
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI generated work for accuracy and to know when human judgment is strongly preferred.
  • Proficiency with professional tax software, such as UltraTax CS, Lacerte, ProConnect, Drake, or CCH Axcess, and the ability to learn new platforms quickly.
  • Proven ability to manage a high volume of returns while meeting deadlines and service level expectations.
  • Clear, professional written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain tax matters to clients and collaborate effectively with teammates and other departments.
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and time management skills.
  • Ability to stay productive and accountable in a remote or hybrid environment.
  • Comfortable working in a fast paced technology company where processes and tools evolve as the organization grows.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands on experience building or improving AI, automation, or workflow tools in a tax or accounting setting.
  • Experience in a technology startup, SaaS, fintech, or technology enabled professional services environment.
  • Experience reviewing work in a high volume or distributed tax practice.
  • Experience with trust returns (Form 1041) and IRS or state representation.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in accounting, taxation, finance, or a related field.

Note: This role description is intended to convey information essential to understanding the scope of the role and is not exhaustive. Duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may evolve or change over time to meet the organization’s needs.

All employees are expected to fulfill the information security responsibilities applicable to their role as defined in the Tickmark Security Plan. At minimum, all employees must:

jobs.excerpt: AHEAD builds platforms for digital business.  By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.
jobs.description:
AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.
At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD.
We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived.
We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD.

AHEAD helps large enterprises assess, design, build, and migrate to modern cloud and AI infrastructure platforms, and increasingly helps those same enterprises design, build, and run AI agent platforms on top of them. This role sits in the AIC Platform Engineering practice, alongside consultants who lead cloud assessments, landing zone build-outs, migrations, on-premises AI infrastructure builds, and enterprise AI agent platforms. As a Senior Technical Consultant, you will deliver assigned client workstreams across discovery, design, implementation, and handoff, partnering with project leads and teammates and leaving client teams able to operate what you build.

You will be aligned to one primary platform focus: a public cloud (Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, or Google Cloud) or on-premises NVIDIA AI infrastructure. The responsibilities and skills below are written in platform-neutral terms; Appendix A maps each capability to the specific services and products for each focus. Public cloud roles are delivered mostly remotely with client site travel. On-premises roles involve more time in client data centers, including racking, cabling, and commissioning GPU infrastructure, while still integrating with client cloud environments.

This is a hands-on role with delivery leadership attached. You will write infrastructure code, agent code, and the documents that client governance boards approve. You will lead technical workstreams, provide project-by-project direction and mentoring to teammates, and remain accountable for the quality and outcomes of your assigned work. You will present your work to engineering leaders and executives, and teach client makers, developers, and platform teams how to build on what you delivered. Our clients include firms in regulated and confidentiality-driven industries, so the platforms you build are private-networked, policy-governed, and evaluated before anything reaches production.

What you will do

    Consulting and delivery leadership

  • Work directly with client stakeholders to interpret business and operational challenges and translate them into the right technical solution, whether that is a landing zone, a migration wave, an on-premises GPU build-out, or an agentic platform: which platform fits, what data and governance boundaries apply, and what the first production candidate should be.
  • Provide technical direction to project teammates: clarify tasks and standards, review work, help resolve blockers, and support less-experienced consultants in growing their delivery skills.
  • Partner with project and account teams to scope workstreams, define deliverables, estimate effort, identify risks and mitigations, and keep delivery on plan as client priorities shift.
  • Build client trust through dependable delivery, clear communication, and consistent follow-through.
  • Serve as a technical voice in client steering and working sessions, presenting options with tradeoffs and a clear recommendation rather than a menu.
  • Provide mentorship and coaching for teammates, and contribute actively to AHEAD's technical communities.

    • Platform engineering

  • Lead discovery and assessment engagements: current-state architecture reviews, workload and application inventories, dependency mapping, and readiness assessments that inform landing zone, migration, and capacity roadmaps. For on-premises work, this includes GPU workload profiling and power, cooling, rack density, and network fabric readiness.
  • Design and deploy enterprise-scale landing zones aligned to the platform vendor's reference architecture: organizational hierarchy, hub-and-spoke or equivalent network topology, policy-as-code guardrails, centralized logging, and identity and access foundations. For on-premises work, design and deploy GPU cluster reference architectures with a high-speed interconnect fabric and storage sized to GPU throughput.
  • Plan and execute migrations: workload assessment and right-sizing, migration wave sequencing, cutover runbooks, and post-migration validation across compute, storage, databases, and containers, including AI and ML workload migrations onto on-premises GPU clusters and hybrid bursting patterns to cloud GPU capacity.
  • Establish hybrid and cross-premises connectivity: dedicated private circuits, VPN gateways, and DNS strategies that connect client on-premises environments to cloud platforms.
  • Own cost and capacity governance: budgets and alerts, tagging or labeling standards, commitment-based discount strategy, GPU utilization monitoring, capacity planning, and showback or chargeback reporting.
  • Develop and implement infrastructure as code and CI/CD solutions for every platform you deliver, using branching strategies and automated promotion rather than manual change.

    • AI agent platform engineering and delivery

  • Design and deploy managed agent platforms and model-serving environments for enterprise clients, including network-isolated configurations behind client firewalls: private endpoints, private DNS, subnet delegation, managed identity and role-based access design, and customer-managed encryption keys.
  • Stand up governance for client agent platforms: environment strategy, data loss prevention baselines, connector and tool governance, generative AI settings, channel approval flows, and licensing and capacity guidance.
  • Build promotion pipelines that move agents from sandbox to production through automated tests, evaluation thresholds, and human approval gates implemented as environment protection rules.
  • Implement evaluation and safety frameworks: golden datasets, quality, retrieval, and safety evaluators run in CI, content guardrails, and compensating controls for model paths where platform content filtering does not apply.
  • Develop agents in code with the platform's agent SDK and in its low-code tooling, and establish application lifecycle management so agents and fine-tuned models move between environments by pipeline rather than by hand.
  • Advise clients on model selection and placement across the platform's model catalog, including proprietary, partner, and open-weight models, with data residency, in-region or on-premises inference, and cost as first-class constraints.

    • Documentation and enablement

  • Author the design documents, as-builts, build guides, technical roadmaps, capacity plans, and runbooks the client operates from after the engagement ends.
  • Run workshops, enablement sessions, and office hours for client makers, developers, and administrators.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive | New Logo | Mumbai
jobs.excerpt: At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust.
jobs.description:
At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.

The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #OneJamf.

What you’ll do at Jamf:

The Enterprise New Logo Account Executive INDIA is a results-driven hunter responsible for identifying, pursuing, and closing new enterprise logos for Jamf. Focused exclusively on net-new acquisition within the enterprise segment (organizations with 1,000+ employees), this role requires strong prospecting discipline, the ability to manage complex multi-stakeholder sales cycles, and the consultative acumen to position Jamf's Apple Enterprise Management solutions at the executive level. Success in this role is defined by consistent pipeline generation, new logo attainment, and laying the foundation for long-term customer partnerships.

We are currently looking for 3 new colleagues. This role is offered in INDIA only, preferably for candidates located in Mumbai, Bangalore, Chennai/Hyderabad and used to travel in the territory.

What you can expect to do this role:

New Logo Prospecting & Pipeline Development

  • Build and manage a targeted outbound prospecting motion to identify and engage net-new enterprise accounts within an assigned segment or territory.
  • Develop segment fluency — understanding buyer personas, common objections, industry-specific compliance needs, and Apple ecosystem maturity within target accounts.
  • Partner with Marketing, Business Development, and Channel partners to execute coordinated account-based prospecting that feeds a healthy, qualified pipeline.
  • Maintain consistent pipeline coverage and hygiene, ensuring sufficient volume and stage diversity to meet and exceed quota targets.

Enterprise Sales Cycle Management

  • Manage the full sales cycle from initial outreach and discovery through proposal, negotiation, and close — navigating the complexity typical of enterprise buying processes.
  • Identify and engage multiple stakeholders across IT, Security, Finance, Legal, Procurement, and executive leadership to build multi-threaded relationships within target accounts.
  • Apply a structured qualification methodology (e.g., MEDDPICC) to assess deal health, prioritize effort, and improve forecast accuracy.
  • Navigate enterprise procurement processes, including security reviews, DPAs, and SLAs, with support from Jamf Legal and internal stakeholders.
  • Develop and deliver compelling business cases, demonstrations, and ROI presentations tailored to the priorities of diverse buying audiences.

Commercial & Deal Execution

  • Structure initial commercial agreements that are competitive, value-aligned, and appropriately sized to facilitate a strong land — with long-term expansion in mind.
  • Negotiate contract terms with support from Jamf Legal and Finance, maintaining deal momentum while protecting Jamf's commercial interests.
  • Maintain competitive positioning in deals where incumbents or alternatives are present; articulate Jamf's differentiated value with confidence.

Partner & Ecosystem Engagement

  • Build productive working relationships with Apple's enterprise sales team and Jamf's channel and reseller partners to generate introductions and support deal execution.
  • Engage partner resources appropriately to accelerate pipeline and strengthen account access, especially within named accounts or complex organizations.

Forecasting, Reporting & Team Contribution

  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date records in Salesforce, including account activity, pipeline stage, and deal notes, to support individual and team forecasting.
  • Provide consistent, reliable monthly and quarterly forecasts, with clear visibility into deal status and expected close timelines.
  • Share learnings from the field — win/loss patterns, competitive intelligence, objection themes — to contribute to team and segment knowledge.

What we are looking for:

  • Minimum of 5 years of B2B SaaS or technology sales experience with a demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding quota (Required)
  • Professional working proficiency in English (required)
  • Experience managing complex enterprise sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders, including IT and executive-level buyers (Required)
  • Proven ability to generate pipeline through outbound prospecting, partner engagement, and marketing collaboration (Required)
  • Familiarity with a structured sales qualification methodology (e.g., MEDDPICC, MEDDIC, SPIN) and ability to apply it to assess deal health (Required)
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in both direct and indirect (channel/partner) selling models (Required)
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to deliver clear and persuasive presentations to technical and business audiences (Required)
  • Proficiency with Salesforce or equivalent CRM for pipeline tracking, forecasting, and activity documentation (Required)
  • Consultative, solutions-oriented selling approach with the ability to connect technology to business outcomes (Preferred)
  • Familiarity with Apple enterprise ecosystem, endpoint management, or SaaS security solutions (Preferred)
  • Experience navigating enterprise procurement processes including DPAs, SLAs, and security reviews (Preferred)
  • Self-directed and resilient; able to manage long sales cycles and ambiguous buying processes with discipline and focus (Preferred)
  • Travel in territory minimum Mumbai 40%; Bangalore 50% and Hyderabad 50%.

SECURITY AND PRIVACY REQUIREMENTS

  • Participation in ongoing security training is mandatory.
  • Established security protocols will be adhered to, sensitive data will be handled responsibly, and data protection practices are followed, including understanding relevant privacy regulations and reporting breaches.
  • Acknowledging the Jamf Code of Conduct, where applicable security and privacy policies can be found, is a requirement of all roles at Jamf.

Why Jamf?

  • Named a Fortune Best Workplace for Millennials, 2021.
  • We offer a clear and defined sales career path. Our main goal is to help you successfully step into our Account Executive role, but there are many ways to advance your career at Jamf.
  • We train and then we give you the room to grow. Our Jamfs can explore the vertical career path, as well as the horizontal, to discover new interests and opportunities.
  • You don’t have to be a techie to be a Jamf. Our best-in-class sales focused Bootcamp training provides you with the technical and product knowledge required to confidently talk with customers about Jamf.
  • We set achievable targets, help each other out, and share best practices across the team.
  • You will have the opportunity to make a real and meaningful impact for more than 70,000 global customers with the best Apple device management solution in the world.
  • We put people over profits – which is why our customers keep coming back to us.
  • We encourage you to simply be you. We constantly seek and value different perspectives to ensure Jamf is a place where everyone feels comfortable and can be successful.
  • 23 of 25 world’s most valuable brands rely on Jamf to do their best work (as ranked by Forbes).

What it means to be a Jamf?We are a team of free-thinkers, can-doers, and problem-crushers. We value humility and the relentless pursuit of knowledge. Our culture flows from a spirit of selflessness and relentless self-improvement - driving both personal growth and collective progress throughout our company. We unite around common goals while respecting personal approaches, believing that fulfilled individuals create a thriving, vibrant workplace.

Our aim is simple: hire exceptionally good people who are incredibly good at what they do and let them do it. We provide the support and resources to let everyone be their authentic, best selves at work, at rest, and at play. We are committed to supporting the continual improvement of Apple in the workplace, the organizations that rely on them and the people who keep it all running smoothly.

Above it all, waves our banner of #OneJamf – and the knowledge that when we stand together, we accomplish so much more than we could alone. We seek individuals who share this unwavering journey toward growth to join us in our quest for constant improvement.

What does Jamf do?Jamf extends the legendary Apple experience people enjoy in their personal lives to the workplace. We believe the experience of using a device at work or school should feel the same, and be as secure as, using a personal device. With Jamf, customers are able to confidently automate Mac, iPad, iPhone and Apple TV deployment, management, and security – anytime, anywhere – to protect the data and applications used by employees in the workplace, students learning in the classroom, and streamline communications in healthcare between patients and providers. More than 2,500 Jamf strong worldwide, we are free-thinkers, can-doers, and problems crushers who are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work each and every day.

Get social with us and follow the conversation at #OneJamf

Jamf is committed to creating an inclusive & supportive work environment for all candidates and employees. Candidates with disabilities or religious beliefs are encouraged to reach out if they need additional support or alternative options to our recruiting processes to accommodate their disability or religious belief. If you need an accommodation, please contact your Recruiter or Recruiting Coordinator directly. Requests for accommodation will be handled confidentially by Recruiting and will not be shared with the hiring manager. Jamf is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against individuals who request reasonable accommodation for disability or religious beliefs. jobs.description:
We are looking for a highly experienced and driven Senior Software Engineer to join our AI and container cloud infrastructure delivery team. In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain code that extends and customizes CNCF container platform components — including Kubernetes and its ecosystem — to run AI workloads on cutting-edge NVIDIA-certified hardware from leading vendors.

You will work hand in hand with our Senior Site Reliability Engineers on the same customer projects. While the SRE deploys and operates the platform, you will own the software changes it requires: Kubernetes operators and controllers, custom resources, scheduler extensions, device plugins, admission webhooks, CNI/CSI integrations, and patches to upstream projects. Together you will turn architecture and implementation designs into reliable, secure, and performant production systems.

As a senior engineer, you will work closely with stakeholders to shape technical solutions, solve complex engineering challenges, and mentor team members and Mirantis customers. This is an excellent opportunity to make a significant impact on open source infrastructure for AI in a rapidly evolving cloud ecosystem.

Main Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain software that extends and modifies Kubernetes and other CNCF components for AI workloads (operators, controllers, CRDs, schedulers, device plugins, admission webhooks, CNI/CSI drivers).
  • Partner closely with Senior SREs on shared projects, turning operational requirements and field findings into robust code changes.
  • Integrate GPU and high-performance networking and storage capabilities into the container platform, working with NVIDIA software stacks such as the GPU Operator and Network Operator.
  • Fork, patch, and maintain open source components where customer needs require it, and contribute fixes and features back upstream.
  • Build automation, tooling, and CI/CD pipelines for building, testing, and releasing platform components.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather and refine technical requirements and translate them into software designs.
  • Optimize the performance, reliability, scalability, and security of platform code.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve complex issues across the software, Kubernetes, Linux, and hardware layers.
  • Write and participate in code reviews to maintain high quality standards.
  • Work with geographically distributed international teams on technical challenges and process improvements.
  • Apply AI-assisted development practices across the software lifecycle, including code generation, testing, and maintenance.
  • Produce clear technical documentation and facilitate knowledge transfer to customers during delivery.
  • Stay up to date with industry trends and best practices in cloud-native and AI infrastructure development.

Required Skills/Abilities

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience, with a strong focus on cloud and infrastructure software.
  • Strong proficiency in Golang, with working knowledge of other programming languages (Python, Bash, and ideally Rust or C).
  • Hands-on experience extending Kubernetes: writing controllers or operators (client-go, controller-runtime, Kubebuilder or Operator SDK), CRDs, and webhooks.
  • Solid understanding of Kubernetes internals (API server, scheduler, kubelet, container runtimes) and how its extension points work.
  • Strong knowledge of distributed systems, microservices architecture, API design, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Good understanding of Linux systems, networking, and storage as they relate to containerized workloads.
  • Solid software engineering practices: automated testing (unit, integration, e2e), version control with Git, code review, and release management.
  • Exceptional problem-solving and debugging skills, with attention to performance optimization and security.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical tasks and collaborate effectively with diverse teams, including operations and SRE colleagues.
  • Comfortable making independent judgment calls when working directly with customers, often with limited day-to-day oversight.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

  • Excellent customer-facing communication skills.
  • Ability to travel up to 25% if needed, including internationally.

Nice to have

  • Upstream contributions to Kubernetes or other CNCF projects (e.g., Cluster API, Kueue, Volcano, KubeVirt, Cilium, Istio, Helm).
  • Experience with GPU and high-performance computing software: Kubernetes device plugins, Dynamic Resource Allocation (DRA), GPU scheduling, MIG/vGPU, NVIDIA GPU Operator and Network Operator, DCGM, or NVIDIA AI Enterprise.
  • Experience with RDMA/RoCE or InfiniBand fabrics, NVLink, SR-IOV, or Multus networking in Kubernetes.
  • Experience with AI/ML platform components such as Kubeflow, KServe, Ray, or LLM inference servers (vLLM, Triton).
  • Experience building CNI or CSI plugins, or deep knowledge of network and/or storage architecture.
  • Familiarity with GitOps tooling (Flux, Argo CD) and policy engines (OPA/Gatekeeper, Kyverno).
  • Experience with OpenStack development or operations.
  • Prior experience with commercial container and virtual compute platforms such as Rancher, OpenShift, and VMware.

Ready to own it, build it, and grow it?

The Mission:

Publitas lets people, and increasingly agents, create, host and distribute digital flyers and catalogues for retail brands. Our customers include ALDI, IKEA, Carrefour, Metro and Decathlon. Right now we’re building a fully automatic, agentic workflow that generates a whole catalogue from a brand guide and a list of products.

As a Staff Product Engineer, you’ll build this product hands-on, taking open-ended problems to working software in whatever part of the stack the problem needs. You’ll join a team of senior engineers who are put on our hardest problems, some of which cut across teams. Our customer base is large (not Google scale, but big), so what you ship gets used, and it comes with real technical challenges. Our core stack is Ruby on Rails on the backend and JavaScript with React on the frontend, with services around it in JavaScript, TypeScript and Python. This is a staff-level role, and you’ll have a lot of influence in a mid-sized company with very little red tape.

This role is for you if

  • You've built several complete products and you'd enjoy showing them to us.

  • You like open-ended problems, and you'd rather work out what to build than be handed a spec.

  • You enjoy problems that are hard to think through, and you can point to one you cracked.

  • You get excited about the end result, not just the code.

  • AI has changed what you dare to build: you ship faster, and you take on projects you’d never have started alone.

  • You want real influence in a mid-sized company with a large customer base and very little red tape.

It's probably not for you if

  • You prefer to stay in one layer of the stack.

  • You want a detailed spec or a clear list of tasks before you start.

  • You're still trying AI out rather than building with it every day.

Where and when you work

The role is fully remote, and most of the stakeholders and peers work Central European hours. Nobody sets your schedule, but we'd like around six hours of overlap with the team on a normal day. In practice that works best if you live within about two hours of CET.

Show us what you've built

When you apply, point us to things you've made. Complete, working applications say the most, but libraries and tools are welcome too. We'd love to hear how you built them.

What We Offer You to Win

  • Transparent Compensation: A competitive salary (geo-bracketed to your location in the EU) with a clear, performance-based path for career progression.

  • True Remote Autonomy: No clock-watching or useless alignment meetings. You manage your territory as if it were your own business.

  • Global Team Retreats: Working remotely shouldn't mean working isolated. We gather the entire company in inspiring cities across the globe once a year to connect, strategize, and celebrate in person.

  • Modern Sales Stack & Gear: A premium MacBook, remote work accessories, and a co-working budget if you want to work outside your home.

  • Personal Growth Budget: A monthly wellness allowance, an education/course budget to sharpen your skills, and free access to Kindle and Audible books.

  • Time Off: 25 days of paid vacation plus your local national holidays.

At Publitas, we see AI as a core lever for performance, efficiency, and innovation. We expect all team members to actively use AI in their daily work to improve quality, speed, and output.

Depending on the role, this ranges from effectively using AI tools in day-to-day workflows to designing and scaling AI-driven systems. We are not looking for candidates who are “AI-curious”; we look for people who already use AI to do better work and can demonstrate tangible impact.

jobs.description:
As the most trusted global leader in data-first contract lifecycle management (CLM) software, Agiloft helps organizations manage the end-to-end process of proposing, negotiating, signing, and leveraging contracts using our flexible Data-first Agreement Platform (DAP). With contract data as the foundation, customers quickly and collaboratively reach agreement and leverage contract visibility to thrive with competitive advantage. Employing powerful, pragmatic artificial intelligence as a legal force multiplier, and robust integration capabilities as a data liberator, organizations around the world trust Agiloft’s certified implementers to deliver connected, intelligent, and autonomous solutions across the entire contract lifecycle.
Top analysts like Gartner, Forrester, and IDC agree, all showing Agiloft as a leader in the CLM space. Our no code platform is easily managed and administered by business users, which is why Agiloft is the contract you keep: nearly a full 100% of new customers are satisfied with their initial implementations, and some 97% of customers renew every year. Ours is a growing, vibrant, successful company that is at the forefront of a market that is becoming a must-have for all organizations.
We believe that the way to build the strongest, most vibrant place to work is to bring in individuals from all walks of life, and to support them in bringing their authentic selves to their day, every day. Our working philosophy is that “EX = CX”: when employee experience is excellent, so is customer experience. We support multiple Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), and offer a working environment that supports healthy work/life balance, including floating holidays and a quarterly, no-questions-asked wellness day.

Position Overview

Agiloft's customers rely on our Ecosystem of System Integration (SI) partners to help them design, build and deliver solutions on the Agiloft platform. This role is designed to help our partners build robust capabilities within their organization and ultimately ensure our customers are realizing maximum value from the platform.

As Partner Solution Architect, you'll support the partners as a technical advisor for partner-led implementations from kickoff through go-live. You'll guide SIs on architecture, integrations, data sync, and configuration. When something breaks, you'll figure out whether it's a configuration issue, an integration issue, or a real product defect, and get it to the right owner.

You'll sit in the Partner Center of Excellence, the team responsible for making partner delivery repeatable and high quality. Our Partner Alliance Managers own the overall relationship with each partner and this role will be responsible for the successful technical outcome and capability development. You'll work daily with Sales, Professional Services, Product, Engineering, and Support, and you'll turn what you learn on each project into playbooks the whole ecosystem can use.

Job Responsibilities

    What you'll do

    Guide Partners to Go-live

  • Serve as the product & technical point of contact for SI partners and their customers during the implementation project and through go-live.
  • Advise on solution architecture, integration design, data synchronization, and configuration best practices across Agiloft's platform: core CLM, procurement and source-to-pay workflows, ERP sync (such as SAP S/4HANA), APIs and MCP-based orchestration, and AI and analytics capabilities.
  • Help partners separate out-of-the-box capability from custom implementation work so each fix lands with the right owner.

    • Own the Technical Escalation Path

  • Act as the Tier 3 technical resource for partner-led projects.
  • Triage and reproduce issues, document them clearly, and log true defects and enhancement requests to Product and Engineering in Jira.
  • Join partner and customer working sessions when a blocker needs Agiloft in the room.
  • Hand accounts off cleanly to Support at transition, with documented configuration and open items.

    • Enable the Ecosystem

  • Build and deliver partner training, webinars, and learning content with Product and go-to-market teams.
  • Work with Product and Engineering to stand up and maintain partner sandboxes, test environments, and knowledge base access.
  • Support the change management and promote the value of monthly releases into the partner ecosystem.

    • Build the Playbook

  • Create and maintain implementation playbooks, a known-issue library, escalation runbooks, and environment setup guides.
  • Feed patterns from real projects back into enablement, documentation, and the product roadmap.

    • What Success Looks Like in Year One

  • Partner-led go-lives land on schedule, with fewer slipping because of unresolved technical blockers.
  • Technical escalations from partners reach a clear owner quickly, with reproducible detail, and resolve faster.
  • Product and Engineering receive structured, prioritized signal from partner projects instead of ad hoc pulls.
  • Product and Engineering receive a steady, well-documented stream of implementation feedback that shapes the roadmap.
  • A working go-live toolkit exists and partners actually use it: playbooks, known-issue library, runbooks, reference architectures, and environment guides.
  • Support inherits cleaner, better-documented accounts at handoff.
  • Target metrics: e.g. on-time go-live rate, median time to resolve partner escalations, escalations per quarter, training events delivered.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

    What you'll bring

  • 5+ years in a technical, customer- or partner-facing implementation role: solution architecture, professional services, implementation or integration consulting, or sales engineering with post-sale delivery.
  • Agiloft certification, or relevant platform certifications (Salesforce, SAP, cloud).
  • Hands-on experience designing and troubleshooting enterprise integrations including REST APIs, webhooks, authentication patterns (OAuth, JWT), and data sync between systems of record.
  • Working knowledge of the systems CLM connects to, such as Salesforce, ERP (SAP, Oracle, NetSuite), and Procurement relevant ISVs
  • Strong troubleshooting instincts. You can isolate whether an issue is configuration, integration, or product defect, and explain it precisely to engineers and executives alike.
  • Solution design skills: you can translate business requirements into a technical design and explain the trade-offs to both technical and business stakeholders.
  • Experience guiding external partners or customers while working across Product, Engineering, and Support.
  • Exposure to AI-enabled workflows, LLM tooling, or MCP-based integrations.
  • A builder's habit of turning one-off fixes into reusable documentation and process.

Preferred Qualifications

    Nice to have

  • Integration middleware experience: Workato, MuleSoft, or Boomi.
  • Background in CLM, procurement or source-to-pay, CPQ, or related enterprise workflow platforms; hands-on experience implementing a CLM platform is a strong plus.
  • Prior work at or alongside SI and consulting partners.
  • Exposure to ISV/managed-package delivery, versioning, and enterprise deployment considerations.
  • Prior experience working directly with or inside SI or consulting partners.

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

iTmethods has run engineering platforms for regulated enterprises since 2005. Today we build and operate Reign, governed AI software delivery for banking, capital markets, life sciences, semiconductor and defence.

Reign is three products, each available today. Reign Factory: tickets in, pull requests out. Reign Gateway: one governed path to the models your teams use. Reign Ops: the platforms you deliver on, operated for you, 24×7, as a dedicated single-tenant service in the customer's AWS or Azure account or on Reign Dedicated.

We build Reign with Reign: agents and models write the code, and a named engineer owns the outcome. Reign Ops carries a SOC 2 Type II attestation. iTmethods is a member of the Linux Foundation, FINOS and the Agentic AI Foundation. Founded in Toronto; we work Canada remote.

THE WORK

You own the relationship with a portfolio of enterprise accounts in regulated industries. You are their day-to-day contact and their advocate inside iTmethods, and you are accountable for retention, renewal and expansion. Most customers today run on Reign Ops; you will introduce Reign Gateway and Reign Factory where they fit, and bring the customer's engineering, security and risk leaders into those conversations.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the overall customer relationship for assigned accounts, building trust at technical and executive levels and becoming their trusted advisor.
  • Own renewals and expansion in your accounts. Identify and progress opportunities across Reign Ops, Reign Gateway, Reign Factory and professional services, and run the briefing motion that turns interest into scoped work.
  • Lead conversations with CIOs, CISOs, risk and audit leaders and engineering leaders about AI-enabled software delivery, governance and audit evidence.
  • Build and maintain account gameplans for each customer, using AI tooling for account research, meeting summaries, action-item extraction and QBR preparation. Review all AI output before it is sent or acted on.
  • Follow iTmethods' AI use commitments in every customer engagement.
  • Manage ongoing customer requests: budget, invoicing, audit and compliance, and growth topics.
  • Run regular customer meetings, QBRs, satisfaction surveys and customer health reporting; produce customer-facing operational and value reporting.
  • Act as liaison between customer stakeholders, iTmethods delivery and support teams, and partners including Sonar, GitLab, GitHub, CloudBees, Sonatype, JFrog and AWS.
  • Participate in partner programs, including AWS partner motions and the Sonar Launchpad program, and maintain partner certifications as required.
  • Support contracting, including drafting and managing proposals and statements of work.
  • Document all account, prospect and lead activity in Salesforce and contribute to the organization's reporting.
  • Bring customer feedback to Product, Pre-Sales, Professional Services, Finance and Delivery to improve the platform and offerings.
  • Apply first-principles thinking: understand the outcome the customer needs, not just the request.
  • Attend customer and partner events as required.
  • Keep learning about Reign, our partners' products, and the AI governance and software delivery landscape.
  • Be flexible and open to shifting priorities as the business changes.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 5+ years in Customer Success, account management or sales in SaaS, cloud, DevOps or IT services.
  • A track record of retaining and growing enterprise accounts and securing timely renewals.
  • Experience managing regulated enterprise accounts (financial services, life sciences, semiconductor, defence or similar).
  • Comfort discussing AI governance, security, compliance and audit evidence with regulated customers. Deep AI expertise is not required; curiosity and fluency are.
  • AI-native: you use tools such as Claude or ChatGPT daily for planning, reporting and communication, and you check their output.
  • Strong communication, presentation and negotiation skills for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce, Excel and PowerPoint; comfortable with Slack and Zoom.
  • Detail-oriented, empathetic, and strong at problem-solving and prioritization.

WHO THRIVES HERE

  • You like talking to the customer who uses what we operate, and you take the call when it matters.
  • You write clearly and in the open, and you say so when something is not ready.
  • You want to own the account, the renewal and the outcome, not just the relationship.

This is probably not for you if you want a defined edge to your responsibility or a purely transactional renewal cycle.

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

Your work will touch Sales, Finance, Marketing, Support, Engineering and Professional Services. You will learn our partner technologies and help regulated enterprises adopt governed AI delivery. The role can lead to larger strategic accounts, customer success leadership or a move into sales, and we will map a path with you. We offer a wellness allowance, lunch-and-learns, remote social events, and the autonomy to make decisions that drive customer outcomes.

HOW WE WORK

  • Earn trust with evidence. Every change leaves a record: who asked, who approved, what happened.
  • Own the outcome. Work is measured by what the customer can do afterward, not by tickets closed.
  • Be accountable by name. Agents and models write; a named iTmethods engineer approves. We say so when something is not ready.
  • Stay close to the customer and the work. The person closest to the work makes the decision, in the open and in writing.
  • Build AI native. We hire people who want to work with agents and models inside a gate a person still holds.
  • Ship continuously, with humans in the loop.

HOW TO APPLY

Apply on the posting or write to . Say which role you mean. Send one artifact that represents your work: an incident review you led, a runbook, a customer plan, or a document you had to defend. Tell us about something that broke, or an account that went sideways, and what you changed afterward.

The people you would work with read what you send. Artificial intelligence tools help screen and assess applications, and a person makes every advancement and hiring decision. If you need an adjustment at any stage, say so in your first message and it will be arranged.

iTmethods is committed to an inclusive and accessible environment. This posting is for an existing vacancy that we are actively looking to fill.

jobs.description:
Liderar la gestión comercial integral de las cuentas asignadas, asegurando el crecimiento sostenible y rentable del negocio mediante el desarrollo de relaciones estratégicas con los clientes, la identificación de nuevas oportunidades comerciales y la correcta ejecución de las estrategias de ventas, precios, portafolio y rentabilidad definidas por la compañía.

La posición será responsable de maximizar el potencial de las cuentas bajo su gestión, utilizando información comercial, financiera y de mercado para la toma de decisiones, garantizando el cumplimiento de los objetivos de ventas y rentabilidad y promoviendo relaciones de largo plazo que generen valor tanto para el cliente como para la compañía.

3. Responsabilidades principales

A. Gestión comercial y desarrollo de cuentas

  • Liderar la gestión integral de las cuentas asignadas, desarrollando planes comerciales orientados al cumplimiento de los objetivos de ventas, crecimiento, rentabilidad y participación de mercado.
  • Construir y fortalecer relaciones comerciales de largo plazo con compradores y tomadores de decisión, posicionándose como un socio estratégico para el desarrollo del negocio.
  • Identificar oportunidades de crecimiento mediante la expansión del portafolio, desarrollo de categorías, incorporación de nuevos clientes y fortalecimiento de la presencia en los diferentes canales y mercados.
  • Negociar y administrar acuerdos comerciales asegurando condiciones alineadas con los objetivos estratégicos y financieros de la compañía.
  • Garantizar la correcta implementación de las estrategias comerciales, de precios y portafolio definidas para cada cuenta.

B. Gestión de rentabilidad y recursos comerciales

  • Asegurar el crecimiento rentable de las cuentas mediante la adecuada administración de precios, condiciones comerciales, inversiones promocionales y demás recursos asignados.
  • Liderar la ejecución oportuna de incrementos y ajustes de precios definidos por la compañía.
  • Monitorear el desempeño financiero de clientes, categorías y negocios, identificando desviaciones y estableciendo planes de acción correctivos.
  • Contribuir al cumplimiento de los objetivos de DSO, trabajando de manera coordinada con las áreas de Finanzas, Crédito y Cartera para mantener los indicadores dentro de los parámetros establecidos.

C. Planeación comercial, forecast y análisis

  • Elaborar y gestionar el forecast de ventas de las cuentas asignadas, proporcionando visibilidad sobre proyecciones, oportunidades y riesgos del negocio.
  • Gestionar y monitorear los principales KPIs comerciales y financieros, identificando oportunamente desviaciones frente a los objetivos.
  • Realizar análisis periódicos de ventas, inventarios, tendencias, categorías, productos y desempeño de clientes como soporte para la toma de decisiones.
  • Realizar seguimiento al PSI (Purchase, Sales & Inventory) para anticipar riesgos asociados a disponibilidad, niveles de inventario y demanda.
  • Preparar reportes ejecutivos y business reviews que permitan evaluar el desempeño de las cuentas y establecer planes de acción.

D. Gestión de clientes y ejecución comercial

  • Garantizar un profundo conocimiento de las necesidades, estrategias y prioridades de cada cliente.
  • Asegurar la correcta ejecución del portafolio de productos definido para cada cuenta, identificando oportunidades de distribución, participación y desarrollo de categorías.
  • Coordinar la implementación de planes promocionales, lanzamientos de productos y demás iniciativas comerciales.
  • Realizar seguimiento a los compromisos establecidos con los clientes y asegurar su correcta ejecución.

E. Trabajo multifuncional

  • Trabajar de manera colaborativa con las áreas de Marketing, Trade Marketing, Finanzas, Supply Chain, Customer Service y E-Commerce para asegurar la ejecución integral de los planes comerciales.
  • Facilitar la comunicación entre los clientes y las diferentes áreas internas involucradas en la operación.
  • Liderar internamente la gestión y resolución de situaciones que puedan afectar el desarrollo de las cuentas.
  • Compartir información relevante sobre clientes, consumidores, competencia y mercado que contribuya al proceso de planeación comercial de la compañía.

4. Indicadores clave de desempeño

El desempeño de la posición estará asociado principalmente al seguimiento y cumplimiento de indicadores como:

  • Cumplimiento de ventas vs. presupuesto.
  • Crecimiento de las cuentas asignadas.
  • Rentabilidad y margen.
  • DSO y gestión de cartera.
  • Precisión del forecast.
  • Niveles de inventario y PSI.
  • Desarrollo y distribución del portafolio.
  • Crecimiento de categorías y productos estratégicos.
  • Ejecución de planes comerciales y promocionales.
  • Desarrollo de nuevas oportunidades de negocio.

5. Formación académica

Profesional universitario en:

  • Administración de Empresas.
  • Mercadeo.
  • Ingeniería Comercial.
  • Ingeniería Industrial.
  • Economía.
  • Negocios Internacionales.
  • O carreras afines.

Se valorará formación complementaria en Ventas, Negociación, Finanzas, Marketing, Key Account Management o Gestión Comercial.

6. Experiencia requerida

  • Mínimo 5 años de experiencia en áreas comerciales y ventas, preferiblemente en compañías de consumo masivo, bienes de consumo, retail o industrias relacionadas.
  • Experiencia previa como Senior Sales Representative, Key Account Manager, Ejecutivo Senior de Cuenta o posiciones equivalentes.
  • Experiencia en negociación comercial y administración de condiciones comerciales.
  • Conocimiento del mercado colombiano, canales de comercialización y dinámica competitiva.
  • Experiencia en análisis comercial, forecast, inventarios y seguimiento de indicadores de negocio.

7. Conocimientos técnicos

Se requiere conocimiento y manejo de:

  • Microsoft Excel avanzado.
  • Microsoft PowerPoint avanzado.
  • Portales de proveedores y clientes.
  • Elaboración y seguimiento de forecast.
  • Análisis de PSI.
  • Análisis de ventas y rentabilidad.
  • Negociación comercial.
  • Planeación estratégica de cuentas.
  • Finanzas comerciales.
  • Marketing y Trade Marketing.

8. Competencias requeridas

Competencias de negocio

  • Pensamiento estratégico y visión comercial.
  • Orientación a resultados y rentabilidad.
  • Análisis y toma de decisiones.
  • Capacidad de negociación e influencia.
  • Planeación comercial.
  • Orientación al cliente.
  • Desarrollo de oportunidades de negocio.

Competencias de liderazgo y ejecución

  • Liderazgo e iniciativa.
  • Capacidad de ejecución.
  • Planeación y organización.
  • Comunicación efectiva.
  • Resolución de problemas.
  • Manejo de conflictos.
  • Creatividad y adaptabilidad.
  • Trabajo colaborativo y multifuncional.
  • Orientación al servicio.
  • Alto nivel de autonomía y responsabilidad.

9. Requerimientos de viaje

La posición requiere disponibilidad frecuente para viajar dentro de Colombia, teniendo en cuenta la cobertura geográfica de las cuentas bajo su responsabilidad y la necesidad de mantener relacionamiento presencial con clientes y oportunidades de negocio en diferentes ciudades.

10. Alcance de la posición

El Senior Sales Representative tendrá responsabilidad integral sobre el desarrollo de las cuentas asignadas, gestionando no solamente la venta, sino también las variables de crecimiento, rentabilidad, forecast, portafolio, inversión comercial, inventarios, cartera y desarrollo estratégico del cliente.

Se espera que actúe como referente comercial de sus cuentas dentro de la organización, transformando información de mercado y desempeño en oportunidades concretas de negocio y coordinando con las diferentes áreas de la compañía las acciones necesarias para alcanzar los objetivos establecidos.

Newell Brands (NASDAQ: NWL) is a leading global consumer goods company with a strong portfolio of well-known brands, including Rubbermaid, Sharpie, Graco, Coleman, Rubbermaid Commercial Products, Yankee Candle, Paper Mate, FoodSaver, Dymo, EXPO, Elmer’s, Oster, NUK, Spontex and Campingaz. We are focused on delighting consumers by lighting up everyday moments.

jobs.description:
Senior Solar EPC Estimator

Clark Bros., Inc. | Remote Opportunity | $150,000–$200,000 Annually

About Us

At Clark Bros., Inc., we pride ourselves on being a trusted leader in the construction industry, with over 65 years of success.

As a heavy civil construction company, we are dedicated to driving sustainable change within the water, power, and renewable energy industries while improving the communities we serve. Our team is built on a foundation of excellence, collaboration, and an unwavering commitment to safety. We foster a culture that values independent thinking, innovative problem-solving, accountability, and a strong sense of purpose.

As we continue to expand our renewable energy capabilities, we are looking for experienced professionals who want to make a meaningful impact and help shape the future of the industry. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, along with opportunities to take on significant responsibility and grow alongside the company.

Position Summary

Clark Bros., Inc. is seeking a highly experienced Senior Solar EPC Estimator to take a lead role in developing, managing, and delivering comprehensive estimates and proposals for utility-scale solar construction projects.

This is a senior-level, stand-alone position intended for an established estimating professional who can independently lead the estimating process from initial opportunity review through final proposal submission. The ideal candidate brings extensive experience in solar EPC estimating, a strong understanding of construction means and methods, and the ability to develop accurate, competitive, and comprehensive project budgets with minimal supervision.

This individual will serve as a key estimating resource and subject-matter expert, taking ownership of bid strategy, cost development, subcontractor and vendor coordination, resource planning, and proposal preparation. The successful candidate will work closely with executive leadership, project management, engineering, and operations teams to evaluate opportunities, identify project risks, and support strategic business decisions.

This role offers the opportunity to take ownership of the solar estimating function while helping shape and support the company's continued growth in the renewable energy sector.

This is an independent, lead-level role with the flexibility to work remotely.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Independently lead and manage the full estimating process for utility-scale solar EPC projects, from initial bid review through final proposal submission.
  • Develop detailed, accurate, and competitive cost estimates covering all aspects of solar construction, including labor, materials, equipment, subcontractors, indirect costs, and project-specific requirements.
  • Review and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, scope documents, contracts, and technical requirements to establish complete and accurate project estimates.
  • Develop project budgets, pricing strategies, resource plans, and detailed cost breakdowns based on project scope, construction schedules, and execution requirements.
  • Evaluate construction means and methods, productivity assumptions, labor requirements, equipment utilization, and material quantities to identify the most cost-effective approach to project execution.
  • Lead bid strategy and provide recommendations to executive leadership regarding project pricing, risk exposure, contingencies, and overall competitiveness.
  • Solicit, evaluate, and negotiate pricing with subcontractors, suppliers, and vendors to ensure competitive and comprehensive project costs.
  • Identify scope gaps, potential conflicts, constructability concerns, and commercial risks during the estimating and proposal development process.
  • Establish and maintain estimating standards, cost databases, historical pricing information, production rates, and other tools to improve estimating accuracy and consistency.
  • Collaborate with project management, engineering, procurement, and operations teams to ensure estimates align with anticipated project execution strategies.
  • Prepare and present comprehensive estimates, bid reviews, proposals, and cost summaries to company leadership.
  • Provide senior-level estimating expertise and guidance throughout the preconstruction and project development process.
  • Support project handoff from estimating to operations, ensuring a clear understanding of the original estimate, assumptions, scope, and project budget.
  • Monitor awarded project costs against original estimates and incorporate actual cost and production data into future estimating efforts.
  • Manage multiple estimating opportunities and deadlines independently while maintaining accuracy, organization, and accountability.

Qualifications and Expectations

  • Extensive professional experience in construction estimating, with a strong emphasis on utility-scale solar EPC projects.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently lead and complete complex solar EPC estimates and proposals with minimal supervision.
  • Strong understanding of utility-scale solar construction, including civil, structural, electrical, and related scopes of work.
  • Proven experience developing comprehensive project budgets, performing quantity takeoffs, analyzing labor and equipment requirements, and establishing production rates.
  • Ability to interpret construction drawings, engineering plans, specifications, contracts, and technical documentation.
  • Experience soliciting and evaluating subcontractor and vendor proposals and developing competitive project pricing.
  • Strong understanding of construction means and methods, project scheduling, cost controls, and risk assessment.
  • Demonstrated ability to serve as the primary estimating resource and take ownership of the estimating process.
  • Excellent analytical, organizational, communication, and decision-making skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, along with estimating software and construction cost databases.
  • Experience with HCSS Heavy Bid or comparable estimating platforms preferred.
  • Engineering, Construction Management, or related degree preferred; equivalent industry experience will be considered.

Work Arrangement

This is a senior-level, stand-alone position with remote work flexibility. The ideal candidate must be highly self-directed, organized, and capable of managing the full estimating process independently while maintaining effective communication and coordination with company leadership and project teams.

Periodic travel or in-person meetings may be required based on project and business needs.

Compensation

Annual Salary Range: $150,000–$200,000

Compensation will be based on experience, qualifications, and demonstrated expertise in utility-scale solar EPC estimating.

Clark Bros., Inc. offers a competitive benefits package and the opportunity to play a significant leadership role in the company's continued growth in the renewable energy market.

Job Description: Senior Databricks Engineer

Company: Altera Health (A Harris Computer Business)

Location: India (Remote / Hybrid)

Function: AI & Automation — Engineering

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Databricks Engineer to join our AI and Automation team. In this role, you will lead the architecture and delivery of scalable data platforms on Databricks, drive engineering best practices, and act as a technical anchor for data pipeline and lakehouse initiatives. You will work closely with AI, automation, and reporting teams to build production-grade data infrastructure that powers healthcare IT operations at scale.

We are looking for someone who is deeply self-sufficient — someone who can independently diagnose, debug, and resolve complex technical issues without hand-holding, and who actively uses AI tooling as a force multiplier to deliver faster and smarter solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Technical Leadership

  • Own the end-to-end design and architecture of Databricks-based data platforms, including Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) lakehouse patterns
  • Define and enforce engineering standards for pipeline development, testing, and deployment across the team
  • Lead technical design reviews and contribute to architectural decision-making alongside senior stakeholders
  • Evaluate and recommend tools, frameworks, and platform configurations to meet evolving business needs
  • Independently investigate and resolve complex platform, pipeline, and performance issues — bringing structured debugging and root cause analysis skills to production incidents

Azure Platform & Cloud Engineering

  • Demonstrate deep, hands-on understanding of the Azure ecosystem — not just as a storage layer but as an integrated platform:
  • Understand Azure cost governance and resource optimisation at scale
  • Architect cross-service solutions that leverage Azure-native capabilities alongside Databricks

Open Source Stack Proficiency

  • Bring strong working knowledge of the broader open source data ecosystem:
    • Docker — containerization of data applications and pipelines
  • Evaluate and adopt open source tooling pragmatically — choosing the right tool without over-engineering

GitHub & Development Practices

  • Operate confidently and independently in GitHub:
    • Branching strategies (GitFlow, trunk-based development)
    • Pull requests, code reviews, and merge conflict resolution
    • Repository organisation, tagging, releases, and change management
  • Maintain clean, well-documented codebases and enforce code quality standards across the team
  • Treat infrastructure and pipeline code with the same rigour as application code

AI-Augmented Engineering

  • Actively and fluently use AI tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent) as a core part of the engineering workflow — not occasionally, but as default practice
  • Use AI to accelerate complex problem-solving: debugging cryptic errors, generating boilerplate, refactoring code, writing tests, and exploring unfamiliar APIs
  • Leverage LLMs for data pipeline design ideation, documentation generation, and query optimisation
  • Comfortable prompting AI effectively to get production-quality outputs and critically evaluating AI-generated code before shipping
  • Stay current with AI tooling evolution and bring new productivity patterns to the team

Data Engineering & Pipelines

  • Build and optimise complex ETL/ELT pipelines using Apache Spark on Databricks at production scale
  • Architect Delta Lake solutions with strong focus on reliability, performance tuning, and cost governance
  • Design reusable, modular pipeline frameworks that accelerate team delivery
  • Drive CI/CD adoption for data pipelines — automated testing, deployment, and rollback strategies

Analytics & Reporting Enablement

  • Collaborate with Power BI reporting teams to deliver well-modelled, governed semantic layers
  • Own the design of data models that balance query performance with flexibility for changing requirements
  • Act as a technical bridge between engineering and business/reporting consumers

AI & Automation Integration

  • Lead data engineering workstreams supporting AI/ML initiatives — feature stores, training pipelines, model serving data flows, and MLflow integration
  • Design data feeds and integration layers connecting Databricks outputs with operational tools such as LogicMonitor and ServiceNow ITOM
  • Identify and prototype new AI/automation use cases enabled by the data platform

Platform Governance & Reliability

  • Own Databricks workspace governance — Unity Catalog, cluster policies, access controls, cost monitoring, and security configurations
  • Implement robust data quality frameworks, observability, and alerting for pipeline health
  • Ensure compliance with data handling standards relevant to healthcare IT environments
  • Mentor mid-level and junior engineers, conducting code reviews and upskilling the team

Required Skills & Experience

  • 7+ years of overall data engineering experience, with 4+ years hands-on on Databricks
  • Deep expertise in Apache Spark (PySpark and/or Scala) — including performance tuning, partitioning strategies, and cluster optimisation
  • Strong command of Delta Lake — ACID transactions, schema evolution, time travel, optimisation techniques
  • Advanced SQL and data modelling skills (Kimball, Data Vault, or Lakehouse patterns)
  • Deep, proven hands-on experience with Azure — ADLS Gen2, ADF, Azure DevOps, Event Hubs, Key Vault, Monitor, AAD/Entra ID; able to architect cross-service solutions independently
  • Strong open source stack knowledge — Kafka, Airflow, dbt, Docker, and related tooling
  • GitHub proficiency — branching, PRs, GitHub Actions CI/CD, and repository management
  • Strong independent debugging and troubleshooting skills — able to own and resolve complex production issues without escalation
  • Demonstrated fluency with AI tools in day-to-day engineering — GitHub Copilot, Claude, or equivalent; uses AI to solve problems, not just for autocomplete
  • Excellent communication skills — able to represent technical positions clearly to non-engineering stakeholders

Good to Have

  • Experience with Databricks Unity Catalog and enterprise data governance at scale
  • Familiarity with Power BI — DirectQuery, composite models, semantic layer design
  • Exposure to MLflow, Feature Store, or Model Serving on Databricks
  • Knowledge of healthcare data standards (HL7, FHIR, claims/EHR data)
  • Familiarity with LogicMonitor telemetry or ServiceNow data models
  • Databricks Certified Associate or Professional certification
  • Experience with FastAPI/Flask for building lightweight data APIs

Who You Are

  • Deeply self-sufficient — you don’t wait for someone to unblock you; you dig in, debug, research, and solve
  • You use AI as a natural extension of your engineering toolkit — it makes you faster, not dependent
  • Strong instinct for data quality, platform reliability, and operational excellence
  • Comfortable driving technical direction in a lean, fast-moving team
  • Genuinely curious about AI/automation applications in IT operations and healthcare
  • A collaborative mentor who raises the engineering bar across the team
  • Treat GitHub as a professional discipline — clean commits, meaningful PRs, documented decisions

jobs.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

Instacart's AI Productivity team builds the AI-powered platforms and tools that help our engineers and the broader R&D organization move faster, reduce toil, and deliver higher-quality experiences for customers, shoppers, retailers, and brand partners. We have been at the forefront of applied AI for years, and we move quickly: we prototype, ship, learn, and retire what is no longer the best answer.

As a Senior Staff Software Engineer, you will set the direction for how AI changes the way Instacart builds products and software, and you will drive that change across the whole company. You will stay close to where the AI industry is heading, anticipate where the industry and Instacart will be 18 to 36 months from now, and turn that view into strategy, pilots, and adoption at scale. That means more work handled in the background by orchestrated, cost-efficient, and compliant agents, so people can focus on the work that needs human judgment.

This is a hands-on, high-visibility role. You will write code, partner with senior engineering and finance leadership, evaluate vendors and prototypes, and lead organizational change, including the cultural and people side of adoption. This position is remote-friendly within North America.

About the Job

  • Define and drive the company-wide strategy for AI-assisted software and product development, anticipating where the industry and Instacart are headed over the next 18 to 36 months.
  • Lead adoption of AI tools and agentic workflows across engineering and R&D, including company-wide rollouts, and own the organizational change that comes with them: culture, learning, communication, and working through resistance.
  • Increase engineering throughput by growing the volume of background and parallel agentic work each person can handle, with high quality, strong safeguards, and clear cost controls.
  • Build and prototype hands-on: lead large features, pilots, and proofs of concept that change how work gets done, and scale the ones that prove their value.
  • Define how we measure impact, moving beyond "are people using it?" to "are they using it effectively?", and report outcomes clearly to executive audiences.
  • Partner with engineering leaders, Security, Legal, and Finance to manage AI cost, security, and compliance as usage grows.
  • Evaluate vendors and emerging tools, deciding what to buy, what to build, and what to retire.
  • Mentor and influence senior engineers across all pillars, and represent AI productivity across the company through forums such as lunch-and-learns and brown bags.

About You

Public Partnerships LLC supports individuals with disabilities or chronic illnesses and aging adults, to remain in their homes and communities and “self” direct their own long-term home care. Our role as the nation’s largest and most experienced Financial Management Service provider is to assist those eligible Medicaid recipients to choose and pay for their own support workers and services within their state-approved personalized budget.
