We desire motivated candidates who are excited to join our fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment, and who want to make a difference in helping transform the lives of the consumers we serve. (learn more at www.pplfirst.com).


Position Summary

The Regulatory Intelligence Lead - Legal and Policy is responsible for the legal and policy analysis that underpins the organization's centralized regulatory tracking program. This role identifies, interprets, and classifies regulatory and sub-regulatory guidance, determines what each requirement means for the organization's programs, clients, and states, and communicates those determinations in clear, defensible, and operationally usable terms.


Working alongside the Manager, Regulatory Intelligence and the Regulatory Lead, Data and Analytics, this role serves as the authoritative source for regulatory interpretation. It sets the rules for how requirements are classified, prioritized, and assigned for implementation, and supports Compliance, Operations, Account Management, Government Relations, Program Integrity, and Privacy with sound regulatory guidance.


This is an individual contributor leadership role. The Regulatory Lead provides subject-matter leadership and direction on regulatory interpretation workstreams but does not manage people.


Key Responsibilities


Regulatory Monitoring and Interpretation

  • Monitor and analyze federal and state laws, regulations, and sub-regulatory guidance affecting consumer-directed Medicaid and other state-funded LTSS/HCBS programs administered through an FMS/FI model, including Medicaid authorities (e.g., Social Security Act Sections 1915(c), (i), (j), and (k) and Section 1115 demonstrations), federal regulations, state administrative codes, agency bulletins, program and provider manuals, FAQs, and client and managed care contract requirements
  • Interpret requirements and determine applicability, effective dates, and impact by program, state, client, and operational function
  • Classify guidance by authority and binding effect (e.g., statute, regulation, binding directive, informal agency guidance, or contractual obligation) and document the basis for each determination
  • Develop and maintain regulatory interpretation records, position papers, and precedent files that support consistent and defensible decisions over time
  • Track proposed rules, pending legislation, waiver and State Plan amendments, and agency policy signals to anticipate regulatory change

Advisory and Implementation Support

  • Prepare regulatory impact assessments and plain-language summaries that translate new or changed requirements into actionable guidance for business owners
  • Serve as regulatory subject matter expert for new program implementations, market expansions, contract negotiations and amendments, RFP responses, and client discussions
  • Review policies, procedures, participant-facing materials, and training content for alignment with applicable legal and regulatory requirements
  • Identify and escalate regulatory risks, conflicts between sources of guidance, and implementation challenges to the Manager, Regulatory Intelligence and the VP, Compliance
  • Coordinate with legal counsel (internal or outside) and Privacy on complex or novel interpretations

Regulator and Stakeholder Engagement

  • Prepare and submit inquiries and requests for clarification to state agencies and other oversight entities, and maintain a record of agency responses and interpretations
  • Build and maintain productive relationships with state agency staff, regulators, and industry stakeholders, and support Government Relations and Account Management in regulatory communications
  • Support regulatory audits, reviews, and corrective action responses by providing regulatory citations, interpretation, and supporting documentation
  • Maintain awareness of regulatory trends, emerging program models, and evolving state requirements

Collaboration on Centralized Tracking

  • Define the classification rules, applicability criteria, and escalation criteria that govern how requirements are entered, categorized, and prioritized in the centralized tracking repository
  • Partner with the Regulatory Lead, Data and Analytics to ensure legal determinations are accurately reflected in the data model, workflows, and reports
  • Review high-impact and high-risk repository entries for legal accuracy and completeness
  • Train and coach operational and compliance stakeholders on interpreting and applying regulatory requirements

Required Skills:

  • Strong knowledge of Medicaid, LTSS/HCBS, and consumer-directed program requirements, and of the regulatory obligations specific to FMS/FI operations (e.g., employer-agent and payroll tax, wage and hour, workers' compensation, electronic visit verification, and HIPAA privacy and security)
  • Demonstrated ability to read, interpret, and apply statutes, regulations, and sub-regulatory guidance, and to reconcile conflicting or ambiguous sources
  • Excellent legal and regulatory research and analysis skills, including proficiency with research resources (e.g., Westlaw, Lexis, state registers, and agency websites)
  • Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to convert complex legal analysis into concise, plain-language guidance for non-legal audiences
  • Sound judgment in assessing regulatory risk and in knowing when to escalate to leadership or legal counsel
  • Experience building relationships with state agencies, regulators, and external stakeholders
  • Comfort working with data-driven tracking tools and collaborating with analytics partners to structure legal content
  • Strong organizational and project management skills
  • Excellent verbal, facilitation, and presentation skills
  • Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration abilities

Qualifications:

Education:


Bachelor's degree required. Juris Doctor (JD) or an equivalent advanced degree or credential in law, public policy, health policy, or regulatory affairs is preferred.


Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in regulatory compliance, regulatory affairs, legal, or policy analysis, including at least 3 years focused on Medicaid, LTSS/HCBS, or consumer-directed programs – required
  • Experience working within a Financial Management Services (FMS) or Fiscal Intermediary (FI) organization – required
  • Demonstrated experience interpreting and operationalizing Medicaid, LTSS, and consumer-directed program regulations and sub-regulatory guidance across multiple states – required
  • Experience developing and maintaining relationships with state regulatory agencies and oversight entities – required
  • Experience preparing regulatory impact assessments, policy analyses, or legal memoranda for business and executive audiences – required
  • Experience supporting regulatory audits and responding to state or client inquiries – preferred
  • Active bar admission in any U.S. jurisdiction or a compliance certification (e.g., CHC or CCEP) – preferred

Working Conditions:

  • Remote Work: Home-based; must have a reliable internet connection and a professional workspace
  • Physical Demands: Standard office environment involving extended periods of computer use

Supervisory Responsibility (If applicable):

  • This position does not have direct reports. The Regulatory Lead provides subject-matter leadership, workstream direction, and guidance to cross-functional partners in support of the Regulatory Intelligence program, but does not hire, supervise, or evaluate personnel.

Compensation: $85,000-$90,000

Acting as part of our internal "Customer Zero" initiative, you will leverage and showcase the power of SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC) to govern human and non-human identities, automate business driven complex access lifecycles, and enforce zero standing privilege (ZSP).


This position requires a technical practitioner with a good understanding of Enterprise Architecture, modern AI Governance and security principles, and deep cloud infrastructure expertise (AWS, GCP, and Azure). Beyond your technical credentials, you must be a collaborative team player with a passion for continuous learning, an ability to deliver under tight timelines, and a desire to think outside the box to solve complex security and business challenges.


Key Responsibilities:

Enterprise Identity Architecture & System Design

  • Architectural Alignment: Partner with Enterprise teams to ensure identity structures align with business goals, corporate security baselines, and zero-trust frameworks.
  • Identity Platform Engineering: Assist in the hands-on design, configuration, and maintenance of SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC), ISC workflows automation, access modeling, and role hierarchy definitions.
  • Application Onboarding & Connectors: Design and deploy out-of-the-box and custom connectors for enterprise platforms, including Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Salesforce, ServiceNow (SDIM), Workday, SAP, AWS, and modern SaaS applications.
  • Policy & Logic Implementation: Author and deploy complex transforms, rules, event triggers, and automated workflows to handle conditional attributes and business edge cases.

Multi-Cloud & AI Security Governance:

  • Cloud Infrastructure Governance: Help design, implement, and audit identity and access controls across our public cloud ecosystems—specifically Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and Microsoft Azure.
  • Secure AI Workload Ingestion: Implement secure identity and access management controls for emerging AI deployments, Large Language Models (LLMs), autonomous agentic services and tools.
  • Non-Human Identity (NHI) Governance: Apply security and lifecycle governance principles to non-human identities, including service accounts, API keys, and machine-to-machine integrations.
  • AI-Assisted Access Optimizations: Leverage platform security analytics and machine learning-driven recommendations to streamline role-modeling and access certification campaigns.

Business-Driven Deliverables & Value Realization:

  • Business-to-Identity Translation: Translate complex business-driven requirements and corporate JML (Joiner-Mover-Leaver) lifecycle processes into reliable, automated technical configurations.
  • Track Record of Business Delivery: Take ownership of delivering high-quality, on-time Identity Security projects that directly reduce corporate risk, eliminate risky entitlement combinations, and enhance operational efficiency.
  • Audit & Compliance Support: Ensure all identity system configurations provide complete audit trails and documentation to fulfill SOC 2, PCI DSS, and NIST CSF compliance requirements.

Operations, Collaboration & Continuous Learning:

  • Triage & Production Support: Serve as a Tier-3 escalation point for identity sync failures, aggregation bottlenecks, and provisioning errors. [3]
  • Monitoring & Auditing: Develop health dashboards, track API rate limits, audit system logs, and ensure high availability across identity services. [3]
  • Collaborative Teamwork: Act as a proactive team player who values cross-functional collaboration, shares knowledge openly, and remains eager to learn and adapt to new technologies and architectures.
  • Agility & Out-of-the-Box Thinking: Demonstrate a strong ability to work effectively within tight project timelines while bringing innovative, outside-the-box solutions to complex, non-standard engineering problems.

Required Qualifications:

  • Experience: 4+ years of dedicated, hands-on engineering experience in Identity & Access Management (IAM), Identity Governance & Administration (IGA).
  • SailPoint Technical Expertise: Deep direct experience administering, configuring, and extending SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC) (experience with ISC preferred).
  • Multi-Cloud Expertise: Foundational to advanced knowledge of identity administration and security architectures in AWS, GCP, and Azure (including IAM policies, roles, and managed service identities).
  • Enterprise Architecture & Security Principles: Proven understanding of how identity systems integrate with broader enterprise infrastructure, security boundaries, and corporate risk.
  • AI Governance Awareness: Foundational knowledge of security principles related to SaaS-based AI tools, Large Language Models, and securing developer API/workload tokens.
  • AI tooling expertise: Advanced expertise leveraging the latest AI tool stacks such as Gemini, Claude, Cursor
  • Directories & Cloud IdPs: Advanced working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID and on-premises Active Directory (forest architectures, group types, Kerberos, SASL, and LDAP signing).
  • Scripting & Data: Proficiency with scripting in Python, PowerShell, or Java/BeanShell, as well as structured data handling in JSON, XML, and SQL.
  • Professional Agility: A demonstrated track record of collaborating across teams, successfully managing tight delivery timelines, and showcasing a continuous eagerness to learn and innovate.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Certifications: SailPoint Certified Identity Security Engineer (ISC).
  • AI tooling and expertise: Advanced expertise leveraging the latest AI tool stacks like Claude, Cursor, and Gemini
  • Cloud Credentials: AWS Certified Security - Specialty, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, or Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate.
  • ITSM Integrations: Hands-on experience configuring and maintaining the SailPoint ServiceNow Service Desk Integration Module (SDIM) and catalog request workflows.
  • DevSecOps & Automation: Experience managing identity configuration through source control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).

Roadmap for Success:

30 Days:

  • Complete Identity Security Cloud (ISC) training and earn the ISC certification.
  • Familiarize yourself with team workflows, Jira boards, active projects, and participate in regular team meetings.

60 Days:

  • Handling day-to-day operational tasks and Tier-3 escalated tickets.

90 Days:

  • Provide support across the team’s core tooling and platform environments.

6 Months:

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of high-impact strategic initiatives across cross-functional enterprise systems.
  • Independently manage and execute project deliverables, incident response items, and support queue intake.

1 Year:

  • Serve as a subject matter expert and mentor on Identity Security Cloud architecture and tooling across the organization.
  • Proactively identify optimization opportunities, drive platform automation, and establish best practices for identity governance.

jobs.excerpt: About WRS Health WRS Health builds an Electronic Health Records (EHR) system that medical practices rely on every day to care for patients.
jobs.description:
About WRS Health

WRS Health builds an Electronic Health Records (EHR) system that medical practices rely on every day to care for patients. Our platform runs on Linux servers in AWS with a PHP application stack, and it holds some of the most sensitive data there is: protected health information.
We are now investing heavily in AI agents that work alongside clinicians and staff. That shift opens new ground for our product and new attack surfaces for our security program. We are hiring a Security Engineer to help us protect both.

The role

As our Security Engineer, you will find and fix security risks before attackers do, across our AWS infrastructure, our PHP application, and our growing fleet of AI agents. You will look ahead to emerging threats, especially those unique to LLMs and autonomous agents, and build defenses before they are needed.
This is a hands-on, collaborative role. You will work directly with our development and AI teams, helping them understand issues, prioritize fixes, and ship secure code. We want someone who teaches and enables, not someone who only files tickets.

What you'll do

Application security
  • Review PHP code and architecture for vulnerabilities such as injection, broken authentication, insecure deserialization, and access-control flaws.
  • Run and tune SAST, DAST, and dependency scanning (e.g., Composer packages) in our CI/CD pipelines.
  • Lead threat modeling for new features and work with developers to fix findings, with clear guidance and secure code examples.
Cloud and infrastructure security
  • Harden our AWS environment: IAM least privilege, network segmentation, encryption at rest and in transit, and secrets management.
  • Monitor and respond to findings from tools such as GuardDuty, Security Hub, CloudTrail, and AWS Config.
  • Secure and patch Linux servers, and define hardened baselines for new infrastructure.
AI and agent security
  • Assess AI agents for risks such as prompt injection, data leakage, excessive permissions, insecure tool use, and model supply-chain issues.
  • Define guardrails for what agents can access and do, especially where PHI is involved, including logging, human-in-the-loop controls, and output validation.
  • Partner with the AI team to build security into agent design from the start, using frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.
Threat management and response
  • Track emerging threats to healthcare, cloud, and AI systems, and turn that intelligence into concrete defenses.
  • Coordinate penetration tests and vulnerability management, from discovery through verified fix.
  • Help build and run our incident response plan, including tabletop exercises.
Compliance and culture
  • Support HIPAA and HITECH compliance.
  • Run secure-coding training and build security awareness across engineering.

Qualifications

  • 4+ years in security engineering, application security, or a closely related role.
  • Hands-on experience securing AWS environments, including IAM, VPC design, KMS, and AWS security services.
  • Strong Linux administration and hardening skills.
  • Experience with vulnerability scanning, penetration testing, and driving findings to resolution.
  • Working knowledge of LLM and AI agent risks, such as prompt injection, data exfiltration through tools, and over-permissioned agents.
  • Scripting or automation skills in Python, Bash, or similar.
  • Clear communication, and the ability to explain risk to developers and leadership in practical terms.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA or other regulated-data environments.

Nice to have

  • Experience in healthcare IT or with EHR systems and standards such as HL7 or FHIR.
  • Prior work securing AI agents, RAG pipelines, or LLM integrations in production.
  • Infrastructure-as-code security (Terraform or CloudFormation) and container security.

What success looks like in your first year

  1. First 90 days: You have assessed our AWS, Linux, and PHP environments and our AI agent designs, and you have a prioritized risk roadmap.
  2. By six months: Automated security scanning runs in every pipeline, and developers fix critical findings quickly with your guidance.
  3. By one year: Every new AI agent passes a security review before launch, our incident response plan has been tested, and security is part of how engineering works day to day.

Details and how to apply

  • Location: Remote
  • Employment type: Full-time - Independent Contractor
  • Reports to: CTO
  • Hours: Must be available during standard US business hours (9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST or 8:30 AM – 4:30 PM EST)

WRS Health is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

jobs.description:
• Your purpose: Build and lead a high-performing, predictable and scalable sales organisation that accelerates Genie AI's growth.

  • What you'll learn: Work at the cutting edge of agentic AI and legal technology, helping shape the commercial strategy of an ambitious, investor-backed startup.

  • The impact you'll have: Turn an ambitious sales function into a well-oiled revenue-generating machine, developing our people, sharpening our go-to-market strategy and unlocking significant commercial opportunities.

Your purpose in our mission

We've raised $17.8 million in Series A funding led by Google Ventures and joined by Khosla Ventures. They believe in our vision to empower everyone to draft quality legal documents, and this is where your skills will make a real difference.

We're looking for an exceptional VP of Sales to take our commercial organisation to the next level.

We already have a talented team, an innovative product and a global customer base. What we need now is someone who knows how to bring it all together: building the structure, focus, processes and momentum that turn great individual talent into a consistently high-performing sales organisation.

This isn't a role for someone who wants to inherit a perfectly functioning sales machine. It's an opportunity to build one.

You'll be a true player-coach, spending approximately 50% of your time leading, developing and enabling the team and 50% actively driving sales performance and revenue generation.

You'll bring deep expertise in outbound sales, a sharp understanding of target markets and the ability to turn strategy into action quickly.

You'll thrive in ambiguity, enjoy getting your hands dirty and know how to create clarity without introducing unnecessary bureaucracy.

We're operating in one of the most exciting markets in technology, with significant commercial opportunities ahead. If you're energised by the prospect of building something exceptional, rather than simply maintaining what's already there, we'd love to meet you.

Your manager and team

You'll work closely with our founders and leadership team, taking ownership of the sales function and helping shape our wider commercial strategy.

You'll inherit a talented and ambitious team with significant potential. Your role will be to unlock that potential through effective coaching, clear direction, strong processes and a culture of accountability.

Our organisational structure is made up of pods with distinct areas of focus, designed to maximise impact, autonomy and velocity. Some of our team members work across multiple pods, and collaboration is fundamental to how we operate.

You'll work particularly closely with our Product and Marketing teams, ensuring we're aligned on our ideal customer profile, go-to-market strategy and the activities that drive meaningful commercial results.

We're an AI-native organisation, and we expect our leaders to embrace the same mindset. We use tools including Attio, Apollo, lemlist, Claude and other AI-powered technologies to work smarter, move faster and continuously improve how we operate.

This is what you'll be doing

As VP of Sales at Genie AI, you'll be joining us at a pivotal stage of our growth. You'll have the autonomy to shape our sales organisation, the opportunity to make an immediate impact and the responsibility to build a commercial function capable of delivering sustainable revenue growth.

Here's what we need you to achieve. How you make it happen is up to you.

  • Build a high-performing sales organisation: Establish the structures, processes, operating rhythms and accountability needed to turn a talented group of individuals into a cohesive, consistently successful sales team.

  • Lead from the front: Operate as a hands-on player-coach, balancing team leadership and development with active involvement in sales execution, pipeline generation and closing opportunities.

  • Make outbound sales a growth engine: Design, implement and continuously optimise a repeatable outbound sales motion that generates a consistent flow of high-quality sales-qualified leads (SQLs) and commercial opportunities.

  • Sharpen our target market and go-to-market strategy: Develop a deep understanding of our customers, identify our highest-value market segments and ensure the team focuses its energy on the opportunities most likely to convert.

  • Coach, develop and empower our people: Provide meaningful coaching, clear expectations and actionable feedback. Help individuals maximise their strengths, improve performance and develop professionally, without micromanaging or creating unnecessary complexity.

  • Create a predictable and measurable sales operation: Introduce effective pipeline management, forecasting, reporting, sales meetings and performance cadences that provide visibility, consistency and accountability.

  • Connect Sales, Marketing and Product: Build strong cross-functional relationships, creating feedback loops that improve lead quality, customer understanding, product positioning and overall commercial performance.

  • Champion AI-native selling: Leverage AI, automation and modern sales technologies to improve prospecting, personalisation, productivity and conversion, while understanding when a human-led approach delivers better results.

This is how we'll set you up for success and the outcomes we expect from you

Your first 90 days will be focused on understanding our business, bringing structure to the sales organisation and delivering early, measurable commercial improvements.

We'll give you access to our people, customers, data and leadership team so you can quickly develop a clear understanding of where we are and where we need to go.

Within your first 30 days, we expect you to:

  • Develop a thorough understanding of Genie AI's product, customers, target market and existing sales performance.

  • Establish effective sales meetings, processes, operating rhythms and performance cadences within your first two weeks.

  • Build strong working relationships across Sales, Product and Marketing.

  • Develop and communicate a clear, actionable sales strategy within your first three weeks.

  • Begin implementing improvements to outbound activity and demonstrate early progress in SQL generation within your first month.

By the end of your first 90 days, we expect you to:

  • Have an effective, repeatable outbound sales motion in place, with measurable improvements in lead generation and pipeline quality.

  • Have refined our ideal customer profile and target market, ensuring the team is focused on the highest-value opportunities.

  • Have established clear performance expectations, coaching structures and accountability across the sales team.

  • Be using data, AI and automation to continually optimise sales activity and conversion.

  • Have created a strong operating rhythm between Sales, Product and Marketing.

By the end of your first six months, we expect you to be:

  • Leading a focused, motivated and high-performing sales team with clear individual and collective revenue accountability.

  • Delivering a consistent and growing flow of qualified sales opportunities through a scalable outbound engine.

  • Demonstrating measurable improvements in pipeline generation, conversion rates and revenue performance.

  • Running a structured, data-driven sales organisation with reliable forecasting and clear visibility of performance.

  • Continuously refining our go-to-market strategy based on customer insights, commercial results and market opportunities.

We'll continually develop and measure success against:

  • SQL generation: The volume, quality and consistency of sales-qualified leads and opportunities.

  • Revenue performance: Individual and team revenue generation against agreed targets.

  • Pipeline effectiveness: Outbound performance, conversion rates, pipeline health and forecasting accuracy.

  • Team performance: Coaching effectiveness, individual development, accountability and overall team focus.

  • Commercial execution: The effectiveness of our target market strategy, sales processes and cross-functional collaboration.

We're a startup in an exceptionally dynamic stage of growth. We're a customer- and employee-led organisation, meaning we adapt quickly to customer needs and emerging opportunities.

The problems we're solving today could look very different in six months. We want someone who embraces that, takes ownership and helps shape how the role and business evolve.

It can be tough here because

  • We're still building the playbook. Our sales motion is evolving, and not every process, strategy or answer is neatly packaged. You'll need to create structure, make decisions and keep moving, even when information is incomplete.

  • We're a startup, not a safe corporate environment. We're operating in a fast-moving, high-stakes environment where priorities can change quickly, resources are finite and commercial results really matter. You'll need to be comfortable with risk, ambiguity and the pressure that comes with building something ambitious.

  • You'll need to be strategic and hands-on. This isn't a role where you can simply set the direction and delegate everything else. You'll be expected to coach, sell, problem-solve and execute alongside your team.

But we think you'll love

  • The opportunity to build something genuinely impactful. You'll have the autonomy and influence to shape our entire sales function, develop talented people and make a visible difference to the company's success.

  • Being at the forefront of AI innovation. You'll be selling a cutting-edge agentic AI product in one of the most exciting and rapidly evolving technology markets, with a global customer base and significant opportunities for expansion.

  • The potential upside. We're backed by world-class investors and exploring exciting strategic opportunities, including potential M&A. This is an opportunity for someone who is motivated by meaningful ownership, significant commercial impact and the potential rewards of helping an ambitious startup succeed.

The skills you need to succeed in this role

  • Proven outbound sales expertise: You've successfully built, scaled or significantly improved outbound sales functions and understand what it takes to generate a consistent pipeline of qualified opportunities.

  • A track record of building sales organisations: You've helped establish or transform a sales function, ideally in an early-stage or scaling technology business. You know how to build the processes, structures and behaviours that drive performance.

  • Strong player-coach leadership: You're an experienced sales leader who genuinely enjoys developing people, but you're equally comfortable rolling up your sleeves and getting involved in the sales process.

  • Deep knowledge of outbound channels: You understand modern outbound prospecting, multichannel engagement, sales automation, personalisation and the balance between automated and manual approaches.

  • AI-native thinking: You have strong knowledge of AI capabilities and a genuine enthusiasm for using AI tools to improve sales productivity, efficiency and effectiveness.

  • Strategic commercial judgement: You know how to identify and refine target markets, develop ideal customer profiles, prioritise opportunities and translate commercial insights into an actionable sales strategy.

  • A data-driven mindset: You're confident working with sales metrics, SQLs, conversion rates, revenue targets, pipeline performance and forecasting to make informed decisions and drive continuous improvement.

  • Exceptional coaching and communication skills: You know how to motivate, challenge and develop talented individuals, bringing clarity and accountability without being overbearing.

  • A startup mentality: You're proactive, resourceful, adaptable and comfortable operating in ambiguity. You don't wait for someone else to solve problems; you take ownership and make things happen.

  • Relevant B2B technology sales experience: You've operated in SaaS, AI or a similarly fast-moving technology environment and understand the challenges of selling innovative products in developing markets.

Don't worry about ticking every single box on the list to be considered for this role. We're particularly interested in people who can demonstrate real commercial impact, a strong learning mindset and the ability to build something exceptional.

Unleash your magic: our interview process

  • Step 1: Meet our Head of Talent Acquisition to explore your experience, motivations and alignment with the opportunity.

  • Step 2: Complete a practical commercial exercise focused on sales strategy, outbound growth and building a high-performing sales organisation.

  • Step 3: Meet our founders and commercial stakeholders to explore your approach to sales leadership, strategy and execution.

  • Step 4: Culture and leadership interview to understand how you coach teams, collaborate and thrive in an ambitious startup environment.

  • Step 5: For leadership-level roles, we collect blind references to help set you up for success. These insights support a smooth transition into the business and meaningful collaboration from day one.

We can't wait to meet you! Bring your authentic self and get ready to explore our culture, team and ambitious mission.

Our benefits

Here's just some of the benefits you can look forward to when you enter the Genie's lamp:

  • Generous Stock Options: We want all our genies to share in our success.

  • Private Healthcare: To help keep you fit as a fiddle.

  • Fully Remote Working: Work from anywhere your heart desires.

  • Unlimited Book Budget: Dive into an unlimited budget for business, law or technology books.

  • Home Office Setup: Equip your home office with a top-of-the-range laptop, monitor, wireless keyboard, mouse and a comfortable office chair.

  • Learning and Development Budget: Each Genie gets an individual £500 L&D budget annually, plus five days off for job-specific learning adventures.

  • Unlimited Holiday: Take as much time off as you need to recharge your batteries.

  • Parental Leave: Both Genie parents get enhanced leave to welcome their little genies into the world.

  • Free Access to Genie: Create, negotiate and collaborate on legal documents in real time on one platform!

About Genie AI

Genie AI is a machine learning startup with a mission to enable everyone to draft quality legal documents. We're shaking up the legal world and flipping the business model on its head!

Think of what GitHub did with open-source code, Instagram and TikTok with entertainment, Airbnb with hospitality, and Uber with travel – Genie AI is doing that with legal contracts.

We're conjuring up a community-based AI law platform that'll change the game. Join us, and let's make some legal magic together!

  • 100,000 companies use Genie AI today.

  • We've raised $17.8 million in Series A funding, backed by Google Ventures and Khosla Ventures.

  • We've collaborated with Oxford University and Imperial College London to co-author research papers on explainable AI.

  • According to Forbes, we're rated one of the top 29 AI startups in the UK.

  • We're a Sunday Times Best Places to Work Award Winner 2024.

  • We're backed by top legal pedigree, from Lord Neuberger to representing the UK on multiple Ministry of Justice trade missions.

  • Our customers save on average £15,000 on legal fees per year with Genie.

  • This isn't just a SaaS product – we're redefining the business model of law.

Ready to grant wishes and disrupt a £750bn industry? Click apply and join us in creating a world of digital wonders!

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer (Contract)
jobs.excerpt: The Motley Fool is looking for a Senior Product Designer to guide and elevate the user experience for our membership products and websites.
jobs.description:
The Motley Fool is looking for a Senior Product Designer to guide and elevate the user experience for our membership products and websites.

This is an opportunity for a highly creative, ideas-driven designer who thrives at the intersection of product strategy, design, and technology. A strong background in fintech, financial services, or investing products is essential, along with a deep understanding of the needs and behaviors of investors.

You'll work closely with product managers, engineering leads, and executive stakeholders to envision what's possible, create new products and experiences from the ground up, and reimagine existing systems. We're looking for someone who brings curiosity, thoughtful ideas, and a strong design perspective while remaining open to collaboration, feedback, and different points of view. The ideal candidate can influence strategic decisions, build trust across teams, and translate ambitious concepts into intuitive, scalable experiences.

You'll work within an empowered product team, ensuring customer value, business viability, and technical feasibility are aligned with world-class UX/UI design.

This is a 100% remote contract position. We expect the work to take roughly 40 hours per week.

About The Motley Fool

The Motley Fool is a purpose-driven financial services company on a mission to make the world smarter, happier, and richer. For 30 years we’ve been helping people make better investment decisions through transparency, education, and Foolish fun. We’re a fast-moving, collaborative team that values high-quality work, curiosity, and initiative. We care deeply about what we do, and we’re driven by the impact our work has on real people’s financial futures.

As a Senior Product Designer, you'll be part of a cross-functional group that leverages modern tools and emerging technologies to build intuitive, engaging, and scalable experiences for our users.

What would you do in this role?

  • Define and evolve the design vision for our premium membership and Fool.com, aligning customer needs with business objectives and technical capabilities.
  • Own the member experience. UX is key: create simple, outstanding experiences with a clear eye for detail and a strong taste for aesthetic design, starting with our premium membership.
  • Lead the design of new greenfield products that help the world get smarter, happier, and richer, from first concept to launch.
  • Build and own our design system and component library as the foundation of how we work. Make it easy for product managers and engineers to build and ship fast without waiting for custom design on every feature.
  • Work AI-native: use AI tools and agents across research, prototyping, and design-to-code, and create the guidelines, components, and workflows that let our product managers, engineers, and their agents produce on-brand, accessible experiences on their own.
  • Partner with executive stakeholders, product managers, and engineering leads to generate ideas, influence product direction, and build alignment around strategic priorities.
  • Translate customer insights and complex financial concepts into intuitive, accessible experiences through research, rapid prototyping, and usability testing. Focus your hands-on design time on new concepts and the moments that matter most.
  • Use analytics, A/B testing, and user feedback to evaluate design decisions and continuously improve experiences.
  • Champion design best practices and accessibility while collaborating across teams and mentoring other designers.

What do you need to apply?

  • 5+ years of product or UX design experience, leading consumer-facing web or mobile products.
  • Significant experience and passion for designing digital products in fintech, financial services, investing, or related industries, with a strong understanding of investor needs and financial products.
  • Experience and passion for designing AI-powered products, intelligent interfaces, or AI-enabled design systems.
  • Ability to translate complex financial information and data into intuitive, engaging, and trustworthy customer experiences.
  • A highly creative, ideas-driven mindset with experience developing new products and redesigning or modernizing established platforms.
  • Experience partnering with executive stakeholders and influencing product strategy through strong communication, thoughtful ideas, and a collaborative, low-ego approach.
  • Expert proficiency in Figma, plus proven expertise in keeping designs in sync with Claude and our code base, so that designs, design system components, and the shipped experience stay consistent.
  • Strong knowledge of responsive design, information architecture, visual hierarchy, and scalable design systems.
  • Hands-on with modern front-end frameworks such as Next.js, React, or Vue.js, and a working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. You create small pull requests yourself for design changes, using AI coding tools and agents to do so.
  • Experience with user research, usability testing, and data-informed design decisions.

Compensation:

Below is our target compensation range. While we are budget conscious, we’re also eager to find the right person for this role, so if your target is outside of this range, please don’t hesitate to apply and we’d be happy to have a conversation.

Hourly Pay Range
$100—$125 USD

By applying on this site, you acknowledge that The Motley Fool will be collecting the personal data you provide for our recruiting purposes. Please see our Applicant Privacy Notice for additional information about how we process, transfer, and store your data, including where that data is stored, and about any additional privacy rights you may have based on your jurisdiction.

jobs.excerpt: Job Description: We welcome remote candidates based in the continental United States Merkle is a leading data-driven, technology-enabled, global performance marketing agency that specializes in the delivery of unique, personalized customer experiences across platforms and devices.
jobs.description:
Job Description:

We welcome remote candidates based in the continental United States


Merkle is a leading data-driven, technology-enabled, global performance marketing agency that specializes in the delivery of unique, personalized customer experiences across platforms and devices. For more than 30 years, Fortune 1000 companies and leading nonprofit organizations have partnered with Merkle to maximize the value of their customer portfolios.


The agency’s heritage in data, technology, and analytics forms the foundation for its unmatched skills in understanding consumer insights that drive people-based marketing strategies. Its combined strengths in performance media, customer experience, customer relationship management, loyalty, and enterprise marketing technology drive improved marketing results and competitive advantage. With 16,000+ employees, Merkle is headquartered in Columbia, Maryland, with additional offices in the US, Europe, and Asia. In 2016, the agency joined the Dentsu Aegis Network.


Job Description


Merkle is seeking a strategic business leader with Adobe Experience Cloud expertise and martech ecosystem knowledge to join the AI Advisory, Enterprise Transformation practice as a Sr. Director, Lead Strategist. This individual will operate at the executive level, combining organizational transformation expertise, change management rigor, and value-driven advisory to anchor the program's strategic direction and drive enterprise client outcomes.


The Lead Strategist is a program-level leadership role operating across two distinct dimensions: as the primary strategic advisor on a large enterprise account and as a senior thought partner providing coverage and oversight across all delivery pods and resourcing groups within a broader client engagement. This individual bridges strategic vision with tactical execution, ensuring the program delivers measurable business value while building client-side organizational capability.


The role combines the advisory mindset of organizational transformation consulting with hands-on accountability for client value realization. There are no immediate direct reports for this role, but the Lead Strategist operates with influence across program leadership, delivery teams, and client stakeholder groups, carrying full ownership of strategic planning and change enablement.

Key Responsibilities


The responsibilities below span strategic advisory, program leadership, and direct enterprise account engagement, reflecting the full lifecycle of client transformation from discovery through sustained value realization.


  • Lead strategic consulting engagements that assess organizational readiness, operating model design, ways of working, governance, and change management within large-scale enterprise transformation initiatives and programs
  • Lead organizational readiness, operating model design, and change management strategies for large-scale Adobe Experience Cloud transformations; assess current-state capability, identify operational gaps, and design future-state operating models that enable clients to sustain and scale their Adobe investments.
  • Drive operational transformation through workflow analysis, business process optimization, capability mapping, and implementation roadmaps that prioritize improvement initiatives against strategic goals, feasibility, value
  • Partner with delivery teams to identify and accelerate value drivers; translate strategic priorities into clear activation sequences, ensuring each engagement builds client capability while moving toward larger program objectives.
  • Provide strategic coverage and guidance across all delivery pods within a critical client program with one of our leading partners; serve as a strategic sounding board for Pod Leads and the Merkle Leadership Team on value realization, client account health, and expansion opportunities.
  • Facilitate workshops, discovery sessions, and prioritization exercises that require managing competing client opinions, agendas, and ambiguous inputs
  • Translate the impact of AI tools and agentic capabilities on marketing workflows, skillsets, operating model, and ways of working
  • Understand how AI tools, automation, and human expertise work together in modern operating models across business functions
  • Lead change management activities and plans related to agentic capability enablement or deployment
  • Surface operational risks related to technology implementation, migration, or adoption initiatives
  • Support stakeholder mapping, readiness surveys, skillset and training assessments, change communication and messaging, as well as KPIs to measure and track ongoing change adoption
  • Design governance structures to clarify roles, decision rights, and accountability in transformation programs
  • Serve as a bridge between strategic vision and tactical execution workstreams
  • Develop trusted advisor relationships with client senior executives to influence strategic investments and business decisions
  • Partner with Merkle pods / delivery teams in identifying business value drivers / frameworks that measure impact of agentic technology enablement initiatives
  • Partner with Merkle Innovation Lab Product Owner and Multi-Solution Architect roles on delivery engagements
  • Partner with Merkle business units, sales, growth and account management functions to support expansion and growth opportunities on strategic accounts

Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s Degree required. Master’s degree preferred
  • 15+ years of consulting experience in business transformation, organizational change leadership, and/or integrated marketing strategy, with demonstrated executive-level client management
  • 10+ years working in a top tier consulting firm and/or marketing agency
  • Deep knowledge of end-to-end consulting approaches to solve client problems, from strategy design through execution.
  • Strong experience assessing and recommending optimal team and operating structures to facilitate integrated program execution
  • Familiarity with change management frameworks, shared services models, organizational design, product and portfolio governance
  • Understanding of marketing technologies to orchestrate and activate customer experiences
  • Experience in leading a team and navigating complex projects by providing innovative, actionable solutions
  • Proven experience in developing solutions to support the sale of new services to clients.
  • Strong writing, presentation, and client facing communication skills
  • Problem solving mindset, thrive in ambiguous and fast moving environments, and in informal, loosely structured and creative work environments
  • Exceptional communication skills, with experience distilling complex, multi-threaded engagements into clear executive narratives
  • Familiarity and working knowledge of Adobe platforms and agentic solutions (strongly preferred)
  • Working fluency in financial or value modeling to partner with technical teams (nice to have)
  • Up to 25% travel may be required (varies with client specific need)

At dentsu, we believe great work happens when we’re connected. Our hybrid way of working combines remote flexibility with regular in-person collaboration to spark ideas and strengthen our teams. Many of our employees who live within commuting distance (90 minutes) from one of our Headquarter or Hub Offices (New York, Chicago, Detroit, Los Angeles) are required to work in the office 2-3 days per week including one Team Day. The minimum number of days may vary by office and role. Dentsu may designate other HQ or Hub offices at any time. Those who do not live near an office may be designated as a remote employee, depending on the role and business needs. Regardless of your work location, we expect you to be flexible to meet the needs of our Company and clients, which may include attendance in an office from time to time.


The annual base salary range for this position is $136,000-$190,500. Placement within the salary range is based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and other factors permitted by law. Additionally, this position is eligible for discretionary incentive compensation.

Benefits available with this position include:


  • Medical, vision, and dental insurance,
  • Life insurance,
  • Short-term and long-term disability insurance,
  • 401k,
  • Flexible paid time off,
  • At least 15 paid holidays per year,
  • Paid sick and safe leave, and
  • Paid parental leave.

Dentsu also complies with applicable state and local laws regarding employee leave benefits, including, but not limited to providing time off pursuant to the Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act, in accordance with its plans and policies. For more information regarding dentsu benefits, please visit www.dentsubenefitsplus.com.

To begin the application process, please click on the “Apply” button at the top of this job posting. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and qualified candidates will be contacted for next steps.

USA-Remote-Pennsylvania

Brand:

Merkle

Time Type:

Full time

Permanent

We do this without regard to race, color, national origin, sex , sexual orientation, gender identity, age, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, ancestry, physical or mental disability, marital status, political affiliation, religious practices and observances, citizenship status, genetic information, veteran status, or any other basis protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.

jobs.excerpt: About Figure Figure Technology Solutions, Inc.  (Nasdaq: FIGR; OPEN: FGRS) is the leading blockchain-native capital marketplace for the origination, funding, sale and trading of tokenized assets.
jobs.description:
About Figure

Figure Technology Solutions, Inc. (Nasdaq: FIGR; OPEN: FGRS) is the leading blockchain-native capital marketplace for the origination, funding, sale and trading of tokenized assets. More than 480 partners use its loan origination system and capital marketplace. Collectively, Figure and its partners have originated over $30 billion of loans to date, among other products. The fastest growing components are Figure Connect, its credit marketplace, and Democratized Prime, Figure’s on-chain lend-borrow marketplace. Figure’s ecosystem also includes DART (Digital Asset Registry Technology) for asset custody and lien perfection, and $YLDS, a yield-bearing stablecoin registered with the SEC as a security under the Securities Act of 1933.

Figure is the market leader in real-world asset (RWA) tokenization. The company has received triple-A ratings ratings from S&P and Moody’s on multiple loan securitizations, the first of its kind for blockchain finance.

We’re proud to be recognized as one of Forbes’ Top 50 Fintech Companies and CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies.

About the Role

We’re looking for an Underwriter to join our growing team! As Underwriter, you’ll own the credit decision on Kiavi’s investor loans, from file review through final credit approval. You’ll partner with Experience Managers, Loan Analysts, the Closing team, and other cross-functional partners to move loans quickly and efficiently through the pipeline while delivering superior client service. Depending on company needs, you may underwrite multiple loan products. You’re analytical, decisive, and self-motivated, with strong credit judgment, comfort with automation and AI tools, and the ability to balance daily production with accuracy. If you want to make sharp credit decisions at speed and keep every file clean through approval, this role is for you.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the credit decision on assigned loan products, underwriting in compliance with company credit guidelines and regulatory requirements
  • Review loan files for completeness, flag missing documentation, and set clear, accurate conditions
  • Analyze borrower and guarantor credit, background, and compliance results, and evaluate collateral, including appraisal and valuation reports and property cash flow
  • Underwrite business entities by verifying formation, good standing, ownership, management control, and signing authority
  • Use automation and AI tools to review documents, validate data, and support credit decisions, applying independent judgment and verifying all tool output
  • Manage a high-volume loan pipeline independently, prioritizing files by closing date and meeting required daily production targets without trading away credit quality or accuracy
  • Own the accuracy and completeness of every loan file through final credit approval, including work from upstream partners, and hand off cleanly to the Closing team
  • Partner with the Loan Analyst and Experience Manager to complete credit analysis on time and enter correct data in the loan origination system
  • Document each decision, and any judgment call outside procedure, in a clear underwriting summary, and escalate exceptions and sensitive issues to the appropriate management with a written rationale
  • Identify and report suspected fraudulent activity by any stakeholder and escalate as needed, and keep current on company policies and federal and state regulatory requirements through in-house training, adapting quickly to policy changes and new process rollouts

What We Look For

  • 3+ years of residential mortgage or investor loan underwriting experience, with sound knowledge of lending regulations and credit and collateral analysis practices
  • Bachelor’s degree or relevant experience
  • Experience underwriting loans to business entities
  • Demonstrated experience using automation and AI tools in credit decision making, such as document review, data validation, and exception flagging, with sound judgment on when to rely on tool output and when to verify it
  • Proven ability to quickly learn new systems, platforms, and underwriting tools and to excel in a fully paperless, technology-driven environment
  • Analytical, detail-oriented, and decisive, with sound credit judgment
  • Self-motivated and accountable, owning your files and results through final credit approval
  • Write clear underwriting summaries and explain decisions to Loan Analysts, Experience Managers, and management
  • Collaborate effectively within a remote-first team and deliver a high standard of client service
  • Experience underwriting investor, DSCR, RTL, or other hard money loans (preferred)
  • Adhere to all company security policies and data handling procedures.
  • Complete mandatory security awareness training within required timeframes.
  • Promptly report any suspected security incidents or suspicious activity to the Security team.

Salary

  • Base Compensation Range: $37.21 - $41.35/hour
  • 25% annual bonus target, paid quarterly

This is the compensation range for the role in the United States. Actual compensation may vary based on a candidate’s experience, skills, location, internal equity, and evolving business needs. While most offers are generally made within the middle of the range, final compensation is determined based on the factors above.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% employer-paid premiums for employees and their dependents on select plans
  • Company HSA, FSA, Dependent Care FSA, 401(k), and commuter benefits
  • Employer-paid life and disability insurance
  • 10 observed holidays and PTO plan
  • Up to 12 weeks of paid family leave
  • Continuing education reimbursement

California Residents, please review our California Employee and General Workforce Privacy Notice for further information. By submitting your application, you are agreeing and acknowledging that you have read and understand the above notice.

Figure will not sponsor work visas for this position. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire.

jobs.title: Practice Lead, Commercial
jobs.excerpt: Datavant is the data collaboration platform trusted for healthcare.
jobs.description:
Datavant is the data collaboration platform trusted for healthcare. Guided by our mission to make the world’s health data secure, accessible and actionable, we provide critical data solutions for organizations across the healthcare ecosystem - including providers, health plans, researchers, and life sciences companies. From fulfilling a single patient’s request for their medical records to powering the AI revolution in healthcare, Datavanters are building the future of how data is connected and used to improve health.

By joining Datavant today, you’re stepping onto a driven and highly collaborative team that is passionate about creating transformative change in healthcare.

The Practice Lead, Commercial Practice leads end-to-end delivery for Datavant’s Commercial pillar in Life Sciences. You will be both the senior domain authority and the delivery leader for programs that connect pharma data assets to commercial use cases such as launch planning, patient journey analytics, adherence and persistence, provider targeting, and omnichannel measurement.

This role is for someone who has spent a career in commercial analytics and knows the US healthcare data landscape deeply: how claims, EHR, lab, specialty pharmacy, hub and patient services, mortality, and consumer data are built, where each one is strong or weak, and how patients are resolved across them. You will lead the team who run Commercial programs, and your expertise will set the standard for how those programs are scoped, executed, and quality-checked.

Customers buy one integrated outcome, but delivery spans Science, Privacy, Technical Solutions, Data Harmonization, and Record Retrieval, all moving in parallel. You will make sure the Commercial practice runs those programs to a consistent standard, with one governance model and one accountable owner. You will work closely with Sales, Account Management, and Delivery & Ops, and alongside peer Engagement Directors across Clinical, HEOR/MA/Safety-Epi, and Ecosystem.

This is a build-and-scale role. The Engagement Management function is newly dedicated, and you will help set the standards and ways of working the organization adopts into 2027.

Responsibilities of the Role

  • Lead, coach, and grow the Commercial pillar Engagement Management team, including Senior Engagement Managers and Engagement Managers.
  • Own delivery execution quality and program-level CSAT for all Commercial engagements.
  • Serve as the practice’s subject matter authority on patient mastering and linkage, including identity resolution approaches, token match rates, deduplication, longitudinal patient construction, and the tradeoffs that affect commercial analytics outcomes.
  • Advise on US data source selection and fit for commercial use cases, including coverage, lag, latency, capture, and bias across claims, EHR, lab, specialty pharmacy, patient services, mortality, and consumer and digital data.
  • Review program designs and data plans before and during delivery to confirm the chosen sources and linkage approach can support the customer’s intended commercial analysis.
  • Run multi-workstream programs to a repeatable standard, with clear governance, program tiering, cross-functional sequencing, and escalation paths.
  • Partner with Delivery & Ops leaders across Privacy, Science, Technical Solutions, Data Harmonization, and Record Retrieval so functional teams are accountable to Engagement Managers for program delivery while expert standards stay intact.
  • Join Sales Executives, Sales Specialists, and Solution Consulting before signature to confirm that scope, SLAs, milestones, program tier, and delivery model are executable.
  • Work with Account Management on a clean handoff from delivery to value realization, so delivery outcomes feed the value story and renewal.
  • Serve as the senior delivery relationship for key Commercial programs at top-50 pharma accounts, translating technical data and linkage topics into clear language for commercial analytics, brand, and executive audiences.
  • Manage capacity, staffing, and utilization for the practice, using hours and coverage data to plan against ACV, program count, and complexity.
  • Build and maintain Commercial practice playbooks, program templates, data source guides, QA standards, and customer-facing delivery materials.
  • Report on delivery health, risks, quality, and capacity to the VP, Engagement Management, and contribute to the function-wide operating model.
  • Contribute to career frameworks and levels, and support development and promotion decisions for your team.
  • Feed delivery learnings and customer feedback to Product and Partnerships to improve Commercial offerings and tooling.

Qualifications of the Role

  • 10+ years of experience in commercial analytics for life sciences, whether at a pharma company, data vendor, analytics provider, or consultancy.
  • Deep understanding of patient mastering and identity resolution, including tokenization, probabilistic and deterministic matching, match quality, and the effect of linkage choices on downstream analysis.
  • Deep knowledge of US healthcare data sources (claims, EHR, lab, specialty pharmacy, hub and patient services, mortality, and consumer/digital data) and how each applies to commercial use cases such as launch, patient journey, adherence and persistence, targeting, and omnichannel measurement.
  • Strong grasp of how pharma commercial, brand, analytics, and data teams buy, consume, and operationalize data.
  • 3+ years leading managers or multi-person delivery teams, with experience running complex, multi-workstream customer programs for pharmaceutical or similarly regulated customers.
  • Ability to lead through influence in a matrixed environment (Sales, CS, Product, Privacy, Legal, Science, Ops) where you don’t own every function involved.
  • Executive presence with senior customer stakeholders, and the ability to explain complex data and privacy concepts to business audiences.
  • A metrics-driven approach to quality, CSAT, capacity, and utilization.
  • Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM, PSA tools, and the Google suite.
  • Ability to travel for customer meetings, program kickoffs, and company events.

Bonus Points If

  • You have worked inside a pharma commercial analytics or data strategy organization.
  • You have hands-on experience with privacy-preserving linkage, tokenization, or clean room environments.
  • You are familiar with the RWD vendor ecosystem and have evaluated or integrated multiple sources for a single use case.
  • You have led delivery or engagement teams at a healthcare data, RWE, or life sciences analytics company.
  • You have built delivery playbooks, program tiering models, or data source frameworks that scaled.

We are committed to building a diverse team of Datavanters who are all responsible for stewarding a high-performance culture in which all Datavanters belong and thrive. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected status.

At Datavant our total rewards strategy powers a high-growth, high-performance, health technology company that rewards our employees for transforming health care through creating industry-defining data logistics products and services.

The range posted is for a given job title, which can include multiple levels. Individual rates for the same job title may differ based on their level, responsibilities, skills, and experience for a specific job. This role is eligible for additional variable compensation.

The estimated base salary range (not including variable pay) for this role is:

Team Overview

  • Lead the Consumer Interactive UK Sales team and take end-to-end accountability for achieving annual revenue targets across the Consumer Line of Business and B2B2C sector.

jobs.description:
Botify’s leading agentic AI search technology and seasoned experts ensure every brand has the power to be found, both in traditional and AI search. With one powerful platform, brands achieve visibility, relevance, and greater control across Google, Bing, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and more.

Botify’s technology powers agentic workflows, AI-driven recommendations, and automated cross-platform indexation and deployment. Brands maximize visibility wherever consumers, bots, and AI agents search, protecting and capturing revenue across all search platforms.

Trusted by 500+ leading brands including Macy’s, Levi’s, Farfetch, the New York Times, and Marks & Spencer, Botify drives digital discovery, sustained profitability, productivity, and brand authority in an AI-first world.

Industry research shows that women and those in traditionally underrepresented groups generally don't apply to jobs unless they check all the boxes for the role. If you feel strongly that you have what it takes for this role but don't check 100% of the boxes - that's okay - we encourage you to apply anyway and highlight what you can bring to the table!

Role Overview

Botify is the AI-powered search optimization platform trusted by 500+ enterprise brands across 30 countries. Our Customer Enablement team is the bridge between the platform and our customers' daily workflows: we make sure the brands we work with don't just have access to Botify, they know how to use it to move the numbers that matter. We're looking for a Customer Enablement Manager to own platform adoption and user proficiency across a dedicated portfolio of enterprise accounts.

You'll report to a Services Manager (Pod Lead) and work alongside Managed Services Consultants on shared accounts. This role exists because the gap between "licensed" and "operationalized" is where customer value is won or lost, and closing that gap is your job.

You are:

We're looking for someone who gets genuine satisfaction from turning complex software into something a busy SEO team uses every day without thinking twice. Specifically, you are:

  • A Platform Champion: You master enterprise software deeply enough to translate high-level features into repeatable workflows any user can follow. Configuring dashboards, building segmentation, and optimizing crawl settings to mirror a client's business structure is the kind of work that energizes you.

  • A Skilled Technical Teacher: You break down technical concepts like JavaScript rendering or log file analysis into structured training that empowers users at every level, from SEO analysts to marketing directors.

  • Analytical and Proactive: You spot low adoption or technical blockers before the client does and step in with a plan before they have to ask.

  • Systems-Oriented: You don't just answer questions; you build solutions. When a client has a recurring problem, you look for the configuration or workflow that makes it stop recurring.

  • Growth-Minded: You have a solid foundation in technical SEO and are building toward deeper technical expertise. A clear path from this role into strategic consulting exists at Botify, and we actively develop people toward it.

What you'll own:

  • Own onboarding and time-to-value for your portfolio. You'll lead post-sale implementation for each account, ensuring technical configurations (crawls, log connections, site mappings) are accurate and aligned to the client's business goals. Success is measured by how quickly accounts reach their first actionable insight.

  • Turn casual users into power users. You'll design and deliver tailored training that builds genuine platform fluency. A power user pulls their own insights from Botify without waiting for your help.

  • Build the reporting and alerting infrastructure each account relies on. You'll configure custom dashboards, alert systems, and reports that give stakeholders a clear, ongoing view of organic search performance. When those are right, Botify becomes part of the daily workflow.

  • Serve as the first line of platform expertise. You'll diagnose usage issues, distinguish platform bugs from configuration problems, and partner with Technical Support or Product to resolve anything that needs escalation.

  • Partner with Managed Services Consultants on shared accounts. You'll keep the platform configuration in sync with the strategic SEO roadmaps your MSC colleagues are executing.

  • Feed customer signals back to Product. You'll capture and synthesize product feedback from your portfolio on a structured cadence, giving the Product team grounded input from the accounts that use the platform most.

Your first 90 days:

  • Within 30 days: Complete platform and process onboarding, hold introductory calls with every account in your portfolio, and map the adoption status and top blocker for each.

  • By 60 days: Own your onboarding and training delivery independently and close your first time-to-value milestone with at least one new account.

  • By 90 days: Have a working adoption plan in place for every account, run your first structured product feedback session with your Pod Lead, and hit your first platform adoption benchmarks.

Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of technical SEO experience, in-house or at an agency, covering the full spectrum. You've worked on high-level strategy and rolled up your sleeves on technical SEO. You're not a specialist in one lane; you've navigated both.

  • A strong working understanding of how search engines crawl, and what crawl behavior means for traffic and revenue. You don't just know the concepts; you've diagnosed crawl issues on real sites and connected those findings to business outcomes.

  • Intermediate familiarity with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, particularly how JS affects modern search discovery and rendering.

  • Sharp analytical and problem-solving skills. You work comfortably with data, spot patterns that others miss, and translate what you find into a clear course of action.

  • Background in SEO project or program management; experience running structured SEO workstreams across multiple stakeholders.

  • Experience configuring dashboards, segmentation, or custom reporting in enterprise SaaS platforms.

  • Comfort picking up new technology quickly; Botify is a complex platform and curiosity about tooling goes a long way

Core Competencies:

  • Analytical instinct: You look at data and see the story before anyone asks you to find it.

  • Technical teaching: You make complex SEO and platform concepts land clearly for users at every level.

  • Proactive ownership: You monitor your portfolio continuously and act before clients have to escalate.

  • Systematic thinking: You build repeatable solutions, not one-off fixes.

Salary:

$95,000 - $105,000 base salary + 15% bonus

  • Unlimited Time Off

  • 11 company holidays

  • 16 weeks of parental leave

  • Summer Fridays

  • ClassPass Subscription

  • Team building events and initiatives

  • Flexible work policy

  • Commuter benefits

  • 401k

  • Health and Wellness perks

jobs.description:
Lilly Pulitzer

Job Type:

Regular

Brand Strategy
Our Brand mission is to inspire confidence and optimism, inviting everyone to shine bright and stand out.
Our Brand vision statement is: “Create Your Sunshine, A Resort State of Mind”.
Our Brand Equities are: Casual Glamour, Sunny & Spirited, and Charmingly Disarming.

Job Description


About the Position

The Fashion Designer, Sweaters, Swim & Coverups is responsible for the design and development of women’s sweaters, swim and coverups for Lilly Pulitzer® consistent with the marketing positioning of Lilly Pulitzer®. This is done under the direction of the Senior Fashion Designer, Swim, Coverups, Sweaters & Seasonal Kickoff.


A day in the life…


  • Develop innovative sweaters, swim and coverups fashion designs for the Lilly Pulitzer customer.
  • Understand the Lilly Pulitzer customer lifestyle and positioning in the marketplace.
  • Work closely with the Senior Designer of Swim, Coverups and Sweaters to ensure that the designs are consistent with the seasonal concept and the overall look of the collection.
  • Work closely and timely with product development, technical design, print design, fabric and trim, and merchandising to develop successful product from start to finish.
  • Work with our Swim partners Amerex to receive swimwear cads and communicate seasonal updates.
  • Prepare clear specifications, technical drawings and layouts for product development, technical design and vendors to understand fashion design’s intent for the style.
  • Update any required changes in Centric PLM system throughout the development process.
  • Prepare necessary documents for seasonal design review meetings.
  • Prepare the necessary material required for on-sale.
  • Work closely with merchandising to understand the product strategy; annual, seasonal, and monthly. This includes wholesale and retail selling analysis, consumer end use and pricing targets. Work with merchandising to understand necessary product assortments to meet or exceed sales plans.
  • Lead the execution of all sweater yarn colors, lab dips and SSY comments for each season.
  • Operate within company product development calendar.
  • Note, associates may be asked to perform duties that are outside the specific functions that are listed.

Qualifications for the Position

  • A four-year college degree is required. This should be in fashion design, with a sweater and knit concentration or a closely related subject.
  • At least 5 years of knitwear design experience, preferably with a ladies’ fashion branded apparel company.
  • The taste level and fashion sense to understand the Lilly Pulitzerâ customer and to design fashion merchandise, which appeals to the Lilly customer and sells.
  • Must have genuine excitement for the Lilly Pulitzer concept and she must share the vision for the merchandise and the lifestyle, consistent with the positioning in the marketplace.
  • Proficient technical skills in design and development for sweaters and knit tops including the ability to develop original designs for Lilly Pulitzer® from start to finish.
  • The creativity and courage to develop fashion trends and a fashion collection, balanced with the pragmatism to create commercially viable merchandise.
  • The ability to interact effectively with your manager, the Vice President of Fashion, Concept and Surface Design, the EVP of Product Design and Development, and with several other departments, including merchandising, technical design, and production.
  • Comfort working with the lead-times and capabilities of a production system, which is sub-contracted, primarily overseas.
  • The sense of urgency necessary in the apparel industry.
  • The ability to effectively manage and adapt to changes in process and procedures as necessitated by the needs of the business.
  • Expertise in Computer Aided Design, preferably with Adobe Photoshopâ, and Adobe Illustratorâ is required. Proficiency in Centric PLM systems. Basic personal computer skills, such as Word and Excel in a Microsoft Windowsâ environment, are required.

Our Core Values: The Lilly Way. Rooted in our bold, original, and inclusive brand outlook, these principles define how we do things The Lilly Way.

  • We take pride in the pursuit of excellence
  • We create our own path
  • We become stronger together
  • We operate with integrity
  • We make the world a brighter place
  • We continuously improve
  • We have fun in the process

Doing Our Part

As a company we commit to corporate social responsibility. We believe in doing the right thing for our people, the places we work, and our planet. We believe in a respectful and inclusive workplace. We recognize the importance of serving the communities where our employees work and live.We are cognizant of the impact that our operations can have on the environment and actively explore and pursue environmentally-friendly processes throughout our business. This position is expected to contribute to the advancement of these principles.


A Little More to Know…

  • This position is classified as full-time, salaried, exempt position. This position is eligible for standard company benefits.
  • This position is remote based, with some travel required to our home office in King of Prussia, Pennsylvania and our design studio in Palm Beach, Florida.  Travel needs will be determined by your supervisor. 
  • The position requires some domestic travel.
  • Given the seasonality of the business, this position may require flexible, additional working hours during peak periods.
  • This position is expected to collaborate effectively with other individuals in alignment with our Core Values and Core Leadership Qualities.
  • This position requires compliance with Lilly Pulitzer policies and a detailed Code of Conduct as outlined in the Employee Handbook.
  • This position is reviewed annually.
