jobs.title: Senior Technical Trainer and Content Developer, AI Networking
jobs.excerpt: NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years.
jobs.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people.

Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in an inclusive, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

Can you take a new networking technology apart, build a lab around it, and teach it to a room of engineers? NVIDIA's Education Services is hiring a Senior Technical Trainer and Content Developer to build and teach our networking curriculum for AI factories.

We train the partner and customer engineers who deploy, operate and troubleshoot networks in production. Our courses cover Spectrum-X Ethernet, Quantum InfiniBand, NVLink, and BlueField DPUs with DOCA. This is a builder's role as much as a teaching one: development carries real weight. We build with AI tools every day, and we want engineers who do the same!

What you'll be doing:

We design, build and maintain our own courses: slides, lab guides, demos and assessments. Our hands-on labs run on on-prem equipment and in simulated and emulated environments, including network digital twins on NVIDIA Air. We keep them reliable for every class. Working with subject-matter experts, we turn new products and reference designs into training, often before formal documentation exists. AI coding assistants and agents help us prototype labs, automate environments and draft content, within NVIDIA's guidelines. We verify their output with an engineer's rigor.

We also lead instructor-led training, in person and remotely, and enable partner instructors to deliver our courses. In class we teach, run live demos on real and simulated systems, and resolve lab issues as they come up. Expect up to 20% travel to customer sites and events such as NVIDIA GTC. You will own this work end to end, from first prototype to classroom.

What we need to see:

We are looking for an engineer with deep technical experience and strong self-learning skills, who teaches clearly in English and writes well. Prior training, enablement, documentation or mentoring work all count. We also expect the basics of AI: training and inference, neural networks, deep learning, and why GPUs matter.

  • 12+ years of hands-on experience administering, monitoring and troubleshooting data center networks.
  • CCNP-level certification (Enterprise or Data Center) or equivalent knowledge, with full command of Ethernet and TCP/IP, for example BGP, EVPN and VXLAN.
  • Intermediate Linux, basic cloud and Kubernetes knowledge, and the IT fluency to debug a lab end to end.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Intensive, demonstrable work with AI tools such as Claude, Codex, Cursor, Gemini and open models, including agent skills and workflows.
  • Hands-on labs, simulated or emulated, built for technical audiences, with DevOps and platform skills for lab automation: Git, Docker and containers, Kubernetes (for example Amazon EKS), Argo CD, Terraform, PostgreSQL, Bash or Python.
  • InfiniBand and/or NVLink, RDMA and RoCE, Cumulus Linux and NVOS, and BlueField DPUs with DOCA.
  • NVIDIA AI factory reference designs, product lines and network designs, DGX or HGX clusters, NVIDIA AI Enterprise software, and benchmarks such as NCCL tests.
  • CCIE or an equivalent expert-level certification, and NVIDIA professional-level certification in AI networking.

Are you ready to build the training behind AI factories? Come build it with us!

Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com/

jobs.excerpt: About Cogstate At Cogstate, we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.
jobs.description:
About Cogstate

At Cogstate, we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.

Our digital cognitive assessments are trusted by researchers, clinicians, and pharmaceutical partners around the world, helping to drive breakthroughs in neuroscience and improve outcomes for people living with neurological conditions. Founded on decades of cognitive science and backed by rigorous validation, Cogstate’s assessments are used in more than 150 countries and over 2,000 clinical trials.

Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. Whether we’re supporting a multinational Alzheimer’s trial or developing tools to bring cognitive testing into routine care, our work is meaningful, collaborative, and constantly evolving.

At Cogstate, we’re not just imagining the future of brain health - we’re building it.

About the Clinician Network

By joining the Cogstate Clinician Network, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute your clinical expertise to research studies around the world.

Depending on your background, scales experience, and therapeutic area expertise, we may have an opportunity for you immediately - or it may take some time before a study opens that is the right fit.

Cogstate is continuing to grow and expand our clinical research initiatives, so new projects and opportunities are always on the horizon.

All applicants to the Clinician Network are kept in our active pipeline, and you’ll also receive our monthly Clinician Network newsletter, which shares updates and upcoming openings.

About the Role

Cogstate Clinicians are clinical psychologists or neuropsychologists responsible for delivering remote clinical interviews and cognitive assessment batteries to subjects with preclinical dementia, enrolled in a pharmaceutical clinical trial.

Cogstate provides all consultants with comprehensive, fully compensated training on general Cogstate operational policies, study-specific procedures, customized clinical interviewing skills and virtual cognitive assessment prior to performing remote scale administrations. Regular supervision and ongoing recalibration of clinical skill set will be provided.

*These are contract position.

*They are fully remote.

*Hired employee will work on an as needed basis based on their schedule.

- VINELAND/VABS Administration Experience Required
- Mandarin Fluency Required

Key Responsibilities

Central Rating

  • Remotely administering semi-structured clinical interview assessments and cognitive battery of tests to study subjects and caregivers.
  • Remotely delivering computerized and traditional cognitive assessments via a tele-health platform.
  • Scoring completed scale administrations.
  • Participating in regular clinical skill recalibration activities.

Central Monitoring

  • Providing reviews of completed neuropsychological test batteries for central monitoring of data to ensure accuracy in administration and scoring and contribute to the overall success of a clinical trial.
  • Reviewing response forms and recordings of remote scale administrations and offering feedback to raters via email and telephone communications.

Qualifications & Expertise

  • MA/MS in Psychology or equivalent
  • ≥25 administrations of study scales or similar semi-structured clinical interviews
  • Experience working with pediatric populations with neurodevelopmental delays
    • Rare disease experience is a plus, including Angelman syndrome, Phelan-McDermid syndrome, Fragile X syndrome, or similar disorders
  • Vineland/VABS administration experience
  • Formal training in clinical interviewing and cognitive assessment, including experience working with pediatric populations and caregivers
  • Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience with direct clinical interviewing and psychological assessment in clinical research industry, academic or clinical settings
  • Direct experience with cognitive/behavioral/functional assessment of neurological/psychiatric populations
  • Ability to meet deadlines, being highly organized and methodical, with attention to detail to ensure delivery
  • Proficiency with MS Office, including Word and Excel, email, teleconference platforms such as Skype, Zoom or other similar applications, and cloud-based storage service.
  • Mandarin Fluency

Our Culture
We bring our whole selves to work every day. We’re courageous and we deliver together. We’re passionate individuals who enjoy working together. We’re brave enough and care enough to have the right conversations to get the best outcome and are famous for our can-do attitude. We see challenges as opportunities and move with pace to achieve our goals.

If you’re ready to help us in our journey to optimize the measurement of brain health around the world, please apply now!

jobs.title: Systems Engineer III
jobs.excerpt: In today's dynamic worksites, seamless collaboration between people and machines is essential.
jobs.description:
In today's dynamic worksites, seamless collaboration between people and machines is essential. FORT's platform ensures safe, secure, and dynamic control that surpasses legacy systems and next-generation AI capabilities.

While autonomous machines offer significant advantages, they also introduce new safety challenges. FORT addresses these concerns by providing solutions such as the Wireless E-Stop, which allows operators to instantly stop any machine from a safe distance, enhancing safety during emergencies.

Additionally, FORT's Safe Remote Control enables operators to manage heavy machinery remotely, reducing the risk of accidents and improving visibility.

By ensuring communications integrity across any network, FORT empowers customers to protect their most valuable assets—people, data, and machines—ensuring they remain safe and secure.

As a Systems Engineer, you will join a small, focused team responsible for defining and managing system-level requirements across hardware, firmware, and cloud software for FORT's Pro Series platform. The processes are established; your focus will be execution: driving rigorous requirements definition, developing architecture diagrams, ensuring traceability, and collaborating cross-functionally to make sure every feature is fully specified from happy path to edge cases before development begins.

This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives in a fast-moving, iterative environment and takes pride in producing requirements that support Development Engineers, Test Engineers, and end customers.

Responsibilities

  • Requirements Definition: Work cross-functionally with Development and Test teams to define a complete set of system-level requirements, including happy path, unhappy path, regulatory, safety, and security requirements for platform and product features.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Engage Hardware, Firmware, Cloud Software, and Product teams to ensure requirements reflect the desired system behavior and attributes, and to identify gaps before they become problems downstream.
  • Requirements Management: Author, organize, and maintain requirements in the requirements database (Jama) and steer cross-functional review cycles.
  • Requirement-to-Test Traceability: Partner with Test Engineering to ensure every requirement maps to a test case and that coverage is complete before release. Leverage automation where possible to expedite tracing and ensure comprehensive coverage.
  • Trade Studies: Conduct trade studies to evaluate technical options and provide clear recommendations to Engineering Leadership with supporting rationale.

    • Experience developing experience supporting safety certifications and/or compliance efforts is a plus.

jobs.excerpt: Bookkeeper – Xero, Account Reconciliation & Financial Reporting | Private Aviation | Remote Position Type: Full-Time, Remote Location: Worldwide – Open to International Candidates Working Hours: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM U.
jobs.description:
Bookkeeper – Xero, Account Reconciliation & Financial Reporting | Private Aviation | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Location: Worldwide – Open to International Candidates
Working Hours: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time (ET), Monday–Friday
Industry: Private Aviation / Charter Services
Department: Accounting & Financial Operations

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients, a growing private aviation company, is hiring an experienced Bookkeeper to manage financial records, account reconciliations, vendor payments, and operational reporting.

The company provides on-demand private charter flights and personalized travel experiences for high-net-worth individuals, executives, and entrepreneurs. Its operations involve coordinating aircraft, operators, catering, ground transportation, and other services across multiple destinations worldwide.

This is a hands-on accounting role requiring strong experience with Xero, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, international payments, and financial reconciliation.

You’ll be responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, reconciling 10+ accounts, tracking payments to international vendors and operators, and helping leadership understand the profitability of individual flights.

Beyond day-to-day bookkeeping, you’ll have the opportunity to improve accounting processes through better reporting, dashboards, templates, and automation.

What You’ll Own

Bookkeeping & Account Reconciliation

  • Perform monthly and quarterly reconciliations across 10+ bank, credit card, HubSpot, and accounting accounts.
  • Maintain accurate financial records using Xero.
  • Review, categorize, and reconcile business expenses.
  • Manage consistent expense coding and chart-of-accounts classifications.
  • Identify duplicate payments, missing transactions, unusual charges, and discrepancies.
  • Reconcile bank statements and corporate card transactions.
  • Maintain supporting documentation for financial transactions.
  • Ensure accounting records remain organized, accurate, and ready for reporting.

Accounts Payable, Receivable & Vendor Payments

  • Track vendor and customer payments, outstanding balances, and payment statuses.
  • Coordinate domestic and international vendor payments.
  • Process and monitor foreign-currency transactions through platforms such as Convera GlobalPay.
  • Maintain accurate payment records and supporting documentation.
  • Coordinate with international operators, vendors, and internal teams to resolve payment discrepancies.
  • Monitor recurring expenses and vendor costs.
  • Identify changes in fixed expenses, including increases, decreases, and discontinued services.
  • Respond promptly to urgent payment issues affecting active trips.

HubSpot & Booking Management

  • Maintain accurate booking and payment information within HubSpot CRM.
  • Update deal stages as bookings progress from quotation through completion.
  • Track booking details, including:
    • Trip dates and routing
    • Aircraft and operators
    • Booking prices
    • Invoice status
    • Payment status
  • Reconcile HubSpot deal information against Xero financial records.
  • Ensure booking, sales, and accounting records remain aligned.
  • Investigate discrepancies between recorded revenue and booking information.

Trip Profitability & Financial Reporting

  • Track gross and net profit margins for individual flights and trips.
  • Monitor expenses associated with:
    • Aircraft charter services
    • Catering
    • Ground transportation
    • Operators and vendors
    • Additional operational costs
  • Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual expense reports.
  • Maintain consolidated financial reporting.
  • Develop vendor and fixed-cost variance reports.
  • Identify spending trends and unusual financial activity.
  • Prepare management reports covering expenses, margins, payments, and operating costs.
  • Provide accurate financial information to support leadership decisions.

Accounting Systems & Process Improvement

  • Develop and maintain financial reporting templates using Excel and Google Sheets.
  • Build dashboards for profitability, expense tracking, and financial variance analysis.
  • Combine and clean financial data exported from multiple systems.
  • Organize accounting documentation and shared financial folders.
  • Improve reporting accuracy and reduce repetitive manual work.
  • Identify opportunities to automate bookkeeping and reconciliation processes.
  • Help develop scalable accounting workflows as the company grows.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in bookkeeping, accounting operations, financial analysis, or a related role.
  • Proven hands-on experience using Xero for bookkeeping, reconciliations, expense coding, and reporting.
  • Experience managing monthly and quarterly reconciliations across 10 or more accounts simultaneously.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets.
  • Experience processing international payments and foreign-currency transactions.
  • Strong understanding of accounts payable, accounts receivable, and expense management.
  • Experience preparing financial reports and analyzing discrepancies.
  • Fluent English with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work 9:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time, Monday through Friday.
  • Availability for occasional after-hours, weekend, and holiday emergencies.
  • Reliable phone access for urgent financial matters.
  • Dedicated, secure remote workspace with reliable high-speed internet.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to work independently.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and sound judgment when handling confidential financial information.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience with Convera GlobalPay, including international payment processing and approval workflows.
  • Experience with HubSpot CRM or similar deal-management platforms.
  • Previous experience in private aviation, charter services, luxury travel, or hospitality.
  • Experience supporting U.S.-based businesses.
  • Familiarity with U.S. dollar accounting and international vendor transactions.
  • Experience building automated financial reports and dashboards.
  • Xero Advisor Certification.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

Tools & Technical Skills

Xero – Required

Candidates should be comfortable with:

  • Bank feeds and bank rules
  • Bank and corporate card reconciliations
  • Chart of accounts management
  • Expense categorization and coding
  • Bills, invoices, and payment tracking
  • Supporting financial documentation
  • Tracking categories for trip-level reporting
  • Profit & Loss statements
  • Balance Sheets
  • Aged Payables and Aged Receivables

Microsoft Excel & Google Sheets – Required

Advanced skills should include:

  • XLOOKUP and VLOOKUP
  • INDEX/MATCH
  • SUMIFS
  • Conditional formulas
  • Pivot tables
  • Data validation
  • Conditional formatting
  • Financial dashboards
  • Expense and variance reporting
  • Cleaning and combining data exports

Convera GlobalPay

  • International beneficiary management
  • Domestic and international payment processing
  • Foreign-currency transactions
  • Payment approval workflows
  • Payment tracking and confirmations
  • Reconciliation reporting

HubSpot CRM

  • Deal and pipeline management
  • Booking and payment tracking
  • Deal-stage updates
  • Contact and company records
  • Exporting booking and payment information
  • Reconciling CRM data against accounting records

Additional Platforms

Google Drive | Banking Platforms | Corporate Card Systems | Financial Reporting Tools

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Take pride in maintaining accurate, organized financial records.
  • Have extensive hands-on experience with Xero.
  • Can confidently reconcile 10+ accounts without missing deadlines.
  • Naturally investigate discrepancies and unusual transactions.
  • Understand international vendor payments and foreign-currency transactions.
  • Can translate financial data into useful reports for leadership.
  • Have strong Excel and Google Sheets skills.
  • Are comfortable working with multiple financial systems.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve accounting processes.
  • Can work independently without constant supervision.
  • Understand the importance of discretion when handling confidential financial information.
  • Remain responsive when urgent payment issues arise.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by reviewing bank and corporate card activity, reconciling transactions in Xero, and identifying any discrepancies requiring attention.

You might then process an international vendor payment through Convera, update payment records in HubSpot, reconcile booking information against accounting records, or follow up on outstanding balances.

Throughout the day, you’ll review trip-related expenses, calculate flight profitability, prepare financial reports, and maintain dashboards that help leadership understand business performance.

You may also improve an existing spreadsheet, automate a recurring report, or organize financial documentation to make accounting processes more efficient.

In short: You’ll keep the company’s books accurate, vendor payments organized, and flight profitability visible while building more efficient financial systems.

Schedule & Availability

This is a fully remote, full-time position open to candidates worldwide.

Core Working Hours: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time, Monday–Friday.

Because private aviation operates across different time zones, occasional support outside standard business hours is required.

You must be available to respond to time-sensitive financial matters, including:

  • Urgent operator payments
  • Declined corporate cards during active trips
  • International vendor payment issues
  • Financial problems that could disrupt a scheduled flight

Occasional evening, weekend, and holiday availability is required when emergencies arise.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Accurate monthly and quarterly reconciliations across 10+ accounts
  • Timely completion of month-end close
  • Accuracy of Xero financial records
  • Alignment between HubSpot booking records and accounting data
  • Timely and accurate vendor payments
  • Accurate tracking of international and foreign-currency transactions
  • Reliable trip-level gross and net margin reporting
  • Identification and resolution of financial discrepancies
  • Quality and timeliness of management reporting
  • Improved accounting workflows and reduced manual processes

What Success Looks Like

First 90 Days

You’ll have:

  • Learned the company’s accounting systems and vendor network.
  • Aligned HubSpot deal records with financial records.
  • Completed a full monthly close.
  • Reconciled all 10+ relevant accounts.
  • Delivered the first trip-level profitability report.
  • Established reliable processes for ongoing financial tracking.

Within Your First Year

Leadership will rely on your reporting to:

  • Evaluate flight profitability.
  • Make informed pricing decisions.
  • Compare vendor costs.
  • Monitor operational expenses.
  • Identify financial trends and opportunities.

You’ll also have helped make the monthly and quarterly close process faster, more organized, and increasingly automated.

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Recruiter Screening
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re an experienced Bookkeeper, Accounting Specialist, or Financial Operations professional with strong expertise in Xero, account reconciliations, Excel, Google Sheets, international payments, and financial reporting, we’d love to hear from you.

Join a growing private aviation company where you’ll take ownership of financial accuracy, support international operations, and help develop scalable accounting systems.

This opportunity is fully remote and open to qualified candidates worldwide who can work U.S. Eastern Time hours.

SSP International, Inc. (SSPI) is an international non-profit organization whose mission is to provide transformational opportunities to learn, do, and belong in science. Our work began in 1959 with the Summer Science Program, an intensive STEM immersion experience for highly motivated high school students.
Today, SSPI brings together young people, scientists, educators, and alumni through a shared commitment to scientific inquiry, collaboration, and belonging. More than 5,000 Summer Science Program alumni are part of our growing community.
Guided by a 10-year strategic plan focused on Scale, Diversify, and Transform, SSPI is building on that foundation to reach more young people and educators in more places. We are expanding access to the Summer Science Program, supporting students through College Link mentorship, and bringing new approaches to science teaching into classrooms through the STEM Learning Institute. Under the direction of the Senior Director of Advancement, the Development Coordinator will help execute and support SSPI's fundraising strategies by managing donor communications, maintaining accurate fundraising data, coordinating mail processes, and supporting reporting and administrative functions. This role is highly detail-oriented and plays a key role in ensuring timely donor stewardship and smooth development operations.

Bachelor's degree and 1 year of professional experience with administrative tasks common to non-profits or an equivalent combination of education and experience, or High School Diploma or the equivalent and 4 years of professional experience.

jobs.description:
About Rewiring America

Rewiring America puts American households at the center of an affordable, resilient, all-electric future. We partner with policymakers, industry leaders, manufacturers, workers, and communities to strengthen the electric grid, lower energy prices, and build homegrown energy solutions for all.

About the role

We are seeking an entrepreneurial and visionary VP Campaigns & Policy to join our executive leadership team. The position is for a systems thinker who understands how to make markets, policy, politics, and public sentiment come together to transform the status quo, and who has the experience, expertise and passion to do so here. The role requires a leader who is a strategist, a coalition builder and someone committed to securing real and lasting policy wins. They must see what we see: that there is no better time to build and advance an agenda that centers the household and communities in an energy transformation where electricity is cheap, clean and abundant.

This position is an integral part of our nimble leadership team. Your first commitments are:

  • Shaping the organization’s long-term impact, culture, and financial health
  • Designing and winning campaigns that lower bills for all Americans

You will manage a dynamic campaigns function, leading and delivering on legislative and regulatory campaigns. In your first 100 days you’ll set a multi-state agenda that builds momentum toward a 2028 federal agenda. Partnering closely with our technical leadership, you will ensure our campaigns are supported by the data and tools needed to win the argument that families should be spending less on energy bills.

What you'll do

Reporting to the CEO, you will be a critical member of executive leadership, helping guide the organization into its next chapter. You will be accountable for embracing and delivering on a 3-year strategic plan that provides immediate financial relief to families, lowers emissions, and positions Rewiring America for long-term political and policy influence.

As our VP of Campaigns & Policy you will:

  • Lead the organization. Serving as a key member of the executive team, you’ll shape organizational priorities, and decisions, and be accountable for shared outcomes and results. You’ll foster a culture of impact and accountability across our teams.
  • Build influence and deliver measurable impact. You’ll mobilize transpartisan coalitions, build influential relationships with policymakers, regulators, and industry leaders, and secure policy wins that drive measurable results, including more homes electrified and lower household energy costs.
  • Deliver winning campaigns. You’ll lead state and federal legislative and regulatory campaigns that advance Homegrown Energy, lower household energy costs, and strengthen energy resilience. You’ll turn strategy into action, navigating political challenges, shaping public sentiments, and delivering results.
  • Be a leading voice. Representing Rewiring America as a trusted authority in the media, at high-profile events, and at speaking engagements, you’ll translate complex policy issues into compelling narratives. These will shape public discourse, influence decision-makers, and ultimately advance our campaign outcomes.
  • Drive research, data, and technology priorities. Partner with senior leaders and SMEs to shape research, data science, and technology priorities that strengthen campaigns, equip our advocacy partner, and position Rewiring America as a trusted authority on energy affordability.
  • Mobilize the public. In partnership with internal teams, drive communications, engagement, and branding efforts to influence public opinion and mobilize Rewiring America’s audiences, coaches, and advocates in support of our campaigns.
  • Raise money. Work closely with the Advancement team to raise money that will expand Rewiring America’s impact.
  • Lead a high-impact team. Cultivate a results-driven Policy & Campaigns team. You’ll establish clear expectations, empower decision-making, and manage resources and budgets to deliver on priorities.

Who you are

You are driven by a commitment to Rewiring America’s values, vision, and mission. You are a relentless, winning leader who is motivated by delivering meaningful outcomes for American families. With expediency, creativity, and determination, you solve complex problems by finding new paths when conventional methods fall short. You embrace the idea that we can do big things, demonstrating humility, curiosity, and a learner’s mindset. You turn setbacks into opportunities to learn, adapt, and win as a passionate, mission-oriented team.

You are an organizational leader first, embracing collective responsibility for Rewiring America’s success while also inspiring a high-performing team. You combine deep policy expertise with strong political instincts and a systems-level understanding of how markets, regulation, politics, and public opinion shape meaningful change. You are a skilled bridge builder and negotiator who brings together government, industry, and advocates to navigate complex challenges, build consensus, and secure lasting policy wins. Above all, you measure success by the impact you deliver: more communities electrified and lower energy bills for American households.

The selected candidate will also possess the following Core and Preferred qualifications and characteristics:

Core qualifications:

  • Strong commitment to the mission, policies and goals of Rewiring America.
  • 10+ years of experience in campaigning, policy, advocacy, and/or related fields,
  • At least 5 years of experience in a senior leadership role, with demonstrated success coaching, and leading high-performing teams.
  • Experience or the ability to quickly acquire knowledge and expertise in and knowledge in the U.S. power sector and home energy markets, including utility rate design, resource planning, grid policy, and clean energy finance.
  • Demonstrated success leading and winning state and national legislative and regulatory campaigns, building influential coalitions, and leveraging strong communications and negotiation skills to navigate complex political landscapes and deliver meaningful outcomes.
  • Strong operational acumen with experience managing budgets and resources, and balancing competing priorities with team capacity.
  • Resourceful, adaptable, and persistent in overcoming obstacles, with a demonstrated ability to turn setbacks into opportunities.
  • Willingness and ability to travel domestically 25% or more

Preferred qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree and/or equivalent work experience.
  • Senior experience in government: a White House, federal agency, legislative , or gubernatorial office.
  • Established strong relationships with state governors, legislators, Public Utility Commission (PUC) commissioners, and other senior policymakers, regulatory leaders and advocacy groups.
  • Demonstrated success negotiating complex, high-stakes agreements among government, industry, and advocacy leaders.

Benefits

Rewiring America is proud to offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

  • Generous offerings in health insurance plans and premiums.
  • 100% employer-paid short term and long term disability insurance and life insurance policies.
  • Employees are eligible for a 401(k) retirement plan with employer contributions.
  • Employees are also eligible for pre-tax transportation benefits.
  • Full Time Employees will receive 160 hours of vacation time, 80 hours of health leave, up to 2 days of casual leave, and 24 hours of volunteer leave annually.

jobs.description:
We Are
Accenture Song accelerates growth and value for our clients through sustained customer relevance. We bring together strategy, creativity, and technology to help organizations imagine and deliver growth across brand, business, product, marketing, commerce, and service. With deep industry expertise and strong client partnerships, B2B Customer Growth leaders design and execute growth strategies that solve real customer needs and deliver measurable outcomes.



You Are
A seasoned growth strategist with 10+ years of experience translating vision into execution and measurable value. You are passionate about solving customer problems in ways that drive lasting impact, and you thrive at the intersection of growth strategy and operational delivery. You are equally comfortable working shoulder-to-shoulder with client executives and leading teams to execute complex transformations. Beyond shaping strategies, you are adept at embedding within client relationships, partnering with Accenture account leads, and identifying new opportunities, both organic and inorganic, that grow Accenture Song’s impact and our clients’ businesses. You are also a thought leader, energized by developing provocative perspectives on the future of CMT or Financial Services industry and packaging them in ways that drive new conversations, opportunities, and growth.



The Work
As a Senior Manager in Customer Growth Strategy, you will:


    • Partner with CMT or FS clients to define and deliver holistic growth strategies that span brand, business, product, marketing, commerce, and service.

    • Support strategic account growth, client development and revenue acceleration initiatives for priority customers
    • Lead cross-functional teams, providing oversight and coaching to deliver on high-impact growth initiatives.
    • Develop and publish thought-provoking points of view on future industry trends, growth levers, and customer behaviors, packaging insights in ways that drive market conversations and sales opportunities.
    • Build strong partnerships across Accenture to bring together creativity, technology, and intelligence to deliver end-to-end growth solutions.
    • Build strong relationships with client stakeholders and act as a trusted advisor on growth, customer and commercial challenges


Basic Qualifications


    • 10+ years of relevant experience in growth strategy, customer strategy, or related consulting/advisory roles.

Job Title:

Director, Specialty Sales, High Technology

Job Description

We're Concentrix. The global technology and services leader that powers the world’s best brands, today and into the future. We’re solution-focused, tech-powered, intelligence-fueled. With unique data and insights, deep industry expertise, and advanced technology solutions, we’re the intelligent transformation partner that powers a world that works, helping companies become refreshingly simple to work, interact, and transact with. We shape new game-changing careers in over 70 countries, attracting the best talent. Join us and be part of this journey towards greater opportunities and brighter futures.
The Sector seller is responsible for developing a sector-led sales strategy allowing Concentrix to address industries’ unique needs and to create deals that align to the prospects’ imperatives and solve their business problems. They achieve this though building a high profile within the sector/market through leadership and becoming a genuine ‘person of interest’.
They will develop a priority list of targets within a sector or market, and they will nurture these into leads and will then manage the opportunities from initial sales qualification, through pursuit to close. To achieve this, they will assemble and lead a strong multifunctional team for each deal, which utilizes enterprise solution support, practice area expertise and the development of productive relationships with key buyers and decision-makers at the potential new clients. This is a strategic, individual contributor role who brings to bear the best of sales at Concentrix, within a high-culture team environment, that positively encourages growth and development.

This is a Work-at-Home role within the United States.

Strategic Selling and Business Growth:

  • Acts as a creator and driver who can originate, shape, and commercially enable complex sales opportunities and maintain both an active priority target list and deal funnel as a result.
    - Proactively generates and builds new client relationships from qualification to close.
    - Demonstrates a strong understanding of CX Operations and specialist propositions, and our ability to bring people, technology and transformation to bear for client benefit, highly tailored to their sector.
    - Acts as a proven storyteller who can build and maintain c-level relationships across multiple disciplines, lines of business, and strategic needs, with a targeted enterprise prospect, including but not limited to, IT, CX, Operations, HR, Finance and Procurement.
    - Provides effective and clear leadership to virtual pursuit teams featuring SMEs from multiple practices and disciplines of the company. Acts as an advisor and coach internally to develop win strategy through to close plan.
    - Articulates a compelling and differentiated value proposition to the prospect, that aligns to their business outcomes and industry context.
    - Sustains urgency through creating compelling events through active listening, storytelling, and personal experiences.
    - Supports and leads business negotiation for complex transactions and opportunities.
    - Works closely with portfolio leaders and practice leaders to leverage relevant subject matter experts in support of the pursuit.
    - Engages the global leadership as appropriate and shepherds the deal through the solutioning and approval process.
    - Provides discipline and rigor to the sales process as an expert on sales best practices.
    - Successfully leads and aligns a complex network of stakeholders, including interaction with senior management levels at a client and/or within Concentrix, involving negotiating or influencing significant matters.

Knowledge and Expertise:

  • Develops sector-specific knowledge in collaboration with Sector and Portfolio leaders to deliver a Sector-led sales strategy and leverages this expertise throughout all stages of the sales process. Ensures the wider organization benefits from this specialized knowledge by sharing insights and best practices across teams.
  • Acts as the technology sales overlay across high tech customers.
    - Builds and demonstrates a very clear understanding of the target client’s business and their strategic business objectives and revisits these objectives in line with the client’s strategic reviews
    - Demonstrates a strong understanding and knowledge of BPO and Technical Services associated with their target client’s industry sector - customer experience transformation.
    - Develops and executes the sales strategy across all appropriate levels of the target client organization. Can develop the long-term growth strategy for Concentrix within the allocated accounts and in line with the sector and portfolio strategy. Supports the Portfolio and Sector Leaders in the development of that sector strategy.
    - Leverages exceptional communication skills to create and share thought leadership, as well as speaking and networking at relevant sector-based forums both internally and externally.

Collaboration and Coordination:

  • Works closely with Portfolio Leads, Sector Leaders, and other internal teams to align sales strategies with overall business goals.
    - Provides effective and timely transition of the client relationships to the appointed Account Executive for sold deals
    - Leverages internal resources and expertise to develop and propose high-value and profitable solutions to clients.
    - Collaborates with Account Executives to understand the context of their respective accounts as well as with a broader sales and account management community by sharing insights, best practices, and assisting with sales-related tasks.

Reporting and Analytics:

  • Monitors and reports on sales performance, tracking key metrics, and reports on progress to Sales Leaders.
    - Gathers and shares client feedback and insights with internal teams to inform strategy and improve service offerings.
    - Prepares and delivers regular reports and updates to Leaders on sales performance and metrics.

Professional Development:

  • Stays updated on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in their sector.
    - Participates in training and development programs to enhance skills and knowledge.
    - Actively seeks opportunities for professional growth and career advancement within the organization.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Marketing, or a related field with 6+ years of experience as a sales hunter (B2B sales) and individual contributor.
    - At least 3 years’ experience in the CX tech and/or BPO marketplace where they have experience of closing complex B2B deals.
    - Experience interacting with and selling to senior leaders (c-level) across multiple functions and lines of business, including but not limited to, CX, Operations, Technology, Finance, Sourcing, etc.
    - Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to build new client relationships of trust and become a trusted advisor.
    - Excellent problem-solving and conflict-resolution abilities.
    - Ability to analyze data and use insights to lead solution build processes and win strategy creation.
    - Proficiency in using CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce) and other relevant tools.
    - Self-starter and strong time management skills.
    - Ability to work collaboratively within a closely linked team environment.

jobs.excerpt: About Us: YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B.
jobs.description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.

About The Role:

We're looking for an experienced, entrepreneurial enterprise sales professional to lead YipitData's growth within the world's largest management consulting firms.
While we've established relationships with leading consulting organizations, including Tier 1 firms, significant opportunity remains to deepen our presence and expand adoption across the largest firms.

In this senior individual contributor role, you'll own our most strategic consulting accounts, with a primary focus on developing new relationships, expanding into additional practices and buying centers, and driving meaningful adoption of YipitData's proprietary data, research, and insights across these organizations.

We're looking for someone who brings deep familiarity with the consulting industry, understands how consulting firms evaluate, purchase, and leverage external data and insights, and can navigate the unique organizational structures and commercial dynamics of these institutions.

This is a highly entrepreneurial role. While YipitData has extensive experience delivering insights to sophisticated customers, our go-to-market approach within major consulting firms is still evolving. You'll have significant ownership in shaping our consulting strategy, from identifying high-value practices and use cases to developing effective commercial models and building a repeatable approach to driving adoption and growth across complex consulting organizations.

The ideal candidate combines a proven track record of selling data and insights solutions into leading consulting firms with strong commercial judgment, an understanding of the consulting operating model, and a passion for building new business.

This is a remote-friendly opportunity that can sit in NYC (where our headquarters is located), one of our office hubs, or anywhere else in the US. However, depending upon where the remote work is performed, income could be subject to New York State tax withholding.

As Our Senior Sales Executive You Will:

  • Own our Tier 1 Consulting commercial strategy: Lead commercial development across the world's largest management consulting firms, with responsibility for expanding relationships, identifying new opportunities, and driving meaningful adoption of YipitData's solutions.
  • Expand our presence within strategic accounts: Build on existing customer relationships while proactively opening doors into new practices, teams, and buying centers across complex consulting organizations.
  • Identify high-value use cases and buyers: Develop a deep understanding of how consulting teams leverage external data, research, and insights across client engagements, identifying the practices, decision-makers, and business challenges where YipitData can deliver differentiated value.
  • Navigate complex consulting operating models: Understand the dynamics of project-based purchasing, practice-level decision-making, and centralized research or procurement functions to develop effective commercial strategies.
  • Drive new business and account expansion: Lead complex sales cycles from prospecting and discovery through solution development, stakeholder engagement, commercial negotiations, and closing, with a focus on acquiring new buying centers and expanding adoption within existing institutions.
  • Build senior-level relationships: Establish credibility with partners, practice leaders, research stakeholders, and other key decision-makers to develop relationships that support broader adoption and long-term commercial growth.
  • Sell differentiated data and insights solutions: Work closely with our Solutions and Research teams to connect YipitData's proprietary capabilities to the specific needs of consulting teams and the strategic questions they are helping clients answer.
  • Develop scalable commercial models: Help determine the most effective approaches to serving consulting clients, including project-based opportunities, practice-level relationships, and broader enterprise agreements.
  • Establish strategic customer partnerships: Prioritize building meaningful, durable relationships with leading consulting firms that create a foundation for recurring usage, broader adoption, and long-term revenue growth.
  • Develop a repeatable sales playbook: Translate customer feedback, market learnings, and early commercial wins into actionable strategies that improve our ability to win and expand across the consulting vertical.
  • Own pipeline development and forecasting: Build and manage a strategic pipeline of enterprise opportunities, maintaining strong deal discipline and accurate revenue forecasts.

You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You have extensive experience selling data, research, analytics, or insights solutions into major management consulting firms, ideally including McKinsey, BCG, Bain, or other leading global consulting organizations.
  • You understand the consulting operating model. You have firsthand experience navigating the organizational structures, purchasing dynamics, and commercial priorities of major consulting firms, including the relationship between individual project teams, practices, and centralized functions.
  • You understand how consultants use external data and insights. You can identify compelling applications for differentiated data and research across consulting engagements and understand what drives adoption among consulting professionals.
  • You have a demonstrated track record of developing and expanding business within large, complex consulting organizations, including opening new buying centers, building relationships across practices, and navigating sophisticated, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
  • You're a proactive, strategic business developer who enjoys creating opportunities from scratch, expanding relationships beyond initial stakeholders, and identifying new commercial opportunities within complex accounts.
  • You have experience navigating complex commercial and purchasing models within consulting firms, including project-driven demand, practice-level adoption, and enterprise agreements, and understand how to translate individual project opportunities into broader, recurring commercial relationships.
  • You have experience operating in emerging markets, developing new customer segments, or introducing new solutions, and you're comfortable building a go-to-market approach without a fully established playbook.

Cardata is where driven people make an outsized impact. We’re a small but mighty team transforming how businesses manage vehicle reimbursement — replacing outdated programs with smart, automated solutions.

We’re building an Integrations pod, and we’re hiring a Full-Stack Engineer to help shape it. Reporting to the Engineering Manager, you’ll work with Product, Design, QA, partners, and subject-matter experts to turn customer needs into technical designs and build integrations end to end, from a partner’s API to the screens customers use to connect and configure them. You’ll agree on scope and success criteria before building, ship in small increments against agreed dates, and keep your integrations healthy in production.

You’ll also collaborate with other Portal engineers wherever integrations connect with reimbursements, payments, and insurance verification. A separate team builds our driver mobile app.

What You’ll Do

  • Own integrations from technical design through launch and ongoing production support, working directly with Product, partners, and subject-matter experts.
  • Agree on scope, success criteria, and delivery dates with Product before building. Clarify incomplete requirements and partner API documentation, break work into shippable pieces, and raise risks early.
  • Build backend services, data models, APIs, background jobs, and customer-facing screens for connecting and configuring integrations.
  • Design data mapping, synchronization, retries, and reconciliation within established platform patterns.
  • Build syncs, webhooks, and scheduled jobs that handle duplicate events, partial failures, and partner outages reliably.
  • Create clear adapter interfaces and shared building blocks for authentication, data mapping, synchronization, and error handling, making each new integration easier to deliver.
  • Agree on test plans with the QA Architect and write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests that validate customer workflows and failure scenarios.
  • Own delivery timelines and outcomes, demo your progress, and keep integrations healthy after launch.
  • Use AI coding agents throughout development to prototype, implement, debug, refactor, and test. Review their plans, verify their output, and hold AI-generated code to the same testing and code-review standards as any other contribution.
  • Protect credentials, payment details, and drivers’ personal information through secure token handling, appropriate access controls, encryption, safe logging, and reliable separation of customer data.
  • Strengthen engineering practices through code reviews, pairing, onboarding, and input on architecture decision records.
  • Make technical decisions within existing platform patterns. Document departures through architecture decision records and follow established review processes for new libraries and infrastructure changes.

In your first 30 days, you’ll learn how our existing integrations work and ship changes to at least one in production. Within three months, you’ll have designed, scoped, and delivered your first new integration by its agreed deadline. Within six months, several integrations you’ve contributed to will be live and meeting their agreed success criteria, and you’ll be a trusted integration partner for the other Portal engineers.

What You Bring

  • 4+ years building modern web applications, including hands-on work with third-party integrations and PostgreSQL or another relational database. Your track record matters more than your title.
  • Strong full-stack experience across backend services and product interfaces. You can walk us through a feature you owned from database to screen, including the trade-offs between its schema, API, and UI.
  • Experience building and supporting integrations that customers depend on, including syncs, webhooks, and scheduled jobs. You can explain an integration that failed, how you handled it, and what you changed afterward.
  • Experience creating reusable integration architecture, including adapter interfaces and shared capabilities for authentication, mapping, synchronization, and error handling.
  • Daily experience using AI coding agents such as Cursor or Claude Code. You work from clear specifications, provide useful context, review generated work, and can explain how AI has improved your speed and quality.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including clean, maintainable code, performance, scalability, unit testing, integration testing, end-to-end testing, and CI/CD.
  • The ability to break complex or ambiguous problems into clear deliverables, agree on scope and success criteria, raise risks early, and take responsibility for timelines and outcomes.
  • Experience working directly with Product, partners, and subject-matter experts to clarify requirements, shape solutions, and explain technical decisions.
  • Practical experience protecting sensitive information in a product used by multiple customers, including OAuth, token handling, role-based access, encryption at rest, safe logging, and customer data isolation.
  • A collaborative approach to helping other engineers through thoughtful code reviews, pairing, and knowledge sharing.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with AWS services such as Lambda, SQS, or SNS.
  • Experience building internal tools, platforms, or design systems.
  • Experience with analytics and data tools such as Snowflake or ThoughtSpot.

jobs.excerpt: Job Title: Communications and Branding Consultancy – Unarmed Civilian Protection (UCP) Academy Department: Programming Duty Station: Remote Administrative Line Manager: UCP Academy Manager Position Type: Consultancy 1.
jobs.description:
Job Title: Communications and Branding Consultancy – Unarmed Civilian Protection (UCP) Academy
Department: Programming
Duty Station: Remote
Administrative Line Manager: UCP Academy Manager
Position Type: Consultancy

1. Background

Nonviolent Peaceforce (NP) advances civilian-led, nonviolent approaches to the protection of civilians and the prevention and reduction of violence. The UCP Academy is an online learning initiative supporting accessible, high-quality learning on Unarmed Civilian Protection and related practice. As its digital platform is being strengthened, the Academy is preparing for its hard launch in the first half of 2027.

In parallel, the Academy is running a three-month pilot with Viamo that adapts NP’s Introduction to UCP course into an interactive, voice-based learning experience delivered by basic mobile phone in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The pilot tests a scalable way to reach people who face barriers to conventional online or in-person training, such as limited connectivity, no access to smartphones or computers, low digital literacy, geographic isolation or a preference for oral learning.

The Academy seeks a Communications and Branding Consultant to complement the work of its Web Design Consultant with a focus on five priorities: defining a branding strategy for the Academy that is rooted in NP’s brand while creating space for partnerships; documenting the Viamo voice-training pilot through case studies; designing a marketing strategy for the launch of the Academy’s online platform; developing the Academy’s social media strategy and branding; and establishing a consistent brand system across Academy products and publications.

2. Objective

The objective of this consultancy is to strengthen the UCP Academy’s brand, marketing and communications so that it can attract and engage learners, partners and supporters. Specifically, the Consultant will:

  • Branding strategy: develop a branding strategy for the UCP Academy that is rooted in Nonviolent Peaceforce’s brand identity and values and that creates clear space for partners to be visible through co-branding and co-delivery;
  • Pilot case studies: produce case studies on the Viamo voice-training pilot in the DRC for social media, the Academy website and partner and donor audiences;
  • Launch marketing strategy: design a marketing strategy for the launch of the Academy’s online platform and produce the related promotional materials;
  • Social media strategy and branding: develop a social media strategy and a branded social media presence for the Academy, aligned with NP’s channels;
  • Brand templates: create brand templates for Academy products and publications, building on the branding strategy, visual identity, tone of voice and website content.

3. Duration and Location

  • Period: 4 January 2027 to 28 February 2027
  • Level of effort: Up to 20 working days in total
  • Fee: up to USD 8,000 in total
  • Location: Remote
  • Work planning: Days may be used flexibly, based on a workplan agreed with the UCP Academy Manager.

4. Reporting Line

The Consultant will report directly to the UCP Academy Manager and will work in close collaboration with relevant NP consultants and communications staff. For pilot-related content, the Consultant will coordinate, through the UCP Academy Manager, with the NP DRC team and Viamo focal points.

5. Scope of Work

5.1 Branding strategy rooted in Nonviolent Peaceforce’s brand

  • Review NP brand guidelines, existing Academy content and communications materials, and consult key stakeholders (NP communications staff, the Academy team, NP country programmes and selected partners) on target audiences, perceptions and key messages.
  • Develop a branding strategy for the UCP Academy that positions it clearly as Nonviolent Peaceforce’s learning offer, defining its brand positioning, value proposition, core messages and brand personality, and drawing on NP’s identity, field credibility and UCP principles, including the primacy of civilians affected by conflict, nonviolence and nonpartisanship.
  • Define the Academy’s brand architecture, setting out how it relates to the NP master brand (e.g. as an endorsed sub-brand), which NP brand elements it inherits and where it may have its own distinct visual and verbal expression.
  • Create space for partnerships by developing a partnership and co-branding framework with tiered options (e.g. NP-led, co-delivered and partner-led adaptations), logo lock-ups and placement rules, attribution and visibility guidance, so that partners such as Viamo, local civil-society organisations, training institutions and humanitarian actors can be visible while NP retains responsibility for UCP content integrity, quality assurance and safeguarding standards.
  • Refresh the Academy’s visual identity (logo usage, colour palette, typography, imagery and iconography) and develop a tone of voice, in English and French, that reflects NP’s values and speaks to practitioners, community actors, students, partners and donors, including audiences reached through oral and low-literacy formats.
  • Redesign and rewrite website content (homepage, course and membership descriptions, calls to action) so that it is clear, accessible and search-friendly.
  • Work with the Web Design Consultant to integrate content and branding coherently into the website, app and user journeys.

5.2 Case studies on the Viamo voice-training pilot in the DRC

  • Develop a case-study format and editorial plan aligned with the final phase and close of the pilot (e.g. final weeks of delivery, learner feedback and end-of-pilot results).
  • Write a series of short case studies for NP and Academy social media channels and the Academy website, covering: why voice-based learning on basic mobile phones makes foundational UCP learning accessible; the learner journey, from the voluntary screening and baseline survey through Lesson 1 (“When people feel unsafe, what do they do?”) and Lesson 2 (“Choosing safer, nonviolent protection actions”) and the knowledge checks; two-way participation by voice or keypad; the NP–Viamo partnership model; and results and insights on participation, completion, comprehension, confidence and learner preferences.
  • Produce one longer-form case study or learning brief for partners and donors that presents the pilot’s results, lessons learned and potential for scale to further languages, modules, countries and partner-led adaptation.
  • Produce accompanying visuals, captions and short-form adaptations (e.g. quote cards, carousels and, where appropriate, short audio clips), in English with French adaptations as needed, and Swahili excerpts where available from pilot content.
  • Gather information remotely in coordination with the NP DRC team and Viamo, using only content and voices obtained with informed consent. Anonymise participants and exclude sensitive incident details or identifying information, in line with the pilot’s safeguarding and data-minimisation protocols.
  • Provide a reusable case-study template so Academy staff can document future phases, new languages or other roll-outs of the voice-training model.

5.3 Marketing strategy for the launch of the Academy’s online platform

  • Develop a marketing strategy for the launch of the Academy’s online platform, defining marketing objectives, target audience segments (e.g. UCP and protection practitioners, NP staff and country programmes, students, partner organisations and donors), the value proposition and key messages for each segment, and pathways from awareness to registration, course enrolment and membership.
  • Set out a channel mix and phased plan covering the pre-launch, launch and post-launch phases, including the Academy website, NP and Academy social media, email and newsletters, NP country programmes and partner networks, sector platforms, webinars and events, with recommendations on low-cost organic options and, where relevant, targeted paid promotion.
  • Integrate the Viamo pilot case studies and partner voices into the launch narrative as evidence of the Academy’s reach, accessibility and partnership model.
  • Define key performance indicators and a simple monitoring framework (e.g. reach, engagement, website traffic, registrations, course enrolments and partner uptake), with indicative targets and recommended tracking tools.
  • Produce launch promotional materials, such as teaser and announcement social media posts, email announcements and newsletter content, flyers, web banners and a short presentation.
  • Prepare a partner toolkit with ready-to-share and co-branded content for NP country programmes, partners and networks, in line with the partnership and co-branding framework.
  • Deliver all launch materials in advance of the hard launch date, following the timeline agreed in the inception workplan.

5.4 Social media strategy and branding

  • Review the current social media presence, audiences and performance of NP and the Academy, and recommend which channels the Academy should prioritise (e.g. LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, WhatsApp) and whether it should use NP’s existing channels, dedicated Academy channels or a hybrid model.
  • Develop a social media strategy setting out objectives, target audiences, content pillars (e.g. UCP learning, field stories and case studies, courses and the platform launch, partnerships and learner community), posting frequency, and engagement and community-management guidelines, aligned with the launch marketing strategy.
  • Develop the Academy’s social media branding, including profile and cover visuals, branded post formats, hashtags, caption tone, co-branded post formats for partners, and accessibility standards (e.g. alt text, subtitles and plain language).
  • Provide guidance on moderation, responding to sensitive or hostile comments and managing reputational and safety risks when communicating about conflict-affected contexts.
  • Prepare a three-month social media content calendar covering the platform launch period.

5.5 Brand templates for Academy products and publications

  • Design editable, branded templates for Academy products and publications, such as course and module covers, certificates of completion, learner guides and handouts, slide decks, reports and briefing notes, case-study and learning-brief layouts, social media and newsletter templates, and webinar and event materials, including co-branded formats for partnerships such as Viamo.
  • Provide short usage guidance so Academy staff can apply the templates consistently and adapt them independently.

5.6 Cross-cutting standards

  • Ensure all materials are inclusive, accessible, conflict-sensitive and consistent with do-no-harm principles, safeguarding, informed consent and NP and partner data-protection requirements.

6. Deliverables

  • Inception note and workplan, within the first week, including a timeline aligned with the Academy hard launch date and pilot milestones.
  • UCP Academy branding strategy and brand guide, rooted in NP’s brand, including brand positioning, brand architecture, visual identity, tone of voice, and a partnership and co-branding framework.
  • Revised website content and visual assets, ready for upload.
  • Series of case studies on the Viamo voice-training pilot, comprising short social media case studies with accompanying visuals and captions, one longer-form case study or learning brief for partners and donors, and a reusable case-study template.
  • Marketing strategy for the launch of the Academy’s online platform, including audience segmentation, key messages, channel plan, phased content calendar and KPI framework.
  • Hard-launch communications package: promotional materials and co-branded partner toolkit, delivered ahead of launch.
  • Social media strategy and branding package: strategy and content pillars, community-management guidance, branded profile assets and post formats, and a three-month content calendar.
  • Suite of editable brand templates for Academy products and publications, with brief usage guidance.
  • Handover note and transfer of all editable source files, by 15 March, 2027.

7. Required Qualifications and Experience

  • Proven experience in communications, branding and copywriting, ideally for NGOs or online learning, supported by a portfolio.
  • Proven experience developing brand strategies, including brand architecture and co-branding or partnership frameworks for sub-brands within an established organisational brand.
  • Demonstrated experience writing short-form case studies and human-interest stories for social media, ideally on humanitarian, development or digital-inclusion programmes.
  • Experience designing and delivering marketing and launch strategies for a digital platform, product or organisation, with measurable KPIs.
  • Experience developing social media strategies and managing branded social media channels, ideally for NGOs, online learning or advocacy campaigns.
  • Experience developing brand identities, tone-of-voice guidelines and template systems for publications and digital products.
  • Sound understanding of ethical storytelling, informed consent and safeguarding when communicating about conflict-affected communities.
  • Proficiency in Canva, Adobe Creative Suite or Figma; familiarity with Wix is an asset.
  • Excellent English writing skills; working knowledge of French is a strong asset. Familiarity with the humanitarian or peacebuilding sectors, or with mobile and voice-based learning, is an asset.

APPLICATION PROCESS

NP recognises that applicants may use AI tools when preparing CVs and cover letters. We ask candidates to use these tools responsibly and to ensure their application remains truthful, specific, and reflective of their own experience and motivation. Applications are reviewed by members of our team, not only automated systems, and we value clear, authentic applications that help us understand the candidate behind the documents.

  • We strongly encourage applicants to carefully review the job description before submitting their application and ensure they meet the essential requirements.
  • Candidates meeting the above requirements are requested to submit a CV (max. 2 pages) and cover letter (max. 1 page), through our website, detailing their experience and how they qualify for the role. Incomplete applications will not be considered.
  • The closing date for applications is: Tuesday December 1, 2026
  • Candidates may be selected before the closing date; apply early.
  • As part of the recruitment process, shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a technical assignment before participating in an interview.

SPECIAL NOTICE

Nonviolent Peaceforce is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against based on disability. 

Nonviolent Peaceforce acknowledges the duty of care to safeguard and promote the welfare of employees, contractors, volunteers, interns, communities we work with, and other stakeholders and is committed to ensuring safeguarding practice reflects statutory responsibilities and government guidance and complies with best practices in the Humanitarian and Development sector.NP expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment through our code of conduct. We prioritise ensuring that only those who share and demonstrate our values are recruited to work for us. 

The post holder will undertake the appropriate level of training and is responsible for ensuring that they understand and work within the safeguarding policies of the organisation.

 

All offers of employment will be subject to satisfactory references and appropriate screening checks, which can include criminal records and terrorism finance checks. NP also participates in the Inter Agency Misconduct Disclosure Scheme. In line with this Scheme, we will request information from job applicants’ previous employers about any findings of sexual exploitation, sexual abuse and/or sexual harassment during employment or incidents under investigation when the applicant left employment. By submitting an application, the job applicant confirms their understanding of these recruitment procedures. 

NO FEE  

We never ask for payment as part of our selection process, and we always contact candidates via our corporate accounts and platforms. If you are approached for payment, this is likely to be fraudulent. Please check whether the role you are interested in is posted here on our website.

The US CDI Training and Quality Associate Director provides strategic and operational leadership for Training and Quality functions supporting US inpatient Clinical Documentation Integrity (CDI) operations.

This role is responsible for establishing and implementing learning frameworks, quality governance, and performance improvement strategies aligned with business objectives and client expectations. The position translates operational requirements into structured training programs, quality standards, and capability-building initiatives to enhance CDI workflow standardization, productivity, documentation accuracy, coding support, and regulatory compliance.

The Associate Director will leverage audit findings, documentation trends, operational metrics, and learning insights to identify performance gaps, drive continuous improvement, and ensure consistent delivery of high-quality CDI services across inpatient operations.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic Leadership and Governance

  • Develop and implement the overall training and quality strategy for US inpatient CDI operations.
  • Establish standardized training frameworks, quality policies, governance structures, and performance benchmarks.
  • Align training and quality initiatives with organizational objectives, client requirements, and operational priorities.
  • Provide strategic direction and leadership to Training and Quality teams, ensuring alignment with business goals.
  • Drive standardization and consistency of CDI practices across teams, processes, and operational sites.

2. Training and Capability Development

  • Oversee the development, implementation, and continuous enhancement of CDI training programs for new hires and tenured employees.
  • Establish competency frameworks, learning pathways, and assessment methodologies for inpatient CDI professionals.
  • Ensure training content reflects current US clinical documentation standards, coding guidelines, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.
  • Identify knowledge and performance gaps through training assessments, operational feedback, and quality audit results.
  • Partner with Operations and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to strengthen clinical knowledge, documentation interpretation, and CDI capabilities.
  • Oversee leadership development, upskilling, and continuous learning initiatives.

3. Quality Assurance and Performance Management

  • Lead the development and execution of quality assurance frameworks, audit methodologies, and evaluation standards for CDI operations.
  • Oversee clinical documentation audits, quality reviews, and performance monitoring to ensure accuracy and consistency.
  • Analyze audit results and identify recurring documentation, coding, and workflow-related issues.
  • Establish corrective action plans, calibration sessions, and targeted improvement programs.
  • Ensure quality standards support compliance with applicable US healthcare regulations, coding guidelines, and client-specific requirements.
  • Monitor quality trends and provide actionable recommendations to improve operational performance.

4. Operational Excellence and Continuous Improvement

  • Collaborate with Operations, Clinical Leadership, and other stakeholders to improve CDI productivity and workflow efficiency.
  • Translate quality and training insights into actionable operational improvement initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline processes, strengthen documentation accuracy, and improve overall CDI outcomes.
  • Drive root cause analysis and resolution of recurring quality and performance issues.
  • Support the implementation of process improvements, best practices, and standardized operating procedures.

5. Stakeholder and Client Management

  • Partner with US-based clients, onshore leadership, and internal stakeholders to understand business requirements and service expectations.
