jobs.description:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

We are open to considering candidates at either the Associate Director or Director level, depending on their experience and expertise.


General Description:


The Scientific & Site Partnerships Lead (SSPL) serves as the principal Scientific interface between BeOne Global Clinical Operations and the external investigator and clinical research community across EMEA. The role is accountable for defining and executing the regional scientific site partnership strategy across the clinical development portfolio, strengthening relationships with Key Opinion Leaders, investigators, research networks, academic organisations and priority institutions. The role also serves as the scientific capability leader for GCO EMEA, ensuring that field and operational teams have the scientific, clinical and competitive knowledge required to conduct high-quality strategic feasibility, site identification, site selection, PSSV and study start-up activities.

The role acts as a senior scientific ambassador for the BeOne pipeline and clinical development strategy. It communicates the scientific rationale, development strategy, differentiation and future potential of molecules and programmes in a compliant and credible manner, while bringing external perspectives back into internal portfolio, protocol and execution decisions. The role translates scientific and clinical development strategy into practical operational guidance for CRAs, Clinical Site Managers, Feasibility Managers and Country Operations teams. Through structured capability building and scientific enablement, the role ensures consistent and credible engagement with investigators throughout the study lifecycle.

TheSSPL develops and maintains a comprehensive understanding of disease biology, treatment pathways, standards of care, patient journeys, healthcare systems, competing clinical trials, competitor pipelines, anticipated regulatory approvals, treatment guideline changes and upcoming launches across EMEA

Essential Functions of the Job:

Scientific Field Excellence and Capability Building


  • Defines and leads the GCO EMEA scientific field excellence strategy.
  • Establishes a train-the-expert model, leveraging existing functional/global leads, for Clinical Site Managers, CRAs, Feasibility Managers and Country Operations teams.
  • Develops study-specific scientific readiness packages covering disease background, treatment landscape, protocol rationale, standard of care, competing trials and anticipated investigator questions.
  • Delivers scientific and competitive landscape training for field teams supporting strategic feasibility, PSSV, site selection and study start-up activities.
  • Establishes minimum scientific readiness standards for field-facing operational personnel.
  • Creates sustainable knowledge-sharing mechanisms across studies, therapeutic areas and countries.
  • Strategic investigator partnerships and site development: develops long-term partnerships with priority research institutions, investigator networks, and centres of excellence across EMEA.

Feasibility Responsibilities


  • Provides scientific oversight and challenge during country and site selection decisions, ensuring recommendations are supported by robust external intelligence, competitive analysis and deep understanding of local treatment practices.
  • Clinical trial strategy and feasibility: translating external scientific insights into strategic feasibility, country/site selection, and early study planning, including bringing investigator perspectives into protocol development discussions.
  • Partners with Global Feasibility, Clinical Development, Medical Affairs, Study Management, Country Operations and other functions to ensure strategic feasibility recommendations incorporate scientific interest, investigator interest, patient access pathways, competing studies, referral dynamics, anticipated treatment changes and operational deliverability

Competitive Intelligence


  • Maintains a structured competitive intelligence framework that evaluates competing studies, sponsor activity, emerging therapies, expected launches, treatment guideline changes and their potential impact on recruitment, retention, investigator interest and site capacity.
  • Provides regular competitive landscape briefings to GCO, Clinical Development and Medical Affairs leadership to support portfolio planning and study execution decisions.

Clinical Development and Medical Affairs Interface


  • Serves as the primary GCO scientific liaison to Clinical Development and Medical Affairs, translating scientific strategy and external insights into operational recommendations and ensuring GCO considerations are incorporated into protocol concepts, protocol design and study planning.

SIV Readiness


  • Supports study start-up and Site Initiation Visit readiness by ensuring GCO field teams understand the scientific rationale, treatment landscape, competitive environment, key protocol considerations and anticipated investigator concerns before site activation.
  • Develops study-specific readiness materials and investigator intelligence packages to support successful study launch and early enrolment performance.

The above list covers the primary responsibilities of the role. Additional activities may be adapted in line with business needs.

Success Criteria and Key Performance Indicators

Scientific Readiness


  • ≥90% of priority studies supported by scientific readiness packages before strategic feasibility activities.
  • ≥90% of targeted field personnel trained before first investigator-facing engagement.
  • Strategic Feasibility and Site Selection
  • Documented use of scientific and competitive intelligence in site and country selection decisions.
  • Improved enrollment performance of selected sites versus forecast.

SIV Readiness


  • ≥90% of priority studies supported by study readiness and investigator intelligence materials before SIV.
  • Reduction in recurring investigator questions and start-up clarification requests.

Competitive Intelligence


  • Competitive landscape assessments completed for all priority programs.
  • Timely communication of major scientific or market events affecting enrollment.

Cross-Functional Impact


  • Protocol recommendations adopted by Clinical Development teams.
  • External insights incorporated into portfolio and study strategy decisions.

Business Impact


  • Improved enrollment forecast accuracy.
  • Improved site productivity.
  • Improved strategic site retention.
  • Improved investigator satisfaction

Supervisory Responsibilities:


  • Provides visible senior leadership and enterprise-level direction for scientific site partnerships across EMEA.
  • Provides scientific mentoring and capability development for field-facing GCO personnel and contributes to the establishment of scientific partnerships excellence standards across the region.
  • May lead, supervise or provide functional direction to employees, contractors or matrixed resources, based on organizational design and business needs.
  • Creates an inclusive, accountable and high-performing environment, enabling teams and cross-functional partners to deliver shared strategic outcomes.

Education and Experience Required:


  • Advanced degree (PhD, PharmD, MD or equivalent) in a scientific, medical or healthcare discipline preferred. A Master's or Bachelor's degree with substantial relevant experience may be considered.
  • Typically 12+ years of progressive experience across clinical operations, clinical development, medical affairs, site engagement or relevant experience in a related pharmaceutical, biotechnology or CRO environment, with demonstrated regional or global leadership responsibilities.
  • Deep scientific and operational knowledge of oncology drug development and clinical trials is strongly preferred.

Computer Skills:


  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint, Excel and Word, and in collaboration, communication and project-management tools.
  • Experience with clinical intelligence, feasibility, trial-planning, stakeholder relationship management and performance data platforms.
  • Ability to adopt and promote digital, analytics and AI-enabled tools, including Copilot and SharePoint, while maintaining appropriate information governance.

Other Qualifications:


  • Demonstrated senior-level experience across clinical operations, clinical development, medical affairs, feasibility, investigator engagement, site partnerships or related areas in pharmaceutical, biotechnology or CRO settings.
  • Credible scientific presence and proven ability to present a clinical development pipeline and discuss molecule and programme strategy with senior investigators and scientific leaders.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex scientific and clinical information into operationally actionable recommendations.
  • Deep knowledge of oncology drug development, clinical trial design and execution, ICH-GCP and relevant regulatory and compliance requirements.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of the diversity of European healthcare and clinical research environments and the ability to translate country-level differences into strategic recommendations.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Strategic Platform Integrations
jobs.excerpt: Who We Are Pindrop is a cybersecurity company delivering continuous identity verification across voice, video, and digital interactions.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Pindrop is a cybersecurity company delivering continuous identity verification across voice, video, and digital interactions. Powered by the Pindrop Intelligence Network, our unified trust platform helps enterprises answer three critical questions:

Is this identity synthetic? Detect AI-generated and manipulated voice and video.
Is this identity risky? Identify fraud, suspicious behavior, and other risk signals.
Is this identity known? Authenticate identities using voice, device, behavioral, and other signals.

Pindrop brings this intelligence together across purpose-built trust engines to help organizations make informed decisions in real time — protecting customers, workforce interactions, and emerging AI-driven interactions.

Pindrop protects billions of high-risk interactions for enterprises, including leading financial institutions, insurers, and healthcare organizations. Its technology is informed by more than 8 billion real-world interactions annually and protected by 300+ patents.

Recognized by TIME as one of the 10 Most Influential Software Companies of 2026 and by Inc. for Best in Business for Innovation, Pindrop is backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, IVP, and CapitalG.

What You'll Do

Help define how Pindrop's identity intelligence reaches the enterprises and platforms where our customers operate.

As Senior Product Manager, Strategic Platform Integrations, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and execution of integrations connecting Pindrop's voice security, fraud detection, and identity solutions with leading contact center and enterprise technology platforms.

You will work closely with Engineering, Partnerships, Sales, and customers to identify strategic integration opportunities and turn complex telephony and real-time data integrations into scalable, repeatable, developer-friendly experiences.

This is an opportunity to build and shape a strategic product area from the ground up, connecting technical innovation with customer adoption and measurable commercial impact.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Define and execute the roadmap for Pindrop's integrations with leading CCaaS and telephony ecosystems, including platforms such as Genesys, NICE, Five9, Amazon Connect, and Twilio.
  • Partner with internal business development and partnerships teams, external technology partners, and enterprise customers to identify opportunities, gather requirements, evaluate technical feasibility, and prioritize investments.
  • Own the product strategy for partner-facing APIs, SDKs, developer documentation, onboarding, sandboxes, and self-service integration tooling. Collaborate with Engineering to establish consistent API standards and improve developer adoption.
  • Work closely with Engineering to understand call flows, real-time data exchanges, integration architecture, reliability, latency, security, and platform constraints. Balance partner-specific needs with reusable platform capabilities.
  • Define the direction for customer-facing reporting and analytics experiences that help enterprises understand, measure, and act on Pindrop's fraud and identity intelligence, including within partner platforms.
  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Product Marketing, and Services to develop product positioning, integration guides, launch plans, and customer enablement materials. Provide product input into pricing, packaging, and commercial strategy.
  • Establish and monitor meaningful product outcomes, including developer activation, integration adoption, reliability, customer value, and business impact. Use customer feedback, partner insights, and performance data to inform roadmap decisions.

Who You Are

You are a technically fluent, commercially minded Product Manager who enjoys working at the intersection of complex technology, strategic partnerships, and customer needs.

You are:

  • You can turn emerging market opportunities, customer needs, and partner requirements into a clear product vision and prioritized roadmap. You are comfortable defending decisions and making trade-offs with senior leadership.
  • You understand how enterprise platforms connect and communicate. You can engage meaningfully with engineers and technical partners, ask informed questions, and translate complex technical constraints into actionable product decisions.
  • You understand that APIs, documentation, onboarding, and integration reliability are critical parts of the customer experience. You prioritize making integrations scalable, intuitive, and easy to adopt.
  • You build productive relationships across Engineering, Product, Sales, Services, and external partner organizations. You influence without formal authority and establish alignment around shared outcomes.
  • You thrive in emerging product areas where the strategy is not fully defined. You proactively identify opportunities, navigate ambiguity, and drive initiatives from discovery through launch and adoption.
  • You use AI responsibly where it can improve product discovery, analysis, experimentation, or execution. You apply human judgment, validate outputs, and understand the importance of customer trust, privacy, and reliability.

Your Skill Set

Must-haves

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including direct experience with B2B telephony or Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) products and strategic platform integrations.
  • Demonstrated ownership of partner integration initiatives from discovery and requirements definition through technical development, launch, and adoption.
  • Working knowledge of enterprise telephony environments, including how calls and associated data flow between carriers, contact center platforms, and third-party services.
  • Experience with developer-facing products, APIs, integration architecture, versioning, documentation, onboarding, and self-service capabilities. Ability to collaborate with engineers on technical requirements and trade-offs.
  • Experience working directly with external technology partners and cross-functional internal teams to deliver complex integration initiatives.
  • Go-to-market experience, including product positioning, commercial enablement, launch planning, and contributing to pricing or packaging decisions.
  • Strong product judgment and prioritization skills, with a demonstrated ability to balance customer needs, technical feasibility, business impact, and platform scalability.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with technical teams, executive stakeholders, customers, and strategic partners.
  • Willingness to travel up to three times per quarter for company events, partner meetings, customer engagements, or conferences.

Nice-to-haves

  • Hands-on product experience with major CCaaS or telephony ecosystems, such as Genesys, NICE, Five9, Amazon Connect, or Twilio.
  • Familiarity with real-time communications and integration technologies such as SIP, WebSockets, audio hooks, streaming data, or event-driven architectures.
  • Experience building integrations for enterprise application marketplaces, such as Salesforce AppExchange or CCaaS partner marketplaces.
  • Experience with developer portals and API documentation tools, including OpenAPI, SDKs, and sandbox environments.
  • Experience building customer-facing reporting, analytics, or dashboard products.
  • Background in security, fraud detection, voice AI, identity verification, or enterprise trust platforms.

What's in It for You

This is an opportunity to build the integration strategy that determines how Pindrop's identity intelligence reaches customers across the enterprise technology ecosystem.

  • Build something from the ground up. Help establish a new strategic product area, influencing how Pindrop approaches partner integrations, developer experiences, and platform expansion.
  • Work on meaningful technical challenges. Collaborate with experienced Engineering, Product, and Research teams on complex integrations spanning real-time voice intelligence, fraud prevention, identity, and enterprise security.
  • Influence strategic partnerships. Work with leading contact center and enterprise technology ecosystems to create new opportunities for customer adoption and product growth.
  • Own outcomes, not just features. Influence product strategy from discovery through launch, adoption, and ongoing commercial impact.
  • Grow your strategic product leadership. Expand your influence across technology, partnerships, go-to-market, and executive leadership as Pindrop continues to evolve.

What we offer

As a part of Pindrop, you’ll have a direct impact on our growing list of products and the future of security in the voice-driven economy. We hire great people and take care of them. Here’s a snapshot of the benefits we offer:

  • Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Flexibility to work remotely from outside your country of residence for up to four weeks per year, subject to manager approval and applicable company policies.
  • Flexibility to work remotely from outside your country of residence for up to four weeks per year
  • Competitive compensation package, including RSUs (Restricted Stock Units) for all employees, so everyone shares in our long-term success.
  • While we work flexibly, we prioritize meaningful in-person moments through regular team on-sites, company-wide events, and intentional gatherings that foster connection, collaboration, and shared success.
  • Generous health and welfare plans to choose from - including one employer-paid “employee-only” plan!
  • Best-in-class Health Savings Account (HSA) employer contribution
  • Low-cost vision and dental plans for you and your family, providing comprehensive coverage and peace of mind.
  • Paid Parental Leave - Including birth, adoptive & foster parents
    • One year of diaper delivery for your newest addition to the family! It’s our way of welcoming new Pindroplets to the family!
  • Recurring monthly phone and internet allowance to help cover essential connectivity costs and support flexible work.
  • Enhanced fertility and GLP-1 benefits to support family-building journeys and personalized health needs.
  • Annual Learning & Development stipend to support your professional growth, skill-building, certifications, and continued education.

Please note that the base pay range is a general guideline only. Pindrop considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, a candidate's work experience, education/training, and key skills, as well as market and business considerations, when extending an offer.

US Base Pay Range
$150,000—$190,000 USD

Not sure if this is you?

We want a diverse, global team, with a broad range of experience and perspectives. If this job sounds great, but you’re not sure if you qualify, apply anyway! We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time.

AI - A Transformative Force

At Pindrop, we view artificial intelligence as a transformative force that, when harnessed responsibly, can unlock unprecedented value for our customers, partners and society and enable and empower us to continue to deliver cutting-edge technology to combat fraud and unblur the lines between what it means to be human versus machine.

Pindrop may use AI tools to help prioritize job applications for human review. The AI tool may analyze your work experience and skills to assess fit for the role, but does not consider your name or contact details. Applications with the strongest match to job requirements are prioritized for human review; not all applications may be individually reviewed.

Pindrop is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Here at Pindrop, it is our mission to create and maintain a diverse and inclusive work environment. As an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, disability, marital and/or veteran status.

jobs.excerpt: About Us At Onterris, we build careers grounded in purpose, responsibility and real-world impact.
jobs.description:
About Us

At Onterris, we build careers grounded in purpose, responsibility and real-world impact.

“For Planet and Progress” is our north star that guides everything we do. We believe environmental responsibility and human progress are interconnected, interwoven and international. Our scientists, engineers, field teams, consultants and professionals collaborate across disciplines and geographies, guiding industries and governments, ensuring that communities and environments thrive.

When you join us, you’re not just forging a career, you’re joining a movement. A movement for better thinking, smarter solutions and lasting impact.

Together, we will advance our way of life and protect the integrity of our environment every step of the way.

A Day in the Life

As a Project Delivery Lead, you will help project managers deliver safe, profitable, high-quality environmental consulting projects while strengthening financial performance across an assigned portfolio. You will combine proactive oversight with practical coaching, helping project managers identify risks early, navigate challenges, and build their commercial and financial capabilities.

Reporting to the Vice President of Project Delivery Excellence for Environmental Consulting with a dotted line to the VP Ops Leader, you will partner with regional, operations, program, finance, and project controls leaders. This is a matrix leadership role: project managers retain their existing reporting relationships, while you provide delivery oversight, guidance, and mentoring. The focus is portfolio performance and project manager development, not performing technical project work. This role may be performed remotely within the United States.

The compensation range for this role is $125,000 to $175,000, in addition to an annual bonus (12%), commensurate with experience, skills, and geographic location.


To thrive in this role, you’ll be comfortable taking ownership of the following responsibilities:

Portfolio Oversight and Performance

  • Oversee safe, efficient project delivery against scope, schedule, quality, risk, and financial commitments, with the goal of achieving or improving the financial performance established when projects are sold.
  • Lead regular portfolio reviews, typically monthly with each assigned project manager, to assess project health, identify emerging risks, and agree on corrective actions and follow-through.
  • Analyze project costs, billings, schedules, estimates at completion, and forecasts. Address root causes of performance issues to reduce write-offs, protect margins, and improve cash flow.
  • Partner with project managers and finance teams on timely invoicing, unbilled balances, accounts receivable, and collection strategies to improve Days Sales Outstanding (DSO).
  • In coordination with the Operations or Program Manager, providing guidance in assigning projects and pursuit efforts to project managers.

Commercial Discipline and Risk Management

  • Review all client-facing cost estimates and proposal pricing within the assigned portfolio before submission. Check pricing guidance, applicable rate schedules, resource plans, and allowances for safety, quality reviews, project oversight, and other delivery requirements.
  • Understand applicable client contracts and help project managers translate commercial terms into delivery plans, budgets, and risk controls. Identify commercial risks and route exceptions through the appropriate approval process.
  • Support proactive scope and change management, including change orders, budget and schedule adjustments, stakeholder communication, and dispute resolution.
  • Help teams budget appropriate project review and oversight effort and recover that effort where permitted by the contract.

Coaching and Consistent Delivery

  • Serve as a practical resource for project managers facing client communication, team coordination, financial, or delivery challenges. Coach project managers and emerging project managers to strengthen judgment, accountability, and confidence.
  • Partner with operations and program leaders on project and pursuit assignments, project manager development, and performance feedback without replacing existing line-management responsibilities.
  • Work with project controls leadership and Project Support Specialists to establish effective scheduling, progress tracking, reporting, and financial monitoring, including earned value methods where appropriate.
  • Promote consistent project kickoffs, milestone reviews, and closeout practices. Share lessons learned and help teams adopt project management tools, processes, and improvements.

Your Expertise and Skills

These requirements reflect the knowledge, skills and abilities that help you do your best work here.

Core Qualifications

  • A bachelor’s degree in engineering, environmental sciences, finance, accounting, business, or a related technical or business discipline.
  • Relevant experience in project management, project controls, project finance, or consulting operations, with demonstrated ability to assess project performance and guide project managers.
  • 8+ years is preferred; candidates with fewer years and strong, directly relevant skills and results will also be considered.
  • Strong financial and commercial judgment, including the ability to interpret project budgets, costs, forecasts, margins, billing, and contract requirements and turn findings into practical actions.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, confident presentation skills, and the ability to build relationships, coach colleagues, and influence outcomes within a matrix organization.
  • Strong organization, problem-solving, and prioritization skills, including the ability to work independently and make sound decisions with incomplete information.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting environmental consulting projects from pursuit through closeout, whether through project delivery, finance, project controls, or operations.
  • Familiarity with fixed-price, fixed-unit-rate, time-and-materials, and other contract models, along with scheduling concepts, earned value management, and risk and contingency management.
  • Experience with proposal development, pricing, financial systems, process improvement, and coaching teams through change. Familiarity with Onterris systems and processes is an advantage.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.

Onterris is a leading global environmental solutions company partnering with organizations to solve complex challenges where environmental pressures, regulatory expectations and operational risks intersect. Guided by our mission to advance the way of life without compromising the integrity of our environment, we believe environmental responsibility and human progress are fundamentally connected. Our scientists, engineers, field teams and consultants apply systems thinking that unites science, data and practical expertise to deliver solutions that strengthen our clients’ resilience, mitigate risk and protect the air, water and soil that sustain communities, while uncovering responsible paths forward for planet and progress. jobs.description:
Jesteśmy częścią międzynarodowej organizacji notowanej na NASDAQ w Sztokholmie, działającej w 11 krajach. W Polsce mamy pełną autonomię. Sami wybieramy technologie, procesy i sposób pracy, zachowując najwyższe standardy.

Realizujemy różnorodne projekty IT w Polsce i globalnie, w wielu obszarach i technologiach, co pozwala rozwijać kompetencje i zdobywać doświadczenie dopasowane do Twoich ambicji.

Naszą współpracę opieramy na filozofii CARE. Rozumiemy ją jako odpowiedzialny dobór projektów, transparentną współpracę oraz długofalowe podejście do rozwoju.

Dołącz do nas jako

Senior Data Scientist

Dołącz do strategicznej inicjatywy badawczo-rozwojowej, której celem jest zbudowanie i przeskalowanie zaawansowanego grafu wiedzy z fazy Proof of Concept do środowiska produkcyjnego operującego na masowej skali danych. Będziesz pracować na styku R&D (50%) oraz inżynierii ML (50%), tworząc rozwiązania oparte o LLM, NLP i representation learning, pozwalające uchwycić złożone semantyczne relacje między obiektami, ich kontekstem użycia oraz intencjami użytkowników.

Rozwijaj się w środowisku, które myśli o Twoim rozwoju tak samo, jak Ty.

Twoje zadania:

  • Projektowanie, trenowanie oraz ewaluacja modeli opartych o LLM, NLP oraz grafowe sieci neuronowe w celu budowy i rozwijania grafu konceptów, ich hierarchii, relacji semantycznych oraz mapowania na wielomilionowy katalog produktów.

  • Skalowanie pipeline'ów przetwarzania danych oraz generowania reprezentacji wektorowych (embeddingów produktów i konceptów) na potrzeby zastosowań downstream, w tym wyszukiwania semantycznego oraz systemów rekomendacyjnych (rekomendacje komplementarne, cross-category, retrieval i ranking).

  • Prowadzenie iteracyjnych eksperymentów R&D – od przeglądu literatury SOTA i stawiania hipotez, przez zaawansowany prompt engineering i ekstrakcję informacji, aż po optymalizację kosztową i wydajnościową modeli dla pełnej skali katalogu.

  • Projektowanie metryk ewaluacyjnych (walidacja offline, podejścia human-in-the-loop oraz LLM-as-a-judge), kalibracja instrukcji i współpraca przy procesach anotacji danych.

  • Przygotowywanie modeli oraz przetestowanego kodu produkcyjnego do wdrożenia we współpracy z zespołami inżynieryjnymi, w tym projektowanie i wsparcie testów A/B.

Kluczowe doświadczenie:

  • Minimum 4–5 lat doświadczenia komercyjnego na stanowisku Senior Data Scientist lub Machine Learning Research Engineer przy projektach opartych na dużych wolumenach danych.

  • Wyższe wykształcenie kierunkowe w obszarze STEM (informatyka, matematyka, statystyka, fizyka lub dziedziny pokrewne).

  • Udokumentowane doświadczenie w prowadzeniu projektów badawczo-rozwojowych end-to-end – od analizy literatury SOTA, projektowania eksperymentów i walidacji offline/online, po dostarczenie rozwiązań gotowych do wdrożenia produkcyjnego i testów A/B.

  • Praktyczna znajomość nowoczesnych metod NLP oraz dużych modeli językowych , w tym prompt engineeringu, structured outputs, ekstrakcji informacji, generowania i czyszczenia danych syntetycznych, klasteryzacji semantycznej oraz pracy z modelami typu Transformers i Sentence Encoders.

  • Biegła znajomość języka Python oraz ekosystemu ML/DL (PyTorch lub TensorFlow, HuggingFace Transformers, Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn).

  • Bardzo dobra znajomość SQL (w tym analitycznego SQL na dużych zbiorach danych) oraz doświadczenie w przetwarzaniu danych w środowisku chmurowym (preferowane GCP, w tym BigQuery, Vertex AI oraz Vertex Pipelines).

  • Musisz mieszkać i/lub posiadać uprawnienia do pracy w Polsce.

Mile widziane:

  • Doświadczenie w projektowaniu, budowie lub wykorzystywaniu grafów wiedzy (Knowledge Graphs), baz grafowych oraz grafowych sieci neuronowych.

  • Praktyka w przetwarzaniu danych na masową skalę oraz budowie systemów ML działających w reżimie niskich opóźnień (low-latency).

Co oferujemy?

• Pracę w skandynawskiej kulturze opartej o logikę i dialog.

• Benefity w obszarze zdrowia i sportu dopasowane do potrzeb.

• Speed Coaching, krótkie sesje, które dają nowe perspektywy i rozwiązania.

• Treningi sportowe, wewnętrzna drużyna, wspólne zawody.

• Imprezy integracyjne i spotkania rozwojowe.

Aplikuj już dziś!

Client Partnerships Director

Quadmark | Remote-first (UK) | Permanent, Full-time

Run the portfolio. Shape the strategy. Help define how the world adopts AI.

You've built strong accounts and earned the trust of senior clients. Now you want to own the bigger picture: where a portfolio focuses, how it wins and how it grows.

At Quadmark, the Client Partnerships Director owns a multi-million dollar portfolio at the forefront of the AI revolution. You'll partner with senior leaders at one of the most talked-about companies in technology, on work that's changing how people learn, work and use new technology. You'll be trusted with the relationships that matter most, and you'll play a direct role in how Quadmark grows.

This is a senior leadership role where your judgement, not just your execution, drives the outcome. You'll stay close enough to the work to spot risk early, and far enough above it to shape the strategy behind it. You'll also lead and enable a team of Client Partnership Leads and help each of them think and act like owners.

What you'll do

Own the number. You'll understand what drives performance across the portfolio and act on it early. You'll challenge forecasts, test assumptions and raise risks before they become problems. You'll make deliberate choices about where growth comes from, whether that means expanding relationships, introducing new services or repositioning an account.

Build trust at the highest level. You'll be a credible partner to senior client stakeholders, someone they bring into their thinking because your perspective improves their decisions. When it matters, you'll step in to strengthen the relationship and move things forward, handling difficult moments with clarity and care.

Grow the people around you. You'll directly manage our Client Partnership Leads. That means coaching them on how to read an account, where to look for growth and how to make a call when the answer isn't obvious. You'll bring them into senior work, give clear and direct feedback, and set a high bar while helping them reach it.

Bring a point of view. You'll represent the portfolio with clarity and conviction, explaining what's happening, what it means and what should happen next. You'll set the direction, priorities and standards for how the portfolio runs, and help shape decisions across Quadmark.

Stay connected to delivery. You'll know where projects are strong and where they're at risk, and step in when delivery threatens commercial performance or client trust. You'll hold your leads accountable for quality and build confidence in the team rather than dependence on you.

You'll thrive here if you

  • Are comfortable owning outcomes, not just contributing to them
  • Think commercially and see how trust, delivery and growth connect
  • Get real satisfaction from developing people and seeing them succeed
  • Can make good decisions with incomplete information and explain your thinking
  • Communicate with clarity and intent, especially when the stakes are high
  • Enjoy balancing short-term performance with long-term value

You'll likely bring significant experience in client partnership, account leadership or commercial leadership in an agency or consultancy. You'll also have a track record of owning and growing a multi-million portfolio, building senior client relationships and developing client-facing leaders.

Your first 90 days

  • Days 1 to 30: Understand. Meet every Client Partnership Lead, build a complete view of the portfolio and introduce yourself to senior stakeholders on key accounts.
  • Days 31 to 60: Diagnose. Get to grips with revenue, margin and forecast confidence. Form a clear view of the accounts that need attention and the opportunities that will drive growth.
  • Days 61 to 90: Lead. Run the portfolio with intent. Forecasts are grounded, risks are managed early, growth opportunities are moving and your team feels clearer direction and stronger support.

What you'll get

  • Competitive, market-benchmarked pay with room to grow as your impact grows
  • Remote-first, flexible working, plus quarterly in-person team days
  • Private medical insurance with Vitality (UK)
  • Employee Assistance Programme and mental health support
  • 25 days' annual leave (UK), plus 3 extra paid days when we close over the holidays
  • Travel insurance, so you're covered when you meet colleagues and clients face-to-face

The one thing

Build relationships where replacing Quadmark would feel like a risk, not a decision.

About The Recruiting Operations Manager Role:

We are seeking a Recruiting Operations Manager to build and own the systems, processes, and reporting that enable our global recruiting team to deliver on an ambitious hiring plan. You’ll help translate hiring priorities into clear workflows, reliable data, and actionable insights—giving recruiters more time to recruit and leaders greater visibility into hiring progress and risks.

You’ll partner closely with Recruiting leadership, People Operations, People Business Partners, FP&A, Legal, and hiring managers to strengthen how we operate across regions.

You’ll be equally comfortable configuring a Greenhouse workflow, reconciling hiring data, building a forecast, and helping teams adopt a better process. Success means our recruiting operations become more accurate, efficient, and predictable as the company grows.

This is a remote-friendly opportunity that can sit in NYC, one of our office hubs, or elsewhere in the US. We expect East Coast work hours, with flexibility to collaborate with global teammates.   • Maintain hiring plan integrity. Partner with FP&A and PBPs to align approved roles, recruiting status, recruiter assignments, and target start dates, providing insights for headcount budgets and financial forecasts.
  • Strengthen recruiting processes. Improve workflows from headcount approval through onboarding handoff, defining responsibilities, service expectations, and escalation paths.
  • Enable consistent execution. Build documentation, training, and tools for recruiting teams and hiring managers. Drive adoption and assess impact on hiring outcomes and candidate experience.
  • Scale through automation and tools. Reduce manual work through integrations, automation, and AI. Evaluate vendors and tool adoption, partnering with People Operations, Legal, and IT on access, privacy, and operational controls.

You Are Likely To Succeed as our Recruiting Operations Manager If:

  • You have 5+ years of experience in recruiting operations, talent operations, or a closely related field, including meaningful ownership of recruiting systems, reporting, and process improvement in a growing organization, at least 2 years as a Recruiter.
  • You have hands-on Greenhouse administration experience and can independently configure workflows, troubleshoot issues, and improve how recruiters and hiring managers use the system.
  • You are highly proficient in Excel or Google Sheets, with experience reconciling data across systems, building reporting, and turning analysis into practical recommendations. Experience with ChartHop, business intelligence tools, or SQL is a plus.
  • You understand recruiting funnels, hiring forecasts, and capacity planning, and can explain both what the data shows and where assumptions or data quality limit the conclusion.
  • You have a track record of taking an unclear or inconsistent process, establishing ownership, and implementing improvements that teams actually adopt.
  • You build strong partnerships across Recruiting, People, Finance, and business leaders. You can clarify responsibilities, navigate competing priorities, and influence decisions without direct authority.
  • You combine strong attention to detail with sound judgment about what matters most. You are comfortable owning recurring operational work while making the underlying processes better.
  • You enjoy being a hands-on individual contributor with broad functional ownership. Experience supporting recruiting across multiple countries or regions is a plus.
  • Prior people management experience preferred

See more on our high-impact, high-opportunity work environment above!

What We Can Achieve Together

The Director of Global Marketing Integration provides direction and leadership to connect TNC's global brand, marketing, and audience strategies across regions, acting as a bridge between global priorities and local market realities.


Reporting to the Senior Director of Global Marketing and Communications, the Director will partner with senior leaders and colleagues across the organisation to turn the vision of a more connected marketing and communications function into practical, effective ways of working. By strengthening collaboration across markets, they will help build a function that is globally aligned, locally relevant, and better equipped to deliver results.


This role will ensure that campaigns, brand initiatives, audience engagement strategies, and key activations are shaped by local insight, adapted for diverse audiences, and delivered in ways that advance TNC's revenue, influence, and conservation goals around the world.

The Director will work closely with Regional Marketing and Communications Directors for Africa, Asia Pacific, Europe, Latin America, and their teams to strengthen capabilities, share ideas, and identify opportunities that increase brand recognition and support TNC's revenue, influence, and conservation ambitions.


The Director will play a key role in implementing and championing systems, processes, and practices that enable Global Marketing and Communications (GMC) to work with greater clarity, consistency, and effect. They will help connect regional, country, and global teams around shared priorities while protecting the local knowledge, relationships, and expertise that make TNC successful around the world.


Responsibilities & Scope:


  • Strengthens TNC’s global brand by helping teams deploy resources to consistently articulate a clear, compelling and unified story about the organisation’s success, expertise and value to audiences around the world.
  • Supports the teams around the world to develop marketing-centred objectives, clearly linking marketing and communications activity to audiences and outcomes.
  • Uses shared brand principles, audience insights, and marketing practices to build recognition, trust, and relevance for TNC globally while enabling regional and local teams to adapt approaches for their markets and cultures.
  • Leads the design and implementation of practical integration approaches that strengthen collaboration across Global Marketing and Communications, regional marketing and communications teams, and relevant enterprise partners.
  • Manages the Associate Director of Marketing, International Activation.
  • Partners with senior leaders to translate strategic priorities into clear operating rhythms, decision-making structures, planning processes, and shared expectations.
  • Serves as a strategic advisor and advocate for regional and country marketing and communications teams, ensuring their market realities, capacity constraints, audience insights, and strategic priorities inform global brand, campaign, planning and resource-allocation decisions.
  • Leads the next phase of change management following the integration of regional teams into GMC, by clarifying roles, strengthening new ways of working, and helping teams navigate the transition to a more connected global function.
  • Develops and manages cross-team forums, working groups, planning cycles and feedback loops that improve visibility, coordination, and accountability across a globally dispersed function.
  • Identifies opportunities to reduce duplication, improve knowledge sharing, align resources and increase the effectiveness of marketing and communications support for conservation, fundraising, influence and engagement priorities.
  • Serves as a strategic advisor to senior marketing and communications leaders on integration, change management, stakeholder engagement and organisational alignment.
  • Tracks progress, evaluates effectiveness, and recommends adjustments to integration approaches based on feedback, data, organisational priorities, and changing conditions.
  • Manages staff, consultants, or project teams responsible for supporting integration, planning, operations, or change-related work.
  • Requires domestic or international travel for team meetings, retreats, stakeholder engagement or organisational planning.
  • May be required to work a flexible schedule to accommodate global time zones.

We're Looking for You

The successful candidate will be an experienced global marketer, strategic thinker, relationship builder, and storyteller. They will be equally comfortable shaping long-term direction and rolling up their sleeves to make things happen in a complex, matrixed and global organisation. Success in this role will come from a genuine curiosity about the places where we work, the people who make that work possible, and the stories that best bring TNC's mission to life. They will be passionate about elevating those stories and connecting them with audiences who can help advance our goals.

Global Marketing and Communications is a geographically dispersed team, and TNC is a highly collaborative organisation. The ability to build meaningful relationships across cultures, functions, and time zones will be essential. In this environment, influence comes less from authority and more from trust, enthusiasm, partnership, and the ability to bring people together around a shared purpose.


Minimum Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, public relations, business, organisational development, or a related field and a minimum of 10 years of related experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • At least three years of senior management or senior leadership experience in marketing, communications, organisational transformation, operations, strategy, or a related function.
  • Experience leading, developing, and implementing marketing, communications, engagement, change management, or organisational alignment strategies in a large, matrixed, or geographically dispersed organisation.
  • Experience cultivating and managing relationships with senior leaders and diverse stakeholders across functions, geographies, and levels of an organisation.
  • Experience facilitating groups, advising leaders, and helping teams resolve ambiguity, competing priorities, or operational complexity.
  • Experience in program management, including broad financial responsibility and measuring results of strategic plans and programs

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience working in a global brand marketing role.
  • Knowledge of working in a global, decentralised, or highly matrixed organisation, proven ability to influence without relying solely on formal authority.
  • Ability to work within, lead, or closely partner with regional or country-level marketing and communications teams in a global organization, with demonstrated understanding of how market, cultural, language, audience, funding, and operational differences shape marketing strategy and execution.
  • Demonstrable track record of translating global marketing, brand, or communications priorities into regionally relevant strategies and practical ways of working.
  • Direct experience supporting marketing and communications teams across multiple countries and levels of organizational maturity.
  • Demonstrated ability to bring structure to ambiguity and move complex work from concept to implementation.
  • Strong understanding of integrated marketing and communications, including brand, content, media, digital, internal communications, audience engagement, and reputation considerations.
  • Track record of supporting organisational change, operating model shifts, team integration, or transformation initiatives, and managing through ambiguity or uncertainty.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex organisational issues into clear, actionable guidance.
  • Strong facilitation, mediation, and negotiation skills, including the ability to build trust across cultures, functions, and perspectives.
  • Experience designing processes, frameworks, tools, or governance models that improve collaboration and accountability.
  • Multilingual skills and significant cross-cultural experience strongly preferred.
  • Commitment to building inclusive ways of working that value local expertise, diverse perspectives and shared ownership

jobs.title: Information Security Officer
jobs.excerpt: eCarsTrade is a digital car marketplace serving professional buyers in more than 40 countries.
jobs.description:
eCarsTrade is a digital car marketplace serving professional buyers in more than 40 countries.
Through our online auction platform, we offer over 20,000 vehicles per week, sourced from leading fleet owners, leasing and rental companies, as well as banks and dealerships.
Over the last 3 years we have delivered 40% YoY profitable growth, building a leading market position in Europe.
Our platform keeps growing in scale and complexity. We want each part of the product to have one engineer who owns it end to end, from the business problem to the change in production and the effect on our users.

About the RoleAs Information Security Officer, you are responsible for all information security in the company.
Our internal systems are as important as our public platform. These systems include finance, CRM, admin tools, and the accounts and devices of our staff. A ransomware attack on an internal system can cause as much damage as an attack on the auction platform.
AI changes this job in two ways. First, attackers use AI. With AI, they find and use vulnerabilities in hours. They write phishing messages in all languages. They make false copies of the voice and the face of a manager. Second, we use AI in our products and in our engineering work. You must protect the company against attacks that use AI. You must also make our own use of AI safe. You use AI for defense every day.

Responsibilities

  • Platform and internal systems. Protect the auction platform, the APIs and the mobile apps. Give the same priority to our internal systems. Make sure that the backups of all critical systems work, and test the recovery.
  • AI and agents. Set limits for AI agents and AI functions. Protect them against prompt injection. Give them only the access that they need. Make sure that a person approves each production change and each payment action. Keep a log of all agent actions. Decide which AI tools the staff can use and which data they can give to these tools.
  • Vulnerabilities. Operate vulnerability scanners. Order external penetration tests. Start a white-hat program. Install patches quickly. For a critical vulnerability on an internet-facing system, install the patch in hours or days, not in weeks.
  • Social engineering. Protect the company against phishing, voice copies and deepfakes. Train the staff and do drills. Make sure that nobody changes a payment or bank details only because of a call, a video or a chat message.
  • Access control. Give people, service accounts and AI agents only the access that they need. Make sure that one person or one agent cannot do a full business transaction alone. Keep the company ready for audits, including Big Four audits.
  • Incidents. Write procedures to find attacks, stop them and recover from them. Make the procedures fast, because some attacks spread in minutes.
  • Rules and compliance. Write the security policies. Make sure that we obey GDPR, ISO 27001, ISO/IEC 42001, the EU AI Act and NIS2.

Requirements

  • You have experience in the security of applications and infrastructure (web apps, APIs, containers).
  • You know AI and LLM security: prompt injection, agent access, the AI supply chain, and the OWASP Top 10 for LLM and Agentic Applications.
  • You use AI tools in your daily work. You know what these tools can do and what they cannot do.
  • You have experience with vulnerability management, penetration test companies and bug bounty programs.
  • You know how to protect staff against social engineering, and you can give security training.
  • You know access control, segregation of duties and audit frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR).
  • You speak and write clear English. You work well with the IT, Product, Finance and Operations teams.
Nice to Have
  • Certificates: CISSP, CISM, OSCP, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor. For AI: ISACA AAISM, IAPP AIGP, ISO/IEC 42001.
  • Knowledge of PHP/Python, MySQL and Docker.
  • Experience in marketplaces, fintech or e-commerce.
  • Experience in red-team tests of LLM applications.

Benefits


  • Full remote position under a B2B contract
  • Multicultural, dynamic international team
  • Competitive salary
  • Fast-growing company with startup spirit and growth opportunities
  • Chance to shape the future of digital automotive trading

jobs.description:
Head of Growth

Company: Established, PE-backed specialty aviation training company. Name disclosed upon mutual interest.
Location: Remote, anywhere in the U.S., ideally near a major airport. Roughly 25% travel to headquarters in the Southwest U.S. and to customers, with some international travel.
Compensation: $180,000–$200,000 base + commission + substantial equity
Reports To: The company's acting CEO, a partner at the investment firm that owns the business

About the Client

Established, PE-backed specialty aviation training company that prepares helicopter mission crews for search and rescue, hoist, tactical, and utility operations. Customers are federal, state, public-safety, and commercial operators in the U.S. and Europe.

The business has three lines: mission training (classroom, hands-on, simulator, and live flight), simulator sales and on-site simulator programs, and operational crew staffing.

About the Role

We are hiring a Head of Growth for a specialty training business that is the recognized leader in its niche: training the crew in the back of the helicopter. It has the past performance, the customer relationships, and the domain experts. What it needs is a leader who turns that into won contracts and lasting partnerships.

The biggest value driver is large government contracts. This seat goes to the top of the customer organization, understands how contracts are shaped and moved, and does not wait to be told what to do.

The owners have already built the foundation (CRM, cadence, marketing), so you start on a platform, not a cleanup. It is a small team and a hands-on seat: you carry deals before you build a team. For the right person there is real room to grow into senior leadership of the business.

Responsibilities

  • New revenue across government and commercial customers, against an annual revenue plan.
  • Large government pursuits from shaping through award: reaching decision-makers, navigating contracting, and pushing deals through when they stall.
  • Contract vehicles and market intelligence: getting on the right vehicles and using spend and award data to find the next win.
  • Strategic partnerships with aircraft OEMs and other distribution channels.
  • Policy and requirements: working with agencies and industry so recurring crew training becomes a standard.
  • The pipeline: forecasting, deal reviews, and coaching the domain experts who support capture today.

Requirements

Must-Haves

  • A record of winning government contracts or major partnerships, where you were in the room and helped move the deal.
  • Working knowledge of the contracting process: capture, vehicles, modifications, and how incumbents are displaced.
  • Top-down selling. You go to the senior decision-maker and build relationships at that level.
  • Initiative. You have created things in past roles that nobody asked you to build.
  • Business fluency: you can explain your customers' economics and use the numbers to sell.
  • A performance-based mindset. You would rather earn the upside than negotiate for it up front.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Industry experience in aviation training, simulation, or rotary-wing products and services.
  • Experience in both commercial and government sales.
  • A director or senior director seat at a mid-size defense or aviation company; PE-owned experience or an MBA is a plus.
  • Military aviation or related service background.

Why This Role

  • A growth mandate at a market leader, with significant equity and the infrastructure already built.
  • Direct work with the owners, including board meetings.
  • A mission that matters: the training keeps rescue and mission crews safe.

jobs.title: Data Engineer III
jobs.excerpt: What are important things that YOU need to know about this role?
jobs.description:
What are important things that YOU need to know about this role?

  • Experience: Advanced SQL coding skills and strong dbt (Data Build Tool) development experience are required. This includes developing complex data models, creating and maintaining transformation pipelines, and troubleshooting data quality and performance issues.
  • Work Location: This position offers permanent remote work.

What will YOU be doing for us?Independently design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain modern data warehouse solutions that transform replicated SKYGEN Enterprise System application data into trusted, reusable data products for analytics and reporting. This role uses Snowflake and dbt to build scalable dimensional models, apply data-quality controls, analyze complex source-system data and relationships, and maintain clear business and technical lineage across SKYGEN’s enterprise data environment supporting more than 160 client databases.

What will YOU be working on every day?

  • Data Warehouse Design & Dimensional Modeling: Independently design, develop, deploy, and maintain dimensional data warehouse objects, including fact, dimension, bridge, and reference tables, using approved Kimball and relational modeling standards. Define grain, business and surrogate keys, historical tracking, slowly changing dimensions, effective dating, and referential relationships for assigned subject areas.
  • dbt Data Development: Develop modular, reusable, documented, and testable dbt models that transform replicated source data through standardized staging, integration, dimensional, and publication layers. Use appropriate dbt sources, references, tests, macros, snapshots, and incremental processing patterns.
  • Landed Data Usage: Use replicated and ingested source data made available in Snowflake to build downstream transformation and publication layers. Validate the completeness, availability, and usability of source data without owning ingestion-platform infrastructure.
  • Enterprise Data Analysis: Analyze complex SKYGEN Enterprise System application schemas to identify authoritative data elements, keys, relationships, business rules, and historical behavior required to support defined reporting, analytics, and data-product use cases.
  • Data Quality & Reconciliation: Develop automated validation and reconciliation controls for completeness, accuracy, uniqueness, accepted values, referential integrity, historical consistency, and source-to-target transformation results. Investigate exceptions and document resolution.
  • Lineage & Documentation: Maintain source-to-target mappings, transformation logic, model and column descriptions, dependencies, lineage, data-quality rules, assumptions, and known limitations so warehouse objects remain discoverable and understandable.
  • Snowflake Development & Optimization: Develop and optimize Snowflake objects and queries with consideration for performance, scalability, concurrency, maintainability, and efficient resource use. Use query history and query profiles to support troubleshooting and optimization.
  • Software Development Lifecycle: Apply software engineering practices to data development, including Git-based source control, peer review, branching and pull-request workflows, automated testing, CI/CD, release validation, deployment documentation, and rollback planning.
  • Monitor & Support Solutions: Monitor data transformations and published data products, investigate failures and discrepancies, perform root-cause analysis, implement sustainable corrections, and communicate status and technical findings to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Collaboration: Work with data integration, analytics, reporting, quality assurance, platform, security, and business teams to translate approved requirements into reliable production data solutions.

What qualifications do YOU need to have to be GOOD candidate?

  • Required Level of Education, Licenses, and/or Certificates
    • Bachelor degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Data Science, Business, Finance, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Required Level of Experience
    • Five or more years of experience in data warehouse development, database development, analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related role, including significant hands-on SQL development. Two or more years of experience developing production solutions using a modern cloud data warehouse and transformation framework, preferably Snowflake and dbt.
  • Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
    • Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, common table expressions, window and analytical functions, data profiling, large-scale transformations, and performance troubleshooting. Demonstrated experience with Kimball dimensional modeling and relational database principles. Proficiency developing documented and tested dbt models. Working proficiency with Python for data analysis, validation, automation, and development utilities. Experience with Git-based version control, peer review, automated testing, and deployment workflows. Ability to independently analyze moderately complex source systems and communicate technical findings clearly.

What qualifications do YOU need to have to be a GREAT candidate?

  • Preferred Level of Education, Licenses, and/or Certificates

    • Dbt Analytics Engineering and/or Snowflake SnowPro Core, Advanced or Specialty certifications.

  • Preferred Level of Experience

    • Experience in healthcare data management, complex SKYGEN Enterprise System application schemas, or regulated data environments.

  • Preferred Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

    • Experience working with replicated data in a multi-client or multi-tenant Snowflake environment.
    • Experience with healthcare data, PII/PHI, HIPAA, HITRUST, or other governed data environments.
    • Experience identifying data elements within complex SKYGEN Enterprise System application or ERP schemas.
    • Experience designing Snowflake objects for consumption through Sigma or another modern analytics platform.
    • Experience with source-to-target reconciliation, production monitoring, and data observability practices.

Compensation Range: $100,962 - $151,444

Compensation Midpoint: $126,203

jobs.description:
Mistplay is the category creator and leader in the 'play-and-earn' mobile loyalty space, built to reward gamers for playing.

LoyaltyPlay is our B2B monetization platform, a powerful Gaming Reward Hub designed for mobile app Publishers. We partner with app owners (e.g., utility, commerce, or entertainment apps) to help them unlock a new, consistent revenue stream and boost user engagement. By integrating LoyaltyPlay, publishers can offer their users rewards (in-app currency) for installing and playing mobile games from our vast advertiser network. This creates a deep engagement loop and a powerful monetization channel for the publisher.

Senior Business Development Manager II, E-commerce (LoyaltyPlay)

Location: United States

Reports to: Head of Sales, North America

About Mistplay and LoyaltyPlay

Mistplay is the category creator and leader in play-and-earn mobile loyalty, built to reward gamers for playing. LoyaltyPlay is our B2B business: a gaming rewards hub that consumer apps add to their own experience. Their users play mobile games and complete offers from our advertiser network to earn the app’s own rewards, and the app gets higher engagement and a new revenue stream, typically on a revenue-share model.

The role

Shopping, marketplace, retail, cashback and travel apps need customers to open the app between purchases, not only when they are ready to buy. LoyaltyPlay lets them reward everyday engagement in their own points or store credit, funded by our advertiser network rather than their margins, and adds a new revenue line.

As our e-commerce vertical lead in North America, you will own the vertical end to end: building the target list, opening relationships with growth, loyalty and monetization leaders, and turning them into live LoyaltyPlay partners. You will focus on mid-market to large e-commerce apps, working alongside our Enterprise Sales Director on the largest brands in the category.

We will teach you the product. We are hiring for your e-commerce relationships and your understanding of how these companies grow.

Who you will sell to

VPs and Heads of Growth, Loyalty and CRM, and Retail Media or Monetization at shopping, marketplace, retail and travel apps. They care about session frequency between purchases, funding their loyalty program without discounting, customer retention and incremental revenue.

What you will do

  • Own the e-commerce vertical: Build and prioritize a target list across marketplaces, retailers, shopping and cashback apps, and travel booking apps, and carry a quota for the vertical.

  • Open doors: Use your network and targeted outreach to start conversations with VP- and C-level leaders in growth, loyalty and monetization.

  • Build the business case: Tailor the LoyaltyPlay story to each partner’s goals and build ROI cases with our analytics and finance teams.

  • Run the deal: Lead discovery, negotiation and contracting, positioning LoyaltyPlay alongside the partner’s existing loyalty program and retail media offering.

  • Structure the commercials: Design revenue-share and incentive structures that align long-term incentives for the partner and Mistplay.

  • Manage your pipeline: Keep pipeline and forecast accurate in Salesforce and report on progress against your quota.

  • Work across teams: Translate partner requirements for Product and Engineering, and bring in Legal and Finance early so launches stay on track.

  • Hand off for growth: Transition launched partners smoothly to Customer Success and stay involved as they scale.

What you will bring

  • 6+ years in business development, partnerships or sales into e-commerce, retail or marketplace companies.

  • An existing network of growth, loyalty and monetization leaders at e-commerce and retail apps.

  • A track record of closing complex partnerships with multiple stakeholders.

  • A solid understanding of how e-commerce apps acquire, retain and monetize customers, including loyalty programs and retail media.

  • Strong negotiation and commercial structuring skills, including revenue-share models.

  • Comfort working in Salesforce and with market research tools such as Sensor Tower.

  • Based in the United States.

Nice to have

  • Experience in ad tech, mobile monetization, rewarded advertising or loyalty.

  • Experience with loyalty platforms, retail media networks, or affiliate and cashback networks.

Why Mistplay?

We strive to make our work environment as inviting and fun as possible! Working at Mistplay is coupled with a whole array of perks that we've adopted virtually and in-person: Team Lunches, game nights, company-wide events, and so much more. Our culture is deeply rooted in growth and upheld by a team of smart, dynamic, and enthusiastic people. We utilize data to constantly learn, improve, and adapt. We foster an environment where everyone is encouraged to share their ideas, push boundaries, take calculated risks, and witness their visions come to life.

  • Support clinically appropriate patient identification, screening, evaluation, and follow-up based on patient needs and clinical standards.

    • identification of a patient for potential screening or evaluation;
    • clinical evaluation and diagnosis;
    • documentation of the patient's condition;
    • coding of the documented condition; and
    • submission or use of that diagnosis for risk-adjustment purposes.
  • Review BOI clinical pathways, suspecting activities, provider education, workflows, communications, and related tools for potential compliance risks.
  • Identify practices that could create actual or perceived pressure to diagnose or document conditions that are not clinically supported.
  • Reinforce the importance of independent provider clinical judgment.

Metrics and Performance Measures

  • Review BOI dashboards, scorecards, prevalence measures, suspect-condition metrics, closure rates, coding metrics, and other performance measures from a compliance perspective.
  • Evaluate whether proposed goals or measures could create unintended incentives affecting clinical decision-making, documentation, or coding.
  • Partner with Compliance leadership regarding the appropriate use of prevalence targets, benchmarks, HCC measures, RAF-related metrics, and similar BOI indicators.
  • Support review of physician and employee incentives associated with BOI, documentation, coding, quality, or risk-adjustment performance.

Compliance Monitoring and Auditing

  • Develop and perform risk-based monitoring and auditing activities under the direction of Compliance leadership.
  • Review areas including:
    • clinical documentation support;
    • diagnosis coding;
    • HCC validation;
    • suspected-condition workflows;
    • retrospective and prospective chart reviews;
    • provider queries;
    • diagnosis additions and deletions;
    • provider education;
    • coding vendors;
    • analytic tools and algorithms; and
    • BOI performance metrics.
  • Analyze findings for trends, root causes, systemic risks, and control weaknesses.
  • Prepare clear findings and recommendations for Compliance leadership and operational stakeholders.
  • Track corrective action plans through completion and validate remediation where appropriate.

Regulatory and Audit Readiness

  • Maintain knowledge of CMS Medicare Advantage risk-adjustment requirements and relevant regulatory developments.
  • Monitor CMS, HHS-OIG, DOJ, and other applicable regulatory and enforcement developments affecting BOI and risk-adjustment activities.
  • Assist with CMS audits, RADV-related activities, internal audits, government inquiries, investigations, and other regulatory reviews.
  • Support preparation and organization of documentation demonstrating the effectiveness of compliance controls.

Policies, Procedures and Education

  • Draft and maintain policies, standards, procedures, guidance, and educational materials addressing BOI and risk-adjustment compliance.
  • Develop and deliver targeted compliance education for physicians, advanced practice clinicians, coders, analysts, operations leaders, and other stakeholders.
  • Translate complex regulatory requirements into practical operational guidance.
  • Promote consistent understanding of documentation integrity, coding accuracy, clinical judgment, escalation expectations, and compliance responsibilities.

Issue Management and Corrective Action

  • Identify and document potential compliance issues arising from monitoring, audits, complaints, data analysis, or business activities.
  • Conduct or support compliance reviews and investigations under the direction of the Director or AVP.
  • Perform root-cause analysis and assist business owners in developing corrective action plans.
  • Track remediation activities and escalate overdue or ineffective corrective actions.
  • Promptly escalate matters presenting significant regulatory, financial, patient-care, or reputational risk.

Reporting and Governance

  • Prepare BOI compliance dashboards, risk summaries, monitoring results, audit findings, and corrective-action reporting.
  • Support presentations to BOI governance committees, compliance committees, and senior leadership.
  • Maintain documentation supporting compliance oversight and decision-making.
  • Identify emerging risk themes and recommend areas for additional monitoring or review.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, health information management, nursing, business, compliance, public health, or related discipline.
  • Approximately 7+ years of healthcare compliance, Medicare Advantage, risk adjustment, coding, auditing, clinical documentation, or related experience.
  • Demonstrated understanding of Medicare Advantage risk adjustment and HCC coding concepts.
  • Knowledge of clinical documentation and coding compliance principles.
  • Experience performing compliance monitoring, auditing, risk assessments, investigations, or corrective-action activities.
  • Ability to analyze data and identify compliance trends and control weaknesses.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively with clinical, coding, operational, financial, technical, and legal stakeholders.
  • Strong written, verbal, analytical, and executive communication skills.

Preferred

  • Certified Risk Adjustment Coder (CRC), Certified Professional Coder (CPC), Certified Professional Medical Auditor (CPMA), Certified in Healthcare Compliance (CHC), RHIA/RHIT, or comparable certification.
  • Experience with Medicare Advantage organizations or provider organizations participating in risk-based arrangements.
  • Experience supporting CMS audits, RADV activities, coding validation, or government reviews.
  • Experience with clinical documentation improvement, coding audits, provider education, or risk-adjustment analytics.
  • Prior supervisory or project leadership experience.

Our culture is built by people who care deeply about doing exceptional work. We set high standards, take ownership, and continually challenge ourselves and one another to be better. We work hard, support each other, and take genuine pride in what we deliver for our clients, partners, and teams.
