jobs.title: Heartland Fund Strategic Partnerships Officer
jobs.excerpt: Please read this before submitting your application: • You will receive initial communication from Clover Search Works, the search firm supporting Heartland Fund in this search.
jobs.description:
Please read this before submitting your application:

  • You will receive initial communication from Clover Search Works, the search firm supporting Heartland Fund in this search. Clover is a nonprofit search firm that partners with nonprofit organizations across the country. Clover team members will conduct the initial review and screening of applications, the Heartland Fund team will conduct formal interviews. We anticipate screening calls to begin in December and formal interviews to take place in January.
  • Throughout the search, if you have questions please reach out to Julie Edsforth at julie[at].

Heartland Fund’s Strategic Partnerships Officer supports the design and implementation of an ambitious development strategy to expand and deepen support for the organization overall, and for its flagship programs, including Rural Democracy, Rural Climate Partnership, and Resource Rural. This position requires an entrepreneurial, strategic, and detail-oriented development professional who is an excellent relationship developer, writer, and verbal communicator, and a skilled project manager.

Working in close partnership with the Strategic Partnerships Director, the Executive Director, and the program directors, the Officer will be a linchpin in raising a $40M+ annual budget to support and expand Heartland programs. They will lead on a variety of donor cultivation and stewardship activities, develop fundraising strategies, support funder learning communities, expand our major donor program, and oversee the grant writing and reporting function, advancing an exciting new field of rural-focused philanthropy.

We are looking for a highly relational, organized, and strategic team member with a commitment to rural people and places, a thriving democracy, and racial, climate, and economic justice. This is a unique and dynamic position with opportunities for leadership and rewarding collaboration with a network of funding partners as the Heartland Fund prepares to launch as an independent entity in 2027.

About the Organization

As a funder collaborative, the Heartland Fund scales investment, supports local leaders, and builds long-term partnerships with rural and Native organizations to create thriving places where rural working people can determine our own futures, strengthening the entire nation. Heartland's grantmaking and programmatic investments support rural people working to transform their lives and communities toward shared prosperity, a healthy climate, and stronger democracy. We invest in building local capacity for issue advocacy, community organizing, economic development and local jobs, climate solutions, civic engagement, and sustainable urban-rural coalitions. In addition to grantmaking, Heartland also supports rural leaders and organizations through convening, research, and communications and storytelling.

Heartland Fund has three programs:

  • Rural Democracy expands nonpartisan civic participation and counters policies that harm our democratic institutions in places where rural action can define policy and democratic outcomes.

  • Resource Rural (RR) mobilizes resources enabling rural communities to unlock public and private investment to create positive economic change in their communities.

  • Rural Climate Partnership (RCP) supports hometowns across America to accelerate climate solutions and build healthy local economies.

Primary Duties & Responsibilities

The Strategic Partnerships Officer will report to the Strategic Partnerships Director. They will collaborate with the Executive Director, and Resource Rural and Rural Climate Partnership directors to steward existing funder relationships, and, crucially, to cultivate new donor relationships to broaden the organization’s base of financial support. Additionally, the role will have management responsibilities matched to organizational needs, likely supervising the Strategic Partnerships & Grant Writing Manager, and supporting the fundraising skill development of team members across the organization.

As a funding collaborative, Heartland Fund has many strong relationships with committed funding partners with annual gifts that range between $100K to $1 million+. These funders may serve as board members, steering committee members, and ambassadors, introducing Heartland Fund to their philanthropic colleagues. In addition to cultivating existing funding partnerships, Heartland Fund puts a high priority on expanding our philanthropic relationships and funding base to grow our programs. The Officer will anchor many of these varied funding relationships, and will be responsible for the following deliverables:

Co-create & implement fundraising plans for Heartland Fund and for individual programs

  • Drive creation and execution of integrated, strategic fund development plans around issue areas and donor segments.

  • Quickly understand Heartland’s Rural Democracy, Rural Climate Partnership and Resource Rural programs and financial needs in order to support the organization in funder spaces, oversee compelling proposals, identify promising funding opportunities, and report on impact.

  • Support the evolution of programmatic strategies based on funder feedback and broader philanthropic trends.

  • With the finance team and Strategic Partnerships Director, develop annual revenue projection scenarios for budget and program planning.

  • Track and forecast trends and preferences in foundation and individual giving.

Cultivate & steward funders with a focus on broadening our reach to new audiences

  • Draw upon, develop, and share strong external relationships to introduce new funders and partners to our work.

  • Identify, prioritize and develop relationships with funder prospects, including institutional philanthropy, donor networks, donor-advised funds, and individual donors.

  • Support the Strategic Partnerships Director, Program Directors, and the Executive Director with prioritization, agenda design, and coordination of donor cultivation and fundraising meetings and events.

  • Drive planning for Heartland Fund-hosted funder webinars and in-person events.

  • Coordinate strategy for and attend funder philanthropic conferences, funder affinity group meetings, and other funder learning convenings.

  • Embody Heartland Fund racial justice goals in funder engagement and learning opportunities.

Develop & maintain compelling fundraising materials

  • Collaborate with program and strategic partnerships staff to understand and translate program plans and outcomes into compelling proposals, reports, funder talking points, and fundraising decks.

  • Work with the Heartland communications team to review, organize, and package stories of success and impact to motivate giving, including collaborating on yearly impact report preparation and periodic funder newsletters.

Deepen the effectiveness of the team & develop efficient processes

  • Oversee systems and processes for managing high quality fundraising efforts and coordinating across programs and teams toward these goals.

  • Co-develop the Strategic Partnerships work plan to ensure the team is meeting deadlines, prepared for donor meetings and trips, and completing consistent follow-up.

  • Work with Strategic Partnerships Senior Associate and Program Directors to implement efficient processes for managing donor information, keeping donor distribution lists updated, and communicating upcoming next steps with each funder.

  • Supervisory responsibilities may evolve over time, with initial responsibilities likely including supervision of the Strategic Partnerships & Grant Writing Manager.

  • Oversee the Strategic Partnerships Senior Associate and Grant Writing Manager on project management, content, and writing for grant proposal and report submissions.

  • Provide fundraising mentorship to program team members.

  • Integrate Heartland Fund’s racial justice goals and plan into Strategic Partnerships’ team plan and practices.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate will combine mid-career level fundraising experience with a passion for environmental and economic justice and a thriving democracy. They will bring exceptional people skills, strong organizational talents, and, ideally, a connection with rural people and places.

Heartland Fund’s growing team takes pride in building an organizational culture rooted in learning, collaboration, racial justice, and a deep commitment to our mission. All staff are expected to provide leadership and vision to advance our mission, vision, and core strategies.

Qualifications

We realize that some great candidates may not have every single thing on this list. If you believe you would be a great fit for this role, we encourage you to apply.

Essential Skills & Characteristics

Fundraising & Development Skills

  • 5+ years of fundraising experience within philanthropic, fiscal sponsor, nonprofit intermediary, funder collaborative, and/or advocacy organization

  • Experience overseeing cultivation and stewardship of 6-figure+ gifts

  • Demonstrated ability to design fund development strategies grounded in partnerships with aligned foundations and major donors

  • Experience with revenue budgeting, budget monitoring, and management reporting

Experience & Expertise

  • Familiarity with solutions and strategies relevant to at least one of Heartland Fund’s programs: climate, rural development, democracy, economic justice

  • Strong understanding of and interest in political and policy landscapes, especially as they relate to climate, civic engagement and rural development

  • Knowledge of and experience with the philanthropic ecosystem, especially in the democracy and climate funder spaces.

  • Fluency with equity practices and racial justice lens in philanthropy

  • Professional or lived experience in rural places (preferred)

Communication & Interpersonal Skills

  • Excellent oral presentation and writing skills, including writing clear, concise, compelling materials and speaking publicly as necessary

  • Outstanding interpersonal and relationship management skills

  • Demonstrated ability to articulate programmatic impact to achieve funders’ objectives

Project Management & Leadership

  • Proven experience in project management, strategic planning, priority setting, facilitation of meetings, and execution of projects and systems

  • Strong systems orientation and experience in utilizing data to drive process change and improvement. Track record of enhancing existing systems and streamlining processes

  • Exceptional attention to detail and ability to ensure a team is organized and efficient

  • Proven ability to supervise staff and help them grow and contribute to a team, as well as coordinate and manage work across teams

  • Proficiency with Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Calendar, Drive), video conferencing platforms (Zoom, etc.), and donor CRMs

Preferred

  • Experience in a start-up environment & success guiding organizational change management

  • Compliance experience with 501c3, c4, and/or other multi-entity organizations; including knowledge of lobbying and/or political activity compliance requirements applicable to charitable, advocacy, and/or social welfare organizations

  • Experience recruiting and working directly with a board of directors to maximize their fundraising effectiveness

  • Experience helping to build an individual major donor program focused on HNWI, donor advised funds, and family offices

  • Bring existing relationships with foundations, donors, and/or philanthropic networks in democracy, climate, and/or economic justice philanthropy

  • Experience optimizing and improving use of a donor CRM system across the organization

  • East Coast geographic base

Compensation & Job Design

This is a full-time, exempt position. The organization is virtual, and the position may work remotely from their home within the United States. The starting salary range for this position is $108,800 - $128,000.

The comprehensive beneﬁts package includes 100% employer-paid health, dental, and vision insurance for employees (and their families). Employees are able to enroll in a 401k retirement plan and are eligible for a 3% automatic contribution and up to a 3% employer match on 401k contributions. Employees are also eligible for pre-tax transportation beneﬁts. Full-time employees will receive 120 hours of vacation time, 80 hours of health leave, up to 2 days of casual leave, and 20 hours of volunteer leave annually. Employees will also receive 13 paid holidays throughout the calendar year. Employees are eligible for 12 weeks of paid family and medical leave after 90 days of employment. All employees of Windward are required to complete timesheets.

Heartland Fund is a project of Windward Fund, a 501(c)(3) public charity that incubates new and innovative public-interest projects and grant-making programs. Windward Fund is committed to attracting, developing and retaining exceptional people, and to creating a work environment that is dynamic, rewarding and enables each of us to realize our potential.

Windward Fund’s work environment is safe and open to all employees and partners, respecting the full spectrum of race, color, religious creed, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, political afﬁliation, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, and all other classiﬁcations protected by law in the locality and/or state in which you are working.

The individual holding this position will also work part-time for a coordinated project, Rural Victory Fund, in Sixteen Thirty Fund, a 501(c)(4) organization, under a resource-sharing agreement between Windward Fund and Sixteen Thirty Fund. The responsibilities under that position will be overseen by Sixteen Thirty Fund.

Windward participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with employees’ Form I-9 information to conﬁrm authorization to work in the United States. Job candidates and employees authorized to work may not be discriminated against on the basis of national origin or citizenship status.

Travel Requirements

This position requires regular travel within the United States.

How to Apply

Applications will be reviewed and considered on a rolling basis with interviews anticipated to start at the end of December/early January 2027. Desired start date by February 2027. Apply by submitting a cover letter and resume to:

The Heartland Fund is partnering with Clover Search Works on this search. Questions regarding this opportunity are welcomed and can be directed to julie(at)cloversearchworks.com.

Job Title: Area Business Manager, Kalamazoo, MI

About the job

Do you thrive in an agile, collaborative, business acumen driven organization where positive outcomes are rewarded? Have you ever wanted to own your own franchise and be accountable to drive business outcomes across a full portfolio of vaccines, and strengthen customer relationships? We are responsible for the implementation of a new go-to market strategy within the US Sanofi Vaccines business unit and searching for several area business managers to pave the pathway forward with us.

Across different countries, our talented teams are exploring new technologies to protect people and promote healthy communities. Join the team protecting half a billion lives every year with next-gen science, mRNA innovation, and AI driven breakthroughs. In Vaccines, you’ll help advance prevention on a global scale - and shape the future of immunization.

The ABM will act as an “account orchestrator” to provide a more cohesive customer experience and ultimately improve customer and patient outcomes by leveraging cross-functional support from internal teams across US vaccines.   • Participate and help lead initiatives to support sales success as assigned (e.g. participate in industry related congresses, local and regional meetings and medical conferences).

About You

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 3+ years of pharmaceutical, of pharmaceutical, biologics, diagnostics biotech, general healthcare, medical device or life sciences field sales or account management experience required or business to business sales experience
  • Must possess valid driver’s license, be eligible for insurance coverage and must be able to safely operate a vehicle

  • Can dynamically adjust priorities due to changing circumstances.

Why Choose Us?

jobs.title: Lead Bookkeeping Specialist - Part-Time
jobs.excerpt: ABOUT Our Company: HigherRing is the ethical outsourcing partner for socially responsible companies.
jobs.description:
ABOUT Our Company:

HigherRing is the ethical outsourcing partner for socially responsible companies. We harness business as a force for good and partner with impact organizations to lighten their load and further their purpose. We create remote, impact employment where our team members and clients are valued and supported in their efforts to advance us all toward a more sustainable world. HigherRing is a B Corp, climate-neutral, and a 1% for the Planet member.

ROLE Description:

This is a remote (work-from-home) position. W-2, not a contractor. Wage is $29.00-$31.00/hr + full benefits.

The Lead Bookkeeping Specialist is our most advanced bookkeeping role. You will work at an assistant controller level. You will do hands-on bookkeeping for your own clients, review the work of other bookkeepers, own month-end and year-end close for your clients, and help raise the quality of our bookkeeping across the team.

You know full-stack bookkeeping inside and out, and you understand the accounting behind it. You can look at a set of books and see what is wrong, why it happened, and how to fix it so it does not happen again. You explain this clearly to clients and to the bookkeepers you review.

You are also very comfortable with AI. You use AI tools every day to work faster and more accurately, and you help the team find better ways to use them. You also know where AI falls short and always check its output.

You will work closely with our Bookkeeping & Financial Operations Manager and serve as a go-to resource for other bookkeepers. We expect you to manage yourself, come to meetings ready to talk about status, risks, and opportunities, and raise issues early.

We expect team members to manage themselves and to come to any meetings prepared to talk about their status, opportunities, and challenges. We also expect them to escalate to the team management as needed for support, guidance, and mentoring.

FURTHER Details:

Core bookkeeping
  • Handle day-to-day bookkeeping for your own clients, including accounts receivable, accounts payable, bank and credit card reconciliations, payroll, and journal entries.
  • Keep client books clean, complete, and up to date throughout the month.
  • Research questions and find the best way to perform work in client systems.
Review and quality
  • Review the work of other bookkeepers, including reconciliations, journal entries, AP/AR, and monthly reports, before it goes to clients.
  • Give clear, constructive feedback that helps bookkeepers grow.
  • Find root causes of recurring errors and fix the process, not just the entry.
Assistant controller work
  • Own month-end and year-end close for assigned clients and make sure deadlines are met.
  • Prepare and review accruals, prepaids, deferred revenue, depreciation, and other adjusting entries.
  • Prepare and explain financial statements, including the Balance Sheet, Profit and Loss, and Statement of Cash Flows.
  • Do variance and trend analysis and flag issues or opportunities to clients.
  • Help clients with budgets, forecasts, and cash flow planning as agreed by HigherRing.
  • Review and improve clients' internal controls.
  • Prepare clean books and reports for CPAs and tax preparers. Request W-9s, prepare 1099s, and support audits and reviews as needed.
AI and process improvement
  • Use AI tools daily for tasks such as transaction categorization, reconciliation support, data cleanup, analysis, and drafting client communications.
  • Test new AI and automation tools and recommend the ones that improve speed and accuracy.
  • Build and document AI-supported workflows and train the team to use them.
  • Check AI output carefully and protect client data when using any tool.
Client and team
  • Act as a trusted advisor to clients and build strong relationships.
  • Handle complex or sensitive client questions and escalate to management when needed.
  • Help organize, systematize, and document our processes and procedures.
  • Perform other duties as requested.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 10+ years of full-charge bookkeeping experience, including work in a multi-client remote environment
  • Non-profit, manufacturing, and/or CPG bookkeeping experience is a must
  • Experience at a lead, supervisory, or assistant controller level, including reviewing others' work
  • Strong knowledge of accounting principles (GAAP), accrual accounting, and month-end and year-end close
  • Hands-on, daily use of AI tools (such as ChatGPT, Claude, or AI features in accounting software), with examples you can share of how you use them
  • Experience with bookkeeping software such as QuickBooks (Online), Xero, Sage, NetSuite, Intacct, or similar
  • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills
  • Proficient in Google Workspace, Slack, and Asana (or similar)
  • Accounting degree preferred
  • Certifications are a plus, such as QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor (Advanced), Xero certification, Certified Bookkeeper, or Enrolled Agent
  • Clear, kind, and direct communicator, in writing and on video calls, with clients and teammates.
  • Able to coach others and give feedback in a way that builds trust
  • Hyper-organized and able to manage many clients and deadlines without letting anything slip
  • Strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills, and a positive attitude on tough days
  • Fluent in written and spoken English. A second language is a plus
  • Dedicated and dependable work ethic
  • Quiet, distraction-free workspace in your home with a door that closes
  • Direct connection from computer to router/modem via Ethernet cable (no satellite or wireless internet)

jobs.description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

A senior leadership role responsible for engineering and operating enterprise infrastructure — compute, networking, storage, and backup — as managed services across hybrid and multi-cloud environments. Each infrastructure domain operates as a product team with defined SLAs, roadmaps, and consumer feedback loops, enabling internal technology teams to build and deliver with speed, security, and reliability.

The role manages on-premises and cloud infrastructure with equal rigor, driving workload migration while maintaining stability for workloads not yet transitioned. Operations is delivered through engineering discipline — automation, Infrastructure-as-Code, observability, and immutable patterns. AI and agentic solutions are leveraged to enhance observability and enable auto-remediation at scale. A primary objective of this role is to accelerate the migration of workloads from on-premises to cloud, reducing the on-prem footprint while ensuring zero disruption to business operations. Equally critical is building enterprise self-service infrastructure capabilities — enabling technology teams to provision, scale, and manage infrastructure on demand through APIs, IaC modules, and automated workflows without dependency on central teams.

The Main Responsibilities

  • Own compute, networking, storage, and backup as internal managed services with published service catalogs, SLAs, and shared responsibility models
  • Run each domain as a product team — backlogs, roadmaps, and continuous improvement driven by internal consumer needs
  • Contribute consumable APIs, IaC modules, and service interfaces into the enterprise self-service platform
  • Own end-to-end network engineering across cloud, hybrid, campus, and multi-site environments — DNS, campus wired/wireless, load balancing (L4/L7), multi-cloud connectivity (transit gateways, SD-WAN, Direct Connect/ExpressRoute), network security (zero-trust, micro-segmentation, firewall policy), and network performance optimization
  • Own the compute managed service — instance lifecycle, right-sizing, auto-scaling, workload placement, golden image pipelines, and immutable infrastructure patterns (fresh instances via IaC replace in-place modifications); support container/Kubernetes base image pipelines with hardened images and runtime scanning
  • Own block, file, and object storage as managed services aligned to application and database performance requirements — IOPS tuning, throughput optimization, data lifecycle policies, cross-region replication, and high availability
  • Own the enterprise backup strategy with defined RPO/RTO targets — automated backup pipelines, immutable backups for ransomware protection, DR restore testing, and retention policies for regulatory compliance
  • Manage hybrid infrastructure spanning on-premises data centers and multi-cloud environments including government cloud (AWS GovCloud, Azure Government); own hardware lifecycle, capacity planning, and the cloud migration roadmap
  • Own infrastructure lifecycle management — track and remediate EOL/EOS across hardware, operating systems, middleware, firmware, and network devices to eliminate cybersecurity exposure
  • Drive the strategic migration of workloads from on-premises to cloud — define migration waves, prioritize by business value and technical readiness, and execute with zero disruption to operations
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning through IaC and GitOps; publish reusable modules with security and compliance baked in
  • Build comprehensive observability (monitoring, logging, tracing, AIOps) and leverage AI/agentic solutions for auto-remediation, predictive capacity planning, and anomaly detection
  • Own audit readiness — controls documentation, evidence collection, and remediation tracking; ensure infrastructure is compliant by design with controls embedded in automation
  • Maintain a defensible EOL/EOS posture with documented lifecycle status and risk assessments; partner with Cybersecurity and GRC on infrastructure risk
  • Establish SRE practices — SLOs/SLIs, error budgets, reliability targets, incident management, and business continuity; keeping infrastructure up is non-negotiable, how it's kept up is through engineering
  • Partner with business leadership, Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity, Finance, and Procurement to align infrastructure strategy with business priorities and translate roadmaps into business outcomes
  • Manage vendor relationships, contracts, and technology partnerships across cloud providers and infrastructure tooling
  • Build and scale a team of engineering managers, principal engineers, SREs, network engineers, and cloud platform engineers organized around product-aligned squads; drive the cultural shift from operations mindset to engineering-first culture while maintaining operational rigor

Requirements

  • 15+ years in infrastructure/cloud engineering, with 5+ years in senior leadership managing large, distributed teams
  • Proven track record of transforming infrastructure operations into an engineering-driven, managed services model
  • Deep hands-on background across compute, networking, storage, and backup/DR in enterprise environments
  • Experience operating hybrid infrastructure — on-premises data centers and multi-cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP) simultaneously, including government cloud environments (AWS GovCloud, Azure Government)
  • Experience managing infrastructure across distributed, multi-site environments
  • Networking depth — DNS, campus networking, load balancing (L4/L7), multi-cloud connectivity, network security (zero-trust, micro-segmentation), and performance engineering
  • Storage expertise — block, file, and object; performance tuning, lifecycle management, and matching tiers to workload needs
  • Golden image pipelines, immutable infrastructure patterns, and backup/DR architecture (RPO/RTO, immutable backups, restore validation)
  • Infrastructure lifecycle management — EOL/EOS tracking, risk-based remediation, and compensating controls
  • Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Pulumi, CloudFormation), Ansible, GitOps
  • AI/ML-driven observability, AIOps, and agentic AI for auto-remediation
  • Security and compliance frameworks (SOC2, ISO 27001, NIST, CMMC)
  • Ability to run infrastructure domains as internal product teams with roadmaps, SLAs, and customer-centricity toward internal consumers
  • Track record of partnering with audit, compliance, and cybersecurity teams in regulated environments
  • Executive communication — translating technical strategy into business outcomes for C-suite stakeholders
  • Cross-functional collaboration across Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity, Finance, Procurement, and business unit leadership

Preferred Qualifications

  • Regulated industry experience (FedRAMP, SOX, CMMC)
  • Experience with government cloud environments (AWS GovCloud, Azure Government) and associated compliance requirements
  • Certifications: AWS Solutions Architect Professional, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, CCNP/CCIE, or GCP Professional Cloud Architect
  • SRE, platform engineering, or DevOps at scale background

Additional Requirements

  • Must be a U.S. Citizen. This role supports infrastructure environments subject to U.S. government regulatory and compliance requirements that mandate U.S. citizenship

The Business Intelligence Analyst will help enhance the data foundation behind our patient support programs. Reporting & Analytics

    • Work with operations, leadership, and client-facing teams to gather requirements and translate business needs into BI solutions.

    • Experience using artificial intelligence tools in day-to-day analytics or development work.

jobs.description:
🌍 Modalità di lavoro:Full remote (ufficio disponibile a Milano per chi preferisce lavorare in presenza)

💻 Key tech skills:AWS (serverless), Infrastructure as Code (CDK), CI/CD con GitHub Actions, Observability e monitoring

⏳ Esperienza:7-8 anni

💰 RAL:50-65k€ + stock option plan

Tundr sta riscrivendo le regole del welfare aziendale in Italia da fintech: tutto il welfare di un'azienda su un'unica carta, la Tundr Card, per rendere semplici e scalabili sia i fringe benefit che i flexible benefit, oggi spesso vissuti dalle aziende come un adempimento burocratico. In due anni Tundr ha acquisito oltre 1.500 clienti, si è posizionata all'11° posto della classifica Sifted 100 Southern Europe 2026 (le startup a crescita più rapida del Sud Europa) e ha appena annunciato un round serie A da 11 milioni di euro.

L'infrastruttura di Tundr gira interamente su AWS, con un'architettura fortemente serverless oriented, progettata e cresciuta in casa fin dall'inizio.
Oggi l'azienda cerca la seconda persona da affiancare a chi ha costruito tutta questa parte, per condividerne la responsabilità. La persona entrerà nel team Platform, che si occupa dell'architettura dell'intero prodotto insieme agli sviluppatori backend.

Cosa farai:

  • Garantirai che tutti i servizi su AWS siano up and running, gestendo l'infrastruttura in ottica Infrastructure as Code con CDK

  • Gestirai e farai evolvere le pipeline di CI/CD su GitHub Actions, che deployano su AWS.

  • Supporterai quotidianamente gli sviluppatori sui feature environment, repliche dell'intera architettura AWS su cui il team testa le nuove funzionalità prima della produzione

  • Imposterai da zero il sistema di observability e monitoring: metriche, SLI e SLO adatti al caso d'uso di Tundr, dashboard e alert, insieme agli standard che permetteranno agli sviluppatori di monitorare in autonomia le proprie feature

  • Contribuirai alle scelte architetturali su AWS quando c'è da progettare qualcosa di nuovo: quali servizi usare, come configurarli, come farli parlare tra loro

  • Lavorerai a stretto contatto con gli sviluppatori per la gestione di tutto il sistema event-driven di Tundr.

Requisiti tecnici:

  • 7-8 anni di esperienza, di cui una parte significativa in un ruolo DevOps, SRE o Platform Engineering su un prodotto in produzione

  • Buona conoscenza di AWS e dei suoi servizi managed

  • Esperienza con Infrastructure as Code (CDK o strumenti analoghi come Terraform)

  • Esperienza nella gestione di pipeline CI/CD

  • Esperienza concreta su observability e monitoring (metriche, alerting, dashboard, SLI/SLO), meglio se in un progetto in cui hai contribuito in prima persona a impostare il sistema

  • Ottime capacità di comunicazione: saper spiegare concetti complessi in modo semplice, anche a persone non tecniche

  • Buona padronanza della lingua italiana

Non serve spuntare ogni voce al 100%: il perimetro del ruolo è ampio e Tundr è disposta a valutare anche chi è un po' meno forte su una delle aree (ad esempio AWS o GitHub Actions) se porta un'esperienza significativa sull'observability, purché abbia voglia di imparare il resto.

Nice to have:

  • Esperienza con architetture serverless su AWS: Lambda, ECS su Fargate, DynamoDB, Aurora, API Gateway, SQS, Cognito

  • Esperienza con GitHub Actions

  • Esperienza con strumenti di observability come Prometheus, Grafana o simili

  • Conoscenza di Go (l'azienda ha una CLI interna in Go a supporto degli sviluppatori)

  • Esperienza in contesti startup o scale-up, su un prodotto consolidato con molti clienti e dati da gestire

  • Interesse verso contesti fintech o pagamenti

Sei la persona ideale se:

Ti piace lavorare in autonomia: in Tundr non ricevi una soluzione già pronta da eseguire, ma una serie di problemi da mettere in priorità e risolvere, trovando tu la strada migliore.
Hai voglia di costruire qualcosa da zero, come il sistema di observability, e di portare le tue idee nelle scelte architetturali.
Pur essendo un ruolo da individual contributor, lavori a stretto contatto con gli altri: sei la persona a cui gli sviluppatori si rivolgono quando qualcosa non funziona negli environment o quando una nuova feature richiede di introdurre nuovi servizi AWS, quindi ti piace collaborare, ti fai sentire spesso e sai spiegare le cose con chiarezza a chiunque.
Ti trovi bene in un contesto da remoto che valorizza molto il confronto diretto e sincrono con il team.

Cosa offre l'azienda:

  • Contratto di assunzione, CCNL Commercio

  • RAL 50-65k€ + stock option plan

  • Bonus su obiettivi aziendali

  • Corposo piano di welfare aziendale

  • Buoni pasto (in arrivo da gennaio 2027)

  • Modalità di lavoro full remote, con ufficio a Milano sempre disponibile per chi lo desidera

  • Offsite periodici per allinearsi, confrontarsi e stare insieme

  • Un problema reale da risolvere, in un team che cresce e insegna, con autonomia vera e impatto misurabile

Processo di selezione:

  • 2 step Welyk: recruiter + tech mentor

  • 1 step tecnico con il team Tundr

  • Breve chiacchierata conoscitiva finale con l'HR

L'annuncio è rivolto a candidati di entrambi i sessi, nel rispetto del D.lgs. 198/2006 e s.m.i., e a persone di ogni età, nazionalità, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere e appartenenza etnica, nel rispetto dei principi di non discriminazione e pari opportunità.

jobs.title: Director, Data Management
jobs.excerpt: Description The Director, Data Management will have overall responsibility for the Data Management team, including Clinical Data Managers, Clinical Data Coordinators, Clinical Study Builders and Clinical Data Coders.
jobs.description:
Description

The Director, Data Management will have overall responsibility for the Data Management team, including Clinical Data Managers, Clinical Data Coordinators, Clinical Study Builders and Clinical Data Coders.

The Director, Data Management, will provide strategic leadership and oversight of data management resources, processes, and deliverables, ensuring the quality, integrity, and timely delivery of clinical trial data.

The Director, Data Management will oversee and participate in all clinical data management activities required to ensure that data captured in clinical trials undertaken, or managed by Indero, are collected, managed and reported clearly, accurately and securely. In addition, this position is required to conduct all these activities in conformance with applicable regulatory requirements, industry guidelines and Indero’s SOP while respecting Indero’s commitment to sponsor’s requirements and timelines.

More specifically, the Director, Data Management must:

Strategic Leadership and Collaboration

  • Inspire, lead and develop all functions within Data Management by helping to formulate a clear vision for the future and attracting and retaining top talent.
  • Define and drive the Data Management strategy and roadmap, including innovation, standardization and automation initiatives that support the company’s business objectives.
  • Collaborate with Biostatistics, Risk-Based Study Management, Project Management and other function leaders to align strategies, processes and tools, and to ensure integrated delivery of clinical trial data.
  • Represent Data Management in sponsor and client meetings and manage the escalation of study risks and issues related to Data Management deliverables.
  • Monitor industry trends and regulatory changes in clinical data management.
  • Provide leadership and accountability to study teams assigned to the dedicated client portfolio.

People and Resource Management

  • Provide direct oversight of data management operations, including planning and assigning work, overseeing the performance of direct reports and conducting performance reviews.
  • Evaluate the performance of assigned project personnel.
  • Oversee and provide ongoing training/mentoring to data management and programming staff and review/approve documentation generated by staff, as necessary.
  • Ensure that all trainings assigned to oneself and to direct and indirect reports are completed on time, and provide direct and indirect reports with appropriate support.
  • Oversee resource allocation for Data Management activities across clinical trials and internal initiatives.
  • Lead the development of flexible resourcing strategies, including internal and external resources, to meet the evolving demands of the company.
  • Adhere to and promote company values and related expected behaviors and follow company SOPs and processes for all deliverables.

Financial Management and Oversight

  • Oversee budget and resources allocated for Data Management.
  • Lead the annual Data Management budget planning.
  • Be responsible for the operational and financial health of Data Management-supported clinical trials by monitoring key operational metrics and supporting budget oversight and forecasting.
  • Participate in the review of Master Service Agreements (MSA) and work orders with external service providers, process and track payment requests to ensure accordance with the budget and the needs of the study.
  • Develop Work Orders with external service providers, process and track payment requests to ensure accordance with the budget and the needs of the study.
  • Oversee activities performed by external service providers to ensure they are done in accordance with effective Work Orders, applicable regulations and Indero SOPs (if applicable).
  • Oversee the selection, implementation and ongoing management of Data Management systems (e.g., EDC) and strategic technology vendors.

Operational Excellence, Quality and Compliance

  • Oversee development and optimization of Data Management processes with specific focus on efficiency and quality, while maintaining or exceeding industry best practices.
  • Define, analyze and monitor Data Management key performance indicators (KPIs) and quality metrics to ensure quality, compliance and timely delivery, and report on performance to senior leadership.
  • Ensure that Data Management standards, SOPs, processes and trainings are aligned with applicable ICH-GCP guidelines, regulatory authority requirements and industry best practices.
  • Oversee the definition, writing and updating of data management SOPs.
  • Monitor timelines and ensure that data management deadlines are met.

Clinical Data Management Delivery

  • Provide escalation support and expertise to project teams, sponsors and external vendors on complex data management matters, as needed.
  • Provide support and close oversight to data management team activities for clinical trials from the development of study protocols to the completion of study reports.
  • Oversee the development of eCRF specifications (including data capture screens and edit check specifications) needed to build a study-specific clinical database/electronic data capture (EDC) system.
  • Oversee the programming and ongoing maintenance of the clinical database.
  • Oversee the validation and testing of the clinical database e.g. User Acceptance Testing.
  • Oversee the development of eCRF completion guidelines and other training material required to train site users and monitors.
  • Oversee the development of data transfer agreements and specifications with vendors providing external data (e.g. laboratory results).
  • Oversee the review/development of the data management plan (DMP), and other clinical data management related documentation.
  • Oversee ongoing data review/cleaning during study conduct.
  • Ensure that data management documentation is complete and up-to-date in the eTMF.
  • Oversee the archiving of the clinical database and related documents.

Employee may be assigned to other responsibilities that do not pertain to their former description, if they have the required experience, are qualified and/or have received adequate training.

Requirements

  • B.Sc. or M.Sc., or related field;
  • Minimum of 8 years of leadership experience, plus at least 15 years of clinical trials experience in biotechnology, pharmaceutical or CRO industry.
  • Proven experience leading and developing data management teams and managing multiple studies and sponsor portfolios.
  • Demonstrated experience leading global or cross-functional initiatives and influencing strategy across multiple stakeholders.
  • Experience with budget planning and resource management, including the oversight of external vendors.
  • Experience in the setup, validation and oversight of EDC systems and other clinical data systems.
  • Experience supporting sponsor audits and regulatory inspections is an asset.
  • Strong knowledge of ICH-GCP, CDISC standards (CDASH, SDTM), and applicable data protection regulations.
  • Strategic thinking, with the ability to define a vision and translate it into operational plans.
  • Strong leadership and coaching skills, with the ability to teach, train and mentor employees at all levels.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence at all levels of the organization and with external stakeholders in a matrix, cross-functional environment.
  • Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple competing demands in a fast-paced environment.
  • Sound judgment, problem-solving and decision-making skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; French is an asset.
  • Good knowledge of good clinical practices, and applicable Health Canada and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations/guidelines.

Our company

At Indero, you will work with brilliant and driven colleagues. Our values are collaboration, innovation, reliability and responsiveness. We offer a stimulating work environment and attractive advancement opportunities.

In this position, you will be eligible for the following perks:

  • Permanent full-time position
  • Flexible schedule
  • Vacation
  • Home-based position
  • Ongoing learning and development

﻿About Indero

A Global Clinical Leader In Dermatology!

﻿Formerly known as Innovaderm, Indero is a world-renowned expert and clinical research leader in dermatology. We have more than two decades of experience serving a broad range of indications, patient populations, administration routes, and drug classes, and a global footprint.

﻿Indero is a dual-focus CRO for dermatology and rheumatology, with 25+ years’ experience in clinical research and trial delivery. Our full-service approach – which includes everything from protocol design and patient recruitment to trial monitoring and biometrics – provides biotech and pharmaceutical sponsors with the rigorous scientific foundation and tailored expertise their studies need to reach the finish line efficiently and effectively. With capabilities in North America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Latin America; vast, continuously growing relationships with investigators and patients; and a dedicated research clinic through which we design and execute our own studies, Indero is the ideal CRO partner for clinical needs at global scale.

﻿Indero is committed to providing equitable treatment and equal opportunity to all individuals. As such, Indero will provide accommodations throughout the recruitment and selection process to applicants with disabilities, upon request.

﻿Indero only accepts applicants who can legally work in Canada.

About the role: We are seeking a Principal Engineer based in Toronto to provide senior technical leadership for teams building customer-facing SaaS product capabilities. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with broad influence across multiple teams. You will own architecture and technical direction, solve complex technical problems, and help evolve mature SaaS capabilities toward an AI-first product and engineering model.

Reporting to Sandeep Reddy, Senior Director of Engineering, you will partner with Engineering Leadership, Product Management, Architecture, Data, Security, and Quality Engineering in a globally distributed environment.

About you: You are a deeply technical engineer who has grown from building systems to shaping how teams build them, while staying hands-on. You are comfortable leading architecture reviews and debugging production bottlenecks. You use AI to improve customer value, engineering quality, and delivery speed, and you challenge constructively while bringing others along through influence and credibility.

Key responsibilities

  • Own technical direction for a multi-team product area. Lead the design and modernization of distributed, cloud-native, data-intensive systems and APIs, balance speed, quality, scalability, cost, and security.

  • Partner with Engineering Managers and Product Management to translate roadmaps into technical plans. Surface risks early and own the technical debt roadmap for your area.
  • Lead the design of AI-enabled product capabilities, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), model integration, and agentic workflows. Champion GenAI-assisted engineering across the software development lifecycle within NIQ security and data governance standards.
  • Drive standards for reliability, observability, CI/CD, test automation, and secure engineering. Act as a senior escalation point during major incidents and root cause analysis.
  • Mentor Senior and Staff Engineers, raise the technical hiring bar, and influence stakeholders across global teams through clear communication and technical credibility.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; an advanced degree is preferred.
  • 12+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, including 4+ years in a Staff Engineer, Principal Engineer, or Lead Architect role with influence across multiple teams.

  • Deep expertise in system design, distributed systems, cloud-native architecture, API design, and reliability engineering.

Validate a prioritized AI-enabled capability or GenAI-assisted engineering practice against agreed quality, security, and value criteria. Establish regular mentoring and architecture decision practices across the teams you support.

  • Modernization and technical debt work progresses alongside product delivery, with risks and dependencies surfaced early.
  • AI-enabled capabilities and engineering practices demonstrate measurable value and meet NIQ security, data governance, and evaluation standards.
  • Senior and Staff Engineers develop greater technical ownership, and global stakeholders trust your judgement, communication, and follow-through.

jobs.description:
Roles and Responsibilities As an Executive VIP Consultant (US Domestic), you will play a key role in supporting Sirva’s continued success by serving as the primary point of contact for EVIP customers throughout their mobility journey. This high-touch, service-led role requires strong organisational capability, sound judgement and the ability to support, guide and advise customers across a varied client portfolio. The Executive VIP Consultant (US Domestic) is accountable for the day-to-day delivery of designated EVIP relocation programmes, ensuring a highly coordinated, responsive and premium customer experience. Working as part of a global EVIP team, the consultant may be required to support urgent customer needs outside standard working hours and across regions. The role provides close oversight of each customer’s move or assignment and is accountable for maintaining consistently high levels of customer satisfaction. The consultant must communicate with clarity, confidence and proactivity, acting as an ambassador for Sirva and ensuring that customer issues are resolved promptly, effectively and with appropriate sensitivity. The successful candidate will bring extensive international mobility service delivery experience, ideally supported by prior exposure to VIP or executive-level programme management. Given the high-touch nature of the service, the Executive VIP Consultant will manage a reduced caseload to enable a more personalised, proactive and elevated level of support. Essential Functions and Responsibilities 70% Direct Customer Interaction

Oversee the full spectrum of relocation management services, including policy counselling, home sale and purchase support, destination services, household goods shipment, intercultural services, visa and immigration support, language training, ongoing assignment support and repatriation. Interpret designated client relocation policies and procedures, evaluate available options and provide tailored consultation to relocating employees based on their individual circumstances and needs. Anticipate, manage and resolve issues quickly, creatively and with appropriate escalation discipline. Act as the single point of contact and accountability for all EVIP moves, ensuring supplier communications are reviewed and that employees are not asked to provide the same information to multiple parties. Partner with internal support teams and external providers to ensure customer needs are met promptly, with all parties operating as one coordinated support team. Respond to relocating employees on the same business day, ideally within four business hours. Provide ongoing consultation and proactive guidance throughout the duration of the international assignment or relocation. Identify and recommend process improvements that enhance efficiency, consistency and the overall customer experience. Demonstrate flexibility in working hours where calls or urgent support are required outside core hours to accommodate VIP employee schedules.

15% Client Support and Stakeholder Engagement

Consult with clients on authorised services and potential policy exceptions in advance of customer briefing calls. Provide ongoing updates to key client and Sirva stakeholders. Support exception management, including providing informed recommendations on policy exception requests. Deliver clear status updates, keep clients informed of emerging issues and provide practical solutions as matters arise. Complete client projects and reports as required, while developing subject matter expertise in client policy and operating procedures.

Regularly attend mandatory, essential and recommended training to strengthen role capability, support career development and reinforce understanding of organisational vision, culture and customer experience standards. Complete additional tasks and responsibilities as required to provide effective support to the manager, clients and customers. Participate in sales efforts as required, demonstrating strong programme knowledge and a clear passion for outstanding customer service.

5% Face-to-Face Support

Provide face-to-face support with relocating employees at key move milestones, where authorised and funded by the client.

High school diploma or equivalent. University degree or three to four years’ experience in a customer experience or business operations role. Prior experience supporting VIP, executive-level or high-touch international relocation programmes is highly desirable. US domestic relocation knowledge is beneficial but not essential. Overall quality scores of 4.6 or above for the past year, where applicable for internal candidates. Proven ability to maintain urgency, prioritise effectively and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.

Technical Skills

Digitally confident, with demonstrated ability to use multiple technology platforms as an integrated part of day-to-day service delivery. Able to adopt new technology quickly and incorporate it effectively into ways of working. Comfortable navigating multiple technology platforms simultaneously.

Cognitive Skills

Highly organised, with strong problem-solving capability and excellent attention to detail. Able to exercise sound judgement and own complex processes through to completion and resolution. Able to anticipate potential issues and develop effective solutions without immediate direction or supervision. Able to think creatively, navigate ambiguity and resolve problems quickly and efficiently. Demonstrates strong accountability for the customer experience and the successful delivery of each move. Demonstrates curiosity and a commitment to continuous learning within a transforming organisation.

Social & Emotional Skills

Demonstrates a trusted advisor mindset in both proactive and reactive customer scenarios. Builds trusted relationships quickly through strong service orientation, credibility and responsiveness. Adapts communication style to support different VIP personas and family needs with confidence and discretion. Operates effectively in a team environment with shared goals and responsibilities in support of a positive customer experience. Maintains a calm, confident and composed approach, particularly in difficult, sensitive or high-pressure situations. Demonstrates strong collaboration, cultural awareness and excellent written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills.

WHAT SIRVA OFFERS

jobs.description:
AirStrip is adding a Regulatory Affairs Manager to our Quality Assurance and Regulatory Affairs team. In this role, you’ll develop and execute regulatory strategies for our Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) products throughout the product lifecycle, including new product development, enhancements, regulatory submissions, and international market expansion. You’ll serve as a regulatory subject matter expert, partnering with cross-functional teams to navigate complex FDA and international medical device requirements, maintain regulatory approvals, and ensure ongoing compliance. As a hands-on individual contributor, you’ll provide regulatory leadership, guidance, and mentorship while helping AirStrip deliver innovative, safe, and effective healthcare technology. This position may be eligible for remote work with supervisor authorization and requires up to 30% travel to company office locations and client sites as needed.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Develop and execute regulatory strategies for AirStrip’s SaMD products, supporting new product development, product enhancements, lifecycle management, and international market expansion. Prepare, coordinate, review, and maintain regulatory submissions, registrations, certifications, and correspondence with regulatory authorities, including the FDA, EU regulatory bodies, Health Canada, and other applicable jurisdictions. Provide strategic regulatory guidance on FDA submission pathways, including pre-submissions, 510(k), Premarket Approval (PMA), and post-market regulatory requirements. Lead regulatory assessments of product design changes, software modifications, intended use, indications, labeling, and product claims to determine regulatory impact and whether additional notifications or submissions are required. Develop and maintain regulatory documentation within Design History Files (DHF) and Technical Documentation, including device descriptions, intended purpose, classification rationale, regulatory requirements, declarations, and submission-ready records. Lead EU MDR transition and ongoing conformity assessment activities, including technical documentation readiness, General Safety and Performance Requirements (GSPR), EUDAMED and Swissdamed obligations, and Notified Body communications. Evaluate regulatory requirements for entry into new international markets, collaborating with authorized representatives, importers, distributors, and local regulatory partners to support market access. Maintain regulatory authorizations, certificates, registrations, device listings, and regulatory commitments across the markets in which AirStrip products are offered, including renewals and change notifications. Review and approve regulatory content in product labeling, electronic instructions for use, marketing materials, product claims, and external product communications within delegated authority. Provide regulatory input into risk management, clinical evaluation, post-market surveillance, periodic safety update reports, vigilance activities, and regulatory reportability assessments. Serve as a regulatory subject matter expert during FDA, Notified Body, MDSAP, customer, and other external audits and inspections, coordinating timely responses to regulatory questions and deficiencies. Develop and maintain regulatory intelligence, submission plans, compliance matrices, regulatory decision records, and tracking systems for agency commitments and regulatory deadlines. Provide regulatory guidance on software development, cybersecurity, interoperability, cloud-based deployment, and emerging technologies as they relate to medical device classification, regulatory submissions, and product claims. Support ongoing compliance with applicable FDA and international medical device requirements while providing regulatory input into Quality Management System (QMS) processes, design controls, change management, and post-market activities. Develop, enhance, and streamline regulatory policies, processes, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), providing guidance, coaching, and training to colleagues as appropriate.

Education & Experience Requirements:

5+ years of medical device regulatory affairs experience, including SaMD regulatory submissions and product lifecycle management. 5+ years of practical experience applying FDA and international medical device regulations, including EU MDR, UKCA, and Health Canada requirements. Educational background in a scientific discipline, engineering, regulatory affairs, biomedical engineering, life sciences, or a related technical field. Relevant educational and professional credentials identified for this role include a bachelor’s or master’s degree in the applicable disciplines and Regulatory Affairs Certification (RAC) or an equivalent regulatory credential. Management or leadership experience preferred.

jobs.description:
About Metis Strategy

Metis Strategy, a management and strategy consulting firm, focused on the intersection of business and technology, continues to grow and is looking for highly motivated individuals to join our San Francisco Bay Area team. We are trusted advisors to Fortune 500 and Global 1000 companies, helping them meet their most critical business objectives through tailored engagements and deep professional relationships. We work across industries on topics related to business & digital strategy and navigating organizational change.

We are an entrepreneurial, fast-growing firm headquartered in the Washington, D.C. area with offices in the San Francisco Bay Area and Dallas, Texas. The firm’s presence from coast to coast allows us to serve clients throughout the United States and internationally. In our 20+ year history, we have established a track record of making lasting impacts on organizational performance and helping executives improve business outcomes. In a career with Metis Strategy you will experience high growth as you encounter new challenges with each client engagement; have a high degree of autonomy to craft the direction of your work; and become empowered to work directly with thought-leaders, C-level clients, and other decision-makers.

What We Look For

Role summary

You will design and deliver hands-on AI training for enterprise clients. Sessions are mostly virtual and run in 3–4 hour blocks across global time zones. Audiences range from executives to software engineers. Builder cohorts work in the labs themselves: skills, agents, MCP servers, coding agents, code review. Leader and enabler cohorts work on everyday workflows. You co-facilitate with other Metis trainers and tailor the content to each client’s industry, tools and security requirements. You own keeping content current. Models, tools and pricing change quarterly, so you update materials before each cohort.

Must-have

Technical depth

  • You have shipped LLM or agentic systems to production, not just prototyped them. You can show examples.
  • You are fluent in how agentic coding harnesses work: context files (CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md), skills, subagents, hooks, MCP and plugins. You have built a custom MCP server and an agent end to end.
  • You know the main ways to extend a model (prompting, RAG, fine-tuning, self-hosting) and can explain when to use each.
  • You understand agent security: prompt injection, least-privilege tools, human-in-the-loop and guardrails outside the model.
  • You can explain Tokenomics and cost control to both engineers and finance audiences.

Ecosystem breadth

  • Hands-on with Anthropic (Claude, Claude Code, Cowork), OpenAI (ChatGPT, Codex, SDKs), Microsoft (M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Copilot Cowork, GitHub Copilot) and open-weight models.
  • Working familiarity with Google (Gemini, Vertex), AWS (Bedrock), Cursor and the major agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, MS Agent Framework).

Teaching and facilitation

  • You have taught live, technical, hands-on sessions to groups, in person or virtual.
  • You pace a 4-hour virtual session well: polls, breakouts, chat, energy management and a clean break structure.
  • You troubleshoot setup problems in locked-down enterprise environments (Windows, WSL2, proxies, restricted installs, SSO and licensing) without losing the room.
  • You can explain complex concepts plainly to different audiences, and you stay calm when a live demo misbehaves. Models are non-deterministic, so demos will sometimes fail.

People skills (observable)

  • You read a remote room and adjust. You can tell who is lost, who is bored and who is already ahead.
  • You handle skepticism and job-displacement anxiety directly, without dismissing it.
  • You are comfortable saying “I don’t know, let’s test it.”

Experience

  • 10+ years in software development, data/ML engineering, architecture or technical product work, with recent, practical experience building with LLMs.

Strong plus

  • Consulting or client-facing delivery experience, including working under a partner brand and co-facilitating.
  • Governance and compliance fluency: responsible AI, data classification, and regional requirements such as the EU AI Act and data residency.
  • Evals and observability experience: building test sets, guardrails and monitoring for LLM applications.
  • Instructional design: building labs, measuring learning with pre/post assessments, and reinforcing it afterward (office hours, 30/60/90-day follow-through).
  • Change management or AI adoption experience, including connecting training to business outcomes and ROI.
  • Domain experience in a regulated or industrial sector (manufacturing, IT/OT, healthcare, financial services).
  • Experience authoring skills, plugins or reusable templates that a client team can maintain.

Nice to have

  • Experience teaching across cultures and non-native English audiences (for example India, EMEA and North America in the same program).
  • Public thought leadership: writing, talks or open-source work.
  • Self-hosted inference and fine-tuning experience (vLLM, Ollama, LoRA/QLoRA).

What Metis Strategy Has to Offer

Successful candidates will be motivated by the desire to make a difference by helping our clients achieve and maintain strategic and operational excellence while continuously improving their own skill set and embracing emerging intellectual challenges.

This position is also eligible for bonus compensation. Additional benefits include but are not limited to:

  • comprehensive medical insurance, dental insurance, and vision insurance;
  • parental leave, and family benefits;
  • retirement contributions;
  • stipend for continued learning;
  • paid time off, and more.

Compensation and benefits are competitive and will be commensurate with each candidate’s qualifications and relevant work experience.

If you are driven by the desire to help some of the world’s most renowned companies solve complex business problems and excited by the intersection of business strategy and technological innovation, you will enjoy being a part of our team.

jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Millions of businesses across the internet run on Stripe. The Stripe Business Network team is building the B2B network that turns that scale into value for every one of them: a place where businesses discover and transact with each other, share verified data, and move money instantly and seamlessly.

We're building the experiences that make that network real. A single view of your entire Stripe network, including every platform, partner, and customer you do business with, where a new relationship is just a click away. Portable identity, so when you start working with a new platform, your verified business information comes with you instead of being collected from scratch. Closed-loop money movement, so paying another Stripe business is instant and costs a fraction of a card payment. A business directory where the right counterparties can find you. And trusted data sharing and profile representation, so counterparties have confidence in who they're working with.

Every business that joins makes the network more valuable for everyone already on it. We think of the Business Network as the business graph for the internet economy, and we're building for what's next.

What you'll do

You will build the Stripe Business Network experiences, including the Network Tab (a single page to see your whole Stripe network), search and discovery, profiles, networked invoicing, and much more, to deliver utility to our users across the board.

That means being a true champion of our users: end-to-end owner of core flows, a cross-functional partner to Engineering, Design, and GTM, and an active voice in shaping the Business Network's strategy alongside leadership. You'll define, build, and scale new and existing products, informed by user insights and data.

We're looking for a technical PM who operates with a high degree of autonomy and drive. You care deeply about craft and impact. The only thing that really matters to you is getting well-built products into users' hands. You're already exploring how AI is changing how products get built and what it means for the PM role; you might even have a few half-finished side projects that prove it.

Responsibilities

  • Own the user's perspective. Spend time with users, and synthesize their feedback and market signals into clear product direction.
  • Obsess over user impact rather than features shipped. Always ask (and quantify) how each release delivers value and utility to our users.
  • Drive high-velocity, high-craft execution and own outcomes. Lead cross-functional work from discovery through launch, and hold yourself accountable for adoption, user value, and business impact.
  • Own Stripe's strategic priorities. Use judgment to factor in Stripe's strategic positioning and leverage, and make network-accretive product choices.
  • Partner deeply with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Marketing, Sales, and Operations to ship cohesive, frictionless experiences.

Who you are

We're looking for a high-agency, high-paced product manager with strong craft to bring the next set of network features to life.

Minimum requirements

  • 7+ years in a product or technical role, with experience shipping world-class products at scale
  • High agency and an ownership mindset. You do whatever it takes to solve problems, delight users, and deliver business impact. You climb walls to get there.
  • High resilience and resourcefulness. You see around corners, think ahead, and find a way where there seemingly isn't one. You are highly proactive and able to set the pace for a team
  • High taste, design empathy, and sharp judgment. You put yourself in the shoes of users and are a steward of great experiences that deliver real utility.
  • Rigorous with data, including digging into metrics, getting to insight, telling a story with data, and thinking from first principles to deliver the right results
  • Strong written and verbal communication, with a talent for distilling user problems into precise, actionable framing
  • Thrive with a high level of autonomy and responsibility

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with complex payments or financial products, or building networks and marketplaces
  • Experience building brand-new products or working in a startup environment
  • Experience working with GTM teams to bring new products to market

    Must have

Hypercare
