jobs.description:
Thanks for your interest in Oklo! We are searching for a Senior Mechanical Design Engineer to join our Rapid Concept Engineering team.

Position Description

As a SeniorMechanical Design Engineer on Oklo’s Rapid Concept Engineering team, you’ll be responsible for evaluating mechanical system concepts and developing early design solutions for future powerhouse products. Working alongside the New Product Introduction team, you’ll play an important role in early system architecture development, technical feasibility studies, and the formation of technical execution strategies.

You’ll work on high-impact engineering challenges involving the mechanical design and integration of large, complex systems. Your work will span concept generation, preliminary CAD modeling, engineering trade studies, system integration, and technical feasibility evaluations – helping establish practical design approaches that balance performance, manufacturability, cost, and regulatory considerations.

This role will focus on early investigations and system architecture rather than detailed design, fabrication, or commissioning. You'll collaborate across engineering disciplines to evaluate design concepts, identify key constraints, and develop the engineering recommendations and resource estimates required to advance new products into subsequent design phases.

This is a highly cross-functional role where technical excellence, broad engineering expertise, clear technical communication, and a collaborative mindset are equally valued.

Specific responsibilities may include:

  • Develop and evaluate mechanical system concepts and architectures for new powerhouse products and supporting systems.

  • Conduct feasibility studies and engineering trade studies to compare design alternatives, balancing performance, cost, schedule, manufacturability, and regulatory considerations.

  • Collaborate with engineering disciplines and cross-functional partners to define early technical requirements, performance criteria, design constraints, and system interfaces.

  • Use 3D CAD tools to develop preliminary designs, system layouts, equipment arrangements, and major component interfaces.

  • Evaluate material selection, manufacturing processes, assembly approaches, and maintenance access for large, complex mechanical systems.

  • Assess concepts against applicable engineering codes and standards, including ASME, and coordinate with analysis teams to evaluate structural, thermal, and mechanical performance.

  • Identify key design risks, assumptions, and uncertainties, using analysis appropriate to the decision and maturity of the concept.

  • Develop preliminary cost, staffing, resource, and engineering development schedule estimates to support product planning.

  • Present recommendations in cross-functional reviews and document design rationale, key decisions, and next steps to support technical execution planning and handoff to engineering and project teams.

  • Improve early-stage engineering tools and practices to support rapid, rigorous concept evaluation.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or higher degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline.

  • 10+ years of engineering experience designing and integrating large, complex mechanical products or systems.

  • Experience leading cross-functional technical efforts and collaborating across engineering disciplines.

  • Proficiency in 3D CAD software, such as SolidWorks, for system modeling, assemblies, and technical drawings.

  • Strong understanding of mechanical design, material selection, manufacturing processes, and design for manufacturability.

  • Fluency in applicable engineering codes and standards, including ASME, and ability to interpret and produce drawings using GD&T.

  • Experience defining technical requirements and system interfaces, evaluating design alternatives, and developing preliminary cost, resource, and schedule estimates.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to clearly explain technical recommendations and tradeoffs.

Bonus Qualifications:

  • Experience in early-stage product development, conceptual engineering, or technical feasibility studies.

  • Experience designing large mechanical systems in regulated industries such as nuclear, aerospace, defense, or energy.

  • Experience developing multidisciplinary system architectures and integrating major equipment, structural assemblies, and subsystems.

  • Familiarity with nuclear licensing requirements and applicable nuclear engineering codes and standards.

  • Experience with engineering simulation tools, such as ANSYS, and thermal-mechanical analysis.

Competencies

We are looking for a Senior Mechanical Design Engineer that is:

  • Connects mechanical design decisions to broader product and system needs.

  • Uses sound engineering judgment to evaluate alternatives and balance technical feasibility, performance, cost, schedule, and regulatory considerations.

  • Works effectively through ambiguity, tests assumptions, and iterates quickly as new information emerges.

  • Passionate about clean energy and making advanced fission a reality, with an optimistic outlook.

  • Quick to learn and comfortable in a fast-paced, highly iterative startup environment.

  • A creative, critical, and reflective thinker who questions established approaches and proposes new solutions to technical problems.

  • An excellent communicator who can clearly explain technical content and results verbally and write in a modern, active voice—so make your cover letter compelling and write it well!

Who you are:

A startup person: You aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process. You don't need or expect to have a lot of guidance but you enjoy working in a fast-paced team. If you prefer the culture and feel of a large organization, that is great, but you likely won’t enjoy working with us! There is plenty of important work and plenty of good opportunities with organizations like that.

Motivated: You are self-motivated. You bring an enthusiasm to the team, and imbue a sense of passion that goes beyond clocking in and clocking out. This isn’t about a fake or arbitrary “pieces of flair” mentality or lack of work-life balance! It is about being a part of the vision and feeling a part of reaching team goals.

A team-player: Oklo genuinely is a team. We aren’t about taking credit for ourselves, and we aren’t about pushing blame to others. We do incredible things because we work as a team.

An excellent communicator: We need a person who is not only technically competent but also a clear and upbeat communicator.

Creative: Being creative means that when things fall outside clear scopes or processes or problems arise without clear solutions, you are able to identify it as well as invent ways to solve a problem or fill a need without micromanagement. The successful person in this job will not only be creative, but also enjoy being creative and solving open-ended problems which may change day-by-day.

Detail-oriented: This focus is a big part of excellence, consistency, and quality. Excellent grammar and spelling matter for both good communication as well as the image of the company that we put forward.

About Oklo travel requirements:

Oklo requires remote employees to travel to headquarters (Santa Clara, CA) twice a quarter annually, based on business or team needs, including attendance at team meetings, off-sites, and other company events or gatherings. For the first two weeks of onboarding, employees are required to be in person at headquarters in Santa Clara, CA.

About Oklo compensation:

Salary: $150,000-$190,000

Oklo offers flexible time off, equity, bonuses, competitive pay, 401(k), health insurance (with employer contribution), HSA, FSA, flexible work hours, wellness credits, and other benefits.

This position may involve access to information subject to U.S. export control laws. Only applicants who meet the definition of a U.S. person under applicable laws may be eligible.

About Oklo Inc.: Oklo Inc. is developing fast fission power plants to deliver clean, reliable, and affordable energy at scale; establishing a domestic supply chain for critical radioisotopes; and advancing nuclear fuel recycling to convert nuclear waste into clean energy. Oklo was the first to receive a site use permit from the U.S. Department of Energy for a commercial advanced fission plant, was awarded fuel material from Idaho National Laboratory, and submitted the first custom combined license application for an advanced reactor to the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission. Oklo is also developing advanced fuel recycling technologies in collaboration with the U.S. Department of Energy and U.S. National Laboratories.

#CHOP: Oklo’s Values
Collaboration: We go further, together. We bring diverse perspectives, listen actively, and build trust through transparency and respect. We work across disciplines, sharing ownership to turn complex challenges into shared successes.
Humility: We are team players who act for the good of the company and for the world. We are focused on our mission, not personal recognition.
Ownership: We take pride in what we do and how we do it. We are proactive in finding solutions and see tasks through to completion. We are committed to delivering on our promises to provide clean, reliable, and affordable energy.
Pathfinding: We chart new ground where no path exists by approaching challenges with curiosity, courage, and creativity while navigating ambiguity.

Candidates should be aware that employment may be contingent upon successful completion of a drug screening, and employees may be subject to drug testing at any time in accordance with company policy and applicable laws.

Recruitment Fraud Disclaimer

Oklo is aware of recent recruitment fraud attempts targeting job seekers. Please be cautious of anyone claiming to represent Oklo who does not contact you from an official Oklo email address.

All legitimate communications from our recruiting team— including application updates, interview requests, and job offers — will come exclusively from an @oklo.com email. Oklo will never ask for sensitive personal information, payments, or account credentials during the hiring process.

If you receive suspicious outreach or have concerns about the authenticity of any communication claiming to be from Oklo, please contact us through the official channels listed on our website.

Standard Job Description

The Global Financial Services Orders to Cash team is responsible for providing Billing and Collections services to various Lockheed Martin business area/unit partners. This position is primarily responsible for providing successful billing support for the Missiles and Fire Control Business Area with additional support in other areas as needed.

Position will be responsible for, but not limited to the following:
- Accurate and timely internal and external customer billing within the 1LMX S4 system
- Completion of invoice and account reconciliations as required
- Independent identification of billing opportunities

- Analyze and create invoices

- Create accounting documents and appropriately transmit invoices
- Assist with collection and cash application activities as needed
- Review system enhancements and make recommendations
- Additional responsibilities and special projects to support the organization as needed

This is a fast-paced, challenging position where the candidate must be a high-performer and quick learner. The candidate must be able and willing to support and meet tight deadlines on a continuous basis while staying focused on internal (billing team) and external (business area/unit, FAR, etc.) policies and procedures. Work is cyclical and follows a billing schedule, but also has a dynamic component that requires analytical, customer service, and strong organizational skills. An ability to work effectively in a diverse team environment is expected.

Applies principles of accounting to analyze financial information, process financial transactions, analyze cost and prepare financial reports. Maintains or oversees the control of accounts and records in such areas as disbursements, expenses, tax payments, income, cash, accounts payable, accounts receivables, billing, fixed assets, liabilities. Compiles and analyzes financial information to record transactions, prepare reports, perform reconciliations and review and verify accuracy. Prepares balance sheet and profit and loss statements, consolidated financial statements, and other accounting schedules and reports. May design, modify, install, and/or maintain accounting and financial information systems to ensure an adequate recognition of financial transactions. Responsible for the adherence to and communication of accounting and auditing policies and procedures, regulatory compliance and government regulations and reporting. May be required to interface with various government agencies.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree from an accredited college and/or equivalent experience
- Effective analytical skills demonstrated through related experience

- Ability to multi-task

- Effective Microsoft Office skills (specifically Excel)
- Experience/knowledge of accounting entries and related impacts

Desired Skills

- Experience with SAP

- Prior Billing Experience

- Exceptional teamwork and customer service attitude
- Quick and proactive learner with aptitude for systems and processes

- Accountability and professionalism

- Experience with automation software

- Advanced Excel and Outlook skills
- Independent problem-solving skills

- Strong organizational skills

jobs.title: Khan Kids: Senior Consumer Marketing Manager (1 year contract, 40 hours/week, $6
jobs.excerpt: Notice to applicants: We have seen a rise in recruitment scams.
jobs.description:
Notice to applicants:

We have seen a rise in recruitment scams. Please note that outreach from Khan Academy recruiters will only come from the @khanacademy.org domain. Our team does not use Gmail or other personal accounts for contacting potential candidates. Khan Academy will never solicit money, equipment fees, or sensitive financial information at any stage of the hiring process. We also do not work with external recruiting agencies, so outreach from headhunters presenting opportunities on behalf of Khan Academy is illegitimate. Please always check the email domain and cross-reference the position with the official Khan Academy Careers page to confirm an opening is valid.

ABOUT KHAN ACADEMY

Khan Academy is a nonprofit with the mission to deliver a free, world-class education to anyone, anywhere. Our proven learning platform offers free, high-quality supplemental learning content and practice that cover Pre-K - 12th grade and early college core academic subjects, focusing on math and science. We have over 181 million registered learners globally and are committed to improving learning outcomes for students worldwide, focusing on learners in historically under-resourced communities.

ABOUT KHAN ACADEMY KIDS

Khan Academy Kids is a free and fun learning program for children ages 2 to 8. Kodi Bear and a cast of animated characters lead children on a personalized education journey filled with fun, standards-aligned activities in early literacy, math, executive functioning and social emotional skills. Built by a small but mighty team, Khan Academy Kids is used by millions of children in homes and classrooms around the world.

OUR COMMUNITY

Our students, teachers, and parents come from all walks of life, and so do we. Our team includes people from academia, traditional/non-traditional education, big tech companies, and tiny startups. We hire great people from diverse backgrounds and experiences because it makes our company stronger. We value diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging as necessary to achieve our mission and impact the communities we serve. We know that transforming education starts in-house with learning about ourselves and our colleagues. We strive to be world-class in investing in our people and commit to developing you as a professional.

THE ROLE

The Khan Academy Kids team is excited to add a contract Marketing Specialist to our team. Working closely with the Marketing Lead, this role runs the channels where families and teachers discover Khan Academy Kids in support of the launch of our new English language learning product. The Marketing Lead sets overall strategy and priorities. From there, the Marketing Specialist builds the channel-level plans and executes them across app store marketing, consumer digital advertising, and organic social media, and serves as our hands-on analyst for all three. We're looking for someone who is curious about what the numbers are telling them and who finds real joy in getting high-quality learning into the hands of more kids..

Responsibilities:

Working with the Marketing Lead, who sets overall strategy and priorities, you will:

  • Manage app store marketing across the Apple App Store and Google Play, including listing optimization, creative testing, promotional events, and seasonal updates.
  • Run consumer advertising across Apple Ads, Google Ads, and Meta. Build campaigns, manage spending within approved budgets, test audiences and creative, and develop ad materials with the Marketing Lead's review.
  • Run organic social across Instagram, Threads, Facebook, and TikTok, and manage our creator and ambassador programs. Own the publishing calendar, community engagement, and partnerships from outreach through delivery. Create content that sounds like us: our characters, our warmth, and learning that feels like play.
  • Support the US and international launch of our new English language learning product. Coordinate localization of store listings and creative, and adapt campaigns and social content for each market.
  • Own performance reporting across channels and markets, including app store impressions, conversion, and installs. Share regular readouts and recommend where to invest next.
  • Work with Khan Academy Kids' design, content, and product teams and Khan Academy's marketing team to keep messaging consistent. Support website updates, content promotion, and occasional school and district marketing. The role may expand to include lifecycle and family email.
  • Use AI tools responsibly to work faster without sacrificing quality, accuracy, or brand voice.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 4–6 years of digital marketing experience, including hands-on consumer app marketing. You understand app store discovery, install conversion, and the difference between a download and an engaged user.
  • Direct experience with at least two of Apple Ads, Google Ads, or Meta Ads, including writing copy, briefing creative, running campaigns, and reading test results.
  • Experience creating organic social content and managing creator, influencer, or ambassador relationships.
  • Experience adapting marketing for international audiences through localized store listings, creative, or campaigns. You know what it takes to make copy land in a market that isn't your own.
  • Strong analytical skills. You can pull your own numbers, explain what they mean, and turn them into recommendations. Familiarity with GA4, Google Tag Manager, Semrush, or Brandwatch is a plus but not required.
  • Clear communication and strong project management. You can write for families and teachers, present recommendations, and keep multiple channels and collaborators moving without dropping details.
  • Real investment in the mission. You care about making high-quality learning accessible and reaching the kids who need it most. Experience marketing to families, teachers, or in edtech is a plus.
  • Experience using AI responsibly in marketing, with good judgment about where it helps and where a person needs to own the output.

This is a 1 year contract at 40 hours/week for $62/hour.

MORE ABOUT US

  • Sal’s TED talk from 2011
  • Sal’s TED talk from 2015
  • Sal's TED talk from 2023
  • Our team:

OUR COMPANY VALUES

Live & breathe learners

We deeply understand and empathize with our users. We leverage user insights, research, and experience to build content, products, services, and experiences that our users trust and love. Our success is defined by the success of our learners and educators.

Take a stand

As a company, we have conviction in our aspirational point of view of how education will evolve. The work we do is in service to moving towards that point of view. However, we also listen, learn and flex in the face of new data, and commit to evolving this point of view as the industry and our users evolve.

Embrace diverse perspectives

We are a diverse community. We seek out and embrace a diversity of voices, perspectives and life experiences leading to stronger, more inclusive teams and better outcomes. As individuals, we are committed to bringing up tough topics and leaning into different points of view with curiosity. We actively listen, learn and collaborate to gain a shared understanding. When a decision is made, we commit to moving forward as a united team.

Work responsibly and sustainably

We understand that achieving our audacious mission is a marathon, so we set realistic timelines and we focus on delivery that also links to the bigger picture. As a non-profit, we are supported by the generosity of donors as well as strategic partners, and understand our responsibility to our finite resources. We spend every dollar as though it were our own. We are responsible for the impact we have on the world and to each other. We ensure our team and company stay healthy and financially sustainable.

Bring out the joy

We are committed to making learning a joyful process. This informs what we build for our users and the culture we co-create with our teammates, partners and donors.

Cultivate learning mindset

We believe in the power of growth for learners and for ourselves. We constantly learn and teach to improve our offerings, ourselves, and our organization. We learn from our mistakes and aren’t afraid to fail. We don't let past failures or successes stop us from taking future bold action and achieving our goals.

Deliver wow

We insist on high standards and deliver delightful, effective end-to-end experiences that our users can rely on. We choose to focus on fewer things — each of which aligns to our ambitious vision — so we can deliver high-quality experiences that accelerate positive measurable learning with our strategic partners.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or Veteran status. We value diversity, equity, and inclusion, and we encourage candidates from historically underrepresented groups to apply.As part of this commitment, Khan Academy will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations for the hiring process. If reasonable accommodation is needed, please contact

Responsibilities

MemorialCare is a nonprofit integrated health system that includes four leading hospitals, award-winning medical groups – consisting of over 200 sites of care, and more than 2,000 physicians throughout Orange and Los Angeles Counties. We are committed to increasing access to patient-centric, affordable, and high-quality healthcare; your personal contributions are integral to MemorialCare's recognition as a market leader and innovator in value-based and other care models.

Whatever your role and whatever expertise you bring, we are dedicated to helping you achieve your full potential in an environment of respect, innovation, and teamwork.

The Value Improvement Office (VIO) Project Management Office (PMO) division is responsible for a range of activities related to the design, planning, execution, facilitation, implementation, and completion of non-information technology operational projects adhering to timeline, budget, and scope. They oversee all aspects of MemorialCare VOI PMO projects and are responsible for working closely with the project stakeholders, including vendor management. Throughout the course of projects, they assign responsibilities, monitor and report on progress of projects, as well as prepare reports for leadership regarding the status of the project.

The Project Manager provides consulting, scoping analysis, and overall project management related to the organization’s operational initiatives. The role is responsible for utilizing the end-to-end project management process from executive approval through governance, planning, implementation to warm hand off to operations, and post-go-live review. This position works independently with executive leaders, multi-disciplinary teams across the healthcare system, and external stakeholders to manage and successfully implement each project and acts as the point of accountability for delivering large scale, complex, and cross-functional implementations on time and on budget.

  • Manages all phases of assigned projects including initiation, definition and planning, execution, monitoring and cost control, and project close out. Works to identify and define project requirements, scope, and objectives

  • Assists all stakeholders in making sure overall project needs and objectives are understood and executed as projects evolve through the development cycle. Where necessary, applies assertiveness to ensure that the project moves along and that decisions are made in a timely manner.

  • Develops project strategies, defines project schedules, manages resources and equipment, develops plans and reports, and tracks information.

  • Evaluate project performance and setting quality and performance standards

  • Identifies and resolves problems of varying complexity that arise in and outside of the department

  • Conducts root cause analysis of problems and take actions to prevent recurring instances of issues

  • Coordinates and manages project governance requests throughout their lifecycle and ensures proper documentation and communication to all stakeholders.

  • Facilitates project meetings; documents and follows-up on actions and decisions. Records and distributes meeting minutes within a timely manner.

  • Ensures that both client and VIO teams’ needs are met as projects evolve, monitors project progress, handles issues that arise, and communicates regularly on project developments to relevant participants in efforts to maintain overall visibility.

  • Ensures proper communication on assigned tasks, both internally to the Team and externally to stakeholders. Responsible for aligning expectations to clearly define requirements and deliver expected results for assigned project tasks.

  • Creates and maintains documentation, plans, templates, and reports on assigned tasks.

  • Helps prepare project proposals, timeframes, and schedule, breaking projects out into measurable milestones.

  • Monitors and reports on progress against established project milestones related to working hours, plans, and expenditures, utilizing MemorialCare provided tools. Analyzes risks, as well as opportunities and areas for improvement and reports project outcomes and/or escalates risks to appropriate individuals

*Placement in the pay range is based on multiple factors including, but not limited to, relevant years of experience and qualifications. In addition to base pay, there may be additional compensation available for this role, including but not limited to, shift differentials, extra shift incentives, and bonus opportunities. Health and wellness is our passion at MemorialCare—that includes taking good care of employees and their dependents. We offer high quality health insurance plan options, so you can select the best choice for your family. And there’s more...Check out our MemorialCare Benefits for more information about our Benefits and Rewards.

  • Demonstrated understanding of key areas of the healthcare business

  • Understanding and application of Lean, process improvement discipline

  • Demonstrated high energy levels and tolerance of tight deadlines, time pressures, and ambiguity

  • Past success leading project with multiple business stakeholders, technical resources, and third parties for solutions

  • Proven knowledge of PCs, collaborative computing tools, re-engineering and process improvement techniques, information management in healthcare, systems integration, and basic project finance regulations

  • Experienced in leading projects, providing expert consultative guidance and direction on change initiatives, effectively dedicating time across more than one project, and meeting established deadlines

  • Proven ability to prepare and interpret flowcharts, schedules, and step-by-step action plans

  • Demonstrated proficiency with the Microsoft Suite Products required

  • Demonstrated analytical, creative thinking, and problem-solving skills

  • Proven superior oral and written communication and presentation skills; able to interact with individuals across all departments

  • Experienced exercising good judgment in fast-paced, high-pressure work environment, with competing priorities

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant healthcare experience required

  • Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent PMI recognized certification preferred

  • Lean Certification preferred

Must exhibit a deep understanding of modern technology stack and agile delivery models, demonstrated focus on customer experience, and must have a proven track record of modernizing technologies.

Close collaboration and alignment with business teams, application development teams and security will be required. As such, exceptional abilities in building and maintaining strong working relationships and organizational savvy will be required. High level communication and presentation skills are required. Ability to attract, retain, and develop engineering talent will be critical.

jobs.description:
Présentation de Soitec et contexte du poste

Soitec est une société cotée à l'indice SBF 120 de la Bourse de Paris qui intervient en amont de la chaîne de valeur de la microélectronique. Nos matériaux semi-conducteurs innovants sont indispensables au fonctionnement des smartphones et au déploiement de la 5G. Ils offrent également de nombreuses opportunités pour l’automobile connectée, les véhicules électriques et autonomes et l’intelligence embarquée dans les objets connectés.

Cette place nous confère une incroyable responsabilité, qui nous inspire au quotidien : rendre possible l’adoption massive d’innovations technologiques tout en limitant considérablement leur impact environnemental, dans une logique d’innovation responsable et de développement durable.

En quoi consiste le job?

Sous la responsabilité du manager “Reporting & Data Analysis” , vous intégrerez une équipe motivée et hautement spécialisée dans le Reporting et la Data Analysis”. Vos missions seront :

  • Accompagner les utilisateurs métier à rédiger des cahiers des charges

  • Proposer des solutions techniques avec le support des experts IT, dans le respect des guidelines de l’entreprise et des best practices techniques

  • Designer les modèles de données du DataWareHouse et des Datasets métier

  • Développer (SQL, Talend, PowerBI, Python) et tester

  • Mettre en oeuvre l’intégration continue et le déploiement continu (Git)

  • Mettre à jour la documentation (spécification, exploitation)

  • Supporter les utilisateurs : prise en charge des incidents niveau 3 et des demandes d’évolution

  • Interagir avec les développeurs du Centre de Service DATA : valider leur travail (spécification, revue de la qualité du code, recette IT) et faciliter l’interface avec nos clients internes sur les phases de spécifications, réception et accompagnement à l’utilisation des nouveaux outils.

Votre temps de travail se partage entre des activités de RUN (support, change) et des activités projet pour réaliser la roadmap du service, toujours en très forte interaction avec des utilisateurs et dans le souci de répondre au mieux aux besoins métier.

Vous serez accompagnés dans votre mission :

  • par des experts techniques internes ou externes (architectes, spécialistes de solutions techniques)

  • par un Centre de Service, en première ligne pour la résolution des incidents, la réalisation des changements et la prise en charge des nouveaux projets.

Position Description

We are looking for a talented and experienced Node JS AI Engineer to join our team in LATAM.

You will build the agent at the core of the intake system: the component that reads messy construction documents and returns structured project fields, each with its source, quote and confidence. You will own extraction quality end to end, from prompts and page-handling strategy to the evaluations that prove the agent is accurate enough for designers to trust. The agent reads and reports; deterministic backend code decides. Keeping that boundary clean is central to the role.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Design and build the agent that inventories project folders, locates the relevant sheets (reflected ceiling plans, sections, legends, specifications), reads text where it exists and renders page regions as images when needed.
  • Implement extraction of project fields with file, page, region, exact quote and confidence, validated against a fixed output schema.
  • Detect and report contradictions between emails and documents, and within a single document, without choosing a value silently.
  • Handle large packages (up to 1,500 pages), scanned PDFs and non-scale drawings, controlling cost with per-session caps and re-reading only changed files.
  • Write and iterate prompts and tool definitions (for example sync_drive) and configure the agent platform, Managed Agents or Deep Agents with a sandbox.
  • Build the evaluation harness in LangSmith: datasets from real projects, citation checks, accuracy thresholds, and model comparisons on accuracy and cost.
  • Apply defenses against prompt injection from external content: no credentials in the sandbox, restricted network, links only from the thread.
  • Work with the Backend Engineer on the contract between the agent and the rules engine, and with designers to turn their corrections into new evaluation cases

Workplace: Remote role open to candidates based in LATAM

Must Have Skills:

  • 6+ years of software engineering experience, with 2+ years building production LLM or agent-based systems.
  • Strong TypeScript and Node.js; working knowledge of Python for document processing in sandboxes.
  • Hands-on experience with LangGraph, Deep Agents, the Anthropic SDK or comparable agent frameworks, including tool use and structured outputs.
  • Proven experience extracting information from unstructured or poor-quality documents (scans, drawings, PDFs with inconsistent structure), including vision-based reading.
  • Experience designing evaluations for LLM systems: datasets, metrics, regression checks, and measuring hallucination or unsupported answers.
  • Solid understanding of prompt injection risks and of agent safety design.
  • Ability to explain model limitations plainly to non-technical stakeholders

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience with construction, architectural, engineering or other drawing-heavy documents.
  • Experience with PDF and OCR tooling, and with Gmail and Google Drive APIs.
  • Experience with LangSmith, Claude Managed Agents, or sandbox platforms such as Daytona.
  • Experience building human-in-the-loop review workflows and deciding when automation can act without review

Professional Skills:

  • Strong, professional English verbal and written communication skills
  • Effective team and individual player
  • Maintains composure during all types of situations and is collaborative by nature
  • High standards of professionalism, consistently producing high quality results
  • Self-sufficient, independent requiring very little supervision or intervention
  • Demonstrate flexibility and openness to bring creative solutions to address issues

This role is ideal for a QA professional with strong hands-on contact center and telephony testing experience who can independently understand complex business flows, translate technical design artifacts into comprehensive test scenarios, coordinate across multiple stakeholders, and drive testing through release readiness.

Key Responsibilities

Amazon Connect, IVR & Telephony Testing

AWS, API & Salesforce Integration Testing

  • Test Salesforce Service Cloud Voice (SCV) integrations including CTI controls, Omni-Channel, screen pops, Voice Call records, agent states and real-time transcription.

Chat, AI & Omnichannel Testing

  • Lead defect triage and track issues through closure with clear evidence, logs, recordings and reproduction steps.

Automation & Performance Testing

  • Support API, voice and chat test automation and CI/CD-based continuous testing.
  • Experience planning and executing load/performance testing using JMeter, LoadRunner, NeoLoad or equivalent tools is desirable.

Must-Have Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of overall QA/testing experience, including 3+ years in contact center, CTI, IVR, telephony or cloud contact center platforms.
  • Strong hands-on Amazon Connect testing experience, preferably with complex IVR and self-service implementations.
  • Proven ability to read Lucidchart/Visio IVR designs and independently convert them into comprehensive functional test scripts.

  • Hands-on experience with Amazon Connect Admin workspace and AWS Console, including Lambda, DynamoDB, S3, Lex and Contact Flows.
  • Experience testing Amazon Connect Agent/Supervisor workspace and Chat.
  • Experience with Amazon Q in Connect, Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Lex or other conversational/Generative AI platforms.
  • Strong API and integration testing experience using Postman, SoapUI, REST-assured or equivalent.
  • Experience with Salesforce Service Cloud Voice / CTI / Omni-Channel is highly desirable.
  • Strong test planning, test case design, regression testing, defect management and release readiness experience.
  • Experience with Jira, qTest, QMetry, TestRail, Zephyr or equivalent test management tools.

Good-to-Have

  • Experience with Cyara, Empirix Hammer or other IVR automation tools.
  • Load, performance and/or security testing experience.
  • Experience validating Generative AI quality, hallucinations, grounding and guardrails.
  • Salesforce SOQL/reporting, Amazon Connect metrics, Contact Lens and CloudWatch experience.
  • Multi-language IVR/chat testing.
  • Experience with Genesys, Cisco, Avaya, Twilio or other contact center platforms.

What You'll Bring

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a quality engineering mindset.
  • Ability to work independently in complex, multi-vendor consulting environments.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to identify gaps in requirements, test data, integrations and E2E business processes.
  • Ability to clearly communicate quality risks and provide data-driven release readiness recommendations.

1. Tender pipeline, procurement outreach and qualification (25%)

  • Own the forward tender calendar for both markets, drawing on portal monitoring, market intelligence, regional owner input and lead generation research.
  • Keep every known RFP in Salesforce to the agreed convention: expected RFP and award dates, potential ACV, incumbent, buyer and procurement stakeholders, pre-tender activity and capacity need. Close dates are set six months after RFP documentation is received, and weighting is derived from observed entry and win rates.
  • Prepare a short summary for every opportunity covering scope, value, timeline, buyer, incumbent, competitors and fit, to support bid/no-bid decisions.
  • Engage early with the commercial owner to shape opportunities before RFP release, and forecast bid capacity against the pipeline.
  • Monitor UK and Irish procurement portals, frameworks and tender alert services daily (currently Stotles). Track contract expiry dates, incumbents and pre-market engagement notices to spot opportunities before they are published, and keep Spectrum.Life registered on the relevant supplier portals and frameworks.
  • Build relationships with procurement teams through supplier events and market engagement days, and respond to pre-market questionnaires.
  • Pass qualified leads and buyer insight to the commercial owner and the lead generation team.

2. Bid writing and leadership (30%)

  • Lead bids end to end: requirements, compliance matrix, response plan, win themes, expert allocation, timetable and drafts. Agree the plan for each strategic bid with the Head of Growth Operations, who provides support and escalation.
  • Write and edit responses directly, particularly the highest-scoring and most bespoke sections. Use the Tender Engine for first drafts and checking where it saves time, so every submission combines hands-on writing, AI-assisted drafting and human judgement on the final answer.
  • Manage portal registrations, clarification questions and final uploads for every submission.
  • Run readiness reviews before submission that test compliance, consistency, evaluation weighting, likely competitive position and intelligence gaps, then prioritise the fixes.
  • Coordinate pricing, legal, product, clinical, security and implementation input into one submission.
  • Keep social value commitments consistent across submissions, and make sure every bid follows the procurement rules that apply, including the Procurement Act 2023 in the UK and Irish public procurement rules.
  • Apply a human quality check to every final submission, including that content moved from AI-assisted drafts into the buyer's format (for example Excel) has not been truncated.

3. Tender Engine, content library and reseller partner governance (30%)

  • Own the UK and Ireland and Australian Tender Engines, with input from subject matter experts. Keep a curated source architecture of corporate information, strongest-scoring submissions, win themes and the skills and tools that generate and evaluate responses, rather than an archive of every historical tender.
  • Improve instructions, prompts and skills, evaluate generated answers against scoring criteria, set the human QA standard, and track time saved and response quality.
  • Maintain the bid process: folder structure, bid summaries, qualification scoring, drafting workbooks, review gates, templates and the links to contract terms review and pricing governance. Pricing decisions stay with pricing governance, and any discount or non-standard term needs Chief Commercial Officer sign-off before it appears in a submission.
  • Own the tender content library that the Tender Engine draws on: approved answers, outcomes and case studies, clinical and product evidence, security, privacy and AI governance responses, implementation material, references and certificates, with Australian variants. Proposition development stays with Marketing, and the role makes sure what goes into a bid is current and approved.
  • Give every library item an owner, a review date and an approval trail. The Chief Clinical Officer signs off clinical and outcome claims, and contracts and legal clear client names and client-derived data before use.
Tender management under the reseller partner model. Spectrum.Life reaches corporate buyers through reseller partners. Where those partners respond to tenders, the role sets up and governs the route as part of the Tender Engine:
  • Build and maintain a partner content pack for each partner: approved bid materials, certificates, decks, templates and tools, so that standard and SME tenders are answered without repeated requests back to Spectrum.Life.
  • Define which tenders each partner handles alone and which come to Spectrum.Life, with escalation criteria and turnaround times.
  • Set what partners may say: approved claims only, agreed pricing frameworks and our data governance positions, including aggregate-only reporting and Australian data hosting.
  • Keep partners on the current approved version, and train their account managers.
  • Track partner-led tenders in a register with result and feedback, and feed the learning into the pipeline, the library and the quarterly review.

4. Win/loss analysis and continuous improvement (10%)

  • Run a retrospective on every material tender: result, competitor, scores, evaluator feedback, price position, requirement and proposition gaps, strongest and weakest response areas, process issues and reusable learning. Record winning bidder and bidder score on closed-lost RFPs in Salesforce.
  • Publish a monthly tender performance dashboard and a quarterly Tender Win/Loss Review for Commercial, Marketing and Product.
  • Turn patterns into action on pricing architecture, proposition scope, references, local evidence and pre-tender engagement, working with the Head of Growth Operations on priorities.

5. Training, enablement and cross-market coordination (5%)

  • Train commercial colleagues in both markets on the Tender Engine, standards and templates, so that small and repeat tenders run through self-service.
  • Share best practice, reusable content and lessons learned with colleagues in Australia and other markets, and keep templates and ways of working consistent across markets.

Key relationships

Head of Growth Operations

Line manager. Sets priorities and bid capacity, supports strategic bids and receives the monthly tender dashboard.

Chief Commercial Officer

Escalation on strategic bids and sign-off on non-standard terms.

Deal owners and market leads

The role runs the tender route, and the deal owner owns the relationship and deal strategy.

Head of Lead Generation

Alignment on market intelligence, incumbent positions and upcoming RFPs.

Marketing

Proposition messaging and collateral used in bids. Tender feedback and competitive intelligence go back to Marketing.

Sales Operations

Salesforce fields, RFP staging and weighting, and the tender dashboard.

Commercial Finance

Pricing frameworks, margin and approval routing.

Clinical, Product, Technology and Privacy

Approved evidence, capability, integration, security, data and AI governance responses.

Contracts and legal

Contract terms review, client naming and use of client-derived data.

Implementation

Mobilisation model and delivery feasibility, particularly in Australia.

Reseller partners

Content packs, escalation of non-standard tenders and partner tender results.

Measures of success

Baselines and targets to be agreed.

Pipeline

  • Tender pipeline value identified and coverage
  • Share of opportunities identified before RFP release
  • Opportunity summaries ready in time for bid/no-bid decisions

Conversion

  • Tender win rate by count and by value, including strategic tenders
  • ACV won through tenders

Quality and efficiency

  • Time from RFP receipt to first complete draft
  • Post-submission errors, including truncation and compliance misses
  • Time saved per bid through the Tender Engine

Content governance

  • Share of library items and partner content packs within their review date

Reseller partners

  • Share of partner tenders handled without escalation, and partner tender win rate

Learning

  • Share of material tenders with a retrospective completed within 30 days of the result
  • Monthly dashboard and quarterly review delivered on schedule

If you want to help build the next era of lending, we’d love to meet you.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Analyst, Portfolio Management to join our growing team! As Senior Analyst, Portfolio Management, you'll support our mortgage loan servicing oversight function with the analysis, reporting, and day-to-day monitoring that keep servicing efficient, compliant, and effective at reducing delinquency and losses. You'll work closely with Portfolio Management leadership to evaluate loss mitigation and default strategies, track how customers in financial hardship are engaged, and refine programs that put borrowers on a long-term path to cure. You'll also keep our data, processes, and systems aligned so key stakeholders (Customer, Company, and Investors) get clear, accurate visibility into portfolio performance. If you want to turn servicing data into decisions that cut delinquency and are ready to own the numbers, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

  • Support the servicing operations team on portfolio oversight and strategic initiatives across our internal Servicing organization and Sub-Servicing partners
  • Gather, analyze, and monitor data to carry out and improve collections strategies that balance customer experience with recovery goals, reduce delinquency rates, and maximize recoveries
  • Track key performance indicators (KPIs), spot trends, and prepare analysis that informs decisions and operational improvements for internal Servicing and Sub-Servicing partners
  • Reconcile servicing transfer reports and investigate data inaccuracies or discrepancies
  • Support data alignment and validation with sub-servicers as part of portfolio oversight
  • Monitor sub-servicer performance and service-level adherence, and prepare materials for partner reviews
  • Work with Capital Markets, Credit, Risk Management, Finance, and Legal teams to research and resolve servicing and collections issues
  • Identify and document risks related to loan servicing and collections, and help develop mitigation recommendations

Agility Robotics is defining the future of humanoid robotics by designing and building intelligent, commercially deployable systems that integrate advanced AI, robotics, and real-world automation at global scale. Reporting directly to the President and partnering closely with Commercial, Product, Operations, and senior leadership, this role will be responsible for building strategic relationships and developing new business opportunities that strengthen Agility’s position in the humanoid robotics market.

This is a highly visible role for a commercial leader who can move fluidly between strategy and execution—identifying opportunities, developing relationships with senior external stakeholders, structuring partnerships, and turning emerging opportunities into scalable business outcomes.

The ideal candidate combines strong commercial judgment with strategic rigor, technical curiosity, and the ability to navigate complex, long-term business development cycles within emerging technology markets.

The Mission

Build and advance the partnerships, customer opportunities, and commercial pathways that establish Agility Robotics as the global leader in humanoid robotics.

jobs.excerpt: POSITION OVERVIEW The Lien Resolution Team Lead runs the function that determines how much of every settlement actually reaches our clients.
jobs.description:
POSITION OVERVIEW

The Lien Resolution Team Lead runs the function that determines how much of every settlement actually reaches our clients. You will supervise a team of reductions and lien resolution specialists, personally handle the largest and most complex lien files, and own the metrics that measure our performance — aggregate reduction rate, net-to-client percentage, and time from settlement to disbursement.

This is a negotiation role with a management layer on top. Every dollar your team takes off a medical balance, a hospital lien, or a health plan’s subrogation claim is a dollar that goes to an injured client instead. You will set the standard for how hard those negotiations are pushed, hold the team to it, and step in personally when a provider or plan will not move.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Post-settlement medical bill and liens
  • Lead the team. Supervise, train, and evaluate a team of reductions and lien resolution specialists. Assign files, manage workload distribution, run regular file reviews, and develop the team’s negotiation skills.
  • Own the numbers. Track and report aggregate reduction percentage, dollars saved, aging, and settlement-to-disbursement turnaround. Identify where the team is leaving money on the table and fix it.
  • Negotiate the hard files. Personally handle high-balance, high-complexity, and escalated reductions where the provider or plan has refused to move at the specialist level.
  • Resolve statutory and plan liens. Direct the resolution of Medicare conditional payments and Medicare Secondary Payer obligations, Florida Medicaid (AHCA) claims under Fla. Stat. § 409.910 including the administrative challenge process, ERISA and self-funded plan reimbursement claims, TRICARE and VA claims, and hospital and provider liens under applicable county ordinances.
  • Manage letter of protection balances. Negotiate LOP balances with treating providers and maintain documentation consistent with Fla. Stat. § 768.0427 disclosure requirements.
  • Apply the collateral source framework. Analyze health insurance payments, PIP benefits, and other collateral sources under Fla. Stat. § 768.76 to establish the correct reimbursement exposure before negotiating.
  • Build provider relationships. Establish and maintain working relationships and, where appropriate, standing reduction arrangements with high-volume providers, facilities, and lien resolution vendors.
  • Partner with the attorneys. Give trial and pre-suit attorneys accurate, timely lien exposure figures so they can evaluate settlement authority and advise clients on net recovery.
  • Protect the client experience. Ensure clients understand their closing statement and that disbursement is accurate, documented, and prompt.
  • Improve the process. Standardize templates, escalation paths, and negotiation playbooks; recommend and help implement case management system and workflow improvements.
  • Maintain compliance. Ensure every file satisfies trust accounting, Florida Bar, and firm documentation requirements before funds are released.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Minimum of four (4) years of experience in medical lien resolution, reductions, or settlement negotiation at a personal injury firm, lien resolution company, or healthcare recovery vendor.
  • Minimum of 5 people managed in past roles (direct or indirect reports)
  • Demonstrated track record of negotiating meaningful reductions on medical balances and liens, with the numbers to support it.
  • Working knowledge of Medicare Secondary Payer rules and conditional payment resolution.
  • Working knowledge of Florida Medicaid third-party recovery and the AHCA lien process.
  • Familiarity with ERISA plan reimbursement claims and the practical difference between self-funded and fully insured plans.
  • Understanding of Florida PIP and the collateral source framework as it affects reimbursement exposure.
  • Strong command of settlement math — gross to net, attorney fees and costs, pro rata allocation, and common fund and made-whole considerations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; able to be firm with providers and plainspoken with clients.
  • Proficiency with legal case management software and spreadsheets.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bilingual English/Spanish, spoken and written.
  • Experience at a high-volume Florida plaintiff personal injury firm.
  • Experience negotiating with hospital systems and large provider groups in the South Florida market.
  • Paralegal certificate, or a bachelor’s degree in a related field.
  • Experience building or refining a reductions workflow from the ground up.
  • Familiarity with Medicare Set-Aside considerations in third-party liability settlements.

LOCATION

Work remotely 5 days a week.

JOIN OUR TEAM

At The Ward Law Group, every role contributes to changing lives.

If you're looking for an opportunity to grow your litigation career, maximize client recoveries, and work alongside a high-performing legal team, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and become part of a team committed to excellence, accountability, and changing lives—one client at a time.

Changing Lives. One Client at a Time

Recognized as one of the Best Places to Work for consecutive years, we are committed to delivering exceptional legal representation while creating an environment where talented professionals can grow, lead, and make a meaningful impact every day.

jobs.title: Senior OutSystems Developer
jobs.excerpt: There are NO limits to your career: come shape the future and be part of a truly unique global culture at OutSystems!
jobs.description:
There are NO limits to your career: come shape the future and be part of a truly unique global culture at OutSystems!

About the OutSystems Digital Team

We are the digital backbone of OutSystems' growth — building the enterprise applications, integrations, and digital products that run the company's operations and accelerate it into the AI-powered era. We work in small, high-autonomy teams of two to five people, each with a clear mission and the authority to ship. We take both craft and speed seriously, and we expect the people who join us to do the same.

The Role

You will join an existing team and take ownership of features and integrations across a portfolio of live, mission-critical OutSystems products and SaaS, while dedicating most of your focus to building new capabilities that did not exist before.

The balance we aim for is roughly seventy percent innovation — new applications, new integrations, new capabilities — and thirty percent maintaining and evolving what is already running. That split is a principle, not a rigid rule: when a live system needs attention, you give it. What stays constant is that you own your output end to end, whether it is new or existing.

As a senior engineer, you are trusted to take a problem from a rough brief to a correct, production-ready solution with little supervision — and to raise the bar for the developers working alongside you.

What You Will Own

  • Solution design and delivery — you take responsibility for the architecture of your own work, execute it, and support it in production, within the guidelines the Tech Lead sets for the team.

  • Features and integrations that ship to production — real users, real consequences, and your name on them; from build through unit and integration testing to the bug fixing that makes them solid.

  • Integrations with external systems — connecting OutSystems applications to the wider ecosystem according to the defined architecture guidelines, with attention to correctness and error handling under real conditions.

  • Your share of the existing portfolio — understanding the applications the team maintains well enough to extend them without accumulating hidden debt, and knowing when something needs escalating.

  • Quality before it merges — you develop and apply the instinct to distinguish code that is correct from code that merely looks plausible, before anything reaches production.

  • Shared context that makes the team faster — documenting decisions and patterns, and helping the more junior developers grow through review and example.

The Behaviours We Are Looking For

We care about how you work as much as what you already know. This is what we are actually evaluating:

  • You own what you ship. You do not hand something off and move on. You care whether it works in production, whether it holds under load, and whether it solves the actual problem — including in systems you inherited rather than built.

  • You distinguish correct from plausible. You have enough experience to know that output which looks right is not always right, and you apply that judgment before anything ships.

  • You deliver with quality and to the timeline. You organise, estimate, and prioritise your own work, and you finish what you take on to a standard you would be happy to defend.

  • You find a way around walls. When you hit a blocker, you try before you ask. When you do ask, you arrive with what you have already tried and ruled out.

  • You share context generously. In a small team, what you know is a shared asset. You document, you flag assumptions, you explain your reasoning, and you help the people around you get better.

  • You are honest about what you do not know. You surface uncertainty rather than hiding it behind confident-sounding output.

  • You use AI to work faster and better. You reach for it by default and you try the new tool rather than waiting to see if it sticks.

  • You solve the business problem with whatever fits. You stay curious beyond OutSystems and explore other technologies when they're the better answer.

Experience

We can teach OutSystems. We're hiring for how you think. Read the list below as a floor, not a wish list.

  • At least 4 years of software development experience, with a minimum of 2 years building on OutSystems (required)

  • Hands-on OutSystems experience, ODC and/or O11. Deep platform expertise is welcome — but so is a strong engineer from an adjacent stack who ramps fast. We'd rather teach the platform than teach curiosity. (required)

  • Strong backend and integration fundamentals: REST APIs, JSON, authentication patterns, and error handling under real conditions (required)

  • Solid grasp of solution architecture and application performance, with the ability to estimate and prioritise your own delivery (required)

  • Experience with unit and integration testing and the bug fixing that follows (required)

  • Active use of AI-augmented development — Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Mentor, or similar — as a core part of how you build, not an occasional shortcut (required)

  • Fluency in English, written and spoken (required)

  • Degree in Computer Science or Engineering

Bonus

  • Experience integrating LLMs via API into enterprise applications

  • Experience programming with databases — SQL Server, Oracle, or MySQL — and knowledge of database modeling

  • Integration knowledge using AWS or Azure-based services

  • OutSystems certifications

  • Prior experience in small, high-autonomy teams where every person's output is visible and tested daily

This Is Not For You If...

  • You hand work off and move on rather than owning it through to production

  • Ambiguity stalls you — you need complete requirements before you can start

  • You consider maintaining and evolving existing systems to be below your level

  • You keep what you learn to yourself rather than helping the team improve

  • You treat asking for help as the first response to a problem, not the third

  • You've stopped being curious about technology outside your own stack

Growth Path

High performers in this role move toward technical leadership — the Tech Lead track — or into specialist ownership of a domain or a body of the portfolio. You’ll have a chance to engage with people who have made that move.

Why Join

You will build and maintain production-grade OutSystems applications that people across the company depend on, with the autonomy to take real problems from brief to production. You will work alongside people who set a high bar and expect you to raise it, and you will develop skills — from integration and solution design to AI-augmented development — that compound quickly in a small, high-trust team. You'll be encouraged to explore beyond OutSystems and bring the best of what you find back to the team.

[ OutSystems ODC ] [ OutSystems O11 ] [ Backend ] [ Integrations ] [ Solution Design ] [ Production Mindset ] [ AI-Augmented Development ]

More about OutSystems

OutSystems is a leading AI Development Platform built for the enterprise. Global organizations trust OutSystems to rapidly build mission-critical apps and agents, modernize legacy processes with agentic systems, and govern their entire AI portfolio across complex regulatory environments, all on one unified platform.

As the future becomes agentic, our customers need us now more than ever. While AI has opened the door to extraordinary possibilities, most large organizations find themselves stuck on one side of the "enterprise gap" because AI by itself doesn't solve their complex use cases and business challenges. OutSystems bridges the "enterprise gap" by combining the speed of generative AI with a deterministic, enterprise-grade framework. We provide the tools for teams of any size to deliver high-quality, reliable AI solutions that drive real business impact.

We are looking for passionate, talented, and motivated people to join us as we empower organizations to build, deploy, and scale the next generation of enterprise software. While we are leading the charge into the agentic era, our mission is broader: we are the platform enterprise leaders trust to evolve their entire business, accelerating innovation through secure, governed human-AI collaboration.

OutSystems is a global company, with more than 900k developer community members, 1,700 employees, more than 600 partners, and thousands of active customers in over 75 countries and across 21 industries. Founded in 2001, OutSystems now has offices in the United States, United Kingdom, the Netherlands, Portugal, Germany, the UAE, Japan, Hong Kong, Malaysia, Australia, India, and Singapore, and includes a thriving, worldwide community of remote employees.

Our customers are some of the world's most recognizable brands across diverse industries— such as Toyota, Heineken, Bosch, KeyBank, and UCLA—who trust OutSystems to deliver ROI and transformational impact.

Consistently recognized as a leader by top analyst firms Gartner, IDC and Forrester, OutSystems continues to shape the future of enterprise software development in the agentic era. We are proud to be named a leader in more than 100 categories on G2, including #1 in Customer Satisfaction in Enterprise Low Code Development, and most recently as a leader in AI Agent Building in the G2 Spring 2026 Reports.

Working at OutSystems

Our culture is built on our core values of Trust, Customer Success, Innovation, and Alignment. We operate as one global OutSystems team, taking ownership to pursue our vision of being the AI platform enterprise leaders trust to build, secure, and evolve their most critical applications and systems.

What do we have to offer you?

  • A company at the vanguard of the agentic revolution, where we don’t just react to AI innovation—we architect it. Joining OutSystems means stepping onto a high-growth rocket ship that combines the fearless agility of a startup with the sophisticated, global foundation of an enterprise powerhouse.

  • Real growth opportunities. We don't just talk about development; we invest in it through structured programs designed to scale your expertise. Whether you are aiming for vertical progression, exploring lateral moves into new domains, or mastering specialized AI skills through our Professional Development Fund and Internal Mobility Program, we provide the resources to get you there.

  • A global collective of world-class talent, where you’ll collaborate with enterprise software legends and sought-after thought leaders. At OutSystems, our industry experts aren't just visionaries—they are accessible, approachable mentors who are deeply invested in your growth as we architect the agentic future together.

OutSystems nurtures an inclusive culture where talented individuals from all backgrounds are empowered to learn, experiment and make an impact. . We believe that driving our next phase of growth requires the radical creativity that only comes from diverse perspectives. We are committed to building a team as global and diverse as the organizations we serve, ensuring every individual can perform to their full potential. As an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants receive equal consideration regardless of race, origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status.

jobs.description:
Drive Innovation as our Next Data Platform Engineer - Data Infrastructure & Services


Ready to participate in building and evolving our next-generation Transportation & Logistics data platform on Google Cloud Platform (GCP)? This role combines cloud engineering, data pipelines, and software engineering with a default focus on automation, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), operational resilience, and corporate governance.

What Makes This Role Interesting:

The Data Platform Engineer – Generalist operates as an AI-augmented builder who decides, designs, and fixes across our cloud infrastructure, platform tooling, and data engineering layers.

Recognizing that no single engineer can be a deep expert across every layer of the modern data stack, this role uses AI tools by reflex to deliver end-to-end capabilities with minimal handoffs or coordination overhead. Operating in a lean Platform Engineering pod, you will bring strong core capabilities while maintaining the breadth required to support our ongoing platform migration from AWS and Azure to GCP, build data workflows, and collaborate closely with lead data engineers.

Your Key Responsibilities:

  • Decide, Design, & Ship End-to-End: Own platform outcomes from intent through to production. Prefer direct iteration (think → build → validate) over cross-role handoffs, pulling in specialists only when risk or complexity truly justifies it.
  • Engineer Infrastructure as Code: Design, provision, configure, and evolve cloud environments using version-controlled, reusable IaC modules (Terraform) and automated CI/CD deployment pipelines.
  • Support Multi-Cloud Migration: Assist in migrating legacy workloads, storage layers, and pipelines from AWS and Azure into our unified GCP platform.
  • Build Data Platform Capabilities: Support the design, deployment, and optimization of data primitives, analytics platforms, and pipeline orchestration (batch and streaming).
  • Embed Governance & Guardrails: Translate corporate security, privacy, compliance, and risk requirements into automated technical guardrails (IAM, network controls, secrets management, data classification, and encryption).
  • Maintain Auditability & Telemetry: Treat observability, technical documentation, decision records (ADRs), deployment evidence, and runbooks as core elements of the product—ensuring all services are observable and safe to operate.
  • Leverage AI by Reflex: Integrate AI coding assistants and LLM workflows into daily platform operations to accelerate automation, troubleshooting, documentation, and code reviews across multiple technical domains.
  • Cost & Capacity Stewardship: Manage cloud spend responsibly through labeling standards, capacity monitoring, cost-control policies, and lifecycle practices.


Production-Ready Delivery Standards ("Definition of Done"):

  • IaC & CI/CD Managed: Infrastructure fully defined in version-controlled IaC with peer review and automated CI/CD pipeline deployment.
  • Observability & Recovery: Monitoring, alerting, logging, and telemetry active prior to release, alongside defined and tested rollback paths.
  • Operational Readiness: Updated runbooks for anything that could create an incident or page someone off-hours.
  • Governance Compliance: Verified alignment with security, data privacy, architecture, and corporate risk controls.

Your Essential Skills & Experience:

  • Engineering Generalism: Ability to read, reason about, and debug code, data pipelines, and infrastructure across multiple layers of the stack—using AI to execute beyond your primary area of expertise while critically validating output for safety and performance.
  • Cloud & Platform Engineering: Solid foundational knowledge of cloud primitives (AWS, Azure, or GCP), with hands-on capability or strong willingness to specialize in GCP. Hands-on experience with declarative IaC tools (e.g., Terraform), state management, and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions).
  • Data Engineering Fundamentals: Working knowledge of modern data stack primitives and tooling (e.g., BigQuery/Redshift, Airflow/Cloud Composer, Pub/Sub/Kafka, Dataflow or dbt).
  • AI & Operational Excellence: Uses AI tools by default to accelerate delivery and solve complex platform issues. Applies critical judgment to identify plausible-but-wrong AI outputs.
  • Systems Thinking & Pragmatic Judgment: Defaults to the simplest solution that satisfies operational needs. Exercises sound judgment on when to iterate independently vs. when to escalate critical security, privacy, or long-term architecture decisions.
  • The ideal candidate is a pragmatic, self-directed builder who views testing, IaC, observability, documentation, and governance as part of the core product rather than administrative overhead. They combine broad technical curiosity with operational discipline, leveraging modern AI workflows to bridge domain gaps, eliminate delivery friction, and keep platform services resilient and cost-effective.

About Us:

Trimble is a global technology company that connects the physical and digital worlds, transforming the ways work gets done. With relentless innovation in precise positioning, modeling and data analytics, Trimble enables essential industries including construction, geospatial and transportation. Whether it's helping customers build and maintain infrastructure, design and construct buildings, optimize global supply chains or map the world, Trimble is at the forefront, driving productivity and progress.


T&L: In the Transportation & Logistics segment, our solutions make it safer, simpler and more efficient to move freight—bringing together a global network of shippers, carriers, brokers and 3PLs.

Why You'll Enjoy Working With Us:

  • At Trimble, we're not just a company that "does good"—we are a team dedicated to making a tangible, positive Real-World Impact. We build innovative solutions designed to solve the world's most critical challenges. From construction sites to transportation hubs, our work tangibly improves how people live, build, move, and grow.

  • You'll work on projects that truly matter: Our purpose-driven culture means you'll be helping to build and deliver solutions that make work faster, safer, and more sustainable for millions of people worldwide. Our impact is tangible, from connected machines that save fuel to data-driven insights that reduce waste.
  • Collaborate with like-minded people: Our strong internal culture is a "hidden gem." You will work with a collaborative, supportive team that shares your purpose and fosters a genuine sense of belonging. We're a company of "visionary pragmatists" who think boldly and build things that work.
  • Be an owner: Trimble thrives on individuals who take initiative and embrace ownership. You'll find an entrepreneurial spirit where success is often "self-authored," empowering proactive "doers."

Data Platform Engineer, Data Engineer, Software Engineer, DevOps, Generalist, Python, SQL, dbt, BigQuery, GCP, AWS, Airflow, Kafka, Agentic AI, Terraform, Transportation and Logistics


How to Apply: Please submit an online application for this position by clicking on the ‘Apply Now’ button located in this posting.

Join a Values-Driven Team: Belong, Grow, Innovate.

At Trimble, our core values of Belong, Grow, and Innovate aren't just words—they're the foundation of our culture. We foster an environment where you are seen, heard, and valued (Belong); where you have an opportunity to build a career and drive our collective growth (Grow); and where your innovative ideas shape the future (Innovate). jobs.description:
Productiv Team is hiring an experienced Tax Preparer to prepare federal and state returns for S corporations, partnerships, C corporations and tax-exempt organizations. You will own returns from source documents through review-ready workpapers, working closely with reviewers, partners and clients.

Key Responsibilities

Business returns
  • Prepare federal and multi-state income tax returns for S corporations (Form 1120-S), partnerships and LLCs (Form 1065) and C corporations (Form 1120), including Schedules K-1, K-2/K-3, M-1/M-3 and L.
  • Compute book-to-tax adjustments, depreciation and amortization (including Section 179 and bonus), and track shareholder basis, partner capital accounts and at-risk limits.
  • Prepare state and local returns, apportionment schedules, composite returns and pass-through entity tax (PTET) elections.
  • Prepare quarterly estimated tax payments, extensions and year-end tax projections.


Tax-exempt returns
  • Prepare Form 990, 990-EZ, 990-N and 990-PF returns, plus related schedules (A, B, D, G, L, O and others as required).
  • Prepare Form 990-T for unrelated business income and related state charitable registrations and annual reports.
  • Review public support tests, functional expense allocations and governance disclosures for accuracy and consistency with the audit or financial statements.


General
  • Organize client source documents, reconcile trial balances and prepare clear, review-ready workpapers.
  • Identify missing information, follow up with clients and respond to IRS and state notices.
  • Research technical issues and document conclusions for reviewers.
  • Meet filing deadlines and manage several engagements at once during peak season.


Required Qualifications
  • 3+ years preparing business income tax returns, with hands-on experience across all three entity types: S corporations (1120-S), partnerships (1065) and C corporations (1120).
  • 2+ years preparing Form 990-series returns for nonprofit organizations.
  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Active IRS Preparer Tax Identification Number (PTIN).
  • Working knowledge of professional tax software such as [CCH Axcess, UltraTax CS, Lacerte, GoSystem or ProSystem fx].
  • Strong Excel skills and comfort working from trial balances and financial statements.
  • Availability for extended hours during tax season (January–April and September–November).


Preferred Qualifications
  • CPA license or Enrolled Agent (EA) credential, or actively pursuing one.
  • Experience with multi-state filings, PTET elections and complex partnership allocations.
  • Exposure to private foundations (990-PF) and unrelated business income (990-T).
  • Public accounting firm experience.
  • Familiarity with document management and workflow tools such as [SurePrep, CCH Axcess Workflow or Karbon].


Skills and Competencies
  • Technical accuracy: catches inconsistencies between returns, financials and prior-year filings.
  • Organization: manages a full caseload and tracks open items without missing deadlines.
  • Communication: explains information requests and tax issues clearly to clients and reviewers.
  • Confidentiality: handles sensitive financial data with discretion and follows data security practices.
  • Continuous learning: keeps current on tax law changes and completes required CPE.
