jobs.title: Penetration Tester - India
jobs.excerpt: Location: India (Remote) Salary:2,000,000 - 2,500,000 INR/year (DOE) About Cognisys Cognisys is a global cybersecurity company specialising in Penetration Testing, GRC Consulting and Managed Security services.
jobs.description:
Location: India (Remote)

Salary:2,000,000 - 2,500,000 INR/year (DOE)

About Cognisys

Cognisys is a global cybersecurity company specialising in Penetration Testing, GRC Consulting and Managed Security services. We work with organisations across more than 30 countries, helping them identify risk, strengthen their security posture and navigate an increasingly complex cybersecurity landscape.

We're a small but mighty team with ambitious plans for growth. We combine deep technical expertise with a strong focus on customer service, practical advice and delivering meaningful outcomes for our clients.

Our people are at the heart of what we do. We value Together, Ownership, Momentum and Excellence, and we're looking for people who are curious, collaborative and willing to take ownership of their work.

As we continue to grow, you'll have the opportunity to work alongside experienced cybersecurity professionals, contribute to challenging client engagements and help shape how we deliver our services. We believe in giving our people the opportunity to develop, share ideas and make a genuine impact.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Penetration Tester to join our growing team and help clients identify and address security weaknesses across a range of technical environments.

You'll deliver security assessments across networks, applications, APIs, mobile platforms and cloud infrastructure, using a combination of automated tools and manual testing techniques to simulate real-world attack scenarios and identify meaningful vulnerabilities.

This is a client-facing role, so technical ability is only part of the picture. You'll also need to produce high-quality reports, explain findings clearly and help clients understand the potential impact of vulnerabilities and the practical steps they can take to improve their security.

You'll work closely with the wider cybersecurity team, contribute to the quality of our penetration testing services and continue developing your technical expertise as the threat landscape evolves.

About You

We're looking for someone with a strong technical foundation in offensive security who enjoys investigating how systems can be compromised and helping organisations improve their security.

You'll be curious, methodical and comfortable working through technical challenges. You'll also understand that good penetration testing involves more than finding vulnerabilities: it means validating the risks, explaining their significance and giving clients recommendations they can act on.

You should be comfortable taking responsibility for your work, managing competing priorities and working collaboratively with colleagues and clients.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Hands-on experience conducting penetration tests or security assessments.

  • Experience using vulnerability scanning tools alongside manual testing and exploitation techniques.

  • A solid understanding of offensive security methodologies, tools and techniques.

  • Practical experience assessing technical security controls, identifying weaknesses and validating vulnerabilities.

  • Experience in one or more of the following areas:

    • Network penetration testing

    • Web application testing

    • API testing

    • Mobile application testing

    • Cloud security testing

  • Strong analytical, investigative and problem-solving skills.

  • The ability to document technical findings accurately and produce clear, actionable reports.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical risks to non-technical audiences.

  • A professional approach to client engagement and customer service.

  • The ability to manage workload, prioritise tasks and deliver work to agreed deadlines.

  • A proactive approach to learning and keeping up to date with developments in offensive security.

Desirable Skills & Experience

  • Experience working in a cybersecurity consultancy or professional services environment.

  • Exposure to a broad range of technologies, infrastructure and client environments.

  • Experience presenting findings and remediation recommendations directly to clients.

  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud.

  • Experience testing APIs and mobile applications.

  • An interest in emerging attack techniques, security research and the continued development of penetration testing tools and methodologies.

Certifications

The following certifications are highly regarded:

Industry-recognised penetration testing certifications are highly regarded and may include:

  • OSCP

  • CPSA

  • CRT

  • CREST-related certifications

  • Other relevant offensive security or penetration testing certifications

Certifications are valued, but practical experience and the ability to demonstrate hands-on technical capability are equally important.

What Success Looks Like

  • Success in this role means delivering technically sound penetration tests while building client confidence through clear communication, reliable delivery and practical recommendations.

  • You'll know you're succeeding when you:

  • Deliver thorough, accurate and professional penetration testing engagements across a variety of client environments.

  • Confidently combine automated scanning with manual testing and exploitation to identify and validate meaningful vulnerabilities.

  • Demonstrate a practical understanding of how security controls can be tested, bypassed and exploited in realistic attack scenarios.

  • Produce clear, well-evidenced reports that explain vulnerabilities, their potential impact and actionable remediation steps.

  • Communicate findings effectively to technical teams and non-technical stakeholders, helping clients understand and prioritise risk.

  • Take ownership of your engagements, managing testing, documentation, deadlines and deliverables effectively.

  • Build positive client relationships and contribute to a professional, helpful client experience throughout each engagement.

  • Keep your technical knowledge current by learning about emerging vulnerabilities, tools, attack techniques and industry developments.

  • Share knowledge with colleagues and contribute to improving Cognisys' penetration testing methodologies and ways of working.

Why Join Us?

At Cognisys, you will be part of a collaborative and innovative team that values your input and shares support. You'll have the opportunity to work on challenging projects that make a real impact for our clients. We'd love to hear from you if you want to challenge, lead and innovate! We're not just about the work; we're about the people. Join a team where innovation is celebrated, and your contributions are valued. We foster a collaborative environment where fresh ideas thrive, and professional growth is encouraged.

What we Offer:

  • Annual Leave: 23 days per year plus 10 Indian public holidays (5 national plus 5 state holidays of your choosing).

  • Additional Leave: 1 day of paid leave for your Birthday.

  • Health & Wellbeing: Individual healthcare insurance plan and access to an employee mental health and wellbeing platform.

  • Professional Development: £2,000 annual training budget to support your continued learning and career growth.

  • Referral Bonus: help to grow our team and earn up to £2,000 per successful referral.

Applications

We’re always happy to help with questions, but to keep our process fair for everyone, we’re unable to accept applications via email—please apply directly through the job advert page.

Please feel free to reach out to Andrea, our Talent Acquisition Lead, if you would like any further information, to discuss accessibility requirements, or if you require this information provided in an alternative format –

We welcome applications from candidates from a range of diverse backgrounds and can make various reasonable adjustments to consider individual needs.

jobs.description:
Systems & Software, a division of Harris; is seeking a Senior Data and Business Intelligence Engineer who will join the S&S Data Platform & Analytics team.

We are a data-driven organization committed to leveraging information as a strategic asset to improve decision-making, operational efficiency, and business performance of our utility customers. Our Analytics team partners with stakeholders across the organization to develop scalable data solutions that deliver trusted insights and drive measurable customer value.

As we continue to invest in our modern data platform, we are seeking a Senior Data and Business Intelligence Engineer to play a key role in building and evolving our enterprise analytics ecosystem.

The successful candidate will report to the DBA and Analytics Manager.

This remote role welcomes candidates anywhere in Canada and the US. Travel is required as needed, approximately 1-2 times per year to Vermont/Customer Site/Some other destinations. Candidates must hold a current, valid passport and be legally eligible to travel internationally. This includes either passport based visa exemption or possession of any required travel visas for entry into Canada, the United States, and the Caribbean. Preference will be given to candidates who can work in EST timezone.

Salary:

80K - 110K

AI & Innovation Mindset

We are committed to leveraging emerging technologies to improve how we work, serve our customers, and drive business outcomes. The successful candidate will demonstrate curiosity and a willingness to actively adopt and leverage AI tools to improve workflows, solve problems, and increase efficiency. Candidates should be comfortable using AI enabled technologies, including copilots, chat based AI assistants, and automation tools, as part of their everyday work while maintaining appropriate judgment, security, and compliance standards.

What your impact will be:

  • Design, build, and support enterprise Data Lake solutions from the ground up.
  • Develop scalable ETL solutions and data pipelines.
  • Move and process terabytes of data efficiently.
  • Implement data quality, data governance, metadata, and lineage processes.
  • Develop anomaly detection, monitoring, and alerting capabilities.

What we are looking for:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, professional experience, and demonstrated technical expertise.
  • 5+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, Business Intelligence Engineering, or related discipline.
  • Proven experience designing and building enterprise Data Lakes, Lakehouses, or analytical data platforms.
  • Strong experience developing enterprise ETL/ELT solutions and scalable data pipelines.
  • Experience designing, implementing, and supporting modern Data Lakehouse and real-time analytics platforms using technologies such as Oracle Database, Debezium, Kafka, Kafka Connect, Apache Flink, Apache Iceberg, Nessie, StarRocks, Spark, Kyuubi, and Power BI. Experience building scalable, reliable data pipelines that support both batch and streaming data workloads is highly desirable.
  • Experience with Change Data Capture (CDC), event-driven architectures, real-time data processing, data cataloging, schema evolution, data versioning, and enterprise-scale ETL/ELT solutions.
  • Experience supporting large-scale data ingestion, transformation, reconciliation, backfill processes, and distributed analytics platforms, including troubleshooting and performance optimization of production data services.
  • Familiarity with observability, monitoring, and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices using technologies such as Prometheus, VictoriaMetrics, and Grafana.
  • Strong experience supporting production Linux environments (Oracle Linux, RHEL, CentOS, or equivalent), including system administration, systemd-managed services, performance tuning, automation, monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational support of distributed data and analytics platforms.
  • Advanced SQL development, data modeling, and performance tuning skills.
  • Experience with dimensional modeling, semantic-layer design, and analytical data structures.
  • Experience processing and managing large-scale data environments.
  • Hands-on experience implementing data quality, reconciliation, monitoring, and observability frameworks.
  • Experience with metadata management, data lineage, governance, and data cataloging practices.
  • Experience implementing monitoring, alerting, anomaly detection, and operational support processes for production data platforms.
  • Experience supporting enterprise reporting, self-service analytics, and business intelligence solutions that leverage curated datasets, semantic models, and high-performance analytical query engines.
  • Ensure enterprise data platforms and analytics solutions adhere to organizational requirements for the handling of sensitive information, including PII, customer data, confidential business information, and other regulated data types.
  • Demonstrated ability to provide technical leadership on complex data and analytics initiatives, mentor team members, conduct code and design reviews, and contribute to the development of engineering standards and best practices.

What would make you stand out:

  • Strong preference will be given to candidates with experience supporting modern Data Lakehouse architectures utilizing Oracle Database CDC, Debezium, Kafka, Flink, Apache Iceberg, Nessie, StarRocks, Spark, Prometheus, VictoriaMetrics, and cloud-native data platforms.
  • Experience supporting real-time analytics, event-driven architectures, data observability, and large-scale distributed systems is highly desirable.

What we can offer:

  • 3 weeks’ vacation and 5 personal days
  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits starting from your first day of employment
  • Employee stock ownership and RRSP/401k matching programs
  • Lifestyle rewards
  • Remote work and more!

About Systems & Software:

Systems & Software, a subsidiary of Harris Computer and part of Constellation Software, has been serving utilities and municipalities since 1973. Headquartered in Vermont, the company provides the enQuesta CIS platform to manage billing and utility operations for electric, water, gas, wastewater, solid waste, and property taxes. Our solutions enable utilities to manage complex rate structures, streamline operations, and enhance customer service, all without the need for custom code or disconnected systems. With cloud-based deployment, SOC 2 Type II certification, and interoperability with meter data systems, GIS, and financial tools, Systems & Software delivers stability, security, and flexibility that utilities can trust. Our commitment to ongoing investment ensures continuous innovation and a strong partnership with our customers across North America.

About Harris:

Harris is a leading provider of mission critical software to the public sector in North America. As a wholly owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc. (“CSI”, symbol CSU on the TSX), Harris has become the cornerstone for CSI’s investment in utility, local government, school districts, public safety, and healthcare software verticals. Our success has been realized through investments in our proprietary software and market expertise. This focus, combined with acquiring businesses that build upon or complement our offerings, has helped drive our success. Harris will continue to growth through reinvestment – both in the people and products that we offer and making investments in acquiring new businesses.

This remote position offers a schedule Monday through Friday.

​

jobs.description:
About Us!

At Sourcing Unicorns, we recruit globally across the creative and experiential industry, always on the lookout for exceptional talent to bring bold ideas to life. For this opportunity, we’re proud to collaborate with the team at Fivestone Studios to find the unicorn, the one who will truly make a difference. Together, we ensure a smooth and human-centered hiring experience that reflects the studio’s vision.

About Fivestone Studios!

Fivestone Studios is a Nashville-based creative media agency that an international clientele trust as their creative secret weapon. Our MO is taking on giants and making heroes of our clients through an impressive arsenal of strategy, design, digital media production & interactive technology capabilities.

Our primary goal at Fivestone Studios is to make a space for creative warriors to grow, thrive and take on their own giants. We use our Five Stones as our lens for success and our foundation for a healthy culture: honor, bravery, vision, generosity and excellence. If you have a passion for teamwork, are willing to leave your ego at the door, and have a strong drive for creative excellence, we would love to talk.

Your Mission

We are seeking a Lead Unreal Engine Developer to take technical ownership of the architecture, development, integration, and final delivery of a complex Unreal Engine application for an immersive, interactive experience.

In this role, you will bridge creative development, technical art, third-party software development, and physical AV systems integration.

You will be responsible for maintaining the Technical Design Document, defining the application's technical architecture, coordinating development tasks, and ensuring that all software components integrate into a stable, optimized, and deployable application.

We are looking for a hands-on technical leader who can balance creative ambition with practical implementation, proactively identify technical risks, collaborate with cross-disciplinary teams, and make informed technical decisions throughout production.

PS.: Candidates must be able to work and collaborate during US business hours (US time zones), regardless of their location.

Roles and Responsibilities

1. Technical Architecture & Documentation

  • Own, develop, and maintain the Technical Design Document (TDD).
  • Define application architecture, software dependencies, integration requirements, and technical workflows.
  • Establish development standards and best practices for C++, Blueprints, project organization, and source control.
  • Identify technical risks, performance constraints, and potential integration challenges early in development.
  • Document the final application architecture and deployment requirements for ongoing maintenance and support.

2. Unreal Engine Application Development & Delivery

  • Lead the development, integration, optimization, and delivery of the final Unreal Engine application.
  • Implement and maintain core application systems using C++ and Blueprints.
  • Integrate independently developed features, assets, and visual systems into a unified application.
  • Troubleshoot performance, rendering, compatibility, and application stability issues.
  • Manage application packaging, deployment configurations, and final production builds.
  • Support system testing, debugging, and final deployment.

3. Development Planning & JIRA Support

  • Collaborate with the Producer and development team to translate technical requirements into actionable JIRA tasks.
  • Define technical dependencies, implementation priorities, and acceptance criteria.
  • Provide technical estimates and identify potential development blockers.
  • Review completed work to ensure consistency with the overall application architecture.
  • Communicate technical progress, risks, and integration requirements to project stakeholders.

4. AV Hardware Consultation & Integration

  • Collaborate with AV integrators and hardware vendors to ensure the Unreal application operates correctly within the specified hardware environment.
  • Consult on GPU/CPU requirements, rendering performance, display configurations, and system architecture.
  • Support integration with external hardware, display systems, and control interfaces.
  • Identify and resolve hardware/software compatibility and performance challenges.
  • Participate in system testing, commissioning, and deployment as needed.

5. Web Overlay & UI Integration

  • Coordinate with a third-party web development vendor responsible for creating web-based UI overlays.
  • Define and support communication interfaces between Unreal Engine and web-based UI components.
  • Integrate web overlays into the Unreal application, ensuring reliable communication, rendering, and interaction.
  • Troubleshoot integration issues and collaborate with the vendor on performance and compatibility.

6. Technical Art & Real-Time Visual Integration

  • Collaborate with Unreal Technical Artists to integrate real-time graphics, shaders, materials, effects, and visual systems.
  • Establish performance budgets and technical guidelines for externally developed visual content.
  • Evaluate and optimize visual assets to meet target frame rates and hardware requirements.
  • Troubleshoot rendering, shader, material, and Blueprint integration issues.
  • Ensure independently developed visual systems function cohesively within the final application.

Requirements

Your Journey Includes

Must Have Experience

  • Unreal Engine: Advanced experience developing and delivering applications using Unreal Engine 5.
  • C++ Programming: Strong proficiency in Unreal C++ development, debugging, and application architecture.
  • Blueprints: Advanced knowledge of Blueprint systems and best practices for combining Blueprints with C++.
  • Graphics & Performance Optimization: Experience profiling and optimizing GPU/CPU performance, shaders, materials, and real-time rendering.
  • Application Architecture: Experience designing modular, maintainable software systems and integrating work from multiple developers.
  • Technical Leadership: Ability to take ownership of technical decisions, coordinate dependencies, and guide development efforts across multiple disciplines.
  • Source Control & Collaboration: Experience with Git, Perforce, or equivalent version control systems.
  • Production Delivery: Experience building, troubleshooting, packaging, and deploying production-ready Unreal Engine applications.

Nice to Have Experience

  • JavaScript / TypeScript: Familiarity with modern web development and communication between native applications and browser-based interfaces.
  • React: Experience integrating React-based interfaces or web overlays with Unreal Engine.
  • AI-Assisted Programming: Practical experience using AI coding assistants to improve development efficiency, debugging, and documentation.
  • Shader & Material Development: Experience building custom shaders, materials, and advanced rendering effects in Unreal Engine.
  • Immersive & Interactive Installations: Experience developing software for museums, exhibitions, themed entertainment, or location-based experiences.
  • AV & Show Control Systems: Experience with external control systems, hardware communication protocols, and real-time event-driven applications.
  • Deployment & Reliability: Experience with unattended installations, application monitoring, recovery workflows, and long-duration runtime stability.

Thank you for applying. We're committed to an inclusive process and we welcome talent from all walks of life. We aim to review every application. Roles in experiential can be ultra-specialized; if it's not a fit for this one, we may still flag your profile for future opportunities. jobs.description:
Marcus Evans is a global leader in business intelligence, helping our clients grow by making connections, sharing knowledge, inspiring people, building relationships and creating new opportunities. With over four decades of experience and teams of highly experienced professionals across 50+ office locations, we deliver impactful strategic insight and business development guidance across all sectors through high-level summits, conferences, online platforms, performance coaching, and curated corporate event programmes. Based in 30+ countries, we create services that connect decision-makers, spark innovation, and drive real business growth.

ME Perform is the performance improvement consultancy of the Marcus Evans Group. We work differently from most of the training market: we diagnose what is actually holding an organisation's people back, design a programme specifically for them, deliver it over months rather than days, and measure whether behaviour genuinely changed, then hand the client written evidence of what improved. Because the design work is done in-house by our Programme Scientists, our trainers get something rare: a fully built, properly researched session, briefed to them in advance, delivered to a cohort who have already been diagnosed and who are expecting to work rather than watch.

Job Summary

You will deliver live sessions, typically 90 to 150 minutes, mostly online, working from a session design and a written brief prepared for you by the Programme Scientist.

This is a delivery role, and deliberately so. You are not asked to write content, find clients, or sell anything. You are asked to be outstanding in the room. Based on the seniority and ability of the applicant there will also be an opportunity extend this role to a follow-up coach with the same group.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver live sessions to our designed structure, to a consistently high standard.

  • Prepare from the written brief you receive at least five working days before each session — preparation time is paid within the session fee.

  • Run structured practice: our sessions are built around participants doing the thing, not listening to it explained. Expect to spend much of each session facilitating small-group work, giving feedback, and coaching in the moment.

  • Manage the room — including the sceptical senior participant, the quiet group, and the one who wants to debate rather than practise.

  • Submit brief written session notes within 48 hours of every session, so the Programme Scientist can adjust what comes next.

  • Take part in accreditation before your first client session, and stay open to observation and feedback afterwards.

Qualifications

Essential

  • 5-10 years of substantial experience in facilitating live learning or development sessions for professional or managerial audiences in a corporate setting.

  • Genuinely strong online delivery — confident running breakout groups, keeping cameras on and energy up, and handling the mechanics without it disrupting the session.

  • Comfortable delivering material you did not write, to a structure you are asked to keep to. This is the single most important requirement of the role.

  • Skilled at running practice and giving direct, useful feedback to adults — rather than presenting.

  • Reliable on the administrative side: punctual, responsive, and consistent with session notes.

  • Fluent, credible professional English, and comfortable with senior audiences.

Desirable

  • Experience in one or more of: leadership and management development, communication and influence, collaboration, resilience and change, or working across cultures.

  • A coaching qualification, or experience delivering one-to-one as well as group work.

  • Additional languages, or experience delivering to international cohorts working in a second language.

  • Familiarity with evidence-based learning design — you do not need to be a researcher, but you should be interested in why a session is built the way it is.

How the engagement works

  • Paid accreditation first: a methodology induction, then you deliver a full session for our Programme Scientist to observe, paid at half the standard session fee. Accreditation is completed before any client-facing work.

  • You are then briefed and booked per session. Fees are paid per session with preparation included, invoiced on delivery, on 30-day terms.

  • Standard contract terms apply, including confidentiality, intellectual property assignment for anything created in connection with the work, and non-solicitation of our clients. These are shared in full before accreditation.

  • If a client cancels at short notice, you are protected: cancellations inside five working days are paid in full.

Marcus Evans is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

jobs.description:
Darktrace is a global leader in AI-driven cybersecurity, helping organizations stay ahead of evolving threats every day.

Darktrace was built on a genuinely differentiated idea: that Adaptive AI could detect and respond to novel, real-time cyber threats. That approach matters more than ever in the era of AI. Today, our customers depend on us to stay ahead.

At Darktrace, we are energized by that responsibility. We work across teams and rally around a shared goal. We make decisions with urgency, say the hard thing, and hold each other to high standards with care and directness. We move first and learn fast anticipating where our customers are going next, continuously challenging ourselves.

We invest in the skills, learning and opportunities that help people deliver at the level their roles demand, and reward the aptitude and curiosity to grow beyond them.

Our Values: Own It | Win as One | Raise Our Bar | Move First. Learn Fast


Job Description:


Regional Director, Customer Support – EMEA & APJRemote and flexible, with travel to our Cambridge office and across EMEA and APJ

About the Role This is an opportunity to shape customer support across EMEA and APJ, two diverse and fast-growing regions. You'll take over an established organization of Support Engineers and Managers. You'll strengthen its leadership, make operations more consistent, and give customers a predictable, high-quality experience.

You'll be responsible for regional Support outcomes: responsiveness, resolution, case quality, escalations and customer sentiment. You'll also help Support become an AI-native organization. This is a highly visible role with real influence. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, Sales, Renewals, Professional Services and global Support leadership.

You put customers first, make decisions with data, and bring structure and consistency to how teams work. You care about developing people, are excited by what AI makes possible, adapt across cultures, and are collaborative and accountable. You help teams through change, turning complex problems into clear, scalable improvements.

This is a remote role. You'll travel to our Cambridge office to work with the team, and across EMEA and APJ to meet customers as needed.

What will I be doing?

  • Shape regional operations: Set a regional strategy that fits the global Support vision. Make sure you have the right leaders, skills and capacity across time zones. Run a regular, data-informed review rhythm covering response and resolution times, backlog, aging, quality, escalations and sentiment, and share progress with executives.
  • Improve the customer experience: Make communication clearer and more predictable, reduce customer effort and handoffs, and take responsibility for escalations and long-running cases. Work directly with customers during major incidents. Share Support insights to inform customer health and retention planning.
  • Champion AI adoption: Find and scale responsible uses of AI in case management, knowledge, troubleshooting and quality. Focus on real workflow problems and measurable results that make work easier for your teams.
  • Develop knowledge and talent: Improve knowledge management, quality assurance, onboarding and ongoing learning. Support your leaders' growth, define career paths and promotion criteria, and strengthen succession planning.
  • Collaborate across teams to scale: Work with Product and Engineering on escalations, defects and root-cause analysis, and with Customer Success, Sales and Renewals on risk and retention. Build workforce plans, processes and playbooks that support growth.

What do I need?

  • Leading and developing leaders: You've supported and developed Managers and senior leaders across distributed teams in several countries, cultures and time zones. You've also built succession plans and helped leaders grow their capability.
  • Using data to improve customer outcomes and team proficiency: You've set meaningful metrics, spotted trends and turned insight into action. You've used quality, knowledge and case data to improve customer outcomes and help engineers become proficient faster.
  • A focus on operational improvement and performance: You've improved response and resolution times, case aging, backlog, quality, escalations and customer satisfaction. You've turned recurring pain points into clear, measurable and lasting process improvements.
  • Using AI for efficiency and process improvement: You've introduced AI, automation or intelligent workflows into Support or another customer-facing team, with measurable gains in productivity, efficiency and quality.
  • Building careers across the whole organization: You've created or evolved career frameworks, role definitions, competencies, promotion criteria, and technical and leadership career paths at every level.
  • Ideally 10+ years in enterprise technical support, customer success, service delivery or a related post-sales function
  • Experience looking after a large, complex region such as EMEA, APJ or similar
  • Experience running regular reviews, service reviews and executive updates
  • Hands-on knowledge management, quality assurance, onboarding and enablement experience
  • Clear, credible communication with executives, and a calm approach with senior customers during critical incidents
  • The ability to bring together stakeholders with different priorities and reporting lines
  • A background in enterprise software, SaaS, cybersecurity or cloud is a plus
  • Experience with CRM, case management, analytics and workforce management tools is a plus

Interested in shaping the future of customer support? If this role excites you but you don't meet every point above, we'd still love to hear from you. Experience comes in many forms.

Benefits:

  • 23 days’ holiday + all public holidays, rising to 25 days after 2 years of service,

  • Additional day off for your birthday,

  • Private medical insurance which covers you, your cohabiting partner and children,

  • Life insurance of 4 times your base salary,

  • Confidential Employee Assistance Program,

  • Cycle to work scheme.

As a growing business strengthening its governance and controls, this role plays a part in supporting high standards of integrity and accountability.

    Evaluate image quality from a senior production perspective. You can see when a render issue comes from lighting, material response, geometry, camera setup, render settings, or compositing. You will refine clearcoat, metallic flakes, glass, rubber, leather, stitching, displays, brushed metal, chrome, and shadow behavior until the image feels physically and visually right.

  • Work inside scalable production pipelines
    Create scenes and outputs that can survive large content sets. You will follow naming, versioning, render-layer, compositing, and scene-organization standards. You will help keep assets clean, reusable, and ready for configurators, campaign derivatives, market adaptations, and automated content workflows.

  • Improve quality while delivering content
    Implement feedback from art directors, leads, clients, and production teams without losing control of the setup. You will spot recurring issues, improve material libraries, refine lighting templates, document useful fixes, and help reduce manual rework across automotive production.

Requirements

You Have

  • Strong experience in automotive CGI and high-end 3D production. You are comfortable working with complex high-poly models, physically based materials, lighting setups, render passes, compositing workflows, and final image polish.

  • You know 3ds Max, V-Ray, Photoshop, and Nuke or After Effects at a professional level. Your portfolio or showreel demonstrates seniority through visual judgment, technical control, and finished output, not just clean modeling or isolated shots.

  • You can communicate clearly in English with artists, leads, producers, and technical teams. You can explain what is wrong in an image, what needs to change, and what tradeoff is being made.

Why Join INDG

INDG has spent more than 20 years building visual production systems for global brands. We are not a traditional creative agency and not a pure software vendor. We build the systems that turn physical products into digital twins, production-grade CGI, and scalable content.

Grip extends that work into AI-assisted content orchestration. For a Senior 3D Artist, that means your craft does not disappear into automation. It defines the quality standard the system must reproduce.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Head of Workforce Strategy & Intelligence

Job Location: Remote, United States of America

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Job Description Summary GE HealthCare is helping to build a world where healthcare has no limits. To get there, the way we work will be as important as what we make. This role is part of a larger transformation at GE HealthCare to redesign our end-to-end HR operating model. AI is changing how work gets done, and we need a leader who will design how our work, our organization and our workforce change with it, and who will guide our business and our people through that shift. Reporting to the Chief People Officer and serving on the Chief People Officer’s leadership team, you will build and lead a new team responsible for workforce strategy and planning, people analytics (workforce and talent intelligence), and the design of work and organizations. This is a newly created role and one of the most important hires for the future of our People & Culture function. Your team will own strategy, policy and program design. This includes setting the enterprise workforce strategy, building people analytics capabilities that drive insight across the organization, and creating the methods and frameworks for successful work redesign and organization design. Business and functional leaders own business outcomes. You bring the workforce and organization strategy, intelligence and design that help them deliver. You will work with business-aligned teams to apply the enterprise strategy to their unique businesses and put that work into practice, making sure they have the tools, guidance and skills to bring it to life. Job Description Key areas of scope Workforce strategy and planning. The enterprise workforce strategy and plan; demand and supply of skills and capacity; planning for people and AI capacity together; the mix of employees, contractors and outside partners; location and footprint; workforce cost and value. People analytics (workforce and talent intelligence). Workforce and talent analytics; external talent market insight; predictive signals; scenario models; and tools that help leaders make workforce decisions. Work redesign and organization design. Organization and operating model design; role architecture; spans and layers; work simplification and productivity; and the redesign of work done by people and AI together. Your first-year priorities Workforce data foundation. Define the workforce data and infrastructure requirements needed to inform workforce strategy and planning over the next 12 to 24 months. Enterprise workforce plan. Build the enterprise workforce strategy and plan for 2028 to 2029. Playbook for the business. Create the playbook business teams use to apply the workforce plan to their own areas of the business. People analytics and AI insight. Provide strategic direction as we build our digital infrastructure and AI-enabled insight into workforce capabilities, partnering with P&C technology, which builds and runs these tools. Work redesign at scale. Build on our proven work redesign pilots, expand the capability across the company, and create the tools and frameworks to transform work at scale. Work redesign is the single biggest area of future value for People & Culture. Key responsibilities Work redesign and organization design Make work redesign a core company capability, building on our existing pilots and growing it across businesses and functions. Lead work redesign with a clear method: start with the outcome, understand how work really happens, design the future flow of work, then decide which tasks and decisions sit with people and which sit with technology. Build the tools and frameworks to redesign work at scale, including a common list of tasks and roles, a library of proven ways for people and AI to work together, a standard for redesigned roles, and a method to measure the workforce impact of each redesign. Set principles for organization and operating model design, role architecture, and spans and layers that adapt as AI changes how teams are structured. Define clear roles and accountabilities across people and technology, including decision rights, where human judgment is required, quality standards and escalation paths, so teams can move quickly and people remain accountable for results. Partner with technology teams on the governance of AI agents, adding a regular review of how they affect roles and the workforce. Workforce strategy and planning Turn business priorities into clear workforce goals, and own the enterprise workforce strategy and plan. Plan for human and AI capacity together, modeling demand and supply of skills under different scenarios. Set clear guidance on when to build, buy, borrow or automate: when to develop people, hire, use contractors or partners, or use AI and automation. Protect the expertise the company needs, and strengthen pathways for early-career colleagues to build judgment as routine work changes. Give leaders scenarios on location and footprint, and on workforce choices when we acquire businesses. Build a clear view of workforce economics, including the full cost of the workforce, how capacity freed by automation is used, and whether expected value is actually realized. People analytics (workforce and talent intelligence) Lead people analytics, bringing together trusted people, skills, workload and performance data with business plans, colleague listening, and external talent market and competitor insight. Define the data, measures and calculation rules that P&C technology needs to build workforce data and AI tools, and set how that data is governed, with strong privacy, security and responsible use. Turn complex evidence into clear, decision-ready recommendations for the Chief People Officer, executives and business teams. Explain choices and uncertainty plainly, without overstating precision. Move from looking back to looking ahead: build predictive signals that tell leaders when to act, and scenario models that show the trade-offs of each choice. Influence and capability building Build the capability of business-aligned teams to apply workforce strategy, planning and work redesign, through playbooks, tools, coaching and training. Make clear who decides what on workforce and organization changes, and how decisions with effects beyond one business are escalated. Partner closely with the Talent, Capability & Change team, Total Rewards, P&C technology, Finance and business unit leaders. Be a trusted advisor to the Chief People Officer and senior leaders on how AI will change work and the workforce, and what to do about it. How success will be measured We will track early signals, such as readiness, decision speed and how quickly capacity moves to higher-value work, and connect them to lasting results that matter to the business, including: Capability readiness. The workforce capabilities we need for our highest-priority work are in place before gaps slow us down. Workforce value. Work, roles, structure and automation are designed so capacity shifts toward the highest-value work. Faster, better decisions. Trusted workforce data and clear trade-offs lead to faster, better people and organization decisions. Basic qualifications Bachelor’s degree. 12+ years of progressive leadership experience in workforce strategy, workforce planning, organization design, people analytics or HR strategy, in a company or as a consultant. Proven experience leading enterprise-wide workforce planning or work redesign in a large, global organization. Experience using data and analytics to shape senior leaders’ decisions about the workforce and the organization. A track record of building new teams and capabilities, and of leading through influence with senior executives. Preferred qualifications HR leadership experience in a large, global company. Strategy consulting experience will also be considered. Hands-on experience redesigning work and roles for AI and automation, at scale. Experience building a people analytics or workforce intelligence function, including predictive models and scenario planning. Experience with workforce economics and close partnership with Finance. Master’s degree or MBA. What will make you successful You design for the future, not the past. You can picture how work should look and build the path to get there. You are a builder. You are comfortable starting with a blank page and creating a team, methods and tools. You make complex ideas simple, without hiding how much work it takes to put them in place. You lead through influence. You get results through teams and leaders you do not manage. You balance people and business needs. When trade-offs are needed, you keep business results first. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening. For U.S. based positions only, the pay range for this position is $268,000.00-$402,000.00 Annual. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the pay range and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. The specific compensation offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors including skills, qualifications, experience and location. In addition, this position may also be eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). GE HealthCare offers a competitive benefits package, including not but limited to medical, dental, vision, paid time off, a 401(k) plan with employee and company contribution opportunities, life, disability, and accident insurance, and tuition reimbursement. Additional Information GE HealthCare offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive compensation. GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. GE HealthCare will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable). While GE HealthCare does not currently require U.S. employees to be vaccinated against COVID-19, some GE HealthCare customers have vaccination mandates that may apply to certain GE HealthCare employees. We’re partnering with our customers to fulfill healthcare’s greatest potential through groundbreaking medical technology, intelligent devices, and care solutions. Better tools enabling better patient care. Together, we are not only building a healthier future but living our purpose to create a world where healthcare has no limits.

Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

What is a Senior Staff Partnerships Lead at Mozilla?

Senior Staff is a senior individual contributor level at Mozilla. People at this level are recognized leaders in their field. They take on complex, ambiguous work that spans several disciplines and organizations with little supervision, lead strategic external relationships, and are comfortable working with executives inside and outside Mozilla.

About this team and role:

Mozilla’s New Products organization is an internal incubator for high-potential ventures. We’re building a new Firefox product for PC gamers, and partnerships across the games industry are central to how it reaches players and grows.

As the partnerships lead, you’ll be responsible for identifying, initiating, and closing the gaming partnerships that bring the product to more players. You will report to the Director of Product and build new gaming partnerships that advance the product roadmap.

What you’ll do:

  • Own the product’s partnerships strategy and pipeline across cloud gaming services, storefronts and launchers, publishers and studios, community platforms, and hardware makers.

  • Identify and propose new product features in support of partnerships, and evangelize new product features with partners.
  • Lead each deal across Mozilla: shape terms with Legal and Finance, scope partner integrations with product and engineering, and hold every partnership to Mozilla’s standards for privacy, trust and responsible design.
  • Represent Mozilla with senior leaders across the games industry, and bring what you learn from partners and the market back into product strategy.

What you’ll bring:

  • 10+ years in business development, product marketing, or strategic partnerships, including 5+ years in the games industry.
  • A track record of originating and closing multi-party commercial partnerships from first conversation to signed agreement, including revenue-share and co-marketing deals.
  • Established relationships with decision-makers across the PC gaming ecosystem, and the standing to get meetings with senior leaders at platform holders and publishers.
  • Strong commercial judgment: you can model deal economics, structure terms that work for both sides, and negotiate with senior counterparts.

  • Commitment to our values:
    • Welcoming differences
    • Being relationship-minded
    • Practicing responsible participation
    • Having grit

Bonus points for: partnerships experience at a browser, operating system or consumer software company; distribution deals such as device pre-installs or app store placements; and a passion for PC gaming and its communities.

Omada Health is on a mission to bend the curve of chronic disease.

Job overview:

As a member of Omada’s Consultant Relations Commercial Channel Growth team and Omada’s GLP-1 Business Unit, the Consultant Relations Business Development Representative, PBM & Pharmacy (CR BDR – PBM) is a quota-carrying, consultant-facing sales support role focused on expanding Omada’s footprint with pharmacy benefit manager (PBM) and pharmacy specialty consultants. Your goal is to ensure PBM consultants know Omada, understand our GLP-1 and cardiometabolic solutions, and bring Omada further into the pharmacy and benefit conversations they lead with employers. You will convert those relationships into qualified commercial employer pipeline for our Employer Sales team and help influence consultant advocacy, in collaboration with the CR AEs, on active deals to increase Omada’s win rate.

The successful candidate is a driven, competitive, and consultative seller who understands how PBMs and PBM consultants work, is fluent in the GLP-1 and prescribing landscape, and is energized by opening doors with a specialized consultant audience. This role offers a defined career path to advancement within Omada’s growing commercial sales organization.

  • 5–7+ years of experience in PBM, pharmacy benefits consulting, employee-benefits sales, consultant relations, or healthcare/digital-health business development, with direct experience engaging PBM or pharmacy consultants serving commercial employers

  • Supporting responsibilities: Maintain accurate Salesforce activity, contact, and opportunity attribution; build PBM practice relationship maps; contribute to CR reporting; help keep PBM- and GLP-1-related consultant resources and RFI/RFP content current; share PBM market and competitive insights; and support CR projects as needed

jobs.description:
eCarsTrade is a digital car marketplace serving professional buyers in more than 40 countries.
Through our online auction platform, we offer over 20,000 vehicles per week, sourced from leading fleet owners, leasing and rental companies, as well as banks and dealerships.
Over the last 3 years we have delivered 40% YoY profitable growth, building a leading market position in Europe.
Our platform keeps growing in scale and complexity. We want each part of the product to have one engineer who owns it end to end, from the business problem to the change in production and the effect on our users.

The Role
As a Product Engineer at eCarsTrade, you will own a part of our product end to end. You will learn the business process behind it and work directly with business stakeholders. Together you will decide what matters most. Then you will build it, ship it, and check whether it worked.
This is a hands-on role with high autonomy. Your working day might look like this: review the metrics and user feedback, talk to a stakeholder, decide what to do next, write and verify the code with AI coding agents, and release it to production (to everyone, to a share of users, or to a test group). The next day, you look at the results and do it again.
We are looking for a senior engineer who still writes code and also understands business. You should be comfortable making decisions and taking responsibility for the outcome.

Responsibilities

  • Own a product area end to end: understand the business process, the users, and the metrics that define success.
  • Work directly with business stakeholders (sales, operations, remarketing, customer support) to find problems, agree on priorities, and decide what to build next.
  • Design, implement, and maintain features across the backend, frontend, and infrastructure layers.
  • Use AI coding agents professionally to write, review, test, and refactor code, keeping quality, security, and maintainability high.
  • Ship changes to production in small, frequent increments using feature flags, gradual rollouts, and test groups.
  • Measure the impact of every change on users and business metrics, and use the data to decide whether to iterate, scale up, or roll back.
  • Monitor user feedback, production behaviour, and errors in your area, and act on what you find.
  • Make pragmatic technical decisions that balance speed, reliability, and long-term maintainability.
  • Help raise the engineering and product culture across the team by sharing practices around AI-assisted development, experimentation, and ownership.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of hands-on software development experience, with strong PHP skills.
  • Strong system design skills: experience designing applications and services from scratch, including architecture, data models, integrations, and trade-offs around scalability, reliability, and cost.
  • Solid experience with relational databases (MySQL or similar): schema design, query optimization, and working with large datasets.
  • Practical knowledge of infrastructure: Docker, CI/CD, queues, monitoring, and deploying and running production systems.
  • Experience in a company with a strong engineering culture, and a track record of growing into a technical leadership role (Team Lead, Head of Development, CTO or similar).
  • Proven ability to work directly with business stakeholders, translate business problems into technical solutions, and make product decisions together with them.
  • A good understanding of product and business metrics (conversion, retention, revenue and similar) and experience using data to make decisions.
  • Hands-on, professional experience using AI coding agents (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or similar) in day-to-day development, including how to verify and take responsibility for AI-generated code.
  • Broad technical knowledge and the judgement to choose the right tool for the problem.
  • A high level of autonomy and ownership: you drive work to results without needing detailed instructions.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Proficiency in both English and Russian is mandatory.
Nice to have:
  • Experience with marketplaces, auctions, B2B platforms, or the automotive industry.
  • Experience with A/B testing, feature flagging, and product analytics tools.

Benefits

  • Full remote position under a B2B contract
  • Real ownership of a product area and direct impact on business results
  • Multicultural, dynamic international team
  • Competitive salary

  • Fast-growing company with startup spirit and growth opportunities
  • Chance to shape the future of digital automotive trading

Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Department Overview

The Offer Strategy and Pricing team serves as the commercial architecture hub for the Command Center Software organization, bridging Product Management, Finance, Sales, and Go-To-Market execution. By translating technical product roadmaps into clear, value-based packaging, pricing, and margin governance frameworks, the department simplifies sales quoting, accelerates customer adoption, and drives sustainable recurring revenue growth.


Job Description

The Offer and Pricing Strategist serves as the commercial architect and domain expert for an assigned product portfolio within the Command Center Software organization. Operating as a senior individual contributor, this role works at the intersection of Product Management, Sales, Finance, and Go-To-Market execution to define how capabilities are packaged, structured, priced, and commercialized.


The ideal candidate brings deep portfolio-specific domain expertise, exceptional financial and analytical acumen, and a proven track record of architecting value-based monetization frameworks. You will own the end-to-end commercial strategy for your portfolio—ensuring that product roadmaps translate into clear, scalable, high-margin commercial offerings that drive customer adoption and sustainable recurring revenue.


Responsibilities


1. Offer Strategy & Commercial Packaging

  • Own the overarching commercial Go-To-Market (GTM) and packaging strategy for the assigned portfolio, aligning offer structures with strategic business priorities (e.g., market share acquisition, SaaS transition, ARR expansion, margin optimization).
  • Design offers structures (including tiering models, add-on frameworks, discounting bundles, and upsell paths) with clear value propositions and differentiation to effectively segment the market

2. Pricing Architecture & Margin Governance

  • Architect value-based pricing structures and determine optimal pricing metrics (e.g., per user, per device, usage-based, or outcome-based models) scaled appropriately to customer value.
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Finance to conduct unit economics analysis, evaluate cost drivers, and maintain targeted gross margin percentages.
  • Formulate list pricing, standard discounting guardrails, and deal desk policies to prevent revenue leakage while preserving field competitiveness.
  • Conduct structured competitive monetization intelligence to evaluate market pricing models, competitor tiering, and list prices, feeding insights into future offer revisions.

3. Product Roadmap Alignment & Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Act as the embedded commercial offer expert alongside Product Management leadership, translating technical product roadmaps into monetizable commercial capabilities.
  • Author comprehensive Offer Guides to document offer structures, pricing mechanics, and quoting business logic for downstream implementation.
  • Collaborate with Product Orderability team to realize the intended ordering experience for sellers
  • Secure executive leadership approvals across Product and Sales for new offer introductions and major portfolio revisions.

4. Field Enablement & Go-To-Market Execution

  • Serve as the single commercial point of contact for field sales, sales enablement, and marketing teams regarding portfolio offer mechanics.
  • Support high-impact commercial enablement collateral, including offer guides, cross-sell/upsell matrices, sales training, and quoting guidance.
  • Partner with Launch Management to ensure offer and go to market strategy translates into requirements for launch readiness.

5. Lifecycle Maintenance & Performance Tracking

  • Monitor post-launch quoting for effectiveness, ensuring proper adoption by presales and sales teams.
  • Monitor discount rates and ASP trends for consideration in annual pricing adjustments.
  • Establish continuous feedback loops with field sales, presales, and customer success teams to identify pricing friction or shifting customer preferences.
  • Continuously evaluate existing portfolio offers to execute necessary lifecycle updates, roadmap adaptations, or price adjustments.

Role Description

As a Financial Reporting & Technical Accounting Sr. Analyst on the Finance team, you will play a key role in supporting quarterly and annual external reporting, SEC filing coordination, and the broader close process. You will independently manage recurring reporting workstreams, help keep critical timelines on track, and contribute to accurate, thoughtful, and audit-ready external reporting.

This role sits at the intersection of financial reporting and technical accounting. In addition to coordinating core reporting deliverables, you will partner across Accounting, Legal, FP&A, Equity Ops, Tax, Investor Relations, senior Finance leadership, and external auditors to support disclosure processes, governance materials, and reporting requirements tied to complex accounting matters.

This is a strong opportunity for someone who enjoys bringing structure to complex processes, thrives in fast-paced environments, and wants to deepen their experience in both SEC reporting and technical accounting. You will gain exposure to new accounting standard adoption, disclosure analysis, and transaction-related workstreams, including M&A and other strategic projects.

Responsibilities

  • Independently manage recurring financial reporting and close workstreams, including journal entry preparation, reconciliations, and financial analysis, with a high degree of ownership and accountability.
  • Support quarterly and annual SEC reporting activities, including preparation and coordination for Forms 10-Q and 10-K.
  • Coordinate timelines, stakeholder feedback, and sign-offs across Accounting, Legal, FP&A, Equity Ops, Tax, Investor Relations, senior Finance leadership, and external auditors.
  • Prepare and maintain reporting support, disclosure checklists, sign-off packages, and audit-ready documentation.
  • Support materials for Disclosure Committee, Audit Committee, earnings-related deliverables, and other reporting governance processes.
  • Partner on technical accounting matters that have disclosure or external reporting implications, including adoption of new accounting standards such as ASU 2024-03, Disaggregation of Income Statement Expenses(“DISE”).
  • Contribute to technical accounting and special projects, including M&A, strategic transactions, and other non-routine accounting matters.

Requirements

  • 4-6 years of relevant experience in financial reporting, technical accounting, audit, or corporate accounting.
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP and financial statement reporting.
  • Experience supporting SEC reporting processes, including 10-Q and 10-K preparation and review.
  • Experience working in reporting at a publicly traded company.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines and stakeholders.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional partners.
  • High attention to detail, sound judgment, and a strong sense of ownership.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance.
  • CPA preferred.
  • Experience with technical accounting topics, including new accounting standard adoption, complex accounting issues, and disclosure analysis.
  • Experience preparing or supporting technical accounting memoranda, reporting support, or external reporting disclosures.
  • Experience supporting M&A, strategic transactions, or other special accounting projects.

Durable Skills

The opportunity

At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.

We are proud of:

  • The work we do and the innovation we drive
  • Our values of share, care and dare
  • Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

The Role

Valtech is looking for a Contentstack Solution Architect to design and deliver scalable, composable digital experience solutions for our clients.

In this role, you will lead the technical architecture of content platforms built on Contentstack. You will work closely with client stakeholders, product teams, experience designers, developers, and integration specialists to translate business and content requirements into secure, maintainable, and high-performing solutions.

The ideal candidate combines deep hands-on knowledge of Contentstack with broader expertise in headless CMS architecture, APIs, cloud platforms, integrations, and modern web development. You should be comfortable guiding both technical and non-technical stakeholders through architectural decisions and delivery trade-offs.

Role Responsibilites

  • Lead the architecture and technical design of enterprise solutions using Contentstack.

  • Mentor developers and contribute to reusable accelerators, standards, and best practices.

  • Experience designing headless CMS and composable digital experience architectures.
  • Strong knowledge of REST APIs, GraphQL, JSON, authentication, authorization, and integration patterns.
  • Experience with modern web technologies and frameworks such as JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, or Node.js.
  • Strong .Net experience and knowledge
  • Experience integrating CMS platforms with systems such as commerce, DAM, PIM, CRM, CDP, search, analytics, translation, or personalization platforms.

  • Strong documentation, presentation, stakeholder-management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience working in consulting, agency, or client-facing delivery environments.

PreferredRequirements

  • Experience with search and personalization platforms such as Algolia, Coveo, Constructor, Dynamic Yield, or Optimizely.

  • Experience contributing to solution proposals, statements of work, estimates, or pre-sales presentations.
  • Experience leading distributed engineering teams across multiple regions.

jobs.description:
Conetic is an innovative global company dedicated to transforming the flying experience by making the passenger journey engaging and truly memorable.

We specialize in comprehensive media services, with a focus on creating more personalized and engaging experiences for travelers at every step of the journey.

By uniting Touch Inflight Solutions and ABOVE, Conetic brings together a leading IFE content service provider and a robust cloud-based media distribution platform. This combination of curated content, data-driven personalization, and an automated cloud media supply chain enables airlines to deliver fresh, personalized content to passengers faster and more efficiently through a seamless, end-to-end solution.

About the role:

  • We are hiring a Senior Full-stack .NET Engineer to take over and develop the Touch Media Center (TMC), the platform Touch runs its inflight entertainment content business on: content library, selection for each airline's programme cycle, processing and delivery, with portals for airlines and content vendors.

  • TMC is a live product, built over several years with an external development partner. In 2027 Touch brings it in-house, and you will be the first engineer of the new internal team. You will join while the partner's team is still developing the platform, work alongside them, learn it from the inside and take over support step by step.

  • You will work with a product manager and Touch's Head of Architecture, in a team that grows as the takeover progresses.

About the responsibilities:

  • Take over a live platform. Learn TMC from the team that built it, challenge what is undocumented, and make sure the knowledge ends up in the code base and its documentation, not in people's heads.

  • Support and run production. Investigate and fix issues across the stack, from the Blazor front end through the APIs to SQL Server and the Azure environments, without disrupting the teams and airlines that depend on TMC every day.

  • Build across the stack. Deliver roadmap features end to end in the modern part of the platform: .NET 9 back-end modules and the Blazor WebAssembly back office.

  • Integrate with other systems. Connect TMC to Touch's Voyager platform, partner APIs and business systems such as NetSuite, and maintain the existing content provider integrations.

  • Modernise in small steps. TMC runs two generations side by side, a legacy .NET 6 stack and a modular .NET 9 stack. Move functionality to the new stack incrementally and retire what is no longer needed.

  • Raise the quality bar. Bring the automated tests into the delivery pipeline, strengthen CI/CD on GitHub Actions, and improve monitoring and release safety.

  • Work AI-first, and own the result. Use AI-backed tools every day, such as Claude Code. The repository is already set up for it. Write clear specifications, review generated code critically, and decide what is good enough to ship.

  • Shape how the team works. Set standards, review code and help onboard the engineers who join after you.

About you:

  • Solid full-stack .NET experience, with production applications you built and supported yourself.

  • Strong C# and ASP.NET Core on current .NET versions (8 or 9), including REST API design.

  • Blazor experience, or strong Razor and component-based front-end experience with the willingness to go deep on Blazor WebAssembly.

  • SQL Server and Entity Framework Core, including migrations, query performance and working with large data sets.

  • Azure in practice: App Service, storage, and deployments through GitHub Actions or a comparable CI/CD setup.

  • Experience taking over or evolving existing code, with a record of changing legacy systems safely and incrementally.

  • Messaging and background processing, for example with Wolverine, MassTransit, RabbitMQ or Hangfire.

  • Test automation with xUnit or similar, and the habit of writing tests before trusting a change.

  • AI-assisted development. You already use AI-backed tools such as Claude Code, and can show how you keep their output reliable and reviewable.

jobs.description:
Bioinformatics Analyst – NGS & Oncology Diagnostics (Remote, US)

We are looking to hire a candidate with the mentioned skill sets and experience for one of our clients within the diagnostics company. This is contracting and REMOTE role.

Job Summary

We are seeking a Bioinformatics Analyst to support NGS-based oncology diagnostic programs. This is a hands-on, individual contributor role focused on NGS data analysis, statistical evaluations, assay performance assessment, pipeline regression and equivalency testing, and NGS quality control.

The ideal candidate will work closely with Bioinformatics Leads, scientists, laboratory staff, and algorithm development teams to ensure bioinformatics pipelines and assays perform as validated. Deep wet-lab expertise is not required.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform hands-on analysis of DNA and RNA NGS data, including targeted panels, whole-genome sequencing (WGS), liquid biopsy, and gene expression.
  • Conduct statistical evaluations to assess assay performance, sensitivity, specificity, concordance, and limit of detection (LoD).
  • Execute pipeline regression and equivalency testing following software version, infrastructure, and sequencing platform changes.
  • Review NGS quality control metrics at the run, sample, and variant levels.
  • Identify QC failures and recommend new quality control checks with defined thresholds and scientific rationale.
  • Submit, monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize computational jobs in HPC environments using Slurm.
  • Support bioinformatics algorithm development and validation activities.
  • Execute validation plans against predefined acceptance criteria.
  • Develop reproducible analysis packages using version-controlled code, Jupyter notebooks, visualizations, and technical documentation.
  • Collaborate with scientists and laboratory teams to prepare analysis summaries supporting regulatory validation packages.

Required Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Biostatistics, or a related field (Ph.D. preferred), or a Bachelor's degree with equivalent experience.
  • 4+ years of hands-on NGS data analysis experience, preferably within oncology, clinical diagnostics, or regulated environments.
  • Strong hands-on experience with HPC environments and Slurm, including job submission, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
  • Proficiency in Python and/or R, Linux, and Git.
  • Experience analyzing DNA and RNA sequencing data, including targeted panels, WGS, liquid biopsy, and gene expression.
  • Strong statistical analysis experience, including:
    • Sensitivity, specificity, and concordance
    • Limit of detection (LoD) and confidence intervals
    • Regression and equivalency analysis
    • Dimensionality reduction
  • Experience analyzing molecular biomarkers, including SNVs, CNVs, structural variants (SVs), fusions, and gene expression.
  • Hands-on experience with bioinformatics pipeline regression and equivalency testing.
  • Strong understanding of NGS QC metrics, including sequencing coverage, duplication rates, contamination, and error/noise profiles.
  • Familiarity with NGS wet-lab workflows, including library preparation, capture, and amplicon-based sequencing.
  • Experience executing validation plans and maintaining reproducible analysis documentation.
  • Excellent analytical, documentation, and cross-functional communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Cancer genomics experience, including hematologic malignancies and solid tumors.
  • Experience with liquid biopsy, circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA), or minimal residual disease (MRD).
  • Exposure to CAP, CLIA, or NYSDOH regulatory validation requirements.
  • Experience with Nextflow or Snakemake, container technologies, and AWS.
  • Familiarity with Illumina DRAGEN, GATK, Sentieon, or similar variant-calling tools.
  • Experience with UMI-based processing and consensus calling.
  • Knowledge of panel-of-normals and error modeling for low-frequency variant detection.
  • Experience supporting sequencing platform transitions, particularly NovaSeq X.
